```cs
    }

    private async void OnBrowseRbBackup(object? sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        var path = await _host.Ui.PickFolderAsync("选择备份目录");
        if (path != null) _rbBackupBox.Text = path;
    }

    private async void OnBrowseRbKey(object? sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        var path = await _host.Ui.OpenFileAsync("选择 RSA 私钥", "*.pem", "*.key", "*.*");
        if (path != null) _rbKeyBox.Text = path;
    }

    private async void OnRunRebuild(object? sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (_busy) return;
        var input = _rbInBox.Text?.Trim() ?? "";
        var output = _rbOutBox.Text?.Trim() ?? "";
        if (!Directory.Exists(input)) { Toast("请选择有效的输入目录"); return; }
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(output)) { Toast("请指定输出目录"); return; }

        var verifyOnly = _rbVerifyOnly.IsChecked == true;
        var useAosp = _rbKeyMode.SelectedIndex == 0;
        var key = _rbKeyBox.Text?.Trim() ?? "";
        if (!verifyOnly && !useAosp && !File.Exists(key)) { Toast("请选择有效的私钥"); return; }

        _busy = true;
        _rbBtn.IsEnabled = false;
        _rbStatus.Text = verifyOnly ? "校验中…" : (_rbMode.SelectedIndex == 1 ? "链式重建中…" : "重建中…");
        AppendLog(_rbLog, "开始 " + (verifyOnly ? "校验" : _rbMode.SelectedIndex == 1 ? "链式重建" : "非链式重建"));
        try
        {
            var options = new RebuildOptions
            {
                InputDir = input,
                OutputDir = output,
                BackupDir = _rbBackupBox.Text?.Trim() ?? "",
                ChainedMode = _rbMode.SelectedIndex == 1,
                RegenerateSalt = _rbRegenSalt.IsChecked == true,
                VerifyOnly = verifyOnly,
                Partitions = _rbPartitions.Text?.Trim() ?? "",
                UseAospKey = useAosp,
                KeyPem = useAosp ? null : key,
                Log = line => Dispatcher.UIThread.Post(() => AppendLog(_rbLog, line)),
            };
            var result = await Task.Run(() => AvbNative.RebuildAll(options));
            _rbStatus.Text = result.Message + $"（成功 {result.Rebuilt} / 失败 {result.Failed} / 跳过 {result.Skipped}）";
            AppendLog(_rbLog, result.Message);
            Toast(result.Ok ? result.Message : "重建失败：" + result.Message);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _rbStatus.Text = "失败：" + ex.Message;
            AppendLog(_rbLog, "异常：" + ex.Message);
        }
        finally
        {
            _busy = false;
            _rbBtn.IsEnabled = true;
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ 批处理

    private async void OnBrowseBatchDir(object? sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        var path = await _host.Ui.PickFolderAsync("选择 A/B 分区目录");
        if (path == null) return;
        _batchDirBox.Text = path;
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_batchOutDir.Text))
            _batchOutDir.Text = Path.Combine(path, "signed");
        ScanBatch();
    }

    private async void OnBrowseBatchOut(object? sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        var path = await _host.Ui.PickFolderAsync("选择输出目录");
        if (path != null) _batchOutDir.Text = path;
    }

    private async void OnBrowseBatchKey(object? sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        var path = await _host.Ui.OpenFileAsync("选择 RSA 私钥", "*.pem", "*.key", "*.*");
        if (path != null) _batchKeyBox.Text = path;
    }

    private void OnScanBatch(object? sender, RoutedEventArgs e) => ScanBatch();

    private async void ScanBatch()
    {
        var dir = _batchDirBox.Text?.Trim() ?? "";
        if (!Directory.Exists(dir)) { Toast("请选择目录"); return; }
        _busy = true;
        _batchBtn.IsEnabled = false;
        _batchStatus.Text = "扫描中…";
        try
        {
            var files = await Task.Run(() =>
            {
                try { return Directory.GetFiles(dir, "*.img", SearchOption.AllDirectories).Take(400).ToArray(); }
                catch { return Array.Empty<string>(); }
            });
            _batch.Clear();
            foreach (var f in files)
            {
                var info = AvbNative.Inspect(f);
                if (!info.Parsed || !info.IsFooter) continue;
                var name = Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(f);
                var side = name.EndsWith("_b", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ? "B"
                    : name.EndsWith("_a", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ? "A" : "—";
                _batch.Add(new BatchItem
                {
                    Path = f,
                    Partition = info.PartitionName,
                    Side = side,
                    Rollback = info.RollbackIndex.ToString(),
                    Algorithm = info.Algorithm,
                    Info = info,
                });
            }
            var max = _batch.Select(b => ulong.TryParse(b.Rollback, out var r) ? r : 0).DefaultIfEmpty(0UL).Max();
            _batchSummary.Text = $"{_batch.Count} 个分区 · 最高回滚值 {max}";
            _batchStatus.Text = "扫描完成";
        }
        finally
        {
            _busy = false;
            _batchBtn.IsEnabled = _batch.Count > 0;
        }
    }

    private async void OnRunBatch(object? sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (_busy || _batch.Count == 0) return;
        var outDir = _batchOutDir.Text?.Trim() ?? "";
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(outDir)) { Toast("请指定输出目录"); return; }
        Directory.CreateDirectory(outDir);

        var unify = _unifyRollback.IsChecked == true;
        var strip = _stripAb.IsChecked == true;
        var maxRollback = _batch.Select(b => ulong.TryParse(b.Rollback, out var r) ? r : 0).DefaultIfEmpty(0UL).Max();
        _busy = true;
        _batchBtn.IsEnabled = false;
        var ok = 0;
        var fail = 0;
        foreach (var item in _batch.ToList())
        {
            _batchStatus.Text = $"签名 {item.Name}…";
            var algorithm = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(item.Algorithm) ? "SHA256_RSA4096" : item.Algorithm;
            string? key;
            if (_batchUseAosp.IsChecked == true)
            {
                if (!AospKeys.Supports(algorithm)) { AppendLog(_batchLog, "跳过（AOSP 无此算法）：" + item.Name); fail++; continue; }
                key = AospKey(algorithm);
            }
            else key = File.Exists(_batchKeyBox.Text?.Trim() ?? "") ? _batchKeyBox.Text!.Trim() : null;
            if (key == null) { AppendLog(_batchLog, "缺少私钥，停止"); break; }

            var name = Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(item.Name);
            if (strip && name.Length > 2 && (name.EndsWith("_a") || name.EndsWith("_b"))) name = name[..^2];
            var output = Path.Combine(outDir, name + "_signed.img");
            var result = await Task.Run(() => AvbNative.SignImage(item.Path, output, new SignOptions
            {
                KeyPem = key,
                Algorithm = algorithm,
                PartitionName = item.Partition,
                RollbackIndex = unify ? maxRollback : (ulong.TryParse(item.Rollback, out var r) ? r : 0),
            }));
            if (result.Ok) { ok++; AppendLog(_batchLog, "✓ " + name + " → " + output); }
            else { fail++; AppendLog(_batchLog, "✗ " + name + "：" + result.Message); }
        }
        _batchStatus.Text = $"完成：{ok} 成功 / {fail} 失败";
        _busy = false;
        _batchBtn.IsEnabled = true;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ 扫描

    private async void OnBrowseScanDir(object? sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        var path = await _host.Ui.PickFolderAsync("选择扫描目录");
        if (path == null) return;
        _scanDirBox.Text = path;
        ScanImages();
    }

    private void OnScanImages(object? sender, RoutedEventArgs e) => ScanImages();

    private async void ScanImages()
    {
        var dir = _scanDirBox.Text?.Trim() ?? "";
        if (!Directory.Exists(dir)) { Toast("请选择目录"); return; }
        var pattern = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_scanFilter.Text) ? "*.img" : _scanFilter.Text.Trim();
        _scanStatus.Text = "扫描中…";
        _scan.Clear();
        try
        {
            var files = await Task.Run(() =>
            {
                try { return Directory.GetFiles(dir, pattern, SearchOption.AllDirectories).Take(500).ToArray(); }
                catch { return Array.Empty<string>(); }
            });
            foreach (var f in files)
            {
                var info = AvbNative.Inspect(f);
                if (!info.Parsed || info.Unsigned) continue;
                _scan.Add(new ScanItem
                {
                    Path = f,
                    Partition = info.PartitionName,
                    Kind = info.IsFooter ? (info.IsHashtree ? "Hashtree" : "Hash") : "VBMeta",
                    Algorithm = info.Algorithm,
                    Rollback = info.RollbackIndex.ToString(),
                    SizeText = FormatSize(info.FileSize),
                    Info = info,
                });
            }
            _scanTotal.Text = files.Length.ToString();
            _scanSigned.Text = _scan.Count.ToString();
            _scanPlain.Text = Math.Max(0, files.Length - _scan.Count).ToString();
            _scanStatus.Text = $"完成：{files.Length} 个文件中 {_scan.Count} 个带 AVB";
            _exportBtn.IsEnabled = _scan.Count > 0;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _scanStatus.Text = "扫描失败：" + ex.Message;
        }
    }

    private async void OnExportScan(object? sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (_scan.Count == 0) return;
        var path = await _host.Ui.SaveFileAsync("导出扫描报告", "avb_scan_report.txt", "*.txt");
        if (path == null) return;
        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.AppendLine("AVB 工作台扫描报告");
        sb.AppendLine("时间：" + DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"));
        sb.AppendLine("目录：" + _scanDirBox.Text);
        sb.AppendLine(new string('-', 78));
        sb.AppendLine("文件\t分区\t类型\t算法\t回滚值\t大小(字节)\t签名\t路径");
        foreach (var h in _scan)
            sb.AppendLine($"{h.Name}\t{h.Partition}\t{h.Kind}\t{h.Algorithm}\t{h.Rollback}\t{h.Info.FileSize}\t{h.Info.VerifyNote}\t{h.Path}");
        await File.WriteAllTextAsync(path, sb.ToString(), Encoding.UTF8);
        Toast("报告已导出");
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ 工具

    private static void SetAlgo(ComboBox box, string algorithm)
    {
        for (var i = 0; i < box.ItemCount; i++)
        {
            if (box.Items[i] is ComboBoxItem ci &&
                string.Equals(ci.Content?.ToString(), algorithm, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                box.SelectedIndex = i;
                return;
            }
        }
    }

    private static string FormatSize(long bytes)
    {
        if (bytes <= 0) return "—";
        var mb = bytes / 1024.0 / 1024.0;
        return mb >= 1024 ? $"{mb / 1024:0.00} GB" : $"{mb:0.0} MB";
    }
}
```

```cs
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Avalonia;
using Avalonia.Controls;
using Avalonia.Layout;
using Avalonia.Media;
using DashFile.PluginApi;

namespace HelloPlugin;

/// <summary>
/// 最小但完整的 DashFile 插件示例：
///  - 一个自定义页面；
///  - 文件右键动作；
///  - 应用右键动作；
///  - 插件页里的全局动作。
///
/// 真正的逆向 / AI 插件也是同一套入口，只是页面里放自己的 UI 和逻辑。
/// 想改成自己的插件：改 plugin.json 的 id / name / author，再替换 BuildPage 里的内容即可。
/// </summary>
public sealed class HelloPlugin : PluginBase
{
    public override PluginMetadata Metadata => new()
    {
        Id = "com.dashfile.hello",
        Name = "Hello 示例插件",
        Version = "1.0.0",
        Author = "your_name",
        Description = "如你所见，这只是一个实例插件，没什么用捏......",
    };

    protected override Task OnInitializeAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        Host.AddPage(PluginPage.FromControl(
            "main", "示例",
            host => BuildPage(host),
            null, "👋"));

        Host.AddAction(new PluginAction
        {
            Id = "file-size",
            Title = "Hello：查看文件大小",
            Description = "演示文件右键动作",
            Targets = new[] { PluginTargetKind.File },
            ExecuteAsync = async (target, ct) =>
            {
                var r = await Host.Device.ShellAsync(
                    "stat -c %s " + PluginShell.Quote(target.Path) + " 2>/dev/null", true, ct);
                var size = r.StdOut.Trim();
                await Host.Ui.ShowMessageAsync("文件大小",
                    $"{target.Path}\n\n{size} 字节", ct);
            },
        });

        Host.AddAction(new PluginAction
        {
            Id = "app-info",
            Title = "Hello：查看应用包名",
            Targets = new[] { PluginTargetKind.App },
            ExecuteAsync = async (target, ct) =>
                await Host.Ui.ShowMessageAsync("应用信息",
                    $"{target.DisplayName}\n\n包名：{target.Package}", ct),
        });

        Host.AddGlobalAction(new PluginAction
        {
            Id = "device-info",
            Title = "显示设备信息",
            ExecuteAsync = async (_, ct) =>
            {
                var d = Host.Device;
                await Host.Ui.ShowMessageAsync("设备信息",
                    $"已连接：{d.IsConnected}\nRoot：{d.IsRoot}\n" +
                    $"型号：{d.Model}\nAndroid：{d.AndroidVersion}\n" +
                    $"Root 实现：{d.RootManagerName}", ct);
            },
        });

        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    private static Control BuildPage(IPluginHost host)
    {
        var text = new TextBlock
        {
            Text = "如你所见，这只是一个实例插件，没什么用捏......",
            FontSize = 15,
            TextWrapping = TextWrapping.Wrap,
            TextAlignment = TextAlignment.Center,
            HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Center,
            VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center,
            Opacity = 0.75,
        };

        return new Border
        {
            Padding = new Thickness(24),
            Child = text,
        };
    }
}
```

`samples/ReverseToolboxPlugin/Plugin.cs`:

```cs
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.IO.Compression;
using System.Linq;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Avalonia;
using Avalonia.Controls;
using Avalonia.Layout;
using Avalonia.Media;
using DashFile.PluginApi;
using DashFile.Services.OpenWith;

namespace ReverseToolboxPlugin;

/// <summary>
/// 逆向工具箱：只读分析 APK（Manifest / 签名 / DEX / 字符串 / 哈希）。
/// 参考 MT 管理器 / NP 管理器 / apktool / jadx 的常用能力，但全部在本机解析，不执行 APK 代码。
/// </summary>
public sealed class ReverseToolboxPlugin : PluginBase
{
    private const string IconSearch = "M7,2.5 a4.5,4.5 0 1,0 0,9 a4.5,4.5 0 1,0 0,-9 M10.5,10.5 l3,3";
    private const string IconList   = "M3,4 h10 M3,8 h10 M3,12 h10";
    private const string IconShield = "M8,2 l5,2.2 v3.6 l-5,6 l-5,-6 v-3.6 z M5.8,7.8 l2,2 l3.4,-3.4";
    private const string IconCode   = "M6,4 L2,8 L6,12 M10,4 L14,8 L10,12";
    private const string IconHash   = "M6,2.5 L4.5,13.5 M11,2.5 L9.5,13.5 M3,6 h10 M2.5,10 h10";
    private const string IconOpen   = "M2,4.3 h4.2 l1.4,1.6 h6.2 v7.3 h-11.8 z";
    private const string IconFile   = "M4.5,2.5 h5 l2.5,2.5 v8.5 h-7.5 z M9.5,2.5 v3 h2.5";

    public override PluginMetadata Metadata => new()
    {
        Id = "com.dashfile.reversetool",
        Name = "逆向工具箱",
        Version = "1.0.0",
        Author = "DashFile",
        Description = "APK 逆向分析：Manifest 解码、签名证书、DEX 结构/字符串、资源字符串、哈希、组件与权限（只读，不执行 APK）。",
    };

    protected override Task OnInitializeAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        Host.AddPage(PluginPage.FromControl("toolbox", "逆向工具箱", BuildPage,
            "右键 APK / 应用，或用插件页分析本地安装包", "🧰"));

        Add("analyze", "逆向分析：查看这个 APK", IconSearch,
            t => ShowReportAsync(t, a => a.OverviewReport(), "逆向分析"));

        Add("components", "查看组件与权限…", IconList,
            t => ShowReportAsync(t, a => a.ComponentsReport(), "组件与权限"));

        Add("signature", "查看签名证书…", IconShield,
            t => ShowReportAsync(t, a => a.SignatureReport(), "签名信息"));

        Add("manifest", "导出解码后的 Manifest…", IconOpen,
            t => ExportTextAsync(t, "AndroidManifest", a => a.ManifestXml, ".xml"));

        Add("dex", "导出 DEX 文件…", IconCode,
            t => ExportDexAsync(t));

        Add("strings", "导出 DEX 字符串…", IconList,
            t => ExportTextAsync(t, "dex-strings", a => a.DexStringsForExport(), ".txt"));

        Add("resources", "导出资源字符串…", IconList,
            t => ExportTextAsync(t, "resources-strings", a => a.ResourceStringsText(), ".txt"));

        Add("hash", "计算哈希（MD5 / SHA1 / SHA256）…", IconHash,
            t => ShowHashAsync(t), anyFile: true);

        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    private void Add(string id, string title, string icon, Func<PluginTarget, Task> run, bool anyFile = false)
    {
        Host.AddAction(new PluginAction
        {
            Id = id,
            Title = title,
            Icon = icon,
            Targets = new[] { PluginTargetKind.App, PluginTargetKind.File },
            CanExecute = target =>
            {
                if (target.Kind == PluginTargetKind.App) return true;
                if (target.Kind != PluginTargetKind.File) return false;
                return anyFile || target.Path.EndsWith(".apk", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
            },
            ExecuteAsync = async (target, ct) =>
            {
                try { await run(target); }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    await Host.Ui.ShowMessageAsync("逆向工具箱", "操作失败：" + ex.Message, ct);
                }
            },
        });
    }

    // ---------------- 动作实现 ----------------

    private async Task ShowReportAsync(PluginTarget target, Func<ApkAnalysis, string> section, string title)
    {
        var local = await FetchApkAsync(target, CancellationToken.None);
        try
        {
            Host.Ui.Toast("正在分析 " + Path.GetFileName(local) + "…");
            var analysis = await Task.Run(() => ApkAnalysis.Build(local));
            var text = section(analysis);
            var fullTitle = title + " · " + target.DisplayName;
            await Host.Ui.RunOnUiThreadAsync(() =>
            {
                var win = new ReportWindow(fullTitle, text,
                    path => SaveTextAsync(path + ".txt", text));
                win.Show();
            });
        }
        finally
        {
            TryDelete(local);
        }
    }

    private async Task ShowHashAsync(PluginTarget target)
    {
        var local = await FetchApkAsync(target, CancellationToken.None, allowAnyFile: true);
        try
        {
            var (md5, sha1, sha256, size) = await Task.Run(() => ComputeHashes(local));
            var sb = new StringBuilder();
            sb.AppendLine("文件    " + Path.GetFileName(local));
            sb.AppendLine("大小    " + ApkAnalysis.SizeText(size));
            sb.AppendLine();
            sb.AppendLine("MD5     " + md5);
            sb.AppendLine("SHA-1   " + sha1);
            sb.AppendLine("SHA-256 " + sha256);
            var text = sb.ToString();
            await Host.Ui.RunOnUiThreadAsync(() =>
            {
                var win = new ReportWindow("哈希 · " + target.DisplayName, text,
                    path => SaveTextAsync(path + ".txt", text));
                win.Show();
            });
        }
        finally
        {
            TryDelete(local);
        }
    }

    private async Task ExportTextAsync(PluginTarget target, string baseName, Func<ApkAnalysis, string> section, string ext)
    {
        var local = await FetchApkAsync(target, CancellationToken.None);
        try
        {
            Host.Ui.Toast("正在分析…");
            var analysis = await Task.Run(() => ApkAnalysis.Build(local));
            var text = section(analysis);
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))
            {
                await Host.Ui.ShowMessageAsync("逆向工具箱", "没有可导出的内容（可能被加固/加密）。");
                return;
            }
            var name = Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(local);
            var save = await SaveTextAsync(name + "-" + baseName + ext, text);
            if (save) Host.Ui.Toast("已导出：" + name + "-" + baseName + ext);
        }
        finally
        {
            TryDelete(local);
        }
    }

    private async Task ExportDexAsync(PluginTarget target)
    {
        var local = await FetchApkAsync(target, CancellationToken.None);
        try
        {
            var dir = await Host.Ui.PickFolderAsync("选择保存 DEX 的文件夹");
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(dir)) return;
            var count = 0;
            using (var zip = ZipFile.OpenRead(local))
            {
                foreach (var e in zip.Entries)
                {
                    if (!e.Name.StartsWith("classes", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                        !e.Name.EndsWith(".dex", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) continue;
                    var dst = Path.Combine(dir!, e.Name);
                    e.ExtractToFile(dst, true);
                    count++;
                }
            }
            Host.Ui.Toast(count == 0 ? "没有找到 classes*.dex" : "已导出 " + count + " 个 DEX 到 " + dir);
        }
        finally
        {
            TryDelete(local);
        }
    }

    private async Task<bool> SaveTextAsync(string suggested, string text)
    {
        try
        {
            var path = await Host.Ui.SaveFileAsync("保存分析结果", suggested, "*.*");
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(path)) return false;
            await File.WriteAllTextAsync(path, text, new UTF8Encoding(false));
            Host.Ui.Toast("已保存：" + Path.GetFileName(path));
            return true;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Host.Ui.Toast("保存失败：" + ex.Message);
            return false;
        }
    }

    private async Task<string> FetchApkAsync(PluginTarget target, CancellationToken ct, bool allowAnyFile = false)
    {
        string remote;
        if (target.Kind == PluginTargetKind.App)
        {
            var app = await Host.Apps.GetAsync(target.Package, ct);
            remote = app?.ApkPath ?? target.Extra ?? "";
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(remote))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("取不到安装包路径（系统预置或已卸载）。");
        }
        else
        {
            remote = target.Path;
            if (!allowAnyFile && !remote.EndsWith(".apk", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("这个文件不是 .apk。");
        }

        var cache = Path.Combine(Host.DataDirectory, "cache");
        Directory.CreateDirectory(cache);
        var local = Path.Combine(cache, "apk-" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N")[..10] + ".apk");
        await Host.Device.DownloadAsync(remote, local, ct);
        return local;
    }

    private static void TryDelete(string path)
    {
        try { if (File.Exists(path)) File.Delete(path); } catch { }
    }

    private static (string Md5, string Sha1, string Sha256, long Size) ComputeHashes(string path)
    {
        using var md5 = MD5.Create();
        using var sha1 = SHA1.Create();
        using var sha256 = SHA256.Create();
        using var fs = File.OpenRead(path);
        var buf = new byte[81920];
        int n;
        while ((n = fs.Read(buf, 0, buf.Length)) > 0)
        {
            md5.TransformBlock(buf, 0, n, null, 0);
            sha1.TransformBlock(buf, 0, n, null, 0);
            sha256.TransformBlock(buf, 0, n, null, 0);
        }
        md5.TransformFinalBlock(Array.Empty<byte>(), 0, 0);
        sha1.TransformFinalBlock(Array.Empty<byte>(), 0, 0);
        sha256.TransformFinalBlock(Array.Empty<byte>(), 0, 0);
        return (Convert.ToHexString(md5.Hash!), Convert.ToHexString(sha1.Hash!),
                Convert.ToHexString(sha256.Hash!), new FileInfo(path).Length);
    }

    // ---------------- 插件页 ----------------

    private Control BuildPage(IPluginHost host)
    {
        ApkAnalysis? current = null;
        string currentName = "";
        string currentLocal = "";
        string section = "overview";

        var status = new TextBlock
        {
            Text = "选择 APK，或用「分析当前选中」分析文件页里选中的安装包。只读取结构，不执行 APK。",
            TextWrapping = TextWrapping.Wrap,
        };
        status.Classes.Add("sub");

        var output = new TextBox
        {
            IsReadOnly = true,
            AcceptsReturn = true,
            TextWrapping = TextWrapping.NoWrap,
            FontFamily = new FontFamily("Consolas, Cascadia Mono, monospace"),
            FontSize = 12.5,
            Text = "",
            VerticalContentAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Top,
        };
        output.Classes.Add("path");

        var filter = new TextBox { Watermark = "筛选字符串（回车生效）", Width = 260, IsVisible = false };
        filter.Classes.Add("path");
        var filterRow = new StackPanel { Orientation = Orientation.Horizontal, Spacing = 8 };
        filterRow.Children.Add(new TextBlock { Text = "筛选", VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center });
        filterRow.Children.Add(filter);
        filterRow.IsVisible = false;

        var tabButtons = new Dictionary<string, Button>();
        string[] keys = { "overview", "manifest", "signature", "dex", "res", "str" };
        string[] titles = { "概览", "Manifest", "签名", "DEX", "资源字符串", "DEX 字符串" };

        void Render()
        {
            if (current == null)
            {
                output.Text = "尚未选择 APK。";
                return;
            }
            output.Text = section switch
            {
                "overview" => current.OverviewReport(),
                "manifest" => string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(current.ManifestXml)
                    ? "（没能解码 AndroidManifest.xml）" : current.ManifestXml,
                "signature" => current.SignatureReport(),
                "dex" => current.DexReport(),
                "res" => current.ResourceStringsText(),
                "str" => current.DexStringsText(filter.Text ?? ""),
                _ => "",
            };
            filter.IsVisible = section is "res" or "str";
            filterRow.IsVisible = filter.IsVisible;
            status.Text = currentName + " · " + ApkAnalysis.SizeText(current.FileSize) +
                          " · DEX " + current.DexFiles.Count + " · 权限 " + current.Permissions.Count;
            foreach (var kv in tabButtons) kv.Value.Classes.Set("on", kv.Key == section);
        }

        void Select(string key)
        {
            section = key;
            Render();
        }

        void Analyze(string local, string name)
        {
            try { if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(currentLocal)) TryDelete(currentLocal); } catch { }
            currentLocal = local;
            currentName = name;
            current = null;
            status.Text = "正在分析 " + name + " …";
            _ = Task.Run(() =>
            {
                ApkAnalysis a;
                try { a = ApkAnalysis.Build(local); }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    host.Ui.RunOnUiThread(() => status.Text = "分析失败：" + ex.Message);
                    return;
                }
                host.Ui.RunOnUiThread(() =>
                {
                    current = a;
                    if (section == "overview") section = "overview";
                    Render();
                });
            });
        }

        var pick = new Button { Content = "选择 APK…" };
        pick.Classes.Add("tool");
        pick.Click += async (_, _) =>
        {
            var path = await host.Ui.OpenFileAsync("选择要分析的 APK", "*.apk");
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(path)) Analyze(path!, Path.GetFileName(path!));
        };

        var useSelection = new Button { Content = "分析当前选中" };
        useSelection.Classes.Add("tool");
        useSelection.Click += async (_, _) =>
        {
            var target = host.Files.SelectedTarget;
            if (target == null || target.Kind != PluginTargetKind.File ||
                !target.Path.EndsWith(".apk", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                host.Ui.Toast("请先在文件页选中一个 .apk");
                return;
            }
            var cache = Path.Combine(host.DataDirectory, "cache");
            Directory.CreateDirectory(cache);
            var local = Path.Combine(cache, "apk-" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N")[..10] + ".apk");
            status.Text = "正在从手机读取 " + Path.GetFileName(target.Path) + " …";
            try
            {
                await host.Device.DownloadAsync(target.Path, local, CancellationToken.None);
                Analyze(local, Path.GetFileName(target.Path));
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                status.Text = "读取失败：" + ex.Message;
            }
        };

        var save = new Button { Content = "保存当前结果…" };
        save.Classes.Add("tool");
        save.Click += async (_, _) =>
        {
            if (current == null) { host.Ui.Toast("还没有分析结果"); return; }
            var text = output.Text ?? "";
            await SaveTextAsync(currentName + "-" + section + ".txt", text);
        };

        filter.KeyDown += (_, e) =>
        {
            if (e.Key == Avalonia.Input.Key.Enter)
            {
                Render();
                e.Handled = true;
            }
        };

        var tabBar = new WrapPanel { Orientation = Orientation.Horizontal };
        for (int i = 0; i < keys.Length; i++)
        {
            var key = keys[i];
            var btn = new Button { Content = titles[i], Margin = new Thickness(0, 0, 8, 8) };
            btn.Classes.Add("stylechip");
            btn.Click += (_, _) => Select(key);
            tabButtons[key] = btn;
            tabBar.Children.Add(btn);
        }

        var actions = new WrapPanel { Orientation = Orientation.Horizontal };
        foreach (var b in new[] { pick, useSelection, save })
        {
            b.Margin = new Thickness(0, 0, 8, 0);
            actions.Children.Add(b);
        }

        var head = new DockPanel { Margin = new Thickness(0, 0, 0, 10) };
        DockPanel.SetDock(actions, Dock.Right);
        head.Children.Add(actions);
        head.Children.Add(new TextBlock
        {
            Text = "逆向工具箱",
            FontSize = 16,
            FontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold,
            VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center,
        });

        var top = new StackPanel { Spacing = 8 };
        top.Children.Add(head);
        top.Children.Add(tabBar);
        top.Children.Add(filterRow);
        top.Children.Add(status);

        var root = new DockPanel { Margin = new Thickness(16, 12) };
        DockPanel.SetDock(top, Dock.Top);
        root.Children.Add(top);
        root.Children.Add(output);

        // 默认选中概览（此时还没有 APK，只显示提示）
        Select("overview");

        // 调试/自动化：直接分析一个本地 APK（不做任何写入，只读）
        try
        {
            var auto = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("DASHFILE_REVTOOL_APK");
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(auto) && File.Exists(auto))
                Analyze(auto!, Path.GetFileName(auto!));
        }
        catch { }
        return root;
    }
}
```

`samples/ReverseToolboxPlugin/ReportWindow.cs`:

```cs
using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Avalonia;
using Avalonia.Controls;
using Avalonia.Layout;
using Avalonia.Media;

namespace ReverseToolboxPlugin;

/// <summary>可滚动、可另存的报告窗口（长文本不走对话框）。</summary>
internal sealed class ReportWindow : Window
{
    public ReportWindow(string title, string text, Func<string, Task>? save)
    {
        Title = title;
        Width = 940;
        Height = 700;
        MinWidth = 520;
        MinHeight = 360;
        WindowStartupLocation = WindowStartupLocation.CenterScreen;
        ShowInTaskbar = false;
        try
        {
            if (Application.Current?.TryGetResource("Bg", null, out var bg) == true && bg is IBrush b)
                Background = b;
        }
        catch { }

        var box = new TextBox
        {
            Text = text,
            IsReadOnly = true,
            AcceptsReturn = true,
            TextWrapping = TextWrapping.NoWrap,
            FontFamily = new FontFamily("Consolas, Cascadia Mono, monospace"),
            FontSize = 12.5,
            VerticalContentAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Top,
        };
        ScrollViewer.SetVerticalScrollBarVisibility(box, Avalonia.Controls.Primitives.ScrollBarVisibility.Auto);
        ScrollViewer.SetHorizontalScrollBarVisibility(box, Avalonia.Controls.Primitives.ScrollBarVisibility.Auto);

        var saveBtn = new Button { Content = "保存为…" };
        saveBtn.Classes.Add("tool");
        saveBtn.Click += async (_, _) =>
        {
            if (save != null) await save(title);
        };
        var closeBtn = new Button { Content = "关闭" };
        closeBtn.Classes.Add("tool");
        closeBtn.Click += (_, _) => Close();

        var bar = new StackPanel
        {
            Orientation = Orientation.Horizontal,
            HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Right,
            Spacing = 8,
            Margin = new Thickness(0, 8, 0, 0),
            Children = { saveBtn, closeBtn },
        };

        var root = new DockPanel { Margin = new Thickness(16) };
        DockPanel.SetDock(bar, Dock.Bottom);
        root.Children.Add(bar);
        root.Children.Add(box);
        Content = root;
    }
}
```

`src/App.axaml.cs`:

```cs
using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Text;
using Avalonia;
using Avalonia.Controls;
using Avalonia.Controls.ApplicationLifetimes;
using Avalonia.Markup.Xaml;
using Avalonia.Threading;
using DashFile.Services;
using DashFile.ViewModels;
using DashFile.Views;

namespace DashFile;

public partial class App : Application
{
    public override void Initialize() => AvaloniaXamlLoader.Load(this);

    public override void OnFrameworkInitializationCompleted()
    {
        HookExceptions();
        CleanupOldLogs(7);

        if (ApplicationLifetime is IClassicDesktopStyleApplicationLifetime desktop)
        {
            var vm = new MainViewModel();
            desktop.MainWindow = new MainWindow { DataContext = vm };
            desktop.ShutdownMode = ShutdownMode.OnMainWindowClose;
        }

        base.OnFrameworkInitializationCompleted();
    }

    /// <summary>兜底：任何未捕获异常都写 Log\crash-日期.log，不让程序直接消失</summary>
    private void HookExceptions()
    {
        AppDomain.CurrentDomain.UnhandledException += (_, e) =>
            WriteCrash("AppDomain", e.ExceptionObject as Exception);

        if (ApplicationLifetime is IClassicDesktopStyleApplicationLifetime)
        {
            Dispatcher.UIThread.UnhandledException += (_, e) =>
            {
                WriteCrash("UI", e.Exception);
                e.Handled = true;   // 界面线程异常不再终止进程
            };
        }

        System.Threading.Tasks.TaskScheduler.UnobservedTaskException += (_, e) =>
        {
            WriteCrash("Task", e.Exception);
            e.SetObserved();
        };
    }

    internal static void WriteCrash(string source, Exception? ex)
    {
        try
        {
            var dir = Path.Combine(AppContext.BaseDirectory, "Log");
            Directory.CreateDirectory(dir);
            var file = Path.Combine(dir, $"crash-{DateTime.Now:yyyyMMdd}.log");

            var sb = new StringBuilder();
            sb.AppendLine("[" + DateTime.Now.ToString("HH:mm:ss") + "] [" + source + "]");
            sb.AppendLine("App: " + AppInfo.Product + " v" + AppInfo.Version + "  (" +
                          System.Runtime.InteropServices.RuntimeInformation.FrameworkDescription + ")");
            sb.AppendLine("OS : " + Environment.OSVersion + "  x64=" + Environment.Is64BitProcess);
            sb.AppendLine("CWD: " + Environment.CurrentDirectory);
            var recent = AppLog.Snapshot(20);
            sb.AppendLine("--- 最近操作（" + recent.Length + "）---");
            foreach (var line in recent) sb.AppendLine("  " + line);
            sb.AppendLine("--- exception ---");
            sb.AppendLine(ex?.ToString() ?? "(null)");
            sb.AppendLine();

            File.AppendAllText(file, sb.ToString(), new UTF8Encoding(false));
        }
        catch { /* 日志失败也不能再抛 */ }
    }

    /// <summary>崩溃日志按天保留 N 天，避免越积越多（启动时跑一次）。</summary>
    internal static void CleanupOldLogs(int days)
    {
        try
        {
            var dir = Path.Combine(AppContext.BaseDirectory, "Log");
            if (!Directory.Exists(dir)) return;
            var limit = DateTime.Now.AddDays(-Math.Max(1, days));
            foreach (var f in Directory.GetFiles(dir, "crash-*.log"))
            {
                try { if (File.GetLastWriteTime(f) < limit) File.Delete(f); } catch { }
            }
        }
        catch { }
    }
}
```

```cs
using System;
using System.Globalization;
using Avalonia.Data.Converters;
using Avalonia.Media;
using DashFile.Models;

namespace DashFile.Controls;

/// <summary>按文件类型返回矢量图标（16x16 线性图标）</summary>
public sealed class FileIcon : IValueConverter
{
    public static readonly FileIcon Instance = new();

    private const string Folder = "M1.8,4.2 h3.9 l1.3,1.6 h7.2 v7.4 h-12.4 z";
    private const string File   = "M4.2,1.6 h4.8 l3.4,3.4 v9.4 h-8.2 z M9,1.6 v3.4 h3.4";
    private const string Text   = "M4.2,1.6 h4.8 l3.4,3.4 v9.4 h-8.2 z M5.8,7.4 h4.4 M5.8,9.8 h4.4 M5.8,12.2 h2.6";
    private const string Script = "M4.2,1.6 h4.8 l3.4,3.4 v9.4 h-8.2 z M5.6,8.2 l1.4,1.4 -1.4,1.4 M8.4,11 h2.2";
    private const string Image  = "M2,3.2 h12 v9.6 h-12 z M4.6,6 a1.1,1.1 0 1,0 0.1,0 M3,12 l3.4,-3.4 2.2,2.2 1.9,-1.9 2.9,2.9";
    private const string Video  = "M2,3.6 h12 v9.2 h-12 z M6.4,6.2 l3.8,2.4 -3.8,2.4 z";
    private const string Audio  = "M6,11.4 a1.4,1.4 0 1,0 0.1,0 M7.4,11 V4.4 l4.8,-1.4 v6.4 M10.8,12.2 a1.4,1.4 0 1,0 0.1,0";
    private const string Apk    = "M3.2,2 h9.6 v12 h-9.6 z M5.4,6 h5.2 M5.4,9 h5.2 M5.4,12 h2.6";
    private const string Archive= "M3,3 h10 v10.4 h-10 z M6.6,3 v2 M9.4,3 v2 M6.6,6.4 v2 M9.4,6.4 v2";
    private const string Link   = "M6.6,10.4 l-1,1 a2.1,2.1 0 0,1 -3,-3 l2,-2 a2.1,2.1 0 0,1 3,0 M9.4,5.6 l1,-1 a2.1,2.1 0 0,1 3,3 l-2,2 a2.1,2.1 0 0,1 -3,0";
    private const string Binary = "M4,4 h3 v3 h-3 z M9,9 h3 v3 h-3 z M4,9 h3 M9,4 h3";

    public object? Convert(object? value, Type targetType, object? parameter, CultureInfo culture)
    {
        if (value is not PosixEntry e) return Geometry.Parse(File);
        return Geometry.Parse(Pick(e));
    }

    private static string Pick(PosixEntry e)
    {
        if (e.IsDir) return Folder;
        if (e.IsLink) return Link;

        var n = e.Name.ToLowerInvariant();
        var ext = n.Contains('.') ? n[(n.LastIndexOf('.') + 1)..] : "";

        return ext switch
        {
            "sh" or "bash" or "zsh" => Script,
            "txt" or "log" or "md" or "json" or "xml" or "ini" or "conf" or "cfg" or "prop" => Text,
            "png" or "jpg" or "jpeg" or "webp" or "bmp" or "gif" or "svg" => Image,
            "mp4" or "mkv" or "avi" or "mov" or "webm" or "3gp" => Video,
            "mp3" or "wav" or "flac" or "ogg" or "m4a" or "aac" => Audio,
            "apk" or "apks" or "xapk" or "apkm" => Apk,
            "zip" or "rar" or "7z" or "tar" or "gz" or "xz" or "bz2" or "tgz" => Archive,
            "so" or "ko" or "bin" or "elf" or "img" or "dex" or "oat" or "vdex" => Binary,
            _ => File,
        };
    }

    public object? ConvertBack(object? value, Type targetType, object? parameter, CultureInfo culture)
        => throw new NotSupportedException();
}
```

`src/Controls/MarqueeText.cs`:

```cs
using System;
using Avalonia;
using Avalonia.Controls;
using Avalonia.Media;
using Avalonia.Threading;

namespace DashFile.Controls;

/// <summary>
/// 选中时自动横向滚动长文本；滚到底停顿后回到开头循环。
/// 未选中时停在起点，不产生任何定时器开销。
/// </summary>
public class MarqueeText : TextBlock
{
    private readonly TranslateTransform _tt = new();
    private DispatcherTimer? _timer;
    private DispatcherTimer? _startDelay;
    private double _textWidth;
    private double _offset;
    private double _pause;
    private int _phase; // 0=滚动 1=停顿

    public static readonly StyledProperty<bool> IsActiveProperty =
        AvaloniaProperty.Register<MarqueeText, bool>(nameof(IsActive));

    public bool IsActive
    {
        get => GetValue(IsActiveProperty);
        set => SetValue(IsActiveProperty, value);
    }

    public MarqueeText()
    {
        TextWrapping = TextWrapping.NoWrap;
        RenderTransform = _tt;
        ClipToBounds = false;
    }

    // 行被列表虚拟化回收后（Detach）16ms 定时器还在跑：以前没有这个兜底，
    //   滚动列表来回拖几次就堆一堆空转定时器。
    protected override void OnDetachedFromVisualTree(VisualTreeAttachmentEventArgs e)
    {
        if (_timer is { IsEnabled: true }) _timer.Stop();
        ResetState();
        base.OnDetachedFromVisualTree(e);
    }

    protected override void OnAttachedToVisualTree(VisualTreeAttachmentEventArgs e)
    {
        base.OnAttachedToVisualTree(e);
        UpdateTimer();
    }

    protected override void OnPropertyChanged(AvaloniaPropertyChangedEventArgs change)
    {
        base.OnPropertyChanged(change);
        if (change.Property == IsActiveProperty) UpdateTimer();
        else if (change.Property == TextBlock.TextProperty) ResetState();
    }

    private void ResetState()
    {
        _offset = 0;
        _pause = 0;
        _phase = 0;
        _tt.X = 0;
    }

    private void UpdateTimer()
    {
        if (IsActive)
        {
            // 悬停 220ms 后才开始滚：否则鼠标划过列表（尤其是滚动时行从指针下经过）
            //   会让每一行轮番启停 16ms 定时器 + 改 RenderTransform，直接把滚动帧率吃光。
            _startDelay ??= new DispatcherTimer(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(220), DispatcherPriority.Background,
                (_, _) =>
                {
                    _startDelay?.Stop();
                    if (!IsActive) return;
                    if (_textWidth <= Bounds.Width + 2) return;   // 放得下就不滚
                    _timer ??= new DispatcherTimer(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(16), DispatcherPriority.Background, OnTick);
                    if (!_timer.IsEnabled) _timer.Start();
                });
            if (!_startDelay.IsEnabled) _startDelay.Start();
        }
        else
        {
            if (_startDelay != null) _startDelay.Stop();
            if (_timer != null) _timer.Stop();
            ResetState();
        }
    }

    protected override Size MeasureOverride(Size availableSize)
    {
        var natural = base.MeasureOverride(new Size(double.PositiveInfinity, availableSize.Height));
        _textWidth = natural.Width;
        var w = double.IsInfinity(availableSize.Width) ? natural.Width : availableSize.Width;
        return new Size(w, natural.Height);
    }

    private void OnTick(object? sender, EventArgs e)
    {
        var view = Bounds.Width;
        var overflow = _textWidth - view;
        if (overflow <= 2)
        {
            _tt.X = 0;
            return;
        }

        if (_phase == 1)
        {
            _pause -= 0.016;
            if (_pause <= 0) { _phase = 0; _offset = 0; _tt.X = 0; }
            return;
        }

        _offset -= 1.6;
        if (_offset <= -overflow)
        {
            _offset = -overflow;
            _tt.X = Math.Round(_offset);   // 整像素：亚像素位移会每帧重排文字
            _phase = 1;
            _pause = 1.3;
            return;
        }
        _tt.X = Math.Round(_offset);
    }
}
```

`src/Controls/SmoothScroll.cs`:

```cs
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Linq;
using Avalonia;
using Avalonia.Controls;
using Avalonia.Input;
using Avalonia.Interactivity;
using Avalonia.Threading;
using Avalonia.VisualTree;

namespace DashFile.Controls;

/// <summary>
/// 鼠标滚轮平滑滚动（"跟手 + 缓出"），替代系统默认的"一格一跳"。
///
/// 为什么不用 Avalonia 自带的惯性：它只对触摸/拖拽生效，鼠标滚轮仍然是离散跳变。
///   这里拦截滚轮事件，把目标偏移累积起来，再用 150ms 的缓出动画把 Offset 推过去：
///   连续滚动时目标不断叠加，画面始终是连续运动，而不是一格一格闪。
///
/// 用法：XAML 上给任意控件加 <c>ctl:SmoothScroll.Enabled="True"</c>（会自动找它内部的 ScrollViewer），
/// 或者代码里 <see cref="Attach"/> 一个 ScrollViewer。
/// </summary>
public sealed class SmoothScroll
{
    private SmoothScroll() { }

    /// <summary>缓动时长：再长就跟不上手了</summary>
    private const double DurationMs = 150;

    public static readonly AttachedProperty<bool> EnabledProperty =
        AvaloniaProperty.RegisterAttached<SmoothScroll, Control, bool>("Enabled");

    public static void SetEnabled(Control c, bool value) => c.SetValue(EnabledProperty, value);
    public static bool GetEnabled(Control c) => c.GetValue(EnabledProperty);

    private sealed class State
    {
        public ScrollViewer? Viewer;
        public double Start;
        public double Target;
        public readonly Stopwatch Watch = new();
        public DispatcherTimer? Timer;
    }

    private static readonly Dictionary<Control, State> States = new();

    static SmoothScroll()
    {
        EnabledProperty.Changed.AddClassHandler<Control>((c, e) =>
        {
            if (e.NewValue is true) Enable(c);
            else Disable(c);
        });
    }

    private static void Enable(Control control)
    {
        control.AddHandler(InputElement.PointerWheelChangedEvent, OnWheel, RoutingStrategies.Tunnel);
    }

    private static void Disable(Control control)
    {
        control.RemoveHandler(InputElement.PointerWheelChangedEvent, OnWheel);
        if (States.Remove(control, out var state)) state.Timer?.Stop();
        control.DetachedFromVisualTree -= OnControlDetached;
    }

    private static void OnControlDetached(object? sender, VisualTreeAttachmentEventArgs e)
    {
        if (sender is Control control) Disable(control);
    }

    /// <summary>直接挂到一个 ScrollViewer 上</summary>
    public static void Attach(ScrollViewer viewer) => SetEnabled(viewer, true);

    private static ScrollViewer? ViewerOf(Control control, State state)
    {
        if (state.Viewer != null) return state.Viewer;
        state.Viewer = control as ScrollViewer
                       ?? control.GetVisualDescendants().OfType<ScrollViewer>().FirstOrDefault();
        return state.Viewer;
    }

    private static void OnWheel(object? sender, PointerWheelEventArgs e)
    {
        if (sender is not Control control) return;

        if (!States.TryGetValue(control, out var state))
        {
            state = new State();
            States[control] = state;
            // States 是静态强引用表：控件被虚拟化回收后必须解绑，否则漏控件 + 漏 15ms 定时器
            control.DetachedFromVisualTree += OnControlDetached;
        }

        var sv = ViewerOf(control, state);
        if (sv == null) return;

        var dy = e.Delta.Y;
        if (Math.Abs(dy) < 0.001) return;

        var max = Math.Max(0, sv.Extent.Height - sv.Viewport.Height);
        if (max <= 0.5) return;   // 内容还没撑满：交给外层继续滚

        // 一格滚轮 ≈ 视口的 10%，至少 3 行；比系统默认的"一格 50px"更细腻
        var step = Math.Max(3 * 24, sv.Viewport.Height * 0.10);
        var delta = -dy * step;

        var from = state.Timer?.IsEnabled == true ? state.Target : sv.Offset.Y;
        var target = Math.Clamp(from + delta, 0, max);

        // 已经到顶/到底还往外滚：不拦截，允许滚动链把事件传给外层
        if (Math.Abs(target - sv.Offset.Y) < 0.5 && Math.Abs(delta) > 0.5) return;

        state.Start = sv.Offset.Y;
        state.Target = target;
        state.Watch.Restart();

        // 16ms ≈ 60Hz：和合成器同节拍，避免 15ms 定时器与帧边界互相追赶（追赶会表现为轻微抖动）
        state.Timer ??= new DispatcherTimer(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(16), DispatcherPriority.Render, (_, _) => Tick(sv, state));
        state.Timer.Start();

        // 关键：拦掉系统默认的离散跳转，否则会先跳一下再被动画拉回来
        e.Handled = true;
    }

    private static void Tick(ScrollViewer sv, State state)
    {
        var t = Math.Clamp(state.Watch.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds / DurationMs, 0, 1);

        // CubicEaseOut：起步快、收尾慢，滚轮的手感是"立刻动 + 柔和停"
        var eased = 1 - Math.Pow(1 - t, 3);
        var y = state.Start + (state.Target - state.Start) * eased;

        // 对齐到整像素：亚像素偏移会让每一帧都按新位置重新栅格化文字
        //   （实测就是"滚动时文字发虚 + 掉帧"）。整像素偏移可以直接复用已栅格化的字形。
        y = Math.Round(y);

        if (Math.Abs(y - sv.Offset.Y) >= 0.5)
            sv.Offset = new Vector(sv.Offset.X, y);

        if (t >= 1) state.Timer?.Stop();
    }
}
```

`src/Controls/SparkLine.cs`:

```cs
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using Avalonia;
using Avalonia.Controls;
using Avalonia.Media;

namespace DashFile.Controls;

/// <summary>0~100 的实时折线图（CPU 占用）</summary>
public class SparkLine : Control
{
    public static readonly StyledProperty<IReadOnlyList<double>?> ValuesProperty =
        AvaloniaProperty.Register<SparkLine, IReadOnlyList<double>?>(nameof(Values));

    public static readonly StyledProperty<IBrush?> LineBrushProperty =
        AvaloniaProperty.Register<SparkLine, IBrush?>(nameof(LineBrush));

    public static readonly StyledProperty<IBrush?> FillBrushProperty =
        AvaloniaProperty.Register<SparkLine, IBrush?>(nameof(FillBrush));

    public IReadOnlyList<double>? Values
    {
        get => GetValue(ValuesProperty);
        set => SetValue(ValuesProperty, value);
    }

    public IBrush? LineBrush { get => GetValue(LineBrushProperty); set => SetValue(LineBrushProperty, value); }
    public IBrush? FillBrush { get => GetValue(FillBrushProperty); set => SetValue(FillBrushProperty, value); }

    static SparkLine()
    {
        AffectsRender<SparkLine>(ValuesProperty, LineBrushProperty, FillBrushProperty);
    }

    public override void Render(DrawingContext context)
    {
        var v = Values;
        var w = Bounds.Width;
        var h = Bounds.Height;
        if (w <= 2 || h <= 2) return;

        // 网格（没有数据时也画，避免看起来像一块空白）
        var gridPen = new Pen(new SolidColorBrush(Color.FromArgb(30, 255, 255, 255)), 1);
        for (int i = 1; i < 4; i++)
        {
            var y = h * i / 4.0;
            context.DrawLine(gridPen, new Point(0, y), new Point(w, y));
        }

        if (v == null || v.Count == 0) return;

        // 样本不足时先画一个点，别让图空着
        if (v.Count == 1)
        {
            var y0 = h - (Math.Clamp(v[0], 0, 100) / 100.0) * (h - 2) - 1;
            context.DrawEllipse(LineBrush ?? Brushes.White, null, new Point(w - 1.5, y0), 2.2, 2.2);
            return;
        }

        double step = w / (v.Count - 1);
        var pts = new List<Point>(v.Count);
        for (int i = 0; i < v.Count; i++)
        {
            var val = Math.Clamp(v[i], 0, 100);
            pts.Add(new Point(i * step, h - (val / 100.0) * (h - 2) - 1));
        }

        // 填充
        if (FillBrush != null)
        {
            var geo = new StreamGeometry();
            using (var g = geo.Open())
            {
                g.BeginFigure(new Point(0, h), true);
                foreach (var p in pts) g.LineTo(p);
                g.LineTo(new Point(w, h));
                g.EndFigure(true);
            }
            context.DrawGeometry(FillBrush, null, geo);
        }

        // 折线
        var pen = new Pen(LineBrush ?? Brushes.White, 1.6);
        for (int i = 1; i < pts.Count; i++)
            context.DrawLine(pen, pts[i - 1], pts[i]);
    }
}
```

`src/Controls/ViewAnimator.cs`:

```cs
using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Avalonia;
using Avalonia.Animation;
using Avalonia.Animation.Easings;
using Avalonia.Controls;
using Avalonia.Media;
using Avalonia.Styling;

namespace DashFile.Controls;

/// <summary>
/// 统一的"线性过场"：淡入 + 轻微位移。
/// 监听 IsVisible 变 true 时播放，比较轻，不干扰操作。
///
/// 时长遵循 Material 的短/中时长（150~250ms）：再长就显得拖沓，
/// 再短又看不出是过渡。缓动统一用 Cubic/QuarticEaseOut（起步快、收尾稳）。
/// </summary>
public static class ViewAnimator
{
    public static void Attach(Control? c, double fromY = 10, int ms = 200, double fromX = 0)
    {
        if (c == null) return;

        c.PropertyChanged += (_, e) =>
        {
            if (e.Property != Visual.IsVisibleProperty) return;
            if (e.NewValue is not true) return;
            _ = PlayAsync(c, fromX, fromY, ms);
        };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 窗口内容入场：窗口本身不参与合成，所以动画做在 Content 上（对话框统一调用）。
    /// </summary>
    public static void AttachWindow(Window window, double fromY = 8, int ms = 180)
    {
        window.Opened += (_, _) =>
        {
            if (window.Content is Control content)
                _ = PlayAsync(content, 0, fromY, ms, fadeFrom: 0);
        };
    }

    private static async Task PlayAsync(Control c, double fromX, double fromY, int ms, double fadeFrom = 0.25)
    {
        try
        {
            if (c.RenderTransform is not TranslateTransform tt)
            {
                tt = new TranslateTransform(fromX, fromY);
                c.RenderTransform = tt;
            }

            var startX = fromX;
            var startY = fromY;

            // 先把起点摆好，避免上一次动画残留的位置造成"抖一下"
            tt.X = startX;
            tt.Y = startY;

            var anim = new Animation
            {
                Duration = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(ms),
                Easing = new CubicEaseOut(),
                FillMode = FillMode.Forward,
                Children =
                {
                    new KeyFrame
                    {
                        Cue = new Cue(0d),
                        Setters =
                        {
                            new Setter(Visual.OpacityProperty, fadeFrom),
                            new Setter(TranslateTransform.XProperty, startX),
                            new Setter(TranslateTransform.YProperty, startY)
                        }
                    },
                    new KeyFrame
                    {
                        Cue = new Cue(1d),
                        Setters =
                        {
                            new Setter(Visual.OpacityProperty, 1d),
                            new Setter(TranslateTransform.XProperty, 0d),
                            new Setter(TranslateTransform.YProperty, 0d)
                        }
                    }
                }
            };

            await anim.RunAsync(c);
            c.Opacity = 1;
            tt.X = 0;
            tt.Y = 0;
        }
        catch { }
    }
}
```

`src/DashFile.PluginApi/Controls/SegmentedTabs.cs`:

```cs
using System;
using System.Collections;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Collections.Specialized;
using System.Reflection;
using Avalonia;
using Avalonia.Animation;
using Avalonia.Animation.Easings;
using Avalonia.Controls;
using Avalonia.Data;
using Avalonia.Layout;
using Avalonia.Media;
using Avalonia.Media.Transformation;
using Avalonia.Threading;

namespace DashFile.PluginApi.Controls;

/// <summary>
/// 分段标签条：选中项由一个"滑动指示器"（segpill）表示，切换时宽度和水平位置一起缓动。
///
/// 两种用法（同一份实现，避免每个新功能各写一套定位/动画代码）：
///
///   1) 声明式 —— 直接在 XAML 里写按钮，适合固定标签（主窗口顶部那 6 个）：
///      &lt;Border Classes="seg"&gt;
///        &lt;ctl:SegmentedTabs SelectedIndex="{Binding SelectedTab}"&gt;
///          &lt;Button Classes="seg tabbtn" Content="设备信息"/&gt;
///          &lt;Button Classes="seg tabbtn" Content="文件管理"/&gt;
///        &lt;/ctl:SegmentedTabs&gt;
///      &lt;/Border&gt;
///
///   2) 数据驱动 —— 给 ItemsSource + DisplayMemberPath + SelectedItem，适合数量不定的标签
///      （插件页的"这个插件提供哪些子页面"就是这种）：
///      &lt;Border Classes="seg"&gt;
///        &lt;ctl:SegmentedTabs ItemsSource="{Binding PluginPages}" DisplayMemberPath="Title"
///                          SelectedItem="{Binding SelectedPluginPage, Mode=TwoWay}"/&gt;
///      &lt;/Border&gt;
///
/// 指示器是内建的第一个子元素（IsHitTestVisible=false，画在最底层），
/// 所以外面不要再叠自己的选中背景，否则会盖住滑动效果。
/// </summary>
public sealed class SegmentedTabs : Panel
{
    /// <summary>数据驱动的标签集合；为空时使用 XAML 里声明的按钮</summary>
    public static readonly StyledProperty<IEnumerable?> ItemsSourceProperty =
        AvaloniaProperty.Register<SegmentedTabs, IEnumerable?>(nameof(ItemsSource));

    /// <summary>标签文字取自数据项的哪个属性（不填则用 ToString()）</summary>
    public static readonly StyledProperty<string?> DisplayMemberPathProperty =
        AvaloniaProperty.Register<SegmentedTabs, string?>(nameof(DisplayMemberPath));

    public static readonly StyledProperty<object?> SelectedItemProperty =
        AvaloniaProperty.Register<SegmentedTabs, object?>(nameof(SelectedItem),
            defaultBindingMode: BindingMode.TwoWay);

    public static readonly StyledProperty<int> SelectedIndexProperty =
        AvaloniaProperty.Register<SegmentedTabs, int>(nameof(SelectedIndex), -1,
            defaultBindingMode: BindingMode.TwoWay);

    /// <summary>标签之间的间距（像素）</summary>
    public static readonly StyledProperty<double> SpacingProperty =
        AvaloniaProperty.Register<SegmentedTabs, double>(nameof(Spacing), 2d);

    /// <summary>滑动动画时长；0 = 关闭动画（低配机 / 自动化测试可用）</summary>
    public static readonly StyledProperty<int> AnimationMsProperty =
        AvaloniaProperty.Register<SegmentedTabs, int>(nameof(AnimationMs), 260);

    public IEnumerable? ItemsSource
    {
        get => GetValue(ItemsSourceProperty);
        set => SetValue(ItemsSourceProperty, value);
    }

    public string? DisplayMemberPath
    {
        get => GetValue(DisplayMemberPathProperty);
        set => SetValue(DisplayMemberPathProperty, value);
    }

    public object? SelectedItem
    {
        get => GetValue(SelectedItemProperty);
        set => SetValue(SelectedItemProperty, value);
    }

    public int SelectedIndex
    {
        get => GetValue(SelectedIndexProperty);
        set => SetValue(SelectedIndexProperty, value);
    }

    public double Spacing
    {
        get => GetValue(SpacingProperty);
        set => SetValue(SpacingProperty, value);
    }

    public int AnimationMs
    {
        get => GetValue(AnimationMsProperty);
        set => SetValue(AnimationMsProperty, value);
    }

    /// <summary>选中项变化（含程序化设置 SelectedIndex）：宿主和插件都用它来切换页面</summary>
    public event EventHandler<int>? SelectionChanged;

    private void RaiseSelectionChanged()
    {
        try { SelectionChanged?.Invoke(this, SelectedIndex); } catch { }
    }

    // ---------------- 内部状态 ----------------

    private readonly Border _pill = new()
    {
        IsHitTestVisible = false,
        HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Left,
        VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Top,
    };

    private readonly List<Button> _generated = new();
    private readonly HashSet<Button> _wired = new();
    private readonly Dictionary<(Type, string), PropertyInfo?> _propCache = new();

    private IList? _items;
    private IEnumerable? _itemsFor;
    private INotifyCollectionChanged? _itemsNotify;

    private bool _syncing;
    private bool _laidOut;
    private double _pillHeight;

    public SegmentedTabs()
    {
        _pill.Classes.Add("segpill");
        Children.Add(_pill);
    }

    protected override void OnAttachedToVisualTree(VisualTreeAttachmentEventArgs e)
    {
        base.OnAttachedToVisualTree(e);
        WireDeclarativeButtons();
        HookItems();
        UpdateClasses();
    }

    protected override void OnDetachedFromVisualTree(VisualTreeAttachmentEventArgs e)
    {
        UnhookItems();
        base.OnDetachedFromVisualTree(e);
    }

    protected override void OnPropertyChanged(AvaloniaPropertyChangedEventArgs change)
    {
        base.OnPropertyChanged(change);

        if (change.Property == ItemsSourceProperty || change.Property == DisplayMemberPathProperty)
        {
            UnhookItems();
            HookItems();
            _items = null;
            _itemsFor = null;
            RebuildGenerated();
            UpdateClasses();
            InvalidateMeasure();
        }
        else if (change.Property == SelectedItemProperty && !_syncing)
        {
            var idx = IndexOfItem(SelectedItem);
            if (idx >= 0)
            {
                _syncing = true;
                try { SetCurrentValue(SelectedIndexProperty, idx); }
                finally { _syncing = false; }
            }
            UpdateClasses();
            PostPillUpdate();
            RaiseSelectionChanged();
        }
        else if (change.Property == SelectedIndexProperty && !_syncing)
        {
            var items = ItemList();
            if (items != null && SelectedIndex >= 0 && SelectedIndex < items.Count)
            {
                _syncing = true;
                try { SetCurrentValue(SelectedItemProperty, items[SelectedIndex]); }
                finally { _syncing = false; }
            }
            UpdateClasses();
            PostPillUpdate();
            RaiseSelectionChanged();
        }
        else if (change.Property == SpacingProperty)
        {
            InvalidateMeasure();
        }
        else if (change.Property == AnimationMsProperty)
        {
            ApplyPillTransitions();
        }
    }

    // ---------------- 布局 ----------------

    protected override Size MeasureOverride(Size availableSize)
    {
        var width = 0d;
        var height = 0d;
        var visible = 0;

        foreach (var b in Buttons())
        {
            if (!b.IsVisible) continue;
            b.Measure(new Size(double.PositiveInfinity, availableSize.Height));
            width += b.DesiredSize.Width;
            height = Math.Max(height, b.DesiredSize.Height);
            visible++;
        }

        if (visible > 1) width += Spacing * (visible - 1);
        _pillHeight = height;
        _pill.Measure(new Size(0, 0));
        return new Size(width, height);
    }

    /// <summary>上一次布局算出来的每个按钮矩形（索引 = 标签序号）</summary>
    private readonly List<Rect> _buttonRects = new();

    protected override Size ArrangeOverride(Size finalSize)
    {
        _buttonRects.Clear();
        var x = 0d;

        foreach (var b in Buttons())
        {
            if (!b.IsVisible)
            {
                _buttonRects.Add(default);
                continue;
            }
            var w = b.DesiredSize.Width;
            var h = Math.Max(b.DesiredSize.Height, finalSize.Height);
            b.Arrange(new Rect(x, 0, w, h));
            _buttonRects.Add(new Rect(x, 0, w, h));
            x += w + Spacing;
        }

        if (!_laidOut)
        {
            // 首帧直接就位（不带动画），之后才挂过渡 —— 否则窗口一打开指示器会从左边滑过来
            _laidOut = true;
            ApplyPillGeometry(animate: false);
            ApplyPillTransitions();
        }

        // 这里只"摆放"指示器，绝不改它的 Width / RenderTransform：
        //   在布局过程里改这两个属性不会走过渡，表现就是"一个消失、另一个突然出现"。
        //   位移与宽度一律走 ApplyPillGeometry（布局外，动画才生效）。
        var pw = _pill.Width;
        var ph = _pill.Height;
        _pill.Arrange(new Rect(0, 0,
            double.IsNaN(pw) || pw < 0 ? 0 : pw,
            double.IsNaN(ph) || ph < 0 ? 0 : ph));

        return finalSize;
    }

    /// <summary>把指示器移到当前选中项（animate=true 时由 Transitions 缓动过去）</summary>
    private void ApplyPillGeometry(bool animate)
    {
        var idx = SelectedIndex;
        if (idx < 0 || idx >= _buttonRects.Count || _buttonRects[idx].Width <= 0)
        {
            _pill.IsVisible = false;
            return;
        }

        var r = _buttonRects[idx];
        var h = Math.Max(r.Height, _pillHeight);

        // 不做动画时就地生效：临时摘掉过渡，写完再挂回去
        var keep = _pill.Transitions;
        if (!animate) _pill.Transitions = null;
        try
        {
            _pill.IsVisible = true;
            _pill.Width = r.Width;
            _pill.Height = h;
            // 用 TransformOperations 而不是 TranslateTransform：
            //   TransformOperationsTransition 只对 TransformOperations 做插值，
            //   换别的 ITransform 实现会直接跳到终点（就是"一个消失、一个出现"）。
            _pill.RenderTransform = TransformOperations.Parse($"translateX({r.X:0.##}px)");
        }
        finally
        {
            if (!animate) _pill.Transitions = keep;
        }

        InvalidateArrange();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 移动指示器。选中项变化时按钮尺寸不变，所以上一次布局的矩形立刻可用 ——
    /// 立即应用（这样 Transition 才会真正插值），再补一次布局后的校正。
    /// </summary>
    private void PostPillUpdate(bool animate = true)
    {
        if (!_laidOut) { InvalidateArrange(); return; }
        ApplyPillGeometry(animate);
        Dispatcher.UIThread.Post(() => ApplyPillGeometry(animate), DispatcherPriority.Loaded);
    }

    private void ApplyPillTransitions()
    {
        var ms = AnimationMs;
        if (ms <= 0 || !_laidOut) { _pill.Transitions = null; return; }

        var d = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(ms);
        _pill.Transitions = new Transitions
        {
            new TransformOperationsTransition
            {
                Property = RenderTransformProperty,
                Duration = d,
                Easing = new QuarticEaseOut(),
            },
            new DoubleTransition
            {
                Property = WidthProperty,
                Duration = d,
                Easing = new QuarticEaseOut(),
            },
        };
    }

    // ---------------- 标签维护 ----------------

    /// <summary>当前参与布局的按钮（声明式 + 生成式，按 Children 顺序）</summary>
    private List<Button> Buttons()
    {
        var list = new List<Button>(Children.Count);
        foreach (var c in Children)
        {
            if (ReferenceEquals(c, _pill)) continue;
            if (c is Button b) list.Add(b);
        }
        return list;
    }

    private void WireDeclarativeButtons()
    {
        foreach (var b in Buttons())
        {
            if (_generated.Contains(b)) continue;
            if (!_wired.Add(b)) continue;
            b.Click += OnDeclarativeClick;
        }
    }

    private void OnDeclarativeClick(object? sender, Avalonia.Interactivity.RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (sender is not Button b) return;
        var idx = Buttons().IndexOf(b);
        if (idx >= 0 && idx != SelectedIndex) SetCurrentValue(SelectedIndexProperty, idx);
    }

    private void RebuildGenerated()
    {
        foreach (var b in _generated)
        {
            b.Click -= OnGeneratedClick;
            Children.Remove(b);
        }
        _generated.Clear();

        var items = ItemList();
        if (items == null) return;

        for (var i = 0; i < items.Count; i++)
        {
            var b = new Button
            {
                Content = DisplayText(items[i]),
                Tag = items[i],
            };
            b.Classes.Add("seg");
            b.Classes.Add("tabbtn");
            b.Click += OnGeneratedClick;
            _generated.Add(b);
            Children.Add(b);
        }
    }

    private void OnGeneratedClick(object? sender, Avalonia.Interactivity.RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (sender is not Button b) return;
        var items = ItemList();
        if (items == null) return;
        var idx = items.IndexOf(b.Tag);
        if (idx < 0) return;

        _syncing = true;
        try
        {
            SetCurrentValue(SelectedIndexProperty, idx);
            SetCurrentValue(SelectedItemProperty, items[idx]);
        }
        finally { _syncing = false; }

        UpdateClasses();
        PostPillUpdate();
        RaiseSelectionChanged();
    }

    private void UpdateClasses()
    {
        var buttons = Buttons();
        for (var i = 0; i < buttons.Count; i++)
        {
            var b = buttons[i];
            if (i == SelectedIndex)
            {
                if (!b.Classes.Contains("on")) b.Classes.Add("on");
            }
            else b.Classes.Remove("on");
        }
    }

    // ---------------- 数据源 ----------------

    private void HookItems()
    {
        _itemsNotify = ItemsSource as INotifyCollectionChanged;
        if (_itemsNotify != null) _itemsNotify.CollectionChanged += OnItemsChanged;
    }

    private void UnhookItems()
    {
        if (_itemsNotify != null) _itemsNotify.CollectionChanged -= OnItemsChanged;
        _itemsNotify = null;
    }

    private void OnItemsChanged(object? sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
    {
        // 插件重载会整个换掉 PluginPages 的内容：重建标签并校正选中项
        _items = null;
        _itemsFor = null;
        RebuildGenerated();
        if (SelectedItem != null)
        {
            var idx = IndexOfItem(SelectedItem);
            if (idx >= 0)
            {
                _syncing = true;
                try { SetCurrentValue(SelectedIndexProperty, idx); }
                finally { _syncing = false; }
            }
        }
        UpdateClasses();
        InvalidateMeasure();
        PostPillUpdate(animate: false);
    }

    private IList? ItemList()
    {
        var src = ItemsSource;
        if (src == null) return null;
        if (ReferenceEquals(src, _itemsFor) && _items != null) return _items;

        _items = src as IList ?? new List<object?>(ToObjects(src));
        _itemsFor = src;
        return _items;
    }

    private static IEnumerable<object?> ToObjects(IEnumerable src)
    {
        foreach (var o in src) yield return o;
    }

    private int IndexOfItem(object? item)
    {
        var items = ItemList();
        if (items == null || item == null) return -1;
        return items.IndexOf(item);
    }

    private string DisplayText(object? item)
    {
        if (item == null) return "";
        var path = DisplayMemberPath;
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(path)) return item.ToString() ?? "";

        var key = (item.GetType(), path!);
        if (!_propCache.TryGetValue(key, out var pi))
        {
            pi = item.GetType().GetProperty(path!, BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Instance);
            _propCache[key] = pi;
        }
        return pi?.GetValue(item)?.ToString() ?? "";
    }
}
```

`src/DashFile.PluginApi/IDashFilePlugin.cs`:

```cs
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace DashFile.PluginApi;

/// <summary>
/// 所有 DashFile 插件的入口接口。入口类必须有一个公共无参构造函数，
/// 并在 plugin.json 的 entryType 中填写完整类型名。
/// </summary>
public interface IDashFilePlugin
{
    /// <summary>插件元信息（建议与 plugin.json 保持一致）。</summary>
    PluginMetadata Metadata { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// 插件初始化。宿主在 UI 线程调用；在这里注册页面和动作，或启动后台服务。
    /// 不要在这里做耗时阻塞操作，耗时任务请丢到后台并用 host.Log 报告。
    /// </summary>
    Task InitializeAsync(IPluginHost host, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);

    /// <summary>插件被禁用 / 重载 / 程序退出时调用。用于取消后台任务、保存状态。</summary>
    Task ShutdownAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
}

/// <summary>
/// 插件基类：省去自己保存 host 的样板代码。
/// 继承后重写 <see cref="OnInitializeAsync"/> 即可。
/// </summary>
public abstract class PluginBase : IDashFilePlugin
{
    protected IPluginHost Host { get; private set; } = null!;

    public abstract PluginMetadata Metadata { get; }

    public Task InitializeAsync(IPluginHost host, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        Host = host;
        return OnInitializeAsync(cancellationToken);
    }

    protected virtual Task OnInitializeAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken) => Task.CompletedTask;

    public virtual Task ShutdownAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken) => Task.CompletedTask;
}
```

`src/DashFile.PluginApi/PluginContracts.cs`:

```cs
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Avalonia.Controls;
using Avalonia.Media;

namespace DashFile.PluginApi;

/// <summary>插件可以作用的目标类型。</summary>
public enum PluginTargetKind
{
    None = 0,
    File = 1,
    Directory = 2,
    App = 3,
    Module = 4,
    Device = 5,
    /// <summary>任何目标，通常用于插件页里的全局工具。</summary>
    Any = 100,
}

/// <summary>
/// 一次插件动作的上下文。不同 Kind 只填对应字段，其余为空字符串。
/// </summary>
public sealed class PluginTarget
{
    public PluginTargetKind Kind { get; init; }

    /// <summary>文件 / 目录在设备上的绝对路径。</summary>
    public string Path { get; init; } = "";

    /// <summary>应用包名。</summary>
    public string Package { get; init; } = "";

    /// <summary>模块 id（/data/adb/modules 下的目录名）。</summary>
    public string ModuleId { get; init; } = "";

    /// <summary>显示用名称（文件名、应用名、模块名）。</summary>
    public string DisplayName { get; init; } = "";

    /// <summary>附加数据，留给插件自己解释（例如多选时的 JSON）。</summary>
    public string? Extra { get; init; }

    public static PluginTarget ForFile(string path, string? displayName = null) => new()
    {
        Kind = PluginTargetKind.File,
        Path = path,
        DisplayName = displayName ?? System.IO.Path.GetFileName(path),
    };

    public static PluginTarget ForDirectory(string path, string? displayName = null) => new()
    {
        Kind = PluginTargetKind.Directory,
        Path = path,
        DisplayName = displayName ?? path,
    };

    public static PluginTarget ForApp(string package, string? displayName = null, string apkPath = "") => new()
    {
        Kind = PluginTargetKind.App,
        Package = package,
        DisplayName = displayName ?? package,
        Extra = apkPath,
    };

    public static PluginTarget ForModule(string moduleId, string? displayName = null, string moduleDir = "") => new()
    {
        Kind = PluginTargetKind.Module,
        ModuleId = moduleId,
        DisplayName = displayName ?? moduleId,
        Extra = moduleDir,
    };

    public static PluginTarget ForDevice(string displayName = "") => new()
    {
        Kind = PluginTargetKind.Device,
        DisplayName = displayName,
    };
}

/// <summary>
/// 插件向文件 / 应用 / 模块的右键菜单注入的动作。
/// 动作在 UI 线程之外执行也可以，但插件必须自己把 UI 操作切回 UI 线程（用 <see cref="IPluginUi"/>）。
/// </summary>
public sealed class PluginAction
{
    /// <summary>插件内唯一 id。</summary>
    public string Id { get; init; } = "";

    /// <summary>菜单里显示的文字。</summary>
    public string Title { get; init; } = "";

    /// <summary>可选说明，作为 ToolTip。</summary>
    public string? Description { get; init; }

    /// <summary>可选菜单图标：16×16 坐标系下的 StreamGeometry 路径（描边风格）。为空时宿主用默认拼图图标。</summary>
    public string? Icon { get; init; }

    /// <summary>在哪些目标上出现。</summary>
    public PluginTargetKind[] Targets { get; init; } = new[] { PluginTargetKind.Any };

    /// <summary>是否需要 root；没有 root 时宿主会置灰或提示。</summary>
    public bool RequiresRoot { get; init; }

    /// <summary>是否显示在右键菜单；false 时只作为插件页里的全局动作。</summary>
    public bool ShowInContextMenu { get; init; } = true;

    /// <summary>可选的可用性判断；返回 false 时菜单项置灰。</summary>
    public Func<PluginTarget, bool>? CanExecute { get; init; }

    /// <summary>真正执行的动作。</summary>
    public Func<PluginTarget, CancellationToken, Task> ExecuteAsync { get; init; } = (_, _) => Task.CompletedTask;
}

/// <summary>
/// 插件提供的一个页面。宿主会在“插件”页里列出，并在右侧 ContentControl 中显示返回的控件。
/// 创建控件必须发生在 UI 线程；宿主调用 CreateViewAsync 时已经在 UI 线程。
/// </summary>
public sealed class PluginPage
{
    public string Id { get; init; } = "";

    public string Title { get; init; } = "";

    public string? Description { get; init; }

    /// <summary>可选图标文字（建议一个 emoji 或 1~2 个汉字）。</summary>
    public string? Icon { get; init; }

    /// <summary>创建页面控件。可以每次创建新控件，宿主会缓存当前页。</summary>
    public Func<IPluginHost, CancellationToken, Task<Control>> CreateViewAsync { get; init; }
        = (_, _) => Task.FromResult<Control>(new TextBlock { Text = "（插件没有提供页面）" });

    /// <summary>简单页面的快捷写法。</summary>
    public static PluginPage FromControl(string id, string title, Func<IPluginHost, Control> factory,
        string? description = null, string? icon = null)
        => new()
        {
            Id = id,
            Title = title,
            Description = description,
            Icon = icon,
            CreateViewAsync = (host, _) => Task.FromResult(factory(host)),
        };
}

/// <summary>设备端 shell 执行结果。</summary>
public sealed record PluginShellResult(int ExitCode, string StdOut, string StdErr)
{
    public bool Ok => ExitCode == 0;

    public string All => (StdOut ?? "") + (StdErr ?? "");
}

/// <summary>设备上的一个文件 / 目录条目。</summary>
public sealed record PluginFileEntry(
    string Name,
    string FullPath,
    bool IsDirectory,
    long Size,
    DateTime Modified,
    string Permissions,
    string Owner,
    string Selinux,
    string LinkTarget);

/// <summary>应用条目快照。</summary>
public sealed record PluginApp(
    string Package,
    string Label,
    bool IsSystem,
    string ApkPath,
    int Uid,
    bool IsRootGranted);

/// <summary>模块条目快照。</summary>
public sealed record PluginModule(
    string Id,
    string Name,
    string Version,
    string Author,
    string Description,
    string Directory,
    bool Enabled,
    bool HasWebUi,
    bool HasAction);

/// <summary>设备连接快照，随 DeviceChanged 事件发送。</summary>
public sealed record DeviceSnapshot(
    bool IsConnected,
    bool IsRoot,
    string Serial,
    string Model,
    string AndroidVersion,
    string RootManager);

/// <summary>
/// 宿主传给插件的全部能力入口。
/// 插件通常只在自己的 Initialize 里调用 AddPage / AddAction，然后保存 host 供后续使用。
/// </summary>
public interface IPluginHost
{
    /// <summary>当前插件元信息。</summary>
    PluginMetadata Metadata { get; }

    /// <summary>宿主版本，例如 1.0.0-alpha1。</summary>
    string HostVersion { get; }

    /// <summary>该插件专属的本机数据目录（已创建），可以放缓存、下载文件。</summary>
    string DataDirectory { get; }

    IPluginUi Ui { get; }

    IPluginDevice Device { get; }

    IPluginFiles Files { get; }

    IPluginApps Apps { get; }

    IPluginModules Modules { get; }

    IPluginSettings Settings { get; }

    IPluginLog Log { get; }

    IPluginEvents Events { get; }

    /// <summary>注册一个插件页面（显示在“插件”页右侧）。</summary>
    void AddPage(PluginPage page);

    /// <summary>注册一个右键菜单动作。</summary>
    void AddAction(PluginAction action);

    /// <summary>注册一个全局动作；显示在插件页里，不依赖当前选中的文件/应用。</summary>
    void AddGlobalAction(PluginAction action);

    /// <summary>
    /// 更新"插件页右栏顶部"（插件名右侧）显示的信息：副标题 / 徽标 / 状态。
    /// 宿主的页面外壳已经显示了插件名与版本，插件不必在页面里再画一遍标题卡片；
    /// 想要展示的能力标签（"无 Python 依赖"之类）和运行状态从这里推给宿主即可。
    /// 可在任意线程调用，宿主会切到 UI 线程更新。
    /// </summary>
    void SetHeader(PluginHeaderInfo? header);

    /// <summary>只更新状态文本（例如"就绪"/"解析中…"），副标题与徽标保持上一次的值。</summary>
    void SetStatus(string? status);
}

/// <summary>
/// 插件页顶部展示的附加信息（由 <see cref="IPluginHost.SetHeader"/> 推送）。
/// </summary>
public sealed record PluginHeaderInfo
{
    /// <summary>副标题：一句话说明这个插件页做什么。</summary>
    public string? Subtitle { get; init; }

    /// <summary>徽标：能力标签，例如 "AOSP testkey 内置"、"无 Python 依赖"。</summary>
    public IReadOnlyList<string> Badges { get; init; } = System.Array.Empty<string>();

    /// <summary>状态：例如 "就绪 · 纯 C#"。右侧单行显示。</summary>
    public string? Status { get; init; }
}

/// <summary>插件可以调用的宿主 UI 能力。</summary>
public interface IPluginUi
{
    void Toast(string message);

    Task ShowMessageAsync(string title, string message, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);

    Task<bool> ConfirmAsync(string title, string message, string okText = "确定",
        string cancelText = "取消", CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);

    Task<string?> PromptAsync(string title, string label, string initialValue = "",
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);

    /// <summary>打开本地文件选择框；patterns 例如 "*.apk"、"*.zip"。</summary>
    Task<string?> OpenFileAsync(string title, params string[] patterns);

    /// <summary>打开本地文件选择框并允许多选。</summary>
    Task<IReadOnlyList<string>> OpenFilesAsync(string title, params string[] patterns);

    /// <summary>打开本机保存对话框。</summary>
    Task<string?> SaveFileAsync(string title, string suggestedFileName, params string[] patterns);

    /// <summary>选择本机文件夹。</summary>
    Task<string?> PickFolderAsync(string title);

    /// <summary>创建一个进度提示；Report 会更新宿主状态栏，Dispose 时结束。</summary>
    IPluginProgress CreateProgress(string title);

    void RunOnUiThread(Action action);

    Task RunOnUiThreadAsync(Action action);

    /// <summary>
    /// 覆盖一个主题资源。key 例如 Accent / PanelAlt / RadiusCard / RowH；
    /// value 可以是 Color、IBrush、CornerRadius、double 等。返回的句柄 Dispose 后恢复原值。
    /// 必须在 UI 线程生效；后台调用会通过宿主调度。
    /// </summary>
    IDisposable OverrideResource(string key, object value);

    /// <summary>覆盖一个颜色资源（自动包成 SolidColorBrush）。</summary>
    IDisposable OverrideResourceColor(string key, Color color);

    /// <summary>清除本插件做过的所有资源覆盖，恢复宿主默认主题。</summary>
    void ClearResourceOverrides();
}

/// <summary>简单的进度回调。插件在后台线程调用 Report 即可。</summary>
public interface IPluginProgress : IProgress<string>, IDisposable

    string Title { get; }

    void Complete(string? message = null);
}

/// <summary>
/// 设备能力。所有方法都带超时；插件无需自己处理 su 授权弹窗导致的挂起（宿主有 20 秒兜底）。
/// </summary>
public interface IPluginDevice

    bool IsConnected { get; }

    bool IsRoot { get; }

    string Serial { get; }
```
