```cs
    Task<PluginShellResult> ExecAsync(string executable, IReadOnlyList<string> arguments,
        bool root = true, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);

    /// <summary>执行命令并把 stdout 当二进制取回。</summary>
    Task<byte[]> ExecCaptureAsync(string command, bool root = true,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);

    Task<byte[]> ReadBytesAsync(string remotePath, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);

    Task<bool> WriteBytesAsync(string remotePath, byte[] data,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);

    Task<string> ReadTextAsync(string remotePath, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);

    Task WriteTextAsync(string remotePath, string text, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);

    Task<bool> ExistsAsync(string remotePath, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);

    Task DownloadAsync(string remotePath, string localPath,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);

    Task UploadAsync(string localPath, string remoteDirectory,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);

    /// <summary>
    /// 把本机文件推到 /data/local/tmp 并返回远端临时路径（已 chmod 644）。
    /// 自动处理 adb push 只能以 shell 身份写文件的限制。

    Task<string> PushTempFileAsync(string localPath, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);

    /// <summary>在 /data/local/tmp 下创建一个随机临时目录并返回路径。</summary>
    Task<string> CreateTempDirectoryAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);

    Task DeleteRemoteAsync(string remotePath, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
}
```

`src/DashFile.PluginApi/PluginMetadata.cs`:

```cs
namespace DashFile.PluginApi;

/// <summary>
/// 插件 API 的版本信息。宿主与插件通过 <see cref="Version"/> 判断兼容性：
/// 插件声明的 apiVersion 大于宿主支持的版本时，宿主会拒绝加载并提示升级 DashFile。
/// </summary>
public static class PluginApiInfo
{
    /// <summary>当前插件 API 主版本。破坏性改动才递增，新增接口用新类型/默认实现。</summary>
    public const int Version = 1;

    /// <summary>宿主产品名。</summary>
    public const string HostProduct = "DashFile";

    /// <summary>插件清单文件名。</summary>
    public const string ManifestFileName = "plugin.json";
}

/// <summary>
/// 插件自报的元信息。宿主会优先使用 plugin.json 里的信息做展示，
/// 插件实现 <see cref="IDashFilePlugin.Metadata"/> 返回的元信息用于运行期自检。
/// </summary>
public sealed class PluginMetadata
{
    /// <summary>全局唯一 id，建议用反向域名，例如 com.example.dexhelper。</summary>
    public string Id { get; init; } = "";

    /// <summary>展示名。</summary>
    public string Name { get; init; } = "";

    /// <summary>插件版本，例如 1.0.0。</summary>
    public string Version { get; init; } = "1.0.0";

    /// <summary>作者。</summary>
    public string Author { get; init; } = "";

    /// <summary>一句话说明。</summary>
    public string Description { get; init; } = "";

    /// <summary>展示用的亮点短语（可选）。插件页列表与详情页优先用它，比 description 短。</summary>
    public string? Tagline { get; init; }

    /// <summary>多作者写法（可选），例如 "甲 / 乙"；为空时用 <see cref="Author"/>。</summary>
    public string? Authors { get; init; }

    /// <summary>版本序号（可选），用于比较新旧，例如 1002003 表示 1.2.3。</summary>
    public int VersionCode { get; init; }

    /// <summary>许可证标识（可选），例如 GPL-3.0-or-later。</summary>
    public string? License { get; init; }

    /// <summary>能力徽标（可选），显示在插件页头部，例如 "无 Python 依赖"。</summary>
    public string[]? Tags { get; init; }

    /// <summary>列表图标（可选），一个 emoji 或 1~2 个汉字。</summary>
    public string? Icon { get; init; }

    /// <summary>主页 / 仓库地址（可选）。</summary>
    public string? Homepage { get; init; }
}

/// <summary>
/// plugin.json 的宿主侧映射。插件作者只需要照文档填写，不需要引用这个类型。
/// </summary>
public sealed class PluginManifest
{
    /// <summary>全局唯一 id（必填）。</summary>
    public string Id { get; set; } = "";

    /// <summary>展示名（必填）。</summary>
    public string Name { get; set; } = "";

    /// <summary>插件版本。</summary>

    public bool Enabled { get; set; } = true;
```

`src/DashFile.PluginApi/PluginShell.cs`:

```cs
namespace DashFile.PluginApi;

/// <summary>
/// 设备端 shell 的常用工具。插件拼命令时务必用 <see cref="Quote"/> 包住路径和用户输入，
/// 否则空格、引号、$(...) 会被 shell 解释。
/// </summary>
public static class PluginShell
{
    /// <summary>包成 POSIX 单引号字面量。</summary>
    public static string Quote(string value) => "'" + (value ?? "").Replace("'", "'\\''") + "'";

    /// <summary>远端路径拼接（POSIX 风格）。</summary>
    public static string Join(string directory, string name)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(directory)) directory = "/";
        if (directory == "/") return "/" + name;
        return directory.TrimEnd('/') + "/" + name;
    }

    public static string Parent(string path)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(path) || path == "/") return "/";
        var trimmed = path.TrimEnd('/');
        var index = trimmed.LastIndexOf('/');
        return index <= 0 ? "/" : trimmed[..index];
    }

    public static string BaseName(string path)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(path)) return "";
        var trimmed = path.TrimEnd('/');
        var index = trimmed.LastIndexOf('/');
        return index < 0 ? trimmed : trimmed[(index + 1)..];
    }
}
```

```cs
using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Avalonia.Media;
using Avalonia.Media.Imaging;
using CommunityToolkit.Mvvm.ComponentModel;

namespace DashFile.Models;

/// <summary>应用列表的一项（名称暂不解析，用包名代替）</summary>
public partial class AppItem : ObservableObject
{
    public string Package { get; init; } = "";
    public bool IsSystem { get; init; }
    public string ApkPath { get; init; } = "";

    [ObservableProperty] private string _version = "";
    [ObservableProperty] private string _label = "";
    [ObservableProperty] private bool _iconUncertain;
    [ObservableProperty] private bool _isGranted;
    [ObservableProperty] private bool _showSwitch;
    [ObservableProperty] private bool _showActions = true;
    /// <summary>当前 root 实现是否允许直接改授权表；false 时开关置灰但仍显示状态。</summary>
    [ObservableProperty] private bool _canToggleRoot = true;
    [ObservableProperty] private Bitmap? _icon;

    public bool HasIcon => Icon != null;
    partial void OnIconChanged(Bitmap? value) => OnPropertyChanged(nameof(HasIcon));

    public string Initial =>
        string.IsNullOrEmpty(Package) ? "?" : char.ToUpperInvariant(Package[0]).ToString();

    public IBrush FallbackBrush
    {
        get
        {
            // 用包名哈希稳定地取一个色相，避免每次刷新颜色乱跳
            var h = 0;
            foreach (var c in Package) h = (h * 31 + c) & 0x7FFFFFFF;
            var hue = h % 360;
            return new SolidColorBrush(ColorFromHsl(hue, 0.45, 0.45));
        }
    }

    private static Color ColorFromHsl(double h, double s, double l)
    {
        double c = (1 - Math.Abs(2 * l - 1)) * s;
        double x = c * (1 - Math.Abs((h / 60) % 2 - 1));
        double m = l - c / 2;
        double r = 0, g = 0, b = 0;
        if (h < 60) { r = c; g = x; }
        else if (h < 120) { r = x; g = c; }
        else if (h < 180) { g = c; b = x; }
        else if (h < 240) { g = x; b = c; }
        else if (h < 300) { r = x; b = c; }
        else { r = c; b = x; }
        return Color.FromRgb((byte)((r + m) * 255), (byte)((g + m) * 255), (byte)((b + m) * 255));
    }
}
```

`src/Models/BulkObservableCollection.cs`:

```cs
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Collections.ObjectModel;
using System.Collections.Specialized;
using System.ComponentModel;

namespace DashFile.Models;

/// <summary>
/// 支持"整批替换"的集合：内容换掉时只发一次 Reset 通知。
///
/// 为什么需要它：直接 <c>Clear()</c> + 循环 <c>Add()</c> 时，
///   ListBox 每收到一次 Add 就会重新度量/布局一遍。一个 800 个文件的目录
///   就是 800 次布局 —— 这就是"切目录要顿零点几秒"的主因，跟 adb 快慢无关。
///   换成一次 Reset 后，布局只跑一次。
/// </summary>
public sealed class BulkObservableCollection<T> : ObservableCollection<T>
{
    private bool _suppress;

    /// <summary>用新内容整体替换（只触发一次 Reset）</summary>
    public void ReplaceAll(IEnumerable<T> items)
    {
        _suppress = true;
        try
        {
            Items.Clear();
            foreach (var item in items) Items.Add(item);
        }
        finally
        {
            _suppress = false;
        }

        OnPropertyChanged(new PropertyChangedEventArgs(nameof(Count)));
        OnPropertyChanged(new PropertyChangedEventArgs("Item[]"));
        OnCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset));
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 把内容增量改造成 desired：按"引用身份"做最小改动（增/删/移动），
    /// 已经存在的对象一个都不重新创建，界面上的行容器也就不会被重建。
    ///
    /// 这就是目录树不卡的关键：以前每改一个展开状态就 <see cref="ReplaceAll"/>
    ///   一次（一次 Reset = 整棵树的可视元素推倒重来，200 行要 30~40ms）；
    ///   现在只对真正变动的行发一条事件，通常 0 条。
    ///
    /// 变化太大（首屏、换根）时退回整体 Reset，避免 O(n²) 的插入/移动。
    /// </summary>
    public void Patch(IReadOnlyList<T> desired)
    {
        if (desired.Count == 0)
        {
            if (Count > 0) ReplaceAll(desired);
            return;
        }

        // 先看有多少旧行能留下来：留得太少就不值得逐条改
        var want = new HashSet<T>(desired);
        var keep = 0;
        foreach (var item in this)
            if (want.Contains(item)) keep++;

        if (keep * 2 < desired.Count)
        {
            ReplaceAll(desired);
            return;
        }

        // 1) 删掉不在新列表里的
        for (var i = Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
            if (!want.Contains(this[i])) RemoveAt(i);

        // 2) 按顺序落位：存在的移动，不存在的插入
        for (var i = 0; i < desired.Count; i++)
        {
            if (i < Count && ReferenceEquals(this[i], desired[i])) continue;

            var existing = IndexOf(desired[i]);
            if (existing < 0) Insert(i, desired[i]);
            else if (existing != i) Move(existing, i);
        }

        // 3) 兜底：绝不允许残留（之前用前后缀比对时就是因为残留多出旧行）
        while (Count > desired.Count) RemoveAt(Count - 1);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 把内容增量同步成 items：只对真正变化的中段发 Remove / Insert，
    /// 前后没变的部分一个事件都不发（ItemsControl 也就不会重建它们的可视元素）。
    /// </summary>
    public void SyncTo(IList<T> items)
    {
        var max = Math.Min(Count, items.Count);

        var prefix = 0;
        while (prefix < max && EqualityComparer<T>.Default.Equals(this[prefix], items[prefix])) prefix++;

        var suffix = 0;
        while (suffix < max - prefix &&
               EqualityComparer<T>.Default.Equals(this[Count - 1 - suffix], items[items.Count - 1 - suffix]))
            suffix++;

        for (var k = 0; k < Count - prefix - suffix; k++) RemoveAt(prefix);
        for (var k = 0; k < items.Count - prefix - suffix; k++) Insert(prefix + k, items[prefix + k]);
    }

    protected override void OnCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (!_suppress) base.OnCollectionChanged(e);
    }
}
```

`src/Models/DeviceInfo.cs`:

```cs
using System;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;

namespace DashFile.Models;

public sealed class DeviceInfo
{
    public string Serial { get; init; } = "";
    public string State { get; init; } = "";
    public string Model { get; init; } = "";
    public string Product { get; init; } = "";

    public bool IsOnline => State.Equals("device", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

    public string Display
    {
        get
        {
            var m = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Model) ? Product : Model;
            var name = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(m) ? Serial : $"{m}  ·  {Serial}";
            if (!IsOnline) name += $"   [{State}]";
            return name;
        }
    }

    public override string ToString() => Display;

    public static DeviceInfo? Parse(string line)
    {
        // 1234567890abc  device product:xxx model:OPD2413 device:yyy transport_id:3
        var m = Regex.Match(line, @"^(?<serial>\S+)\s+(?<state>\S+)(?<rest>.*)$");
        if (!m.Success) return null;
        var rest = m.Groups["rest"].Value;
        string Pick(string key)
        {
            var mm = Regex.Match(rest, key + @":(?<v>\S+)");
            return mm.Success ? mm.Groups["v"].Value : "";
        }
        return new DeviceInfo
        {
            Serial = m.Groups["serial"].Value,
            State = m.Groups["state"].Value,
            Model = Pick("model"),
            Product = Pick("product"),
        };
    }
}
```

```cs
using System.Collections.ObjectModel;

/// <summary>目录树节点（懒加载子目录，展开状态一直保留）</summary>
```

`src/Models/PosixEntry.cs`:

```cs
using System;

namespace DashFile.Models;

public sealed class PosixEntry
{
    public string Name { get; init; } = "";
    public string FullPath { get; init; } = "";
    public char TypeChar { get; init; } = '-';   // d - l c b p s
    public string Perms { get; init; } = "---------";
    public string Owner { get; init; } = "";
    public string Group { get; init; } = "";
    public string Selinux { get; init; } = "";
    public long Size { get; init; }
    public DateTime Modified { get; init; }
    public string LinkTarget { get; init; } = "";

    public bool IsDir => TypeChar == 'd';
    public bool IsLink => TypeChar == 'l';
    public bool IsExec => Perms.Length == 9 && Perms[2] == 'x';

    /// <summary>是不是 zip 压缩包（小写比较，忽略结尾空格）</summary>
    public bool IsZip => !IsDir && !IsLink &&
        Name.TrimEnd().EndsWith(".zip", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

    public string Kind => TypeChar switch
    {
        'd' => "目录",
        '-' => "文件",
        'l' => "链接",
        'c' => "字符设备",
        'b' => "块设备",
        'p' => "管道",
        's' => "套接字",
        _ => "其它"
    };

    public string DisplayName
    {
        get
        {
            if (IsLink && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(LinkTarget)) return $"{Name} → {LinkTarget}";
            return Name;
        }
    }

    public string SizeText
    {
        get
        {
            if (IsDir) return "";
            if (Size < 1024) return Size + " B";
            double v = Size;
            string[] u = { "KB", "MB", "GB", "TB" };
            int i = -1;
            while (v >= 1024 && i < u.Length - 1) { v /= 1024; i++; }
            return v.ToString(v >= 100 ? "0" : v >= 10 ? "0.0" : "0.00") + " " + u[i];
        }
    }

    public string ModifiedText => Modified == DateTime.MinValue ? "" : Modified.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm");

    /// <summary>
    /// 把 ls 的权限串还原成八进制。
    /// 以前把 s/S/t/T 一律当"有执行位"算，结果 setuid 文件显示 755 而不是 4755，
    ///   和权限对话框（PermissionDialog 正确解析特殊位）对不上。
    ///   小写 s/t = 特殊位 + 执行位；大写 S/T = 只有特殊位。
    /// </summary>
    public string ModeOctal
    {
        get
        {
            if (Perms.Length != 9) return "000";

            var special = 0;
            if (Perms[2] is 's' or 'S') special += 4;
            if (Perms[5] is 's' or 'S') special += 2;
            if (Perms[8] is 't' or 'T') special += 1;

            bool ExecAt(int i) => Perms[i] is 'x' or 's' or 't';

            int Triplet(int start)
            {
                var v = 0;
                if (Perms[start] == 'r') v += 4;
                if (Perms[start + 1] == 'w') v += 2;
                if (ExecAt(start + 2)) v += 1;
                return v;
            }

            var body = Triplet(0) * 100 + Triplet(3) * 10 + Triplet(6);
            return special > 0
                ? (special * 1000 + body).ToString("0000")
                : body.ToString("000");
        }
    }

    /// <summary>面向用户的类型描述（文件夹 / SH 脚本 / PNG 图片 …）</summary>
    public string TypeText
    {
        get
        {
            if (IsDir) return "文件夹";
            if (IsLink) return "符号链接";
            var n = Name.ToLowerInvariant();
            var ext = n.Contains('.') ? n[(n.LastIndexOf('.') + 1)..] : "";
            return ext switch
            {
                "sh" or "bash" or "zsh" => "SH 脚本",
                "txt" => "文本文档",
                "log" => "日志文件",
                "md" => "Markdown 文档",
                "json" => "JSON 文件",
                "xml" => "XML 文件",
                "ini" or "conf" or "cfg" or "prop" => "配置文件",
                "png" => "PNG 图片",
                "jpg" or "jpeg" => "JPEG 图片",
                "webp" => "WebP 图片",
                "gif" => "GIF 图片",
                "svg" => "SVG 矢量图",
                "mp4" => "MP4 视频",
                "mkv" => "MKV 视频",
                "mp3" => "MP3 音频",
                "wav" => "WAV 音频",
                "flac" => "FLAC 音频",
                "apk" => "APK 安装包",
                "apks" or "xapk" or "apkm" => "APK 合集",
                "zip" => "ZIP 压缩包",
                "rar" => "RAR 压缩包",
                "7z" => "7Z 压缩包",
                "tar" => "TAR 归档",
                "gz" or "tgz" => "GZ 压缩包",
                "so" => "共享库",
                "ko" => "内核模块",
                "img" => "镜像文件",
                "dex" => "DEX 字节码",
                "bin" => "二进制文件",
                "" => "文件",
                _ => ext.ToUpperInvariant() + " 文件",
            };
        }
    }

    /// <summary>精确字节数（属性面板用）</summary>
    public string SizeFull => IsDir ? "—" : $"{Size:N0} 字节（{SizeText}）";
}
```

`src/Program.cs`:

```cs
using System;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using System.Threading;
using Avalonia;
using DashFile.Services;

namespace DashFile;

internal static class Program
{
    private static Mutex? _mutex;

    [STAThread]
    public static void Main(string[] args)
    {
        // 单实例：第二次双击只激活已有窗口，避免两个进程抢 adb server / 图标缓存 / settings.json
        _mutex = new Mutex(true, "Local\\DashFile.SingleInstance", out var createdNew);
        if (!createdNew)
        {
            ActivateExisting();
            return;
        }

        try
        {
            AppLog.Add("应用启动 v" + AppInfo.Version);
            BuildAvaloniaApp().StartWithClassicDesktopLifetime(args);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Console.Error.WriteLine(ex);
            App.WriteCrash("Main", ex);
            throw;
        }
        finally
        {
            try { _mutex.ReleaseMutex(); } catch { }
            _mutex.Dispose();
        }
    }

    private static void ActivateExisting()
    {
        try
        {
            foreach (var p in Process.GetProcessesByName("DashFile"))
            {
                if (p.Id == Environment.ProcessId) continue;
                var h = p.MainWindowHandle;
                if (h == IntPtr.Zero) continue;
                ShowWindow(h, 9);            // SW_RESTORE
                SetForegroundWindow(h);
                return;
            }
        }
        catch { }
    }

    [DllImport("user32.dll")] private static extern bool SetForegroundWindow(IntPtr hWnd);
    [DllImport("user32.dll")] private static extern bool ShowWindow(IntPtr hWnd, int nCmdShow);

    public static AppBuilder BuildAvaloniaApp()
        => AppBuilder.Configure<App>()
            .UsePlatformDetect()
            .LogToTrace();
}
```

`src/Services/AdbClient.cs`:

```cs
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using DashFile.Models;

namespace DashFile.Services;

public sealed class AdbClient
{
    private readonly AdbRunner _adb;
    public AdbClient(AdbRunner adb) => _adb = adb;

    public async Task<(bool ok, string message)> EnsureServerAsync(CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        // 关键：如果已经有 adb server 在跑，就不要再去 start-server
        //   否则 adb 客户端版本不一致时会杀掉旧服务，导致设备掉线且必须重新插拔
        try
        {
            using var probe = new System.Net.Sockets.TcpClient();
            using var timeout = new CancellationTokenSource(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(300));
            // 旧写法 Task.WhenAny(connect, Delay) 超时后 connect 被弃置，socket 释放时
            //   会抛 SocketException(995)，变成未观察的 Task 异常（crash-*.log 的根因）。
            //   这里让 ConnectAsync 自己带 300ms 取消，并 await 到结束再 dispose。
            await probe.ConnectAsync("127.0.0.1", 5037, timeout.Token).ConfigureAwait(false);
            if (probe.Connected)
                return (true, "server already running");
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException) { }
        catch (System.Net.Sockets.SocketException) { }

        var r = await _adb.RunAsync(new[] { "start-server" }, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        return (r.Ok, r.All.Trim());
    }

    public async Task<List<DeviceInfo>> ListDevicesAsync(CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var list = new List<DeviceInfo>();
        var r = await _adb.RunAsync(new[] { "devices", "-l" }, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        foreach (var raw in r.StdOut.Split('\n'))
        {
            var line = raw.TrimEnd('\r').Trim();
            if (line.Length == 0) continue;
            if (line.StartsWith("List of devices", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) continue;
            if (line.StartsWith("*")) continue;
            var d = DeviceInfo.Parse(line);
            if (d != null) list.Add(d);
        }
        return list;
    }

    public async Task<string> GetPropAsync(string serial, string key, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var r = await _adb.RunAsync(new[] { "-s", serial, "shell", "getprop", key }, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        return r.StdOut.Trim();
    }

    /// <summary>adb server 可能卡在陈旧状态（设备已插但列表为空），需要重启服务</summary>
    public async Task ResetServerAsync(CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        await _adb.RunAsync(new[] { "kill-server" }, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        try { await Task.Delay(500, ct).ConfigureAwait(false); } catch { }
        await _adb.RunAsync(new[] { "start-server" }, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        try { await Task.Delay(800, ct).ConfigureAwait(false); } catch { }
    }
}
```

`src/Services/AdbLocator.cs`:

```cs
using System;
using System.IO;

namespace DashFile.Services;

public static class AdbLocator
{
    /// <summary>优先使用 exe 同目录下的 adb.exe（便携包），否则回退到 PATH</summary>
    public static string Resolve()
    {
        try
        {
            var dir = AppContext.BaseDirectory;
            foreach (var d in new[]
            {
                Path.Combine(dir, "Binaries", "Adb"),
                Path.Combine(dir, "Binaries"),
                dir,
                Path.Combine(dir, "tools"),
            })
            {
                var exe = Path.Combine(d, "adb.exe");
                if (File.Exists(exe)) return exe;
                var bin = Path.Combine(d, "adb");
                if (File.Exists(bin)) return bin;
            }
        }
        catch { /* ignore */ }
        return "adb";
    }
}
```

`src/Services/AdbRunner.cs`:

```cs
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.IO;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace DashFile.Services;

public sealed record ProcResult(int ExitCode, string StdOut, string StdErr)
{
    public bool Ok => ExitCode == 0;
    public string All => (StdOut ?? "") + (StdErr ?? "");
}

public sealed class AdbRunner
{
    public string AdbPath { get; }

    public AdbRunner(string adbPath) => AdbPath = adbPath;

    private ProcessStartInfo Base(IEnumerable<string> args, bool utf8)
    {
        var psi = new ProcessStartInfo(AdbPath)
        {
            RedirectStandardOutput = true,
            RedirectStandardError = true,
            UseShellExecute = false,
            CreateNoWindow = true,
        };
        if (utf8)
        {
            psi.StandardOutputEncoding = Encoding.UTF8;
            psi.StandardErrorEncoding = Encoding.UTF8;
        }
        foreach (var a in args) psi.ArgumentList.Add(a);
        return psi;
    }

    /// <summary>普通命令的超时（su 弹授权框时会一直挂着，必须有兜底）</summary>
    public TimeSpan Timeout { get; set; } = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(20);

    /// <summary>大文件传输（push/pull/install）用的超时：20 秒会杀掉正常安装</summary>
    public TimeSpan TransferTimeout { get; set; } = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(30);

    public Task<ProcResult> RunAsync(IEnumerable<string> args, CancellationToken ct = default)
        => RunAsync(args, Timeout, ct);

    /// <summary>指定本次超时（传输类命令用 TransferTimeout，别被普通命令的 20 秒兜底误杀）</summary>
    public async Task<ProcResult> RunAsync(IEnumerable<string> args, TimeSpan timeout, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        Process? p = null;
        using var linked = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(ct);
        if (timeout > TimeSpan.Zero) linked.CancelAfter(timeout);
        var token = linked.Token;

        try
        {
            p = Process.Start(Base(args, true));
            if (p == null) return new ProcResult(-1, "", "无法启动 adb");
            var so = p.StandardOutput.ReadToEndAsync(token);
            var se = p.StandardError.ReadToEndAsync(token);
            await p.WaitForExitAsync(token).ConfigureAwait(false);
            return new ProcResult(p.ExitCode, await so.ConfigureAwait(false), await se.ConfigureAwait(false));
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException) when (!ct.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
            try { p?.Kill(true); } catch { }
            return new ProcResult(-1, "", timeout > TimeSpan.Zero && timeout < TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1)
                ? $"命令超时（{timeout.TotalSeconds:0}s）：可能手机正在等待授权，或设备无响应"
                : $"命令超时（{timeout.TotalMinutes:0.#} 分钟）：设备长时间无响应");
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException)
        {
            try { p?.Kill(true); } catch { }
            throw;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            return new ProcResult(-1, "", ex.Message);
        }
        finally
        {
            p?.Dispose();
        }
    }

    /// <summary>下载用，给足时间（大文件），但仍防止无限挂起</summary>
    public TimeSpan ExecTimeout { get; set; } = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(10);

    /// <summary>安装 APK 用：比普通传输短（等 su 授权弹窗时用户能更早看到失败），但远大于 20 秒</summary>
    public TimeSpan InstallTimeout { get; set; } = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(10);

    /// <summary>最近一次 ExecOutAsync 的 stderr（成功时也可能有 warning，失败时才是关键线索）</summary>
    public string LastExecError { get; private set; } = "";

    /// <summary>最近一次 ExecOutAsync 的退出码（进程没起来/超时为 -1）</summary>
    public int LastExecExitCode { get; private set; }

    public async Task<byte[]> ExecOutAsync(IEnumerable<string> args, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        Process? p = null;
        using var linked = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(ct);
        if (ExecTimeout > TimeSpan.Zero) linked.CancelAfter(ExecTimeout);
        var token = linked.Token;
        LastExecError = "";
        LastExecExitCode = 0;

        try
        {
            p = Process.Start(Base(args, false));
            if (p == null) { LastExecExitCode = -1; LastExecError = "无法启动 adb"; return Array.Empty<byte>(); }
            using var ms = new MemoryStream();
            // 必须同时排空 stderr：Base() 里 RedirectStandardError=true，不读就会写满管道缓冲，
            //   子进程卡在写错误输出上，直到 10 分钟超时才被 Kill —— 而 su/cat 的真实报错也全丢了。
            var errTask = p.StandardError.ReadToEndAsync(token);
            await p.StandardOutput.BaseStream.CopyToAsync(ms, token).ConfigureAwait(false);
            await p.WaitForExitAsync(token).ConfigureAwait(false);
            LastExecError = await errTask.ConfigureAwait(false);
            LastExecExitCode = p.ExitCode;
            return ms.ToArray();
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException) when (!ct.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
            try { p?.Kill(true); } catch { }
            LastExecExitCode = -1;
            LastExecError = $"读取超时（{ExecTimeout.TotalMinutes:0} 分钟）";
            throw new TimeoutException(LastExecError);
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException)
        {
            try { p?.Kill(true); } catch { }
            throw;
        }
        finally
        {
            p?.Dispose();
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 边执行边回传输出（用于刷模块时滚动日志）。
    /// 必须也有超时：以前只依赖外部 ct，刷入脚本卡住（等音量键、等 su 授权）时
    ///   进程会一直挂着，用户只能强关窗口；这里复用 ExecTimeout 兜底。
    /// </summary>
    public async Task<int> RunStreamingAsync(IEnumerable<string> args, Action<string> onLine, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        Process? p = null;
        using var linked = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(ct);
        if (ExecTimeout > TimeSpan.Zero) linked.CancelAfter(ExecTimeout);
        var timedOut = false;
        try
        {
            var psi = Base(args, true);
            psi.RedirectStandardOutput = true;
            psi.RedirectStandardError = true;

            p = new Process { StartInfo = psi, EnableRaisingEvents = true };
            p.OutputDataReceived += (_, e) => { if (e.Data != null) onLine(e.Data); };
            p.ErrorDataReceived += (_, e) => { if (e.Data != null) onLine(e.Data); };

            p.Start();
            p.BeginOutputReadLine();
            p.BeginErrorReadLine();
            await p.WaitForExitAsync(linked.Token).ConfigureAwait(false);
            return p.ExitCode;
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException)
        {
            timedOut = !ct.IsCancellationRequested;
            try { p?.Kill(true); } catch { }
            if (timedOut)
                onLine($"× 执行超时（{ExecTimeout.TotalMinutes:0} 分钟），已终止");
            return -1;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            onLine("执行出错：" + ex.Message);
            return -1;
        }
        finally { p?.Dispose(); }
    }
}
```

```cs
using System;

namespace DashFile.Services;

/// <summary>
/// 调试 / 启动参数集中收口。以前 "DASHFILE_PERF"、"DASHFILE_START_TAB" 等
/// 字符串散在 4 个文件里，改名字要全局搜；现在只在这里定义。
/// </summary>
public static class AppEnvironment
{
    public const string PerfVariable = "DASHFILE_PERF";
    public const string StartTabVariable = "DASHFILE_START_TAB";
    public const string StartPathVariable = "DASHFILE_START_PATH";
    public const string IconDebugVariable = "DASHFILE_ICON_DEBUG";
    public const string PluginDebugVariable = "DASHFILE_PLUGIN_DEBUG";
    public const string AppModeVariable = "DASHFILE_APP_MODE";

    public static readonly bool Perf = IsOn(PerfVariable);
    public static readonly bool IconDebug = IsOn(IconDebugVariable);
    public static readonly bool PluginDebug = IsOn(PluginDebugVariable);

    public static readonly int? StartTab = ParseStartTab();
    public static readonly int? AppMode = ParseAppMode();
    public static readonly string StartPath = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable(StartPathVariable) ?? "";

    private static bool IsOn(string name)
        => string.Equals(Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable(name), "1", StringComparison.Ordinal);

    private static int? ParseStartTab()
        => int.TryParse(Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable(StartTabVariable), out var value) &&
           value is >= 0 and <= 5
            ? value
            : null;

    private static int? ParseAppMode()
        => int.TryParse(Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable(AppModeVariable), out var value) &&
           value is >= 0 and <= 2
            ? value
            : null;
}
```

`src/Services/AppLog.cs`:

```cs
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Text;

namespace DashFile.Services;

/// <summary>
/// 运行日志环形缓冲 + 落盘（Log\runtime.log）。
/// 崩溃日志会带上最近 20 条操作，事后能看出是"连接 / 删除 / 模块 / 插件"哪一步出的事。
/// </summary>
public static class AppLog
{
    private const int Keep = 80;
    private const long MaxBytes = 2 * 1024 * 1024;
    private static readonly object Gate = new();
    private static readonly Queue<string> Recent = new();
    private static string? _lastRaw;
    private static DateTime _lastAt;

    public static string FilePath
    {
        get
        {
            var dir = Path.Combine(AppContext.BaseDirectory, "Log");
            Directory.CreateDirectory(dir);
            return Path.Combine(dir, "runtime.log");
        }
    }

    public static void Add(string message)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(message)) return;
        var raw = message.Trim();
        var line = "[" + DateTime.Now.ToString("HH:mm:ss") + "] " + raw;
        lock (Gate)
        {
            // 1 秒一次的状态轮询会不断产生同一条命令/同一句报错：
            // 60 秒内相同的行只落一次盘，避免把真正的操作记录挤出快照。
            if (_lastRaw == raw && (DateTime.Now - _lastAt).TotalSeconds < 60) return;
            _lastRaw = raw;
            _lastAt = DateTime.Now;

            Recent.Enqueue(line);
            while (Recent.Count > Keep) Recent.Dequeue();
        }
        try
        {
            var path = FilePath;
            var info = new FileInfo(path);
            if (info.Exists && info.Length > MaxBytes)
            {
                var old = path + ".old";
                try { if (File.Exists(old)) File.Delete(old); } catch { }
                try { File.Move(path, old, true); } catch { }
            }
            File.AppendAllText(path, line + Environment.NewLine, new UTF8Encoding(false));
        }
        catch { }
    }

    public static string[] Snapshot(int count)
    {
        lock (Gate)
        {
            var all = Recent.ToArray();
            if (all.Length <= count) return all;
            var result = new string[count];
            Array.Copy(all, all.Length - count, result, 0, count);
            return result;
        }
    }
}
```

`src/Services/AppPaths.cs`:

```cs
using System;
using System.IO;

namespace DashFile.Services;

/// <summary>
/// 本机（Windows）侧的固定目录。以前这些路径散在 AppService / SuperuserService /
/// PluginHostBridge / MainViewModel 里，换目录要点很多处；现在统一从这里取。
/// </summary>
public static class AppPaths
{
    private static readonly string LocalRootCached = Path.Combine(
        Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.LocalApplicationData), "DashFile");

    /// <summary>%LOCALAPPDATA%\DashFile</summary>
    public static string LocalRoot => LocalRootCached;

    public static readonly string Icons = Path.Combine(LocalRootCached, "icons");
    public static readonly string Su = Path.Combine(LocalRootCached, "su");
    public static readonly string Labels = Path.Combine(LocalRootCached, "labels.json");
    public static readonly string Settings = Path.Combine(LocalRootCached, "settings.json");
    public static readonly string Plugins = Path.Combine(LocalRootCached, "plugins");

    /// <summary>插件数据（设置/缓存）。必须在扫描根之外，否则卸载插件时无法保留数据</summary>
    public static readonly string PluginData = Path.Combine(LocalRootCached, "plugin-data");
    public static readonly string PluginLogs = Path.Combine(LocalRootCached, "plugin-logs");

    public static string Ensure(string directory)
    {
        Directory.CreateDirectory(directory);
        return directory;
    }
}
```

`src/Services/AppService.cs`:

```cs
using System;
using System.Collections.Concurrent;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Avalonia.Media.Imaging;
using SkiaSharp;
using DashFile.Models;

namespace DashFile.Services;

/// <summary>
/// 应用列表：包名 / 版本 / 图标。
/// 全程只读：只 list / 读取 APK 内容，绝不在设备上创建任何文件；
/// 图标缓存只写本机 %LOCALAPPDATA%\DashFile\icons。
/// </summary>
public sealed class AppService
{
    private readonly RemoteFileSystem _fs;
    private readonly SemaphoreSlim _unzipGate = new(1, 1);
    private string? _unzipExe;        // 已解析出的解包程序路径
    private bool _unzipIsBusybox;

    private static readonly string CacheDir = AppPaths.Icons;

    public AppService(RemoteFileSystem fs) => _fs = fs;

    private static bool DebugIcons => AppEnvironment.IconDebug;

    private static void IconDbg(string msg)
    {
        if (!DebugIcons) return;
        try
        {
            var dir = Path.Combine(AppContext.BaseDirectory, "Log");
            Directory.CreateDirectory(dir);
            File.AppendAllText(Path.Combine(dir, "icon-debug.log"),
                DateTime.Now.ToString("HH:mm:ss.fff") + "  " + msg + Environment.NewLine);
        }
        catch { }
    }

    // ---------- 解包程序探测 ----------

    /// <summary>上次探测只是"PATH 兜底"，没找到真程序：root 就绪后要允许再探一次</summary>
    private bool _unzipFallback;

    private async Task EnsureUnzipAsync(CancellationToken ct)
    {
        // 以前只要 _unzipExe 非空就永久返回：第一次取图标发生在 su 授权之前时，
        //   探测必然失败并缓存 "unzip"，之后整场会话都取不到图标（设备上没有 unzip 这个名字）。
        if (_unzipExe != null && !(_unzipFallback && _fs.UseRoot)) return;

        // 370 个应用会在并发任务里同时调到这里；不加锁会重复探测 unzip（每个 80ms）。
        await _unzipGate.WaitAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        try
        {
            if (_unzipExe != null) return;

            // 只读探测：系统 unzip 优先，其次各 Root 实现的 busybox
            foreach (var candidate in new[]
                     {
                         DevicePaths.SystemBin + "/unzip",
                         DevicePaths.KsuBusybox,
                         DevicePaths.MagiskBusybox,
                         DevicePaths.ApdBusybox,
                     })
            {
                var r = await _fs.RunCommandAsync($"if [ -x {Sh.Q(candidate)} ]; then echo YES; fi", false, ct)
                                  .ConfigureAwait(false);
                if (r.Contains("YES"))
                {
                    _unzipExe = candidate;
                    _unzipIsBusybox = candidate.EndsWith("busybox", StringComparison.Ordinal);
                    _unzipFallback = false;
                    return;
                }
            }

            // 兜底：交给 PATH（标记为 fallback，root 就绪后还会重试真程序）
            if (_unzipExe == null)
            {
                _unzipExe = "unzip";
                _unzipFallback = true;
            }
        }
        finally
        {
            _unzipGate.Release();
        }
    }

    private string UnzipCmd(string rest) =>
        _unzipIsBusybox ? $"{_unzipExe} unzip {rest}" : $"{_unzipExe} {rest}";

    // ---------- 列表 ----------

    /// <summary>列出全部应用（用户+系统），超级用户页用</summary>
    public Task<List<AppItem>> ListAllAsync(CancellationToken ct = default) => ListAsync(false, ct, true);

    public async Task<List<AppItem>> ListAsync(bool system, CancellationToken ct = default, bool all = false)
    {
        var flag = all ? "" : (system ? "-s" : "-3");

        // 两段式的第一段：一次调用就把包名、APK 路径、versionCode 全拿回来。
        //   versionCode 不是给人看的（我们显示的是 versionName），但能让列表"立刻有版本号"，
        //   不用等每个应用各跑一次 dumpsys（那才是慢的根源：每个 100ms 左右）。
        var raw = await _fs.RunCommandAsync($"pm list packages {flag} -f --show-versioncode 2>/dev/null", false, ct)
                           .ConfigureAwait(false);

        // 老系统不支持 --show-versioncode 时，退回不带版本号的写法（第二段照样会补上）
        if (!raw.Contains("versionCode:", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            raw = await _fs.RunCommandAsync($"pm list packages {flag} -f 2>/dev/null", false, ct)
                               .ConfigureAwait(false);

        var list = new List<AppItem>();
        foreach (var line in raw.Split('\n'))
        {
            var t = line.Trim();
            if (!t.StartsWith("package:", StringComparison.Ordinal)) continue;

            var body = t[8..].Trim();          // /path/base.apk=com.foo versionCode:123

            var code = "";
            var mc = Regex.Match(body, @"\s+versionCode:(\d+)\s*$");
            if (mc.Success)
            {
                code = mc.Groups[1].Value;
                body = body[..mc.Index].Trim();
            }

            var eq = body.LastIndexOf('=');
            if (eq <= 0) continue;

            var apk = body[..eq].Trim();
            var pkg = body[(eq + 1)..].Trim();
            if (pkg.Length == 0) continue;

            list.Add(new AppItem
            {
                Package = pkg,
                IsSystem = system,
                ApkPath = apk,
                Version = code.Length > 0 ? "v" + code : ""      // 先给个占位版本，第二段会换成 versionName
            });
        }
        return list.OrderBy(x => x.Package, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase).ToList();
    }

    /// <summary>读取应用详情（全部来自 dumpsys package，只读）</summary>
    public async Task<List<(string Label, string Value)>> GetDetailsAsync(string pkg, string apk,
        CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var rows = new List<(string, string)>();
        string dump = "";
        try
        {
            dump = await _fs.RunCommandAsync($"dumpsys package {Sh.Q(pkg)}", false, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
        catch { }

        string Get(string pattern, string def = "—")
        {
            var m = Regex.Match(dump, pattern);
            return m.Success ? m.Groups[1].Value.Trim() : def;
        }

        var versionName = Get(@"versionName=(\S+)");
        var versionCode = Get(@"versionCode=(\d+)");
        var minSdk = Get(@"minSdk=(\d+)");
        var targetSdk = Get(@"targetSdk=(\d+)");
        var uid = Get(@"userId=(\d+)", "");
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(uid))
        {
            try
            {
                var st = await _fs.RunCommandAsync(
                    $"stat -c %u {Sh.Q(DevicePaths.UserData(pkg))} 2>/dev/null", false, ct)
                    .ConfigureAwait(false);
                var mu = Regex.Match(st, @"(?m)^\s*(\d+)\s*$");
                if (mu.Success) uid = mu.Groups[1].Value;
            }
            catch { }
        }
        var dataDir = Get(@"dataDir=(\S+)");
        var codePath = Get(@"codePath=(\S+)");
        var firstInstall = Get(@"firstInstallTime=(.+)");
        var lastUpdate = Get(@"lastUpdateTime=(.+)");

        // 安装包大小
        var sizeText = "—";
        try
        {
            var stat = await _fs.RunCommandAsync($"stat -c %s {Sh.Q(apk)} 2>/dev/null", false, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            var mm = Regex.Match(stat, @"(?m)^\s*(\d+)\s*$");
            if (mm.Success) sizeText = FormatBytes(long.Parse(mm.Groups[1].Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
        }
        catch { }

        // 签名（dumpsys 里的 signatures 是一串哈希）
        var sig = "—";
        var sigMatch = Regex.Match(dump, @"signatures=PackageSignatures\{[^\[]*\[([0-9a-fA-F]+)\]");
        if (sigMatch.Success) sig = "已签名（" + sigMatch.Groups[1].Value[..Math.Min(16, sigMatch.Groups[1].Value.Length)] + "…）";
        else if (dump.Contains("signatures=null")) sig = "未签名";

        // 加固检测：常见加固厂商的 so / dex
        var packed = "未检测到加固";
        try
        {
            var listing = await _fs.RunCommandAsync(
                UnzipCmd($"-l {Sh.Q(apk)}") + " 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'libjiagu|libshell|libDexHelper|libmobisec|libtup|libnesec|libexec.so|libprotect' | head -3",
                false, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(listing) && !listing.Contains("[退出码]", StringComparison.Ordinal))
            {
                var line = listing.Split('\n').FirstOrDefault(l => l.Contains("/"));
                if (line != null) packed = "疑似加固：" + line.Trim().Split(' ').Last();
            }
        }
        catch { }

        rows.Add(("包名", pkg));
        rows.Add(("版本", string.IsNullOrEmpty(versionCode) ? versionName : $"{versionName}（{versionCode}）"));
        rows.Add(("安装包大小", sizeText));
        rows.Add(("签名状态", sig));
        rows.Add(("加固状态", packed));
        rows.Add(("目标系统", string.IsNullOrEmpty(targetSdk) ? "—" : $"API {targetSdk}"));
        rows.Add(("最低系统", string.IsNullOrEmpty(minSdk) ? "—" : $"API {minSdk}"));
        rows.Add(("数据目录 1", string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataDir) ? "—" : dataDir));
        rows.Add(("数据目录 2", string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataDir)
            ? "—"
            : dataDir.Replace(DevicePaths.UserDataRoot + "/", DevicePaths.UserDeDataRoot + "/")));
        rows.Add(("APK 路径", string.IsNullOrEmpty(apk) ? "—" : apk));
        rows.Add(("首次安装", string.IsNullOrEmpty(firstInstall) ? "—" : firstInstall));
        rows.Add(("最后更新", string.IsNullOrEmpty(lastUpdate) ? "—" : lastUpdate));
        rows.Add(("UID", string.IsNullOrEmpty(uid) ? "—" : uid));

        _ = codePath;
        return rows;
    }

    private static string FormatBytes(long bytes)
    {
        string[] unit = { "B", "KB", "MB", "GB" };
        double v = bytes;
        var i = 0;
        while (v >= 1024 && i < unit.Length - 1) { v /= 1024; i++; }
        return $"{v:0.#} {unit[i]}";
    }

    // 并发任务会同时读写标签缓存；Dictionary 并发写会损坏内部结构，改用 ConcurrentDictionary。
    private static readonly ConcurrentDictionary<string, string> LabelCache = new(StringComparer.Ordinal);
    private static readonly object LabelSaveLock = new();
    private static int _labelsLoaded;
    private static int _dirtyLabels;

    private static string LabelFile => AppPaths.Labels;

    private static void LoadLabels()
    {
        if (Interlocked.Exchange(ref _labelsLoaded, 1) == 1) return;
        try
        {
            if (!File.Exists(LabelFile)) return;
            var json = File.ReadAllText(LabelFile);
            var map = System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Deserialize<Dictionary<string, string>>(json);
            if (map != null)
                foreach (var kv in map) LabelCache[kv.Key] = kv.Value;
        }
        catch { }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 以前每解析出一个新名称就重写一次 labels.json（370 个应用 = 370 次全量写文件）。
    /// 现在每 20 个新名称写一次，退出时由 FlushLabels 兜底。
    /// </summary>
    private static void SaveLabels()
    {
        lock (LabelSaveLock)
        {
            try
            {
                Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(LabelFile)!);
                var snapshot = LabelCache.ToDictionary(kv => kv.Key, kv => kv.Value, StringComparer.Ordinal);
                AtomicFile.WriteAllText(LabelFile, System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(snapshot));
            }
            catch (Exception ex) { AppLog.Add("写标签缓存失败：" + ex.Message); }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>退出时调用，把不足 20 个的增量也落盘。</summary>
    public static void FlushLabels()
    {
        if (Interlocked.Exchange(ref _dirtyLabels, 0) > 0) SaveLabels();
    }

    /// <summary>解析应用显示名称（android:label → resources.arsc 字符串）</summary>
    public async Task<string> GetLabelAsync(string pkg, string apk, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        LoadLabels();
        if (LabelCache.TryGetValue(pkg, out var cached) && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(cached)) return cached;

        await EnsureUnzipAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);   // 必须先探到解包程序

        string? label = null;
        try
        {
            var manifest = await ReadEntryAsync(apk, "AndroidManifest.xml", ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            if (manifest.Length > 8)
            {
                var (id, lit) = AxmlManifestResolver.FindAttr(manifest, "application", "label");
                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(lit)) label = lit;
                else if (id != 0)
                {
                    var arsc = await ReadEntryAsync(apk, "resources.arsc", ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
                    label = ArscIconResolver.ResolveString(arsc, id);
                }
            }
        }
        catch { }

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(label))
        {
            var parts = pkg.Split('.');
            label = parts.Length > 0 ? parts[^1] : pkg;
        }

        LabelCache[pkg] = label!;
        // 每 20 个新增写一次；剩下的由 FlushLabels 在退出时落盘
        if (Interlocked.Increment(ref _dirtyLabels) >= 20)
        {
            Interlocked.Exchange(ref _dirtyLabels, 0);
            SaveLabels();
        }
        return label!;
    }

    public async Task<string> GetVersionAsync(string pkg, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        try
        {
            var raw = await _fs.RunCommandAsync(
                $"dumpsys package {Sh.Q(pkg)} 2>/dev/null | grep -m1 versionName", false, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            var m = Regex.Match(raw, @"versionName=(\S+)");
            return m.Success ? m.Groups[1].Value : "";
        }
        catch { return ""; }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 一次 dumpsys package 拿全部 versionName。
    /// 以前 370 个系统应用 = 370 次 adb 往返（约 30 秒），现在固定 1 次；
    /// 解析失败或包很少时调用方仍可退回 GetVersionAsync。
    /// </summary>
    public async Task<Dictionary<string, string>> GetVersionsAsync(
        IReadOnlyCollection<string> packages, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var result = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
        if (packages == null || packages.Count == 0) return result;

        try
        {
            // 只回传 Package 头和 versionName 行，避免把几 MB 的 dumpsys 全量拉回电脑
            var raw = await _fs.RunCommandAsync(
                "dumpsys package 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'Package \\[|versionName='", false, ct)
                .ConfigureAwait(false);
            if (raw.Length < 32) return result;

            string? current = null;
            foreach (var rawLine in raw.Split('\n'))
            {
                var line = rawLine.Trim();
                if (line.StartsWith("Package [", StringComparison.Ordinal))
                {
                    var end = line.IndexOf(']', "Package [".Length);
                    current = end > 0 ? line["Package [".Length..end] : null;
                    continue;
                }

                if (current == null || !line.StartsWith("versionName=", StringComparison.Ordinal)) continue;
                if (result.ContainsKey(current)) continue;

                var value = line["versionName=".Length..].Trim();
                if (value.Length > 0) result[current] = value;
            }
        }
        catch { }

        return result;
    }

    // ---------- 精确取图标 ----------

    /// <summary>只读地取出 APK 内某个条目的原始字节</summary>
    private async Task<byte[]> ReadEntryAsync(string apk, string entry, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var args = _unzipIsBusybox
            ? new List<string> { "unzip", "-p", apk, entry }
            : new List<string> { "-p", apk, entry };

        var bytes = await _fs.ExecCaptureArgsAsync(_unzipExe!, args, false, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        if (bytes.Length < 8 && _fs.UseRoot)
        {
            IconDbg($"  ReadEntry({entry}) 普通权限失败({bytes.Length}B)，试 root");
            bytes = await _fs.ExecCaptureArgsAsync(_unzipExe!, args, true, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
        IconDbg($"  ReadEntry({entry}) => {bytes.Length}B head={Convert.ToHexString(bytes.AsSpan(0, Math.Min(8, bytes.Length)))}");
        return bytes;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 如果解析出来的是"自适应图标 XML"，再往下挖一层：
    /// &lt;adaptive-icon&gt;&lt;foreground android:drawable=...&gt; → 真正的图片
    /// </summary>
    private async Task<string?> FollowAsync(string apk, string? path, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(path)) return null;
        if (!path!.EndsWith(".xml", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) return path;

        try
        {
            var xml = await ReadEntryAsync(apk, path, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            if (xml.Length < 8) return null;

            var (fgId, fgStr) = AxmlManifestResolver.FindAttr(xml, "foreground", "drawable");
            var inner = fgStr;

            if (inner == null && fgId != 0)
            {
                var arsc = await ReadEntryAsync(apk, "resources.arsc", ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
                var cands = ArscIconResolver.Resolve(arsc, fgId);
                inner = cands.FirstOrDefault(c =>
                            c.Path.EndsWith(".png", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                            c.Path.EndsWith(".webp", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                            c.Path.EndsWith(".xml", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))?.Path;
            }

            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(inner)) return null;
            return inner;
        }
        catch { return null; }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 把图标 XML 渲染成位图。支持 Android 常见的 drawable 包装：
    /// vector / adaptive-icon / layer-list / inset / bitmap / color / shape
    /// </summary>
    private async Task<Bitmap?> RenderIconXmlAsync(string apk, string xmlPath, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        try
        {
            var arsc = await ReadEntryAsync(apk, "resources.arsc", ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            return await RenderDrawableAsync(apk, arsc, xmlPath, 192, 0, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
        catch { return null; }
    }

    private static bool IsImagePath(string p) =>
        p.EndsWith(".png", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
        p.EndsWith(".webp", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
        p.EndsWith(".jpg", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
        p.EndsWith(".jpeg", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

    private async Task<Bitmap?> RenderDrawableAsync(string apk, byte[] arsc, string path,
        int size, int depth, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        if (depth > 4) return null;

        if (IsImagePath(path))
        {
            var raw = await ReadEntryAsync(apk, path, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            return Decode(raw);
        }

        if (!path.EndsWith(".xml", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) return null;

        var xml = await ReadEntryAsync(apk, path, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        if (xml.Length < 8) return null;

        // ① 纯矢量
        if (VectorDrawableRenderer.IsVector(xml))
        {
            var png = VectorDrawableRenderer.RenderToPng(xml, size, id => ArscIconResolver.ResolveColor(arsc, id));
            if (png != null && HasVisiblePixels(png))
            {
                using var ms = new MemoryStream(png);
                return new Bitmap(ms);
            }
            return null;
        }

        var root = VectorDrawableRenderer.RootName(xml) ?? "";
        var attrs = AxmlManifestResolver.AllAttrs(xml);

        string? ResolvePath(uint id) =>
            ArscIconResolver.Resolve(arsc, id)
                .FirstOrDefault(c => IsImagePath(c.Path) || c.Path.EndsWith(".xml", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))?.Path;

        switch (root)
        {
            case "adaptive-icon":
                {
                    var fgId = attrs.FirstOrDefault(a => a.elem == "foreground" && a.attr == "drawable").data;
                    var bgId = attrs.FirstOrDefault(a => a.elem == "background" && a.attr == "drawable").data;
                    if (fgId == 0) return null;

                    var fgPath = ResolvePath(fgId);
                    if (fgPath == null) return null;

                    var fgBmp = await RenderDrawableAsync(apk, arsc, fgPath, size, depth + 1, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
                    if (fgBmp == null) return null;

                    uint? bgColor = bgId != 0 ? ArscIconResolver.ResolveColor(arsc, bgId) : null;
                    return ComposeAdaptive(fgBmp, bgColor, size);
                }

            case "layer-list":
                {
                    var items = attrs.Where(a => a.elem == "item" && a.attr == "drawable" && a.data != 0).ToList();
                    if (items.Count == 0) return null;

                    using var canvasBmp = new SKBitmap(size, size);
                    using var canvas = new SKCanvas(canvasBmp);
                    canvas.Clear(SKColors.Transparent);
                    var drew = false;

                    foreach (var it in items)
                    {
                        var p2 = ResolvePath(it.data);
                        if (p2 == null) continue;
                        var b = await RenderDrawableAsync(apk, arsc, p2, size, depth + 1, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
                        if (b == null) continue;
                        using var sk = ToSkBitmap(b);
                        if (sk == null) continue;
                        canvas.DrawBitmap(sk, SKRect.Create(0, 0, size, size));
                        drew = true;
                    }
                    return drew ? Encode(canvasBmp) : null;
                }

            case "inset":
                {
                    var inner = attrs.FirstOrDefault(a => a.attr == "drawable" && a.data != 0).data;
                    if (inner == 0) return null;
                    var p2 = ResolvePath(inner);
                    if (p2 == null) return null;
                    var b = await RenderDrawableAsync(apk, arsc, p2, size, depth + 1, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
                    if (b == null) return null;

                    var left = attrs.FirstOrDefault(a => a.attr == "insetLeft").data;
                    var top = attrs.FirstOrDefault(a => a.attr == "insetTop").data;
                    var right = attrs.FirstOrDefault(a => a.attr == "insetRight").data;
                    var bottom = attrs.FirstOrDefault(a => a.attr == "insetBottom").data;
                    // inset 的数值是 dimension 类型，这里按比例近似（不做单位换算）
                    var pad = Math.Min(size / 4, (int)Math.Max(left, Math.Max(top, Math.Max(right, bottom))) / 4);

                    using var canvasBmp2 = new SKBitmap(size, size);
                    using var canvas2 = new SKCanvas(canvasBmp2);
                    canvas2.Clear(SKColors.Transparent);
                    using var sk2 = ToSkBitmap(b);
                    if (sk2 == null) return null;
                    canvas2.DrawBitmap(sk2, SKRect.Create(pad, pad, size - pad * 2, size - pad * 2));
                    return Encode(canvasBmp2);
                }

            case "bitmap":
                {
                    var src = attrs.FirstOrDefault(a => a.attr == "src" && a.data != 0).data;
                    if (src == 0) return null;
                    var p2 = ResolvePath(src);
                    if (p2 == null) return null;
                    return await RenderDrawableAsync(apk, arsc, p2, size, depth + 1, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
                }

            case "color":
                {
                    var id = attrs.FirstOrDefault(a => a.attr == "color" && a.data != 0).data;
                    var col = id != 0 ? ArscIconResolver.ResolveColor(arsc, id) : null;
                    if (col == null) return null;
                    using var canvasBmp3 = new SKBitmap(size, size);
                    using var canvas3 = new SKCanvas(canvasBmp3);
                    canvas3.Clear(SkColorOf(col.Value));
                    return Encode(canvasBmp3);
                }

            default:
                return null;
        }
    }

    private static Bitmap? ComposeAdaptive(Bitmap fg, uint? bgColor, int size)
    {
        try
        {
            using var sk = ToSkBitmap(fg);
            if (sk == null) return null;

            using var canvasBmp = new SKBitmap(size, size);
            using var canvas = new SKCanvas(canvasBmp);

            var radius = size * 72f / 108f / 2f;
            using var circle = new SKPath();
            circle.AddCircle(size / 2f, size / 2f, radius);

            canvas.Save();
            canvas.ClipPath(circle, SKClipOperation.Intersect, true);
            using var bgPaint = new SKPaint
            {
                IsAntialias = true,
                Color = bgColor.HasValue ? SkColorOf(bgColor.Value) : SKColors.White
            };
            canvas.DrawRect(SKRect.Create(0, 0, size, size), bgPaint);
            canvas.DrawBitmap(sk, SKRect.Create(0, 0, size, size));
            canvas.Restore();

            return Encode(canvasBmp);
        }
        catch { return null; }
    }

    private static SKColor SkColorOf(uint argb)
    {
        var a = (byte)((argb >> 24) & 0xFF);
        if (a == 0) a = 255;
        return new SKColor((byte)((argb >> 16) & 0xFF), (byte)((argb >> 8) & 0xFF), (byte)(argb & 0xFF), a);
    }

    private static SKBitmap? ToSkBitmap(Bitmap bmp)
    {
        try
        {
            using var ms = new MemoryStream();
            bmp.Save(ms);
            return SKBitmap.Decode(ms.ToArray());
        }
        catch { return null; }
    }

    private static Bitmap? Encode(SKBitmap sk)
    {
        try
        {
            using var img = SKImage.FromBitmap(sk);
            using var data = img.Encode(SKEncodedImageFormat.Png, 100);
            using var ms = new MemoryStream(data!.ToArray());
            return new Bitmap(ms);
        }
        catch { return null; }
    }

    /// <summary>判断渲染出来的图是不是"全透明"（等于没画出来）</summary>
    private static bool HasVisiblePixels(byte[] png)
    {
        try
        {
            using var bmp = SKBitmap.Decode(png);
            if (bmp == null) return false;
            for (var y = 0; y < bmp.Height; y += 2)
                for (var x = 0; x < bmp.Width; x += 2)
                    if (bmp.GetPixel(x, y).Alpha > 8) return true;
            return false;
        }
        catch { return false; }
    }

    /// <summary>manifest 的 android:icon → resources.arsc → 图标文件路径</summary>
    private async Task<string?> ResolveIconPathAsync(string apk, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        try
        {
            var manifest = await ReadEntryAsync(apk, "AndroidManifest.xml", ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            if (manifest.Length < 8) { IconDbg("  manifest 太短"); return null; }

            var (resId, directPath) = AxmlManifestResolver.ResolveIcon(manifest);
            IconDbg($"  manifest {manifest.Length}B resId=0x{resId:x8} direct={directPath}");
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(directPath)) return await FollowAsync(apk, directPath!, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            if (resId == 0) return null;

            var arsc = await ReadEntryAsync(apk, "resources.arsc", ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            if (arsc.Length < 12) return null;

            var candidates = ArscIconResolver.Resolve(arsc, resId);
            IconDbg($"  arsc {arsc.Length}B candidates={candidates.Count} first={(candidates.Count > 0 ? candidates[0].Path : "-")}");
            var first = candidates.FirstOrDefault(c =>
                c.Path.EndsWith(".png", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                c.Path.EndsWith(".webp", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));

            return first?.Path ?? candidates.FirstOrDefault()?.Path;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            IconDbg($"  resolve icon failed: {ex.GetType().Name}: {ex.Message}");
            return null;
        }
    }

    // ---------- 图标 ----------

    public async Task<(Bitmap? bmp, bool exact)> GetIconAsync(string pkg, string? apkPath = null, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        try
        {
            Directory.CreateDirectory(CacheDir);
            EnsureCacheVersion();
            var cache = Path.Combine(CacheDir, pkg + ".png");

            var cachedExact = File.Exists(Path.ChangeExtension(cache, ".exact"));

            if (File.Exists(cache))
            {
                var cached = await File.ReadAllBytesAsync(cache, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
                if (IsPng(cached))
                {
                    try { return (new Bitmap(new MemoryStream(cached)), cachedExact); } catch { }
                }
                else
                {
                    try { File.Delete(cache); } catch { }   // 清掉以前存进去的坏数据
                }
            }

            // 负缓存：上次已经确认这个包取不到图标，短期内不再重复解析（重新解析要 unzip + 解 arsc）
            var missMarker = Path.ChangeExtension(cache, ".miss");
            try
            {
                if (File.Exists(missMarker) &&
                    DateTime.UtcNow - File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc(missMarker) < TimeSpan.FromDays(3))
                {
                    IconDbg($"[{pkg}] miss 缓存命中，跳过");
                    return (null, false);
                }
            }
            catch { }

            (Bitmap? bmp, bool exact) MarkMiss()
            {
                try { AtomicFile.WriteAllText(missMarker, DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("O")); } catch { }
                return (null, false);
            }
            void ClearMiss()
            {
                try { if (File.Exists(missMarker)) File.Delete(missMarker); } catch { }
            }

            await EnsureUnzipAsync(ct);
            IconDbg($"[{pkg}] unzip={_unzipExe} busybox={_unzipIsBusybox}");

            var apk = apkPath;
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(apk))
            {
                var pathRaw = await _fs.RunCommandAsync($"pm path {Sh.Q(pkg)} 2>/dev/null", false, ct)
                                        .ConfigureAwait(false);
                var apks = Regex.Matches(pathRaw, @"package:(\S+\.apk)");
                if (apks.Count == 0) return MarkMiss();
                apk = apks.Cast<Match>()
                          .Select(m => m.Groups[1].Value)
                          .FirstOrDefault(v => v.Contains("base.apk", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                      ?? apks[0].Groups[1].Value;
            }

            // ① 先走"精确解析"：AndroidManifest 的 icon 引用 + resources.arsc
            var exact = await ResolveIconPathAsync(apk, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            IconDbg($"[{pkg}] exact={exact ?? "(null)"} apk={apk}");
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(exact))
            {
                IconDbg($"[{pkg}] rendering xml={exact}");
#pragma warning disable CA2000 // 位图所有权交给调用方（作为 AppItem 图标显示），这里不能 Dispose
                var exactBmp = exact!.EndsWith(".xml", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                    ? await RenderIconXmlAsync(apk, exact, ct).ConfigureAwait(false)
                    : Decode(await ReadEntryAsync(apk, exact, ct).ConfigureAwait(false));
#pragma warning restore CA2000

                IconDbg($"[{pkg}] exactBmp={(exactBmp == null ? "null" : exactBmp.PixelSize.Width + "px")}");
                if (exactBmp != null && exactBmp.PixelSize.Width >= 24)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        using var ms0 = new MemoryStream();
                        exactBmp.Save(ms0);
                        AtomicFile.WriteAllBytes(cache, ms0.ToArray());
                        AtomicFile.WriteAllText(Path.ChangeExtension(cache, ".exact"), "1");
                    }
                    catch (Exception ex) { AppLog.Add("写图标缓存失败：" + ex.Message); }
                    ClearMiss();
                    return (exactBmp, true);
                }
            }

            // ② 解析不出来再退回"按文件名打分"
            var listing = await _fs.RunCommandAsync(
                UnzipCmd($"-l {Sh.Q(apk)}") + " 2>/dev/null | grep -iE '\\.(png|webp)'", false, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);

            string? best = null;
            var bestScore = int.MinValue;
            var bestSize = -1L;

            foreach (var line in listing.Split('\n'))
            {
                var mm = Regex.Match(line.Trim(), @"^(\d+)\s+\S+\s+\S+\s+(.+)$");
                if (!mm.Success) continue;

                var size = long.Parse(mm.Groups[1].Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
                var name = mm.Groups[2].Value.Trim();
                if (!name.EndsWith(".png", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) &&
                    !name.EndsWith(".webp", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) continue;

                var score = ScoreIcon(name);
                if (score < 0) continue;                        // 明确不是应用图标
                if (score == 0) continue;

                // 同分时取分辨率更高的（体积更大）。以前写的是 size > 0 —— 恒真，
                //   等价于"同分取最后一个"，而同分图标极常见（同一张图多套密度）。
                if (score > bestScore || (score == bestScore && size > bestSize))
                {
                    bestScore = score;
                    bestSize = size;
                    best = name;
                }
            }
            if (best == null) return (null, false);

            // argv 直传：参数分开给，不要加引号（没有 shell 参与）
            var args = _unzipIsBusybox
                ? new List<string> { "unzip", "-p", apk, best }
                : new List<string> { "-p", apk, best };

            // 先用普通权限（快），拿不到再提权
            var bytes = await _fs.ExecCaptureArgsAsync(_unzipExe!, args, false, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            if (!IsPng(bytes) && !IsWebp(bytes) && _fs.UseRoot)
                bytes = await _fs.ExecCaptureArgsAsync(_unzipExe!, args, true, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);

#pragma warning disable CA2000 // 同上：这张位图要交给 UI 显示，所有权不在这里
            var bmp = Decode(bytes);
#pragma warning restore CA2000
            if (bmp == null) return MarkMiss();                      // 防止把报错文本当图片
            if (bmp.PixelSize.Width < 24) return MarkMiss();         // 太小的多半是占位图

            // 统一转成 PNG 缓存（WebP 也能存）；这是猜出来的，必须清掉旧的 exact 标记
            try
            {
                using var ms = new MemoryStream();
                bmp.Save(ms);
                await File.WriteAllBytesAsync(cache, ms.ToArray(), ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
                File.Delete(Path.ChangeExtension(cache, ".exact"));
            }
            catch { }

            ClearMiss();
            return (bmp, false);      // 走到这里说明是"猜"出来的，标记为可能不准
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            IconDbg($"[{pkg}] icon failed: {ex.GetType().Name}: {ex.Message}");
            return (null, false);   // 异常不写负缓存：下次还有机会重试
        }
    }

    private static readonly object CacheVersionLock = new();
    private static bool _cacheVersionChecked;

    /// <summary>
    /// 缓存版本只做记录，不再删文件：图标读过一次就一直留着，刷新时同包名直接命中。
    /// 确实坏掉的旧数据由 GetIconAsync 里的 IsPng 检查就地清掉，不必整目录重来。
    /// </summary>
    private static void EnsureCacheVersion()
    {
        // 每个图标都 stat 一次 marker 太浪费；进程内只检查一次
        if (_cacheVersionChecked) return;

        lock (CacheVersionLock)
        {
            if (_cacheVersionChecked) return;
            try
            {
                var marker = Path.Combine(CacheDir, ".v9");
                if (!File.Exists(marker)) AtomicFile.WriteAllText(marker, "9");
            }
            catch (Exception ex) { AppLog.Add("写图标缓存版本标记失败：" + ex.Message); }
            finally { _cacheVersionChecked = true; }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 图标候选打分：优先 mipmap + 名字含 launcher + 高密度；
    /// 排除 adaptive 图标的部件（background/foreground）和通知/启动图。
    /// </summary>
    private static int ScoreIcon(string name)
    {
        var low = name.ToLowerInvariant();
        if (!low.Contains("launcher") && !low.Contains("ic_")) return 0;

        // 明确不是"应用图标"的东西
        if (low.Contains("background") ||
            low.Contains("notification") || low.Contains("splash") ||
            low.Contains("banner") || low.Contains("logo_") ||
            low.Contains("shortcut") || low.Contains("status"))
            return -1;

        // 自适应图标的"前景层"：单独拿出来也是能认出的 Logo，作为次选
        if (low.Contains("foreground")) return 25;

        var score = 10;

        if (low.Contains("launcher")) score += 100;
        if (low.Contains("mipmap")) score += 60;
        else if (low.Contains("drawable")) score += 10;

        if (low.Contains("xxxhdpi")) score += 40;
        else if (low.Contains("xxhdpi")) score += 30;
        else if (low.Contains("xhdpi")) score += 20;
        else if (low.Contains("hdpi")) score += 10;
        else if (low.Contains("mdpi")) score += 5;

        if (low.Contains("ic_launcher.") || low.EndsWith("/ic_launcher.png")) score += 50;
        if (low.Contains("round")) score -= 5;      // 圆形版本通常更小/带透明边

        return score;
    }

    private static bool IsPng(byte[] b) =>
        b.Length > 64 && b[0] == 0x89 && b[1] == 0x50 && b[2] == 0x4E && b[3] == 0x47;

    private static bool IsWebp(byte[] b) =>
        b.Length > 64 && b[0] == (byte)'R' && b[1] == (byte)'I' && b[2] == (byte)'F' && b[3] == (byte)'F'
        && b[8] == (byte)'W' && b[9] == (byte)'E' && b[10] == (byte)'B' && b[11] == (byte)'P';

    /// <summary>PNG 直接读；WebP 用 Skia 解码后转成 Avalonia 位图</summary>
    private static Bitmap? Decode(byte[] bytes)
    {
        try
        {
            if (IsPng(bytes))
            {
                using var ms = new MemoryStream(bytes);
                return new Bitmap(ms);
            }

            var sk = SKBitmap.Decode(bytes);
            if (sk == null) return null;
            using (sk)
            {
                using var img = SKImage.FromBitmap(sk);
                using var data = img.Encode(SKEncodedImageFormat.Png, 100);
                using var ms2 = new MemoryStream(data.ToArray());
                return new Bitmap(ms2);
            }
        }
        catch { return null; }
    }
}
```

```cs
using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Text.Json;

namespace DashFile.Services;

/// <summary>用户设置（主题色、窗口尺寸、欢迎页是否已勾选不再显示），存到 %LOCALAPPDATA%\DashFile\settings.json</summary>
public sealed class AppSettings
{
    public string AccentHex { get; set; } = "#FFFFFF";
    public bool ThemeDefaultV2 { get; set; }
    public string StyleKey { get; set; } = "m3";
    public double WindowWidth { get; set; } = 1135;
    public double WindowHeight { get; set; } = 707;

    /// <summary>欢迎页勾过「以后不再显示」后置真，以后再启动就不再弹</summary>
    public bool WelcomeHidden { get; set; }

    private static AppSettings? _current;
    private static string Dir => AppPaths.LocalRoot;
    private static string FilePath => AppPaths.Settings;

    public static AppSettings Current
    {
        get
        {
            if (_current != null) return _current;
            try
            {
                if (File.Exists(FilePath))
                {
                    var json = File.ReadAllText(FilePath);
                    var s = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<AppSettings>(json);
                    if (s != null) { _current = s; return _current; }
                }
            }
            catch { }
            _current = new AppSettings();
            return _current;
        }
    }

    public static void Save()
    {
        try
        {
            Directory.CreateDirectory(Dir);
            AtomicFile.WriteAllText(FilePath, JsonSerializer.Serialize(Current,
                new JsonSerializerOptions { WriteIndented = true }));
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { AppLog.Add("保存设置失败：" + ex.Message); }
    }
}
```
