`src/Services/ArscIconResolver.cs`:

```cs
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Text;

namespace DashFile.Services;

/// <summary>
/// 极简 resources.arsc 解析器：把资源 ID（如 0x7f0e0002）解析成 APK 内的文件路径。
/// 只做“按 ID 找文件路径 + 选最合适的密度”这一件事，足够取应用图标。
/// </summary>
public static class ArscIconResolver
{
    private const ushort RES_STRING_POOL_TYPE = 0x0001;
    private const ushort RES_TABLE_TYPE = 0x0002;
    private const ushort RES_TABLE_PACKAGE_TYPE = 0x0200;
    private const ushort RES_TABLE_TYPE_TYPE = 0x0201;

    /// <summary>资源引用最多跟几层（正常图标链 1~2 层，超过就是畸形数据/环）</summary>
    private const int MaxRefDepth = 8;

    public sealed record Candidate(string Path, int Density, bool Night);

    /// <summary>解析出该资源 ID 的全部候选（不同密度/主题），按优先级排好序</summary>
    public static List<Candidate> Resolve(byte[] arsc, uint resId, int depth = 0)
    {
        var result = new List<Candidate>();
        if (arsc == null || arsc.Length < 12) return result;

        // 资源引用可能自指（@xxx 指回自己）或 A→B→A 成环。
        //   以前直接递归，构造出来的 arsc 会让 CLR 抛 StackOverflowException —— 不可捕获，进程直接消失。
        if (depth > MaxRefDepth) return result;

        var type = U16(arsc, 0);
        if (type != RES_TABLE_TYPE) return result;

        var headerSize = U16(arsc, 2);
        var packageCount = U32(arsc, 8);

        var globalStrings = new List<string>();
        var pkgId = (int)(resId >> 24);
        var typeId = (int)((resId >> 16) & 0xFF);
        var entryIdx = (int)(resId & 0xFFFF);

        int pos = headerSize;
        var pkgsSeen = 0;

        while (pos + 8 <= arsc.Length && pkgsSeen < packageCount)
        {
            var chunkType = U16(arsc, pos);
            var chunkHeader = U16(arsc, pos + 2);
            var chunkSize = (int)U32(arsc, pos + 4);
            if (chunkSize <= 0 || pos + chunkSize > arsc.Length) break;

            if (chunkType == RES_STRING_POOL_TYPE)
            {
                globalStrings = AxmlReader.ReadStringPool(arsc, pos);
            }
            else if (chunkType == RES_TABLE_PACKAGE_TYPE)
            {
                pkgsSeen++;
                var id = U32(arsc, pos + 8);
                if (id == (uint)pkgId)
                {
                    ReadPackage(arsc, pos, chunkHeader, chunkSize, typeId, entryIdx, globalStrings, result, depth);
                    break;
                }
            }

            pos += chunkSize;
        }

        // 高密度优先；夜间主题排后面
        result.Sort((a, b) =>
        {
            if (a.Night != b.Night) return a.Night ? 1 : -1;
            return b.Density.CompareTo(a.Density);
        });
        return result;
    }

    private static void ReadPackage(byte[] b, int pkgStart, int pkgHeader, int pkgSize,
        int typeId, int entryIdx, List<string> globalStrings, List<Candidate> outList, int depth = 0)
    {
        int pos = pkgStart + pkgHeader;
        var end = pkgStart + pkgSize;

        while (pos + 8 <= end && pos + 8 <= b.Length)
        {
            var chunkType = U16(b, pos);
            var headerSize = U16(b, pos + 2);
            var chunkSize = (int)U32(b, pos + 4);
            if (chunkSize <= 0 || pos + chunkSize > b.Length) break;

            if (chunkType == RES_TABLE_TYPE_TYPE)
            {
                var id = b[pos + 8];
                if (id == typeId)
                {
                    TryReadType(b, pos, headerSize, chunkSize, entryIdx, globalStrings, outList, depth);
                }
            }

            pos += chunkSize;
        }
    }

    private static void TryReadType(byte[] b, int start, int headerSize, int chunkSize,
        int entryIdx, List<string> globalStrings, List<Candidate> outList, int depth = 0)
    {
        var entryCount = (int)U32(b, start + 12);
        var entriesStart = (int)U32(b, start + 16);
        var typeFlags = b[start + 9];

        var configOff = start + 20;
        var density = (int)U16(b, configOff + 14);

        var offsetsPos = start + headerSize;
        var entryOff = -1;

        if ((typeFlags & 0x01) != 0)
        {
            // 稀疏表：entryCount 个 (idx u16, offset u16) 对
            for (var i = 0; i < entryCount; i++)
            {
                var p = offsetsPos + i * 4;
                if (p + 4 > b.Length) break;
                if (U16(b, p) != entryIdx) continue;
                entryOff = U16(b, p + 2) * 4;
                break;
            }
        }
        else if ((typeFlags & 0x02) != 0)
        {
            // 紧凑偏移（Android 12+）：u16 偏移，单位 4 字节
            var p = offsetsPos + entryIdx * 2;
            if (p + 2 > b.Length) return;
            var o16 = U16(b, p);
            if (o16 == 0xFFFF) return;
            entryOff = o16 * 4;
        }
        else
        {
            if (entryIdx >= entryCount) return;
            var p = offsetsPos + entryIdx * 4;
            if (p + 4 > b.Length) return;
            entryOff = (int)U32(b, p);
            if (entryOff == -1) return;
        }

        if (entryOff < 0) return;

        var entryPos = start + entriesStart + entryOff;
        // entriesStart 是 U32→int，可为负；负的 entryPos 会让后面的裸索引器抛异常
        if (entryPos < 0 || entryPos + 8 > b.Length) return;

        var flags = U16(b, entryPos + 2);
        var compact = (flags & 0x0008) != 0;   // 紧凑条目：value 紧跟 8 字节头

        var valuePos = compact ? entryPos + 8 : entryPos + U16(b, entryPos);
        if (valuePos + 8 > b.Length) return;

        var dataType = b[valuePos + 3];
        var data = U32(b, valuePos + 4);

        if (dataType == 0x01 && data != 0)      // 引用另一个资源，继续跟一层（深度受限）
        {
            if (depth >= MaxRefDepth) return;
            foreach (var c in Resolve(b, data, depth + 1)) outList.Add(c);
            return;
        }

        if (dataType != 0x03) return;
        if (data >= (uint)globalStrings.Count) return;

        var path = globalStrings[(int)data];
        // 普通 APK 是 res/...；ColorOS / 资源混淆后的 APK 会变成 r/...
        // 以前只认 res/，这些应用会得到 0 个候选，最后只能显示字母块。
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(path) || !IsResourcePath(path)) return;

        outList.Add(new Candidate(path, density, path.Contains("night", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)));
    }

    private static bool IsResourcePath(string path)
        => path.StartsWith("res/", StringComparison.Ordinal) ||
           path.StartsWith("r/", StringComparison.Ordinal);

    /// <summary>把资源 ID 解析成颜色值（矢量图里的 fillColor 可能是 @color/xxx）</summary>
    public static uint? ResolveColor(byte[] arsc, uint resId)
    {
        if (arsc == null || arsc.Length < 12) return null;
        if (U16(arsc, 0) != RES_TABLE_TYPE) return null;

        int pos = U16(arsc, 2);
        var globalStrings = new List<string>();
        var pkgId = (int)(resId >> 24);
        var typeId = (int)((resId >> 16) & 0xFF);
        var entryIdx = (int)(resId & 0xFFFF);

        while (pos + 8 <= arsc.Length)
        {
            var chunkType = U16(arsc, pos);
            var chunkHeader = U16(arsc, pos + 2);
            var chunkSize = (int)U32(arsc, pos + 4);
            if (chunkSize <= 0 || pos + chunkSize > arsc.Length) break;

            if (chunkType == RES_STRING_POOL_TYPE) globalStrings = AxmlReader.ReadStringPool(arsc, pos);
            else if (chunkType == RES_TABLE_PACKAGE_TYPE && U32(arsc, pos + 8) == (uint)pkgId)
            {
                var q = pos + chunkHeader;
                var end = pos + chunkSize;
                while (q + 8 <= end)
                {
                    var t = U16(arsc, q);
                    var hs = U16(arsc, q + 2);
                    var sz = (int)U32(arsc, q + 4);
                    if (sz <= 0 || q + sz > arsc.Length) break;

                    if (t == RES_TABLE_TYPE_TYPE && arsc[q + 8] == typeId)
                    {
                        var color = ReadColorFromType(arsc, q, hs, entryIdx);
                        if (color.HasValue) return color;
                    }
                    q += sz;
                }
            }

            pos += chunkSize;
        }
        return null;
    }

    /// <summary>把资源 ID 解析成字符串（应用名称就存在这里）</summary>
    public static string? ResolveString(byte[] arsc, uint resId)
    {
        if (arsc == null || arsc.Length < 12) return null;
        if (U16(arsc, 0) != RES_TABLE_TYPE) return null;

        int pos = U16(arsc, 2);
        var globalStrings = new List<string>();
        var pkgId = (int)(resId >> 24);
        var typeId = (int)((resId >> 16) & 0xFF);
        var entryIdx = (int)(resId & 0xFFFF);
        string? defaultStr = null;
        string? zhStr = null;

        while (pos + 8 <= arsc.Length)
        {
            var chunkType = U16(arsc, pos);
            var chunkHeader = U16(arsc, pos + 2);
            var chunkSize = (int)U32(arsc, pos + 4);
            if (chunkSize <= 0 || pos + chunkSize > arsc.Length) break;

            if (chunkType == RES_STRING_POOL_TYPE) globalStrings = AxmlReader.ReadStringPool(arsc, pos);
            else if (chunkType == RES_TABLE_PACKAGE_TYPE && U32(arsc, pos + 8) == (uint)pkgId)
            {
                var q = pos + chunkHeader;
                var end = pos + chunkSize;
                while (q + 8 <= end)
                {
                    var t = U16(arsc, q);
                    var hs = U16(arsc, q + 2);
                    var sz = (int)U32(arsc, q + 4);
                    if (sz <= 0 || q + sz > arsc.Length) break;
                    if (t == RES_TABLE_TYPE_TYPE && arsc[q + 8] == typeId)
                    {
                        var str = ReadStringFromType(arsc, q, hs, entryIdx, globalStrings);
                        if (str != null)
                        {
                            // ResTable_config: size(4) mcc(2) mnc(2) language(2) country(2)
                            // config 从 q+20 开始，所以 language 在 q+28
                            var langPos = q + 20 + 8;          // language[2]
                            var countryPos = langPos + 2;      // country[2]
                            var isZh = langPos + 2 < arsc.Length &&
                                       arsc[langPos] == (byte)'z' && arsc[langPos + 1] == (byte)'h';
                            var isCn = countryPos + 2 < arsc.Length &&
                                       arsc[countryPos] == (byte)'C' && arsc[countryPos + 1] == (byte)'N';

                            if (isZh && isCn) return str;      // 简体中文：最高优先级
                            if (isZh) zhStr ??= str;           // 繁体先备选
                            else defaultStr ??= str;
                        }
                    }
                    q += sz;
                }
            }
            pos += chunkSize;
        }
        return zhStr ?? defaultStr;
    }

    private static string? ReadStringFromType(byte[] b, int start, int headerSize, int entryIdx, List<string> pool)
    {
        var entryCount = (int)U32(b, start + 12);
        var entriesStart = (int)U32(b, start + 16);
        var typeFlags = b[start + 9];
        var offsetsPos = start + headerSize;
        var entryOff = -1;

        if ((typeFlags & 0x01) != 0)
        {
            for (var i = 0; i < entryCount; i++)
            {
                var p = offsetsPos + i * 4;
                if (p + 4 > b.Length) break;
                if (U16(b, p) != entryIdx) continue;
                entryOff = U16(b, p + 2) * 4;
                break;
            }
        }
        else if ((typeFlags & 0x02) != 0)
        {
            var p = offsetsPos + entryIdx * 2;
            if (p + 2 > b.Length) return null;
            var o16 = U16(b, p);
            if (o16 == 0xFFFF) return null;
            entryOff = o16 * 4;
        }
        else
        {
            if (entryIdx >= entryCount) return null;
            var p = offsetsPos + entryIdx * 4;
            if (p + 4 > b.Length) return null;
            entryOff = (int)U32(b, p);
            if (entryOff == -1) return null;
        }

        if (entryOff < 0) return null;
        var entryPos = start + entriesStart + entryOff;
        // entriesStart 是 U32→int，可为负；负的 entryPos 会让裸索引器抛 IndexOutOfRange
        if (entryPos < 0 || entryPos + 8 > b.Length) return null;

        var flags = U16(b, entryPos + 2);
        var compact = (flags & 0x0008) != 0;
        var valuePos = compact ? entryPos + 8 : entryPos + U16(b, entryPos);
        if (valuePos + 8 > b.Length) return null;

        var dataType = b[valuePos + 3];
        var data = U32(b, valuePos + 4);
        if (dataType != 0x03 || data >= (uint)pool.Count) return null;

        var s = pool[(int)data];
        return string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(s) ? null : s;
    }

    private static uint? ReadColorFromType(byte[] b, int start, int headerSize, int entryIdx)
    {
        var entryCount = (int)U32(b, start + 12);
        var entriesStart = (int)U32(b, start + 16);
        var typeFlags = b[start + 9];
        var offsetsPos = start + headerSize;
        var entryOff = -1;

        if ((typeFlags & 0x01) != 0)
        {
            for (var i = 0; i < entryCount; i++)
            {
                var p = offsetsPos + i * 4;
                if (p + 4 > b.Length) break;
                if (U16(b, p) != entryIdx) continue;
                entryOff = U16(b, p + 2) * 4;
                break;
            }
        }
        else if ((typeFlags & 0x02) != 0)
        {
            var p = offsetsPos + entryIdx * 2;
            if (p + 2 > b.Length) return null;
            var o16 = U16(b, p);
            if (o16 == 0xFFFF) return null;
            entryOff = o16 * 4;
        }
        else
        {
            if (entryIdx >= entryCount) return null;
            var p = offsetsPos + entryIdx * 4;
            if (p + 4 > b.Length) return null;
            entryOff = (int)U32(b, p);
            if (entryOff == -1) return null;
        }

        if (entryOff < 0) return null;
        var entryPos = start + entriesStart + entryOff;
        // entriesStart 是 U32→int，可为负；负的 entryPos 会让裸索引器抛 IndexOutOfRange
        if (entryPos < 0 || entryPos + 8 > b.Length) return null;

        var flags = U16(b, entryPos + 2);
        var compact = (flags & 0x0008) != 0;
        var valuePos = compact ? entryPos + 8 : entryPos + U16(b, entryPos);
        if (valuePos + 8 > b.Length) return null;

        var dataType = b[valuePos + 3];
        var data = U32(b, valuePos + 4);

        return dataType switch
        {
            0x1c or 0x1d or 0x1e or 0x1f => data,      // 直接是颜色
            0x01 when data != 0 => null,                 // 引用别的颜色（不追）
            _ => null
        };
    }

    // ---------- 字符串池 ----------

    // 字符串池只有一份实现（AxmlReader.ReadStringPool）：AXML / resources.arsc 用的是同一套格式，
    // 以前这里还有第四份拷贝，解码细节（双长度前缀）各写各的。

    // 二进制读取统一走 AxmlReader（带边界检查）：以前这里是裸索引器，
    // 任何一处下标算错就是 IndexOutOfRangeException，表现为"图标解析失败"。
    private static ushort U16(byte[] b, int o) => AxmlReader.U16(b, o);
    private static uint U32(byte[] b, int o) => AxmlReader.U32(b, o);
}
```

`src/Services/AtomicFile.cs`:

```cs
using System;
using System.IO;

namespace DashFile.Services;

/// <summary>
/// 配置 / 缓存写入：先写 .tmp，再原子替换。避免写到一半崩溃/断电后留下半截 json，
/// 下次启动反序列化失败把设置清空。
/// </summary>
public static class AtomicFile
{
    // 同一个文件可能被 UI/后台同时写（设置、标签缓存）：串行化 + 每次用唯一临时名，
    // 避免两个写入者抢同一个 .tmp。
    private static readonly object Gate = new();

    public static void WriteAllText(string path, string text)
        => WriteAllBytes(path, new System.Text.UTF8Encoding(false).GetBytes(text));

    public static void WriteAllBytes(string path, byte[] data)
    {
        lock (Gate)
        {
            var dir = Path.GetDirectoryName(path);
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(dir)) Directory.CreateDirectory(dir);
            var tmp = path + "." + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N")[..8] + ".tmp";
            try
            {
                File.WriteAllBytes(tmp, data);
                Replace(tmp, path);
            }
            finally
            {
                try { if (File.Exists(tmp)) File.Delete(tmp); } catch { }
            }
        }
    }

    private static void Replace(string tmp, string path)
    {
        if (File.Exists(path))
        {
            try { File.Replace(tmp, path, null); return; }
            catch { /* 被占用/跨卷时退回 Move */ }
        }
        File.Move(tmp, path, true);
    }
}
```

`src/Services/Axml/AxmlReader.cs`:

```cs
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Text;

namespace DashFile.Services;

/// <summary>
/// 二进制 Android XML（AXML）与 res 字符串池的**唯一**实现。
///
/// 背景：这个项目里曾经有三份各自演化的 AXML 解析器 ——
///   · OpenWith/ApkAnalysis.cs 的 Axml + StringPool（解析成整棵树，给 APK 信息页用）
///   · Services/AxmlManifestResolver.cs（单遍扫描，给"取图标"用）
///   · Services/VectorDrawableRenderer.cs（单遍扫描，自己分类成 refs/strs/floats/colors）
/// 三份的越界保护、字符串解码、类型格式化各写各的，修一份永远漏两份
/// （VectorDrawableRenderer 的负索引就是这样漏掉的）。现在统一到这里：
///   · 所有 U16/U32 都做边界检查，任何位置都不会抛 IndexOutOfRange；
///   · 字符串池只有一套解码（UTF-8 双长度前缀 + UTF-16 代理长度都处理）；
///   · 树深度与元素数量都有上限，畸形输入不会把栈打穿。
/// 三份旧实现现在只剩薄封装，行为由这里单点决定。
/// </summary>
internal static class AxmlReader
{
    internal const ushort ResXmlType = 0x0003;
    internal const ushort ResStringPoolType = 0x0001;
    internal const ushort ResXmlStartElement = 0x0102;
    internal const ushort ResXmlEndElement = 0x0103;

    /// <summary>元素最大嵌套层数：畸形/恶意 XML 可以套几千层，递归渲染/序列化会 StackOverflow（不可捕获）</summary>
    private const int MaxDepth = 256;

    /// <summary>单份 XML 最多解析多少个元素（防止 20 万个空标签把内存吃光）</summary>
    private const int MaxElements = 200_000;

    /// <summary>字符串池条数上限（正常 APK 的 manifest 池几百条，几 MB 的 arsc 也就几万条）</summary>
    private const int MaxStrings = 1_000_000;

    // ---------------- 基础读取（全部带边界检查） ----------------

    internal static ushort U16(byte[] d, int p)
        => p >= 0 && p + 2 <= d.Length ? (ushort)(d[p] | (d[p + 1] << 8)) : (ushort)0;

    internal static uint U32(byte[] d, int p)
        => p >= 0 && p + 4 <= d.Length
            ? (uint)(d[p] | (d[p + 1] << 8) | (d[p + 2] << 16) | (d[p + 3] << 24))
            : 0u;

    internal static byte U8(byte[] d, int p) => p >= 0 && p < d.Length ? d[p] : (byte)0;

    // ---------------- 字符串池 ----------------

    /// <summary>解析一个 RES_STRING_POOL chunk（返回空列表表示格式不对，调用方按"没有字符串"处理）</summary>
    internal static List<string> ReadStringPool(byte[] d, int offset)
    {
        var list = new List<string>();
        if (offset < 0 || offset + 28 > d.Length) return list;

        int headerSize = U16(d, offset + 2);
        int count = (int)U32(d, offset + 8);
        int flags = (int)U32(d, offset + 16);
        int stringsStart = (int)U32(d, offset + 20);
        if (count <= 0 || count > MaxStrings) return list;

        bool utf8 = (flags & 0x100) != 0;
        int offsetsPos = offset + headerSize;

        for (var i = 0; i < count; i++)
        {
            int off = (int)U32(d, offsetsPos + i * 4);
            int p = offset + stringsStart + off;
            if (p <= 0 || p >= d.Length) { list.Add(""); continue; }
            list.Add(utf8 ? ReadUtf8(d, p) : ReadUtf16(d, p));
        }
        return list;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// UTF-8 串：先 1~2 字节的 UTF-16 长度，再 1~2 字节的字节长度，再是内容。
    /// 两步都要读，用字节长度截断（有些实现只读第一个长度，遇到非 ASCII 会截断成半个字符）。
    /// </summary>
    private static string ReadUtf8(byte[] d, int p)
    {
        int i = p;
        var b0 = U8(d, i++);
        if ((b0 & 0x80) != 0) i++;                       // UTF-16 长度（用不到，但要跳过去）

        int len = U8(d, i++);
        if ((len & 0x80) != 0) len = ((len & 0x7f) << 8) | U8(d, i++);

        if (len < 0 || i + len > d.Length) len = Math.Max(0, d.Length - i);
        return len <= 0 ? "" : Encoding.UTF8.GetString(d, i, len);
    }

    /// <summary>UTF-16 串：长度（可能 1 或 2 个 u16，最高位是"后面还有一半长度"的标志），再是内容</summary>
    private static string ReadUtf16(byte[] d, int p)
    {
        int i = p;
        int len = U16(d, i); i += 2;
        if ((len & 0x8000) != 0)
        {
            len = ((len & 0x7fff) << 16) | U16(d, i);
            i += 2;
        }
        int bytes = len * 2;
        if (bytes < 0 || i + bytes > d.Length) bytes = Math.Max(0, d.Length - i);
        return bytes <= 0 ? "" : Encoding.Unicode.GetString(d, i, bytes);
    }

    // ---------------- 文档解析 ----------------

    /// <summary>解析 AXML；不是 AXML 或结构坏掉时返回 null（不抛异常）</summary>
    internal static AxmlElement? Parse(byte[]? data)
    {
        try { return ParseCore(data); }
        catch { return null; }   // 任何一处畸形都不该让"看个图标"崩掉调用方
    }

    private static AxmlElement? ParseCore(byte[]? data)
    {
        if (data == null || data.Length < 8) return null;
        if (U16(data, 0) != ResXmlType) return null;

        int headerSize = U16(data, 2);
        int total = (int)U32(data, 4);
        if (total <= 0 || total > data.Length) total = data.Length;

        var pool = new List<string>();
        AxmlElement? root = null;
        var stack = new Stack<AxmlElement>();
        var elements = 0;

        int pos = headerSize;
        while (pos + 8 <= total)
        {
            int chunkType = U16(data, pos);
            int chunkSize = (int)U32(data, pos + 4);
            if (chunkSize <= 0 || pos + chunkSize > total) break;   // 长度自相矛盾：后面的都不信了

            if (chunkType == ResStringPoolType)
            {
                pool = ReadStringPool(data, pos);
            }
            else if (chunkType == ResXmlStartElement)
            {
                if (++elements > MaxElements) break;

                var el = ReadElement(data, pos, chunkSize, pool);
                if (el != null)
                {
                    if (stack.Count > 0) stack.Peek().Children.Add(el);
                    else root ??= el;

                    if (stack.Count < MaxDepth) stack.Push(el);
                    else return root;                    // 太深了：停在已经解析出的部分
                }
            }
            else if (chunkType == ResXmlEndElement)
            {
                if (stack.Count > 0) stack.Pop();
            }

            pos += chunkSize;
        }

        return root;
    }

    private static AxmlElement? ReadElement(byte[] d, int pos, int chunkSize, List<string> pool)
    {
        // 结构：chunk 头 8 + lineNumber 4 + comment 4 = 16，然后 ns 4 / name 4 /
        //        attributeStart 2 / attributeSize 2 / attributeCount 2 / id 2 / class 2 / style 2
        int nameIdx = (int)U32(d, pos + 20);
        var el = new AxmlElement { Name = StrOf(pool, nameIdx) };

        int attrStart = U16(d, pos + 24);
        int attrCount = U16(d, pos + 28);
        int aBase = pos + 16 + attrStart;
        int chunkEnd = pos + chunkSize;

        for (var i = 0; i < attrCount; i++)
        {
            int ap = aBase + i * 20;
            if (ap < 0 || ap + 20 > chunkEnd || ap + 20 > d.Length) break;

            int aNameIdx = (int)U32(d, ap + 4);
            var aName = StrOf(pool, aNameIdx);
            // xmlns 声明与空名对"取图标/看清单"没有任何用处，统一在这里滤掉（三份旧实现里有两份也这么做）
            if (aName.Length == 0 || aName.StartsWith("xmlns", StringComparison.Ordinal)) continue;

            byte dataType = U8(d, ap + 15);
            uint rawValue = U32(d, ap + 8);
            uint value = U32(d, ap + 16);
            string? str = dataType == 0x03 ? StrOf(pool, (int)value) : null;

            el.Attributes.Add(new AxmlAttribute(aName, dataType, rawValue, value, str,
                FormatValue(pool, rawValue, dataType, value)));
        }
        return el;
    }

    private static string StrOf(List<string> pool, int index)
        => index >= 0 && index < pool.Count ? pool[index] : "";

    /// <summary>属性值 → 展示字符串（与原 ApkAnalysis.TypedValue 完全一致的格式）</summary>
    private static string FormatValue(List<string> pool, uint raw, byte type, uint data)
    {
        if (raw < (uint)pool.Count && pool[(int)raw].Length > 0) return pool[(int)raw];

        int i = unchecked((int)data);
        switch (type)
        {
            case 0x00: return "";
            case 0x01: return "@0x" + data.ToString("X8", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
            case 0x02: return "?" + data.ToString("X8", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
            case 0x03: return StrOf(pool, (int)data);
            case 0x04: return BitConverter.Int32BitsToSingle(i).ToString("0.###", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
            case 0x10: return i.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
            case 0x11: return "0x" + data.ToString("X", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
            case 0x12: return data != 0 ? "true" : "false";
            case >= 0x1c and <= 0x1f: return "#" + data.ToString("X8", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
            default: return "0x" + data.ToString("X", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        }
    }

    // ---------------- 树上的小工具 ----------------

    internal static string Attr(AxmlElement? e, string name)
        => e == null ? "" : e.Attr(name);

    internal static AxmlElement? Find(AxmlElement? e, string name)
    {
        if (e == null) return null;
        if (string.Equals(e.Name, name, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) return e;
        foreach (var c in e.Children)
        {
            var hit = Find(c, name);
            if (hit != null) return hit;
        }
        return null;
    }

    internal static IEnumerable<AxmlElement> FindAll(AxmlElement? e, string name)
    {
        if (e == null) yield break;
        if (string.Equals(e.Name, name, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) yield return e;
        foreach (var c in e.Children)
            foreach (var hit in FindAll(c, name)) yield return hit;
    }

    /// <summary>深度优先遍历整棵树（含自身），带显式栈，不递归</summary>
    internal static IEnumerable<AxmlElement> Walk(AxmlElement root)
    {
        var stack = new Stack<AxmlElement>();
        stack.Push(root);
        while (stack.Count > 0)
        {
            var e = stack.Pop();
            yield return e;
            for (var i = e.Children.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--) stack.Push(e.Children[i]);
        }
    }

    // ---------------- 兼容旧调用点的单遍接口 ----------------

    /// <summary>列出 XML 里所有属性（元素名 + 属性名 + 类型 + 原始值 + 字符串值）,用于遍历 layer-list 等</summary>
    internal static List<(string elem, string attr, byte dataType, uint data, string? str)> AllAttrs(byte[]? axml)
    {
        var list = new List<(string, string, byte, uint, string?)>();
        var root = Parse(axml);
        if (root == null) return list;

        foreach (var el in Walk(root))
            foreach (var a in el.Attributes)
                list.Add((el.Name, a.Name, a.DataType, a.Data, a.StringValue));
        return list;
    }

    /// <summary>查找某元素的某属性（返回资源 ID 或字符串），找不到返回 (0, null)</summary>
    internal static (uint resId, string? str) FindAttr(byte[]? axml, string element, string attr)
    {
        var root = Parse(axml);
        if (root == null) return (0, null);

        foreach (var el in Walk(root))
        {
            if (!string.Equals(el.Name, element, StringComparison.Ordinal)) continue;
            foreach (var a in el.Attributes)
            {
                if (!string.Equals(a.Name, attr, StringComparison.Ordinal)) continue;
                if (a.DataType == 0x01) return (a.Data, null);
                if (a.DataType == 0x03) return (0, a.StringValue ?? "");
            }
        }
        return (0, null);
    }

    /// <summary>取 &lt;application&gt; 的 icon / roundIcon：返回 (资源ID, 直接路径)</summary>
    internal static (uint resId, string? directPath) ResolveIcon(byte[]? axml)
    {
        var root = Parse(axml);
        if (root == null) return (0, null);

        uint roundId = 0;
        string? roundPath = null;

        foreach (var app in FindAll(root, "application"))
        {
            uint iconId = 0;
            string? iconPath = null;

            foreach (var a in app.Attributes)
            {
                if (a.Name == "icon")
                {
                    if (a.DataType == 0x01) iconId = a.Data;
                    else if (a.DataType == 0x03) iconPath = a.StringValue;
                }
                else if (a.Name == "roundIcon")
                {
                    if (a.DataType == 0x01) roundId = a.Data;
                    else if (a.DataType == 0x03) roundPath = a.StringValue;
                }
            }

            if (iconId != 0 || iconPath != null) return (iconId, iconPath);
            if (roundId != 0 || roundPath != null) return (roundId, roundPath);
        }

        return (roundId, roundPath);
    }

    // ---------------- 序列化 ----------------

    internal static string ToXml(this AxmlElement root)
    {
        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.AppendLine("<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"utf-8\"?>");
        Write(sb, root, 0);
        return sb.ToString();
    }

    private static void Write(StringBuilder sb, AxmlElement e, int depth)
    {
        var pad = new string(' ', depth * 2);
        var name = e.Name;
        if (string.Equals(name, "manifest", StringComparison.Ordinal))
            sb.Append(pad).Append("<manifest xmlns:android=\"http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android\"");
        else
            sb.Append(pad).Append("<").Append(name);

        foreach (var a in e.Attributes)
            sb.Append(" ").Append(a.Name).Append("=\"").Append(Escape(a.Value)).Append("\"");

        if (e.Children.Count == 0)
        {
            sb.AppendLine(" />");
            return;
        }

        sb.AppendLine(">");
        foreach (var c in e.Children) Write(sb, c, depth + 1);
        sb.Append(pad).AppendLine("</" + name + ">");
    }

    private static string Escape(string s)
        => s.Replace("&", "&amp;").Replace("<", "&lt;").Replace(">", "&gt;").Replace("\"", "&quot;");
}

/// <summary>AXML 元素（解析结果的唯一模型）</summary>
internal sealed class AxmlElement
{
    public string Name = "";
    public List<AxmlAttribute> Attributes = new();
    public List<AxmlElement> Children = new();

    /// <summary>按名取属性（忽略大小写，与原 Axml.Attr 语义一致）；没有返回空串</summary>
    public string Attr(string name)
    {
        foreach (var a in Attributes)
            if (string.Equals(a.Name, name, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) return a.Value;
        return "";
    }

    public AxmlAttribute? Find(string name)
    {
        foreach (var a in Attributes)
            if (string.Equals(a.Name, name, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) return a;
        return null;
    }
}

/// <summary>AXML 属性：保留原始类型与值，同时给出展示字符串</summary>
internal readonly struct AxmlAttribute
{
    public readonly string Name;
    public readonly byte DataType;
    public readonly uint RawValue;      // "raw" 字段：指向字符串池的下标
    public readonly uint Data;          // 值本体（资源 ID / 字符串下标 / int / 颜色 …）
    public readonly string? StringValue; // dataType == 0x03 时的字符串，其他类型为 null
    public readonly string Value;        // 展示用（带 @0x / #RRGGBBAA 等前缀）

    public AxmlAttribute(string name, byte dataType, uint rawValue, uint data, string? stringValue, string value)
    {
        Name = name;
        DataType = dataType;
        RawValue = rawValue;
        Data = data;
        StringValue = stringValue;
        Value = value;
    }
}
```

```cs
namespace DashFile.Services;

/// <summary>
/// 二进制 AndroidManifest.xml 的读取入口（取 &lt;application&gt; 的 icon / roundIcon、遍历属性）。
```

`src/Services/BootloaderState.cs`:

```cs
using System;

namespace DashFile.Services;

/// <summary>
/// Bootloader 解锁状态判定。
///
/// 只看 getprop 是不准的：隐藏类模块（Shamiko / Zygisk 系）会把
/// <c>ro.boot.verifiedbootstate</c> 伪造成 green、<c>ro.boot.flash.locked</c> 伪造成 1，
/// 于是本来已解锁的机器被读成"未解锁"。这里改成多来源交叉，再用 root 是否真的可用做反证：
/// 原厂锁着 BL 的设备拿不到 root，所以只要 root 可用，就不可能是锁定状态。
/// 另外单独读 /proc/cmdline——隐藏模块主要 hook 属性接口，文件内容往往还是真值。
/// </summary>
internal static class BootloaderState
{
    public enum Verdict
    {
        /// <summary>读不到有效信息</summary>
        Unknown,
        /// <summary>各来源一致显示锁定</summary>
        Locked,
        /// <summary>有来源明确显示已解锁</summary>
        Unlocked,
        /// <summary>属性说锁定、但 root 可用 → 状态被隐藏模块伪装过</summary>
        UnlockedSpoofed,
        /// <summary>属性读不到，仅凭 root 反推已解锁</summary>
        UnlockedByRoot,
    }

    public sealed class Signals
    {
        public string FlashLocked { get; init; } = "";
        public string VerifiedBootState { get; init; } = "";
        public string VbmetaState { get; init; } = "";
        public string SecureBootLock { get; init; } = "";
        /// <summary>/proc/cmdline 原文</summary>
        public string Cmdline { get; init; } = "";
        /// <summary>能否真的拿到 root shell（或已识别出 root 实现）</summary>
        public bool RootAvailable { get; init; }
    }

    public static Verdict Judge(Signals s)
    {
        var locked = Norm(s.FlashLocked);
        var vbs = Norm(s.VerifiedBootState);
        var vbmeta = Norm(s.VbmetaState);
        var sbl = Norm(s.SecureBootLock);
        var cmd = s.Cmdline ?? "";

        // ① 任何一处明说"已解锁"，以它为准
        if (locked == "0" ||
            vbmeta == "unlocked" ||
            sbl == "unlocked" ||
            vbs is "orange" or "red" or "yellow" ||
            CmdHas(cmd, "verifiedbootstate=orange") ||
            CmdHas(cmd, "verifiedbootstate=red") ||
            CmdHas(cmd, "verifiedbootstate=yellow") ||
            CmdHas(cmd, "flash.locked=0"))
        {
            return Verdict.Unlocked;
        }

        var lockedEvidence =
            locked == "1" ||
            vbmeta == "locked" ||
            sbl == "locked" ||
            vbs == "green" ||
            CmdHas(cmd, "verifiedbootstate=green") ||
            CmdHas(cmd, "flash.locked=1");

        // ② 属性说锁定，但 root 真的可用 → 只可能是被伪装
        if (lockedEvidence)
            return s.RootAvailable ? Verdict.UnlockedSpoofed : Verdict.Locked;

        var hasAny = locked.Length > 0 || vbs.Length > 0 || vbmeta.Length > 0 || sbl.Length > 0;

        // ③ 一个属性都没读到：有 root 就是解锁，否则未知
        return s.RootAvailable ? Verdict.UnlockedByRoot : (hasAny ? Verdict.Unknown : Verdict.Unknown);
    }

    public static string Describe(Verdict v) => v switch
    {
        Verdict.Unlocked => "已解锁（BL 解锁）",
        Verdict.UnlockedSpoofed => "已解锁（状态被隐藏模块伪装）",
        Verdict.UnlockedByRoot => "已解锁（由 root 反证）",
        Verdict.Locked => "未解锁（BL 锁定）",
        _ => "未知",
    };

    private static string Norm(string? s) => (s ?? "").Trim().ToLowerInvariant();

    private static bool CmdHas(string cmd, string token)
        => cmd.Length > 0 && cmd.IndexOf(token, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0;
}
```

```cs
using System;
using System.IO;

namespace DashFile.Services;

/// <summary>
/// 设备（Android）侧的固定路径与临时文件命名。
///
/// 为什么集中：/data/adb、/data/local/tmp、/sdcard 这些字符串以前在 Root provider、
/// ModuleService、RemoteFileSystem、MainViewModel、插件桥里各写一遍，改一处漏一处。
/// 临时文件统一用 dashfile_/dashfile_plugin_ 前缀，退出清理才不会漏。
/// </summary>
public static class DevicePaths
{
    public const string Sdcard = "/sdcard";
    public const string Download = "/sdcard/Download";
    public const string Dcim = "/sdcard/DCIM";
    public const string SdcardAndroid = "/sdcard/Android";

    public const string AdbData = "/data/adb";
    public const string Modules = "/data/adb/modules";
    public const string ModulesUpdate = "/data/adb/modules_update";
    public const string KsuDir = "/data/adb/ksu";
    public const string KsuAllowlist = "/data/adb/ksu/.allowlist";
    public const string KsuAllowlistAlt = "/data/adb/ksu/allowlist";
    public const string KsuBusybox = "/data/adb/ksu/bin/busybox";
    public const string MagiskDir = "/data/adb/magisk";
    public const string MagiskDb = "/data/adb/magisk.db";
    public const string MagiskBusybox = "/data/adb/magisk/busybox";
    public const string APatchDir = "/data/adb/ap";
    public const string ApdBusybox = "/data/adb/ap/bin/busybox";

    public const string LocalTmp = "/data/local/tmp";
    public const string DataRoot = "/data/data";
    public const string UserDataRoot = "/data/user/0";
    public const string UserDeDataRoot = "/data/user_de/0";
    public const string SystemBin = "/system/bin";
    public const string SystemSu = "/system/bin/su";
    public const string SuperSuConfig = "/system/etc/.supersu";
    public const string Dropbox = "/data/system/dropbox";
    public const string Tombstones = "/data/tombstones";
    public const string AdbKeys = "/data/misc/adb/adb_keys";
    public const string AdbTempKeys = "/data/misc/adb/adb_temp_keys.xml";

    public const string TempPrefix = ".dashfile_";

        => LocalTmp + "/" + TempPrefix + tag + "_" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N")[..12] + extension;

    /// <summary>设备端临时目录路径（调用方负责 mkdir）</summary>
    public static string TempDirectory(string tag)
        => LocalTmp + "/" + TempPrefix + tag + "_" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N")[..12];

    /// <summary>本机临时文件名（用于 adb push 的中转）</summary>
    public static string LocalTempFile(string tag, string extension = "")
        => Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "dashfile_" + tag + "_" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N") + extension);
}
```

`src/Services/ModuleService.cs`:

```cs
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using DashFile.Models;

namespace DashFile.Services;

public sealed class ModuleService
{
    private readonly RemoteFileSystem _fs;
    private readonly AdbRunner _adb;
    private readonly string? _installCmd;     // 例如 "ksud module install {0}" / "magisk --install-module {0}"
    private readonly string? _uninstallCmd;   // 例如 "ksud module uninstall {0}" / "apd module uninstall {0}"

    public ModuleService(RemoteFileSystem fs, AdbRunner adb, string? installCommand = null,
        string? uninstallCommand = null)
    {
        _fs = fs;
        _adb = adb;
        _installCmd = installCommand;
        _uninstallCmd = uninstallCommand;
    }

    private const string Base = DevicePaths.Modules;

    public async Task<List<ModuleInfo>> ListAsync(CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var result = new List<ModuleInfo>();

        // 一次 adb 往返拿回全部模块信息。
        //   原来每个模块要 2 次（cat module.prop + ls 目录）：10 个模块就是 20 次进程往返、
        //   每次 80~110ms，模块页要 2 秒才能出来。现在固定 1 次。
        var script =
            $"cd {Base} 2>/dev/null || exit 0; " +
            "for d in */; do " +
            "d=${d%/}; " +
            "echo \"@@$d\"; " +
            "cat \"$d/module.prop\" 2>/dev/null; " +
            "echo \"@@props_end\"; " +
            "ls -1 \"$d\" 2>/dev/null; " +
            "echo \"@@end\"; " +
            "done";

        var raw = await _fs.RunCommandAsync(script, true, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);

        string? id = null;
        var inProps = false;
        var prop = new System.Text.StringBuilder();
        var files = new List<string>();

        void Flush()
        {
            if (id == null) return;
            var map = ParseProp(prop.ToString());
            if (map.Count > 0)          // module.prop 读不到（空/不存在）的目录直接跳过
            {
                var dir = DevicePaths.ModuleDir(id);
                result.Add(new ModuleInfo
                {
                    Id = id,
                    Name = Get(map, "name", id),
                    Version = Get(map, "version", ""),
                    Author = Get(map, "author", ""),
                    Description = Get(map, "description", ""),
                    Dir = dir,
                    Enabled = !files.Contains("disable"),
                    PendingRemove = files.Contains("remove"),
                    HasWebUI = files.Contains("webroot"),
                    HasAction = files.Contains("action.sh"),
                });
            }
            id = null;
            inProps = false;
            prop.Clear();
            files.Clear();
        }

        foreach (var rawLine in raw.Split('\n'))
        {
            var line = rawLine.TrimEnd('\r').Trim();
            if (line.Length == 0) continue;

            if (line.StartsWith("@@props_end", StringComparison.Ordinal)) { inProps = false; continue; }
            if (line.StartsWith("@@end", StringComparison.Ordinal)) { Flush(); continue; }
            if (line.StartsWith("@@", StringComparison.Ordinal))
            {
                Flush();
                id = line[2..].Trim();
                inProps = true;
                continue;
            }

            if (id == null) continue;
            if (line.StartsWith("[", StringComparison.Ordinal)) continue;   // 退出码那行

            if (inProps) prop.AppendLine(line);
            else files.Add(line);
        }
        Flush();

        // 固定按名称排序：开关模块时不改变位置
        return result.OrderBy(m => m.Name, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase).ToList();
    }

    private static Dictionary<string, string> ParseProp(string text)
    {
        var d = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        foreach (var raw in text.Split('\n'))
        {
            var line = raw.Trim();
            if (line.Length == 0 || line.StartsWith("#")) continue;
            var i = line.IndexOf('=');
            if (i <= 0) continue;
            var k = line[..i].Trim();
            var v = line[(i + 1)..].Trim();
            if (k.Length > 0) d[k] = v;
        }
        return d;
    }

    private static string Get(Dictionary<string, string> map, string key, string def)
        => map.TryGetValue(key, out var v) && v.Length > 0 ? v : def;

    public async Task SetEnabledAsync(ModuleInfo m, bool enabled, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var file = Sh.Q(m.Dir + "/disable");
        // 以前完全不看返回值：touch/rm 失败也照样返回，UI 显示"已启用/已禁用"但设备上没变。
        var cmd = (enabled ? $"rm -f {file}" : $"touch {file}") + " && echo DF_OK";
        var output = await _fs.RunCommandAsync(cmd, true, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        if (!output.Contains("DF_OK", StringComparison.Ordinal))
            throw new IOException((enabled ? "启用模块失败：" : "禁用模块失败：") + output.Trim());
    }

    public async Task UninstallAsync(ModuleInfo m, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        // ① 优先用当前 root 实现提供的卸载命令（ksud / apd …）
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_uninstallCmd))
        {
            try
            {
                var cmd = _uninstallCmd!.Replace("{0}", Sh.Q(m.Id));
                var r = await _fs.ExecuteAsync(cmd, true, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
                var text = r.All ?? "";
                if (r.Ok &&
                    !text.Contains("error", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) &&
                    !text.Contains("not found", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) &&
                    !text.Contains("No such", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    return;
            }
            catch { }
        }

        // ② Magisk / 未知实现：打 remove 标记，重启后由管理器移除（最通用、最安全），但失败要报出来
        var mark = await _fs.RunCommandAsync($"touch {Sh.Q(m.Dir + "/remove")} && echo DF_OK", true, ct)
                             .ConfigureAwait(false);
        if (!mark.Contains("DF_OK", StringComparison.Ordinal))
            throw new IOException("标记卸载失败：" + mark.Trim());
    }

    public async Task<string> RunActionAsync(ModuleInfo m, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var cmd = $"cd {Sh.Q(m.Dir)} && sh action.sh 2>&1";
        return await _fs.RunCommandAsync(cmd, true, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
    }

    /// <summary>把模块 webroot 复制到 /data/local/tmp 并返回该路径（供下载）</summary>
    public async Task<string> ExportWebRootAsync(ModuleInfo m, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var tmp = DevicePaths.TempDirectory("web_" + m.Id.Replace(" ", "_"));
        await _fs.RunCommandAsync($"rm -rf {Sh.Q(tmp)}", true, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        await _fs.RunCommandAsync($"cp -r {Sh.Q(m.Dir + "/webroot")} {Sh.Q(tmp)}", true, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        await _fs.RunCommandAsync($"chmod -R 777 {Sh.Q(tmp)}", true, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        return tmp;
    }

    /// <summary>把本地 zip 推到设备并用 ksud 安装，实时回传日志</summary>
    public async Task<int> InstallAsync(string localZip, Action<string> onLog, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var remote = DevicePaths.TempFile("mod", ".zip");
        onLog("→ 正在上传模块包到设备…");

        var push = await _adb.RunAsync(new[] { "-s", _fs.Serial, "push", localZip, remote }, _adb.TransferTimeout, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        onLog(push.All.Trim());
        if (!push.Ok) { onLog("× 上传失败"); return -1; }

        // ① 优先用 provider 提供的安装命令（KernelSU→ksud，Magisk→magisk --install-module）
        var cmd = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_installCmd)
            ? null
            : _installCmd!.Replace("{0}", Sh.Q(remote));

        // ② 没识别出实现时，仍尝试 ksud（老路径，兼容各种 fork）
        if (cmd == null)
        {
            var probe = await _fs.RunCommandAsync(
                $"command -v ksud || ls {DevicePaths.AdbData}/ksud 2>/dev/null", true, ct)
                .ConfigureAwait(false);
            if (probe.Contains("ksud", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                cmd = "ksud module install " + Sh.Q(remote);
        }

        onLog(cmd != null ? $"→ 开始安装（{cmd}）…" : "→ 没有可用的安装器，改用直接部署…");
        onLog("");

        var code = cmd != null
            ? await _adb.RunStreamingAsync(
                new[] { "-s", _fs.Serial, "shell", "su", "-c", cmd + " 2>&1" },
                onLog, ct).ConfigureAwait(false)
            : await DeployDirectAsync(remote, onLog, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);

        // ③ 管理器安装失败时，再退回"直接部署"兜底（modules_update + .update 是通用机制）
        if (code != 0 && cmd != null)
        {
            onLog("");
            onLog("× 管理器安装失败，改用直接部署重试…");
            code = await DeployDirectAsync(remote, onLog, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }

        onLog("");
        onLog(code == 0 ? "√ 安装流程结束" : $"× 安装返回码 {code}");

        await _adb.RunAsync(new[] { "-s", _fs.Serial, "shell", "su", "-c", "rm -f " + Sh.Q(remote) }, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        return code;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 不依赖 ksud / 管理器的安装方式：
    /// 解压到 /data/adb/modules_update/&lt;id&gt; 并打 .update 标记，重启时由内核侧合并。
    /// </summary>
    private async Task<int> DeployDirectAsync(string remote, Action<string> onLog, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var tmp = DevicePaths.TempDirectory("mod");

        onLog("→ 解压模块包…");
        await _fs.RunCommandAsync(
            $"rm -rf {tmp}; mkdir -p {tmp}; unzip -o {Sh.Q(remote)} -d {tmp} >/dev/null 2>&1; echo DONE",
            true, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);

        var idRaw = await _fs.RunCommandAsync(
            $"sed -n 's/^id=//p' {tmp}/module.prop 2>/dev/null | head -1", true, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        var mm = System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.Match(idRaw, @"(?m)^\s*([A-Za-z0-9_.\-]+)\s*$");
        if (!mm.Success)
        {
            onLog("× 模块包缺少有效的 id=，已中止");
            await _fs.RunCommandAsync($"rm -rf {tmp}; rm -f {Sh.Q(remote)}", true, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            return -2;
        }

        var id = mm.Groups[1].Value;
        var target = DevicePaths.ModuleUpdateDir(id);
        onLog($"→ 模块 ID：{id}，写入 {target}");

        await _fs.RunCommandAsync($"rm -rf {Sh.Q(target)}", true, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        var cp = await _fs.RunCommandAsync(
            $"mkdir -p {Sh.Q(target)} && " +
            $"cp -a {tmp}/. {Sh.Q(target)}/ && " +
            $"chown -R 0:0 {Sh.Q(target)} && " +
            $"find {Sh.Q(target)} -type d -exec chmod 755 {{}} \\; && " +
            $"find {Sh.Q(target)} -type f -exec chmod 644 {{}} \\; && echo OK",
            true, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);

        var ok = cp.Contains("OK", StringComparison.Ordinal);
        if (ok)
        {
            // 关键：.update 标记让内核侧在下次开机的 post-fs-data 阶段合并
            await _fs.RunCommandAsync(
                $"mkdir -p {DevicePaths.ModulesUpdate} && touch {DevicePaths.ModulesUpdate}/.update",
                true, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            onLog("√ 已写入待更新队列，重启后生效");
        }
        else
        {
            onLog("× 写入失败：" + cp.Trim());
        }

        await _fs.RunCommandAsync($"rm -rf {tmp}; rm -f {Sh.Q(remote)}", true, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        return ok ? 0 : -3;
    }

    /// <summary>发送按键（刷模块时有些脚本要按音量/电源）</summary>
    public Task SendKeyAsync(int keyCode, CancellationToken ct = default)
        => _fs.RunCommandAsync($"input keyevent {keyCode}", false, ct);
}
```

`src/Services/NativeShell.cs`:

```cs
using System;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;

namespace DashFile.Services;

/// <summary>
/// 调 Windows 原生 Shell 复制，目的就是让系统弹出那个“正在复制…”的进度窗口，
/// 让用户能看到真实的传输过程（而不是我们悄悄拷完）。
/// </summary>
public static class NativeShell
{
    [StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential, CharSet = CharSet.Unicode)]
    private struct SHFILEOPSTRUCT
    {
        public IntPtr hwnd;
        public uint wFunc;
        public string? pFrom;
        public string? pTo;
        public ushort fFlags;
        public int fAnyOperationsAborted;
        public IntPtr hNameMappings;
        public string? lpszProgressTitle;
    }

    [DllImport("shell32.dll", CharSet = CharSet.Unicode, SetLastError = true)]
    private static extern int SHFileOperation(ref SHFILEOPSTRUCT lpFileOp);

    private const uint FO_COPY = 0x0002;

    private const ushort FOF_NOCONFIRMATION = 0x0010;
    private const ushort FOF_SIMPLEPROGRESS = 0x0100;  // 显示进度条
    private const ushort FOF_NOERRORUI = 0x0400;

    /// <summary>把若干本地文件/文件夹复制到目标目录，并显示系统进度窗口</summary>
    public static bool CopyWithProgress(IntPtr owner, string[] sources, string targetDir, string? title = null)
    {
        if (sources.Length == 0) return false;

        // 多字符串：每个路径以 \0 结尾，整体再补一个 \0
        var from = string.Join("\0", sources) + "\0\0";

        var op = new SHFILEOPSTRUCT
        {
            hwnd = owner,
            wFunc = FO_COPY,
            pFrom = from,
            pTo = targetDir + "\0\0",
            fFlags = (ushort)(FOF_SIMPLEPROGRESS | FOF_NOCONFIRMATION | FOF_NOERRORUI),
            lpszProgressTitle = title ?? "正在复制"
        };

        try { return SHFileOperation(ref op) == 0; }
        catch { return false; }
    }
}
```

`src/Services/OpenWith/ApkAnalysis.cs`:

```cs
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.IO.Compression;
using System.Linq;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Security.Cryptography.X509Certificates;
using System.Text;
using DashFile.Services;

namespace DashFile.Services.OpenWith;

/// <summary>APK 只读逆向分析：Manifest / 签名 / DEX / 资源字符串 / 哈希。</summary>
internal sealed class ApkAnalysis
{
    public string FilePath = "";
    public string FileName = "";
    public long FileSize;
    public string Md5 = "";
    public string Sha1 = "";
    public string Sha256 = "";
    public int EntryCount;
    public string ParseError = "";

    public List<string> EntryNames = new();
    public List<(string Name, long Size)> DexFiles = new();
    public List<string> Abis = new();
    public List<string> Densities = new();
    public List<string> V1SigFiles = new();
    public List<string> Schemes = new();

    public string SignerSubject = "";
    public string SignerIssuer = "";
    public string SignerSha256 = "";
    public string SignerValid = "";

    public string Package = "";
    public string VersionName = "";
    public string VersionCode = "";
    public string MinSdk = "";
    public string TargetSdk = "";
    public string AppLabel = "";
    public string AppDebuggable = "";
    public string AppAllowBackup = "";
    public string ManifestXml = "";

    public List<string> Permissions = new();
    public List<string> Activities = new();
    public List<string> Services = new();
    public List<string> Receivers = new();
    public List<string> Providers = new();

    public List<DexStat> DexStats = new();
    public List<string> DexStrings = new();
    public List<string> ResourceStrings = new();
    public List<(string Name, long Size)> Largest = new();

    public sealed class DexStat
    {
        public string Name = "";
        public long Size;
        public int Version;
        public int StringIds;
        public int TypeIds;
        public int ProtoIds;
        public int FieldIds;
        public int MethodIds;
        public int ClassDefs;
    }

    public static ApkAnalysis Build(string path, Action<string>? progress = null)
    {
        var a = new ApkAnalysis
        {
            FilePath = path,
            FileName = Path.GetFileName(path),
        };
        try
        {
            var fi = new FileInfo(path);
            a.FileSize = fi.Length;
            progress?.Invoke("计算哈希…");
            using (var fs = File.OpenRead(path))
            {
                using var md5 = MD5.Create();
                using var sha1 = SHA1.Create();
                using var sha256 = SHA256.Create();
                var buf = new byte[81920];
                int n;
                while ((n = fs.Read(buf, 0, buf.Length)) > 0)
                {
                    md5.TransformBlock(buf, 0, n, null, 0);
                    sha1.TransformBlock(buf, 0, n, null, 0);
                    sha256.TransformBlock(buf, 0, n, null, 0);
                }
                md5.TransformFinalBlock(Array.Empty<byte>(), 0, 0);
                sha1.TransformFinalBlock(Array.Empty<byte>(), 0, 0);
                sha256.TransformFinalBlock(Array.Empty<byte>(), 0, 0);
                a.Md5 = Hex(md5.Hash);
                a.Sha1 = Hex(sha1.Hash);
                a.Sha256 = Hex(sha256.Hash);
            }

            progress?.Invoke("读取 APK 结构…");
            var dexBuffers = new List<(string Name, byte[] Data)>();
            using (var zip = ZipFile.OpenRead(path))
            {
                a.EntryCount = zip.Entries.Count;
                foreach (var e in zip.Entries)
                {
                    a.EntryNames.Add(e.FullName);
                    var lower = e.FullName.ToLowerInvariant();
                    if (lower.StartsWith("lib/", StringComparison.Ordinal))
                    {
                        var seg = e.FullName.Split('/');
                        if (seg.Length > 1 && seg[1].Length > 0 && !a.Abis.Contains(seg[1])) a.Abis.Add(seg[1]);
                    }
                    if ((lower.StartsWith("res/", StringComparison.Ordinal) || lower.StartsWith("r/", StringComparison.Ordinal)) && lower.Contains("-"))
                    {
                        var seg = e.FullName.Split('/');
                        if (seg.Length > 1)
                        {
                            var dash = seg[1].IndexOf('-');
                            if (dash > 0)
                            {
                                var dpi = seg[1].Substring(dash + 1);
                                if (dpi.EndsWith("dpi", StringComparison.Ordinal) && !a.Densities.Contains(dpi)) a.Densities.Add(dpi);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    if (lower.StartsWith("meta-inf/", StringComparison.Ordinal) &&
                        (lower.EndsWith(".rsa", StringComparison.Ordinal) || lower.EndsWith(".dsa", StringComparison.Ordinal) ||
                         lower.EndsWith(".ec", StringComparison.Ordinal)))
                    {
                        a.V1SigFiles.Add(e.FullName);
                        try
                        {
                            using var s = e.Open();
                            using var ms = new MemoryStream();
                            s.CopyTo(ms);
                            ReadCertificate(a, ms.ToArray());
                        }
                        catch { }
                    }
                    if (lower.StartsWith("classes", StringComparison.Ordinal) && lower.EndsWith(".dex", StringComparison.Ordinal))
                    {
                        a.DexFiles.Add((e.FullName, e.Length));
                        if (e.Length > 0 && e.Length < 96L * 1024 * 1024)
                        {
                            try
                            {
                                using var s = e.Open();
                                using var ms = new MemoryStream();
                                s.CopyTo(ms);
                                dexBuffers.Add((e.FullName, ms.ToArray()));
                            }
                            catch { }
                        }
                    }
                }

                a.Abis.Sort(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
                a.Densities.Sort(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

                // Manifest / 资源表 / 最大条目
                var manifestEntry = zip.GetEntry("AndroidManifest.xml");
                if (manifestEntry != null)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        using var s = manifestEntry.Open();
                        var doc = AxmlReader.Parse(ReadEntryCapped(s, manifestEntry.Length, 16 * 1024 * 1024, "AndroidManifest.xml"));
                        if (doc != null)
                        {
                            a.ApplyManifest(doc);
                            a.ManifestXml = doc.ToXml();
                        }
                    }
                    catch (Exception ex) { a.ParseError += "Manifest: " + ex.Message + "\n"; }
                }

                var arsc = zip.GetEntry("resources.arsc");
                if (arsc != null)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        using var s = arsc.Open();
                        a.ResourceStrings = Arsc.ExtractStrings(
                            ReadEntryCapped(s, arsc.Length, 64 * 1024 * 1024, "resources.arsc"));
                    }
                    catch (Exception ex) { a.ParseError += "resources.arsc: " + ex.Message + "\n"; }
                }

                a.Largest = zip.Entries.OrderByDescending(e => e.Length).Take(10)
                                .Select(e => (e.FullName, e.Length)).ToList();
            }

            progress?.Invoke("解析 DEX…");
            foreach (var d in dexBuffers)
            {
                try
                {
                    var stat = Dex.ReadStat(d.Name, d.Data);
                    a.DexStats.Add(stat);
                    a.DexStrings.AddRange(Dex.ReadStrings(d.Data));
                }
                catch (Exception ex) { a.ParseError += d.Name + ": " + ex.Message + "\n"; }
            }

            if (a.DexStats.Count > 0 && a.DexStrings.Count == 0)
            {
                // DEX 解析失败时也留个可用的空结果
            }

            progress?.Invoke("检查签名方案…");
            try { a.DetectSigningSchemes(); } catch { }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            a.ParseError += ex.Message + "\n";
        }
        return a;
    }

    private void ApplyManifest(AxmlElement root)
    {
        Package = AxmlReader.Attr(root, "package");
        VersionName = AxmlReader.Attr(root, "versionName");
        VersionCode = AxmlReader.Attr(root, "versionCode");
        var sdk = AxmlReader.Find(root, "uses-sdk");
        if (sdk != null)
        {
            MinSdk = AxmlReader.Attr(sdk, "minSdkVersion");
            TargetSdk = AxmlReader.Attr(sdk, "targetSdkVersion");
        }
        foreach (var p in AxmlReader.FindAll(root, "uses-permission"))
        {
            var n = AxmlReader.Attr(p, "name");
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(n) && !Permissions.Contains(n)) Permissions.Add(n);
        }
        var app = AxmlReader.Find(root, "application");
        if (app != null)
        {
            AppLabel = AxmlReader.Attr(app, "label");
            AppDebuggable = AxmlReader.Attr(app, "debuggable");
            AppAllowBackup = AxmlReader.Attr(app, "allowBackup");
            foreach (var child in app.Children)
            {
                var name = Expand(AxmlReader.Attr(child, "name"));
                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(name)) continue;
                switch (child.Name)
                {
                    case "activity": Activities.Add(name); break;
                    case "service": Services.Add(name); break;
                    case "receiver": Receivers.Add(name); break;
                    case "provider": Providers.Add(name); break;
                }
            }
        }
        Permissions.Sort(StringComparer.Ordinal);
    }

    private string Expand(string name)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(name)) return name;
        if (name.StartsWith(".", StringComparison.Ordinal)) return Package + name;
        if (!name.Contains('.')) return Package + "." + name;
        return name;
    }

    private static void ReadCertificate(ApkAnalysis a, byte[] pkcs7)
    {
        try
        {
            var col = new X509Certificate2Collection();
            col.Import(pkcs7);
            foreach (var cert in col)
            {
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(a.SignerSubject)) break;
                a.SignerSubject = cert.Subject;
                a.SignerIssuer = cert.Issuer;
                a.SignerSha256 = cert.GetCertHashString(HashAlgorithmName.SHA256);
                a.SignerValid = cert.NotBefore.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd") + " ~ " + cert.NotAfter.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd");
            }
        }
        catch { }
    }

    /// <summary>读取 APK Signing Block，判断 v2/v3 签名方案。</summary>
    private void DetectSigningSchemes()
    {
        using var fs = File.OpenRead(FilePath);
        var len = fs.Length;
        if (len < 32) return;
        var tail = new byte[Math.Min(65557, len)];
        fs.Seek(len - tail.Length, SeekOrigin.Begin);
        fs.ReadExactly(tail, 0, tail.Length);

        int eocd = -1;
        for (int i = tail.Length - 22; i >= 0; i--)
        {
            if (tail[i] == 0x50 && tail[i + 1] == 0x4b && tail[i + 2] == 0x05 && tail[i + 3] == 0x06)
            {
                eocd = i;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (eocd < 0) return;
        long cdOffset = BitConverter.ToUInt32(tail, eocd + 16);
        if (cdOffset < 32 || cdOffset > len) return;

        var buf = new byte[24];
        fs.Seek(cdOffset - 24, SeekOrigin.Begin);
        fs.ReadExactly(buf, 0, 24);
        var magic = Encoding.ASCII.GetString(buf, 8, 16);
        if (magic != "APK Sig Block 42") return;

        long size = (long)BitConverter.ToUInt64(buf, 0);
        long blockStart = cdOffset - size - 8;
        if (blockStart < 24 || size > len) return;

        fs.Seek(blockStart + 8, SeekOrigin.Begin);
        long pairEnd = cdOffset - 24;
        long pos = blockStart + 8;
        while (pos + 12 <= pairEnd)
        {
            var head = new byte[8];
            fs.ReadExactly(head, 0, 8);
            long pairLen = (long)BitConverter.ToUInt64(head, 0);
            if (pairLen < 4 || pos + 8 + pairLen > pairEnd) break;
            var idBytes = new byte[4];
            fs.ReadExactly(idBytes, 0, 4);
            uint id = BitConverter.ToUInt32(idBytes, 0);
            if (id == 0x7109871a || id == 0xf05368c0)
            {
                AddScheme(id == 0x7109871a ? "v2" : "v3");
                var vLen = (int)(pairLen - 4);
                if (vLen > 0 && vLen < 8 * 1024 * 1024)
                {
                    var val = new byte[vLen];
                    fs.ReadExactly(val, 0, vLen);
                    ParseSigningBlockCerts(val);
                }
            }
            long next = pos + 8 + pairLen;
            if (next <= pos) break;
            fs.Seek(next, SeekOrigin.Begin);
            pos = next;
        }
    }

    private void AddScheme(string s)
    {
        if (!Schemes.Contains(s)) Schemes.Add(s);
    }

    /// <summary>从 APK Signing Block 的 v2/v3 签名值里提取证书（v2-only 的包只有这里能拿到）。</summary>
    private void ParseSigningBlockCerts(byte[] v)
    {
        try
        {
            int p = 0;
            int blockLen = (int)U32(v, ref p);
            if (blockLen <= 0) return;
            int signerLen = (int)U32(v, ref p);
            if (signerLen <= 0) return;
            int signedLen = (int)U32(v, ref p);
            if (signedLen <= 0) return;
            int digestsLen = (int)U32(v, ref p);
            p += digestsLen;
            int certsLen = (int)U32(v, ref p);
            int end = Math.Min(v.Length, p + certsLen);
            while (p + 4 <= end && string.IsNullOrEmpty(SignerSubject))
            {
                int certLen = (int)U32(v, ref p);
                if (certLen <= 0 || p + certLen > Math.Min(v.Length, end)) break;
                try
                {
                    var der = new byte[certLen];
                    Array.Copy(v, p, der, 0, certLen);
                    var cert = new X509Certificate2(der);
                    SignerSubject = cert.Subject;
                    SignerIssuer = cert.Issuer;
                    SignerSha256 = cert.GetCertHashString(HashAlgorithmName.SHA256);
                    SignerValid = cert.NotBefore.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd") + " ~ " + cert.NotAfter.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd");
                }
                catch { }
                p += certLen;
            }
        }
        catch { }
    }

    private static uint U32(byte[] d, ref int p)
    {
        if (p + 4 > d.Length) { p = d.Length; return 0; }
        uint v = (uint)(d[p] | (d[p + 1] << 8) | (d[p + 2] << 16) | (d[p + 3] << 24));
        p += 4;
        return v;
    }

    // ---------- 报告 ----------

    public string OverviewReport()
    {
        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.AppendLine("文件      " + FileName);
        sb.AppendLine("大小      " + SizeText(FileSize));
        sb.AppendLine("条目      " + EntryCount);
        sb.AppendLine("MD5       " + Md5);
        sb.AppendLine("SHA-1     " + Sha1);
        sb.AppendLine("SHA-256   " + Sha256);
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("包名      " + Dash(Package));
        sb.AppendLine("版本      " + Dash(VersionName) + "   (versionCode " + Dash(VersionCode) + ")");
        sb.AppendLine("SDK       minSdk " + Dash(MinSdk) + " / targetSdk " + Dash(TargetSdk));
        sb.AppendLine("标签      " + Dash(AppLabel) + (AppDebuggable == "true" ? "   [debuggable]" : ""));
        sb.AppendLine("签名方案  " + (Schemes.Count == 0 ? (V1SigFiles.Count > 0 ? "v1" : "未发现") : "v1 + " + string.Join(" + ", Schemes)));
        sb.AppendLine("ABI       " + (Abis.Count == 0 ? "—" : string.Join(", ", Abis)));
        sb.AppendLine("屏幕密度  " + (Densities.Count == 0 ? "—" : string.Join(", ", Densities)));
        sb.AppendLine("权限      " + Permissions.Count + " 项");
        sb.AppendLine("组件      Activity " + Activities.Count + " / Service " + Services.Count +
                      " / Receiver " + Receivers.Count + " / Provider " + Providers.Count);
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("DEX 文件  " + DexFiles.Count + " 个");
        foreach (var d in DexFiles) sb.AppendLine("  " + SizeText(d.Size).PadLeft(10) + "  " + d.Name);
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("最大的条目：");
        foreach (var e in Largest) sb.AppendLine("  " + SizeText(e.Size).PadLeft(10) + "  " + e.Name);
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ParseError))
        {
            sb.AppendLine();
            sb.AppendLine("解析警告：");
            sb.AppendLine(ParseError.TrimEnd());
        }
        return sb.ToString();
    }

    public string ComponentsReport()
    {
        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.AppendLine("包名：" + Dash(Package));
        sb.AppendLine("application：label=" + Dash(AppLabel) + "  debuggable=" + Dash(AppDebuggable) +
                      "  allowBackup=" + Dash(AppAllowBackup));
        sb.AppendLine();
        AppendList(sb, "权限（" + Permissions.Count + "）", Permissions);
        AppendList(sb, "Activity（" + Activities.Count + "）", Activities);
        AppendList(sb, "Service（" + Services.Count + "）", Services);
        AppendList(sb, "Receiver（" + Receivers.Count + "）", Receivers);
        AppendList(sb, "Provider（" + Providers.Count + "）", Providers);
        return sb.ToString();
    }

    public string SignatureReport()
    {
        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.AppendLine("APK：" + FileName);
        sb.AppendLine("SHA-256：" + Sha256);
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("v1 签名文件（META-INF）：");
        if (V1SigFiles.Count == 0) sb.AppendLine("  （无）");
        foreach (var f in V1SigFiles) sb.AppendLine("  " + f);
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("APK Signing Block：" + (Schemes.Count == 0 ? "未发现 v2/v3" : string.Join(" + ", Schemes)));
        sb.AppendLine();
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(SignerSubject))
        {
            sb.AppendLine("证书 Subject：" + SignerSubject);
            sb.AppendLine("证书 Issuer ：" + SignerIssuer);
            sb.AppendLine("有效期      ：" + SignerValid);
            sb.AppendLine("SHA-256     ：" + SignerSha256);
        }
        else
        {
            sb.AppendLine("证书：未能解析（可能是拆分包 / 非常规签名）");
        }
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("提示：证书指纹相同 = 同一个签名密钥；改包后必须用同一密钥重签才能覆盖安装。");
        return sb.ToString();
    }

    public string DexReport()
    {
        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.AppendLine("DEX 概览（每个 classes*.dex 的头部统计）：");
        if (DexStats.Count == 0) { sb.AppendLine("（没有可解析的 DEX，可能被加固 / 加密）"); return sb.ToString(); }
        foreach (var d in DexStats)
        {
            sb.AppendLine();
            sb.AppendLine(d.Name + "   " + SizeText(d.Size) + "   dex " + d.Version + ".0");
            sb.AppendLine("  strings " + d.StringIds + "   types " + d.TypeIds + "   protos " + d.ProtoIds);
            sb.AppendLine("  fields  " + d.FieldIds + "   methods " + d.MethodIds + "   classes " + d.ClassDefs);
        }
        var totalMethods = DexStats.Sum(x => (long)x.MethodIds);
        var totalClasses = DexStats.Sum(x => (long)x.ClassDefs);
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("合计：class " + totalClasses + " / method " + totalMethods + " / string " + DexStrings.Count);
        if (DexStrings.Count == 0)
        {
            sb.AppendLine();
            sb.AppendLine("（只有壳 DEX：字符串池为空或被加密，常见于加固/商业保护）");
        }
        return sb.ToString();
    }

    public string ResourceStringsText()
    {
        if (ResourceStrings.Count == 0) return "没解析到资源字符串（resources.arsc 可能被加密或不存在）。";
        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.AppendLine("resources.arsc 全局字符串池：" + ResourceStrings.Count + " 条");
        sb.AppendLine();
        foreach (var s in ResourceStrings) sb.AppendLine(s);
        return sb.ToString();
    }

    public string DexStringsText(string filter, int limit = 60000)
    {
        if (DexStrings.Count == 0) return "没有可解析的 DEX 字符串（可能被加固/加密）。";
        var list = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(filter)
            ? DexStrings
            : DexStrings.Where(s => s.Contains(filter, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)).ToList();
        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.AppendLine("DEX 字符串：" + DexStrings.Count + " 条" +
                      (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(filter) ? "" : "，匹配 " + list.Count + " 条"));
        sb.AppendLine();
        int n = 0;
        foreach (var s in list)
        {
            if (n++ >= limit) { sb.AppendLine("…（已截断）"); break; }
            sb.AppendLine(s);
        }
        return sb.ToString();
    }

    public string DexStringsForExport()
    {
        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        foreach (var s in DexStrings) sb.AppendLine(s);
        return sb.ToString();
    }

    private static void AppendList(StringBuilder sb, string title, List<string> items)
    {
        sb.AppendLine("=== " + title + " ===");
        if (items.Count == 0) sb.AppendLine("  （无）");
        foreach (var i in items) sb.AppendLine("  " + i);
        sb.AppendLine();
    }

    private static string Dash(string? s) => string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(s) ? "—" : s;

    public static string SizeText(long bytes)
    {
        double v = bytes;
        string[] units = { "B", "KB", "MB", "GB" };
        int u = 0;
        while (v >= 1024 && u < units.Length - 1) { v /= 1024; u++; }
        return v.ToString("0.##") + " " + units[u];
    }

    private static string Hex(byte[]? b) => b == null ? "" : Convert.ToHexString(b);

    /// <summary>
    /// 读 zip 条目，但带硬上限：以前 manifest / arsc 是直接 CopyTo(MemoryStream)，
    /// 一个几十 KB 的 zip bomb 就能把内存吃光；dex 那处本来就有 96MB 上限，这两处漏了。
    /// </summary>
    private static byte[] ReadEntryCapped(Stream s, long declaredLength, int max, string name)
    {
        if (declaredLength > max)
            throw new InvalidDataException($"{name} 声明大小超过 {max / 1024 / 1024}MB 上限，已跳过");

        using var ms = new MemoryStream(declaredLength is > 0 and < int.MaxValue ? (int)declaredLength : 64 * 1024);
        var buf = new byte[64 * 1024];
        int n;
        while ((n = s.Read(buf, 0, buf.Length)) > 0)
        {
            if (ms.Length + n > max)
                throw new InvalidDataException($"{name} 解压后超过 {max / 1024 / 1024}MB 上限，已跳过");
            ms.Write(buf, 0, n);
        }
        return ms.ToArray();
    }
}


/// <summary>resources.arsc 全局字符串池提取。</summary>
internal static class Arsc
{
    public static List<string> ExtractStrings(byte[] data)
    {
        var result = new List<string>();
        if (data.Length < 12) return result;
        int type = AxmlReader.U16(data, 0);
        if (type != 0x0002) return result;
        int headerSize = AxmlReader.U16(data, 2);
        int total = (int)AxmlReader.U32(data, 4);
        if (total <= 0 || total > data.Length) total = data.Length;
        int p = headerSize;
        while (p + 8 <= total)
        {
            int ct = AxmlReader.U16(data, p);
            int csz = (int)AxmlReader.U32(data, p + 4);
            if (csz <= 0) break;
            if (ct == 0x0001)
            {
                result = AxmlReader.ReadStringPool(data, p);
                break;
            }
            p += csz;
        }
        return result;
    }
}

/// <summary>DEX 头部与字符串池读取。</summary>
internal static class Dex
{
    public static ApkAnalysis.DexStat ReadStat(string name, byte[] d)
    {
        var s = new ApkAnalysis.DexStat
        {
            Name = name,
            Size = d.Length,
        };
        if (d.Length < 0x70) return s;
        s.Version = int.TryParse(Encoding.ASCII.GetString(d, 4, 3), out var v) ? v : 0;
        s.StringIds = (int)AxmlReader.U32(d, 0x38);
        s.TypeIds = (int)AxmlReader.U32(d, 0x40);
        s.ProtoIds = (int)AxmlReader.U32(d, 0x48);
        s.FieldIds = (int)AxmlReader.U32(d, 0x50);
        s.MethodIds = (int)AxmlReader.U32(d, 0x58);
        s.ClassDefs = (int)AxmlReader.U32(d, 0x60);
        return s;
    }

    public static List<string> ReadStrings(byte[] d)
    {
        var list = new List<string>();
        if (d.Length < 0x70) return list;
        int count = (int)AxmlReader.U32(d, 0x38);
        int off = (int)AxmlReader.U32(d, 0x3C);
        if (count <= 0 || count > 2_000_000 || off <= 0 || off >= d.Length) return list;
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
        {
            int idOff = off + i * 4;
            if (idOff + 4 > d.Length) break;
            int dataOff = (int)AxmlReader.U32(d, idOff);
            if (dataOff <= 0 || dataOff >= d.Length) continue;
            list.Add(ReadMutf8(d, dataOff));
        }
        return list;
    }

    private static string ReadMutf8(byte[] d, int p)
    {
        // 跳过 uleb128 的 utf16 长度
        while (p < d.Length)
        {
            byte b = d[p++];
            if ((b & 0x80) == 0) break;
        }
        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        while (p < d.Length && d[p] != 0)
        {
            int b = d[p++];
            if (b < 0x80) sb.Append((char)b);
            else if ((b & 0xE0) == 0xC0)
            {
                if (p >= d.Length) break;
                int b2 = d[p++];
                sb.Append((char)(((b & 0x1F) << 6) | (b2 & 0x3F)));
            }
            else if ((b & 0xF0) == 0xE0)
            {
                if (p + 1 >= d.Length) break;
                int b2 = d[p++], b3 = d[p++];
                sb.Append((char)(((b & 0x0F) << 12) | ((b2 & 0x3F) << 6) | (b3 & 0x3F)));
            }
            else if ((b & 0xF8) == 0xF0)
            {
                if (p + 2 >= d.Length) break;
                int b2 = d[p++], b3 = d[p++], b4 = d[p++];
                int cp = ((b & 0x07) << 18) | ((b2 & 0x3F) << 12) | ((b3 & 0x3F) << 6) | (b4 & 0x3F);
                cp -= 0x10000;
                sb.Append((char)(0xD800 + (cp >> 10)));
                sb.Append((char)(0xDC00 + (cp & 0x3FF)));
            }
            else sb.Append('?');
        }
        return sb.ToString();
    }
}
```

```cs
    public static string Ext(string name)
    {
        var i = name.LastIndexOf('.');
        return i < 0 || i == name.Length - 1 ? "" : name[(i + 1)..].ToLowerInvariant();
    }

    /// <summary>左键双击的默认动作；返回 null 表示无合适工具，应弹出「打开方式」。</summary>
    public static FileAction? DefaultFor(string name)
    {
        var ext = Ext(name);
        if (name.EndsWith(".9.png", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) return FileAction.NinePatchPreview;
        return ext switch
        {
            "txt" or "log" or "md" or "ini" or "conf" or "cfg" or "prop" or "json"
                or "py" or "lua" or "js" or "css" or "html" or "htm"
                => FileAction.EditText,
            "sh" or "bash" or "zsh" or "run" => FileAction.ScriptRun,
            "xml" => FileAction.XmlInfo,
            "svg" => FileAction.SvgInfo,
            "png" or "jpg" or "jpeg" or "webp" or "bmp" or "gif" => FileAction.ImagePreview,
            "mp3" or "wav" or "flac" or "ogg" or "m4a" or "aac" => FileAction.MusicPlay,
            "mp4" or "mkv" or "avi" or "mov" or "webm" or "3gp" => FileAction.VideoPlay,
            "ttf" or "otf" or "ttc" => FileAction.FontPreview,
            "zip" or "7z" or "rar" or "tar" or "gz" or "xz" or "bz2" or "tgz" => FileAction.ArchiveBrowse,
            "jar" => FileAction.JarInfo,
            "apk" => FileAction.ApkInfo,
            "apks" or "apkm" or "xapk" => FileAction.ApksInfo,
            "dex" => FileAction.DexInfo,
            "arsc" => FileAction.ArscInfo,
            "class" => FileAction.ClassInfo,
            _ => null,
        };
```
