```cs
    // ---------------- 轻量查看器 ----------------

    public static string HexDump(byte[] data, int limit = 256 * 1024)
    {
        var n = Math.Min(data.Length, limit);
        var sb = new StringBuilder(n * 4);
        for (var off = 0; off < n; off += 16)
        {
            sb.Append(off.ToString("x8")).Append("  ");
            var line = Math.Min(16, n - off);
            for (var i = 0; i < 16; i++)
            {
                sb.Append(i < line ? data[off + i].ToString("x2") : "  ");
                sb.Append(i == 7 ? "  " : " ");
            }
            sb.Append(" ");
            for (var i = 0; i < line; i++)
            {
                var b = data[off + i];
                sb.Append(b >= 32 && b < 127 ? (char)b : '.');
            }
            sb.AppendLine();
        }
        if (data.Length > limit) sb.AppendLine($"…（仅显示前 {limit / 1024} KB，共 {data.Length} 字节）");
        return sb.ToString();
    }

    public static string TextReport(byte[] data, int limit = 2 * 1024 * 1024)
    {
        var n = Math.Min(data.Length, limit);
        var text = Encoding.UTF8.GetString(data, 0, n).Replace("\0", "");
        if (data.Length > limit) text += $"\n\n…（仅显示前 {limit / 1024} KB，共 {data.Length} 字节）";
        return text;
    }

    public static string XmlReport(byte[] data)
    {
        // 二进制 AndroidManifest.xml → 解码成文本；普通 xml 直接当文本
        var root = AxmlReader.Parse(data);
        if (root != null) return root.ToXml();
        return TextReport(data);
    }

    public static string DexReport(byte[] data, string name)
    {
        var stat = Dex.ReadStat(name, data);
        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.AppendLine($"DEX 文件：{name}");
        sb.AppendLine($"大小      {stat.Size:N0} 字节");
        sb.AppendLine($"版本      dex {stat.Version}.0");
        sb.AppendLine($"strings   {stat.StringIds:N0}");
        sb.AppendLine($"types     {stat.TypeIds:N0}");
        sb.AppendLine($"protos    {stat.ProtoIds:N0}");
        sb.AppendLine($"fields    {stat.FieldIds:N0}");
        sb.AppendLine($"methods   {stat.MethodIds:N0}");
        sb.AppendLine($"classes   {stat.ClassDefs:N0}");
        var strings = Dex.ReadStrings(data);
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine($"字符串（前 500 条 / 共 {strings.Count} 条）：");
        foreach (var s in strings.Take(500)) sb.AppendLine("  " + s);
        return sb.ToString();
    }

    public static string ArscReport(byte[] data)
    {
        var strings = Arsc.ExtractStrings(data);
        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.AppendLine($"resources.arsc：{data.Length:N0} 字节");
        sb.AppendLine($"全局字符串池：{strings.Count:N0} 条");
        sb.AppendLine();
        foreach (var s in strings.Take(2000)) sb.AppendLine(s);
        if (strings.Count > 2000) sb.AppendLine($"…（仅显示前 2000 条）");
        return sb.ToString();
    }

    public static string ClassReport(byte[] data)
    {
        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.AppendLine($"Class 文件：{data.Length:N0} 字节");
        if (data.Length >= 8 && data[0] == 0xCA && data[1] == 0xFE && data[2] == 0xBA && data[3] == 0xBE)
        {
            var minor = (data[4] << 8) | data[5];
            var major = (data[6] << 8) | data[7];
            sb.AppendLine($"Magic     CAFEBABE");
            sb.AppendLine($"版本      {major}.{minor}");
            sb.AppendLine();
            sb.AppendLine("可打印字符串（前 300 条）：");
            foreach (var s in ExtractStrings(data, 4).Take(300)) sb.AppendLine("  " + s);
        }
        else
        {
            sb.AppendLine("（不是标准 class 文件，下面按十六进制查看）");
        }
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine(HexDump(data, 64 * 1024));
        return sb.ToString();
    }

    public static string ZipReport(string localPath, string title)
    {
        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        try
        {
            using var zip = ZipFile.OpenRead(localPath);
            sb.AppendLine($"{title}：{zip.Entries.Count} 个条目");
            sb.AppendLine();
            foreach (var e in zip.Entries.OrderBy(e => e.FullName, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase).Take(3000))
                sb.AppendLine($"{e.Length,12:N0}  {e.FullName}");
            if (zip.Entries.Count > 3000) sb.AppendLine("…（仅显示前 3000 条）");
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { sb.AppendLine("读取失败：" + ex.Message); }
        return sb.ToString();
    }

    public static string ApkReport(string localPath, bool signatureOnly = false)
    {
        var a = ApkAnalysis.Build(localPath);
        if (signatureOnly) return a.SignatureReport();
        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.Append(a.OverviewReport());
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("── 组件 ──");
        sb.Append(a.ComponentsReport());
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("── 签名 ──");
        sb.Append(a.SignatureReport());
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("── DEX ──");
        sb.Append(a.DexReport());
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(a.ManifestXml))
        {
            sb.AppendLine();
            sb.AppendLine("── AndroidManifest.xml ──");
            var xml = a.ManifestXml;
            sb.AppendLine(xml.Length > 40000 ? xml[..40000] + "\n…（已截断）" : xml);
        }
        return sb.ToString();
    }

    private static IEnumerable<string> ExtractStrings(byte[] data, int minLen)
    {
        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        foreach (var b in data)
        {
            if (b >= 32 && b < 127) { sb.Append((char)b); continue; }
            if (sb.Length >= minLen && sb.Length <= 300) yield return sb.ToString();
            sb.Clear();
        }
    }
}
```

```cs
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Reflection;
using System.Runtime.Loader;
using DashFile.PluginApi;

namespace DashFile.Services.Plugins;

public enum PluginLoadState
{
    Disabled = 0,
    Loaded = 1,
    Error = 2,
}

/// <summary>
/// 一个已发现插件的宿主侧状态。UI 只读这里，不直接碰插件实例。
/// </summary>
public sealed class PluginDescriptor
{
    public PluginManifest Manifest { get; }

    /// <summary>插件目录（绝对路径）。</summary>
    public string Directory { get; }

    /// <summary>入口 DLL 的绝对路径。</summary>
    public string AssemblyPath { get; }

    public PluginLoadState State { get; internal set; } = PluginLoadState.Disabled;

    public string? Error { get; internal set; }

    /// <summary>用户是否启用（可能与 State 不同：启用但加载失败时 State=Error）。</summary>
    public bool Enabled { get; internal set; }

    public string Id => Manifest.Id;

    public string Name => string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Manifest.Name) ? Manifest.Id : Manifest.Name;

    public IReadOnlyList<PluginPage> Pages => _pages;

    public IReadOnlyList<PluginAction> Actions => _actions;

    public IReadOnlyList<PluginAction> GlobalActions => _globalActions;

    public string StateText => State switch
    {
        PluginLoadState.Loaded => "已加载",
        PluginLoadState.Error => "加载失败",
        _ => "已禁用",
    };

    internal IDashFilePlugin? Instance;
    internal IPluginHost? HostObject;

    /// <summary>插件初始化的生命周期令牌：超时只 Cancel，卸载时才 Dispose</summary>
    internal System.Threading.CancellationTokenSource? InitCts;
    internal PluginLoadContext? LoadContext;
    internal Assembly? Assembly;

    private readonly List<PluginPage> _pages = new();
    private readonly List<PluginAction> _actions = new();
    private readonly List<PluginAction> _globalActions = new();

    public PluginDescriptor(PluginManifest manifest, string directory, string assemblyPath)
    {
        Manifest = manifest;
        Directory = directory;
        AssemblyPath = assemblyPath;
    }

    internal void AddPage(PluginPage page)
    {
        if (page == null) return;
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(page.Id)) page = CopyPage(page, "page-" + (_pages.Count + 1));
        _pages.Add(page);
    }

    internal void AddAction(PluginAction action)
    {
        if (action == null) return;
        if (action.ShowInContextMenu) _actions.Add(action);
        else _globalActions.Add(action);
    }

    internal void AddGlobalAction(PluginAction action)
    {
        if (action == null) return;
        _globalActions.Add(action);
    }

    internal void ClearRegistrations()
    {
        _pages.Clear();
        _actions.Clear();
        _globalActions.Clear();
    }

    private static PluginPage CopyPage(PluginPage page, string id) => new()
    {
        Id = id,
        Title = page.Title,
        Description = page.Description,
        Icon = page.Icon,
        CreateViewAsync = page.CreateViewAsync,
    };
}

/// <summary>右键菜单里的一条插件动作，带插件归属信息。</summary>
public sealed record PluginActionBinding(PluginDescriptor Plugin, PluginAction Action);

/// <summary>插件宿主内部的事件发送口，由 PluginHostBridge 实现。</summary>
internal interface IPluginEventSink
{
    void RaiseDeviceChanged(DeviceSnapshot snapshot);

    void RaiseFileSelection(PluginTarget? target);
}

/// <summary>插件程序集加载上下文：共享 API / Avalonia，其余依赖从插件目录加载。</summary>
internal sealed class PluginLoadContext : AssemblyLoadContext
{
    private readonly string _directory;
    private readonly AssemblyDependencyResolver _resolver;

    public PluginLoadContext(string assemblyPath)
        : base("DashFile.Plugin:" + System.IO.Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(assemblyPath), isCollectible: true)
    {
        _directory = System.IO.Path.GetDirectoryName(assemblyPath) ?? "";
        try { _resolver = new AssemblyDependencyResolver(assemblyPath); }
        catch { _resolver = null!; }
    }

    protected override Assembly? Load(AssemblyName assemblyName)
    {
        // 插件与宿主必须共用同一份契约和 UI 程序集，否则 IPluginHost / Control 会是两个不同的类型，
        //   表现为“插件明明实现了接口，宿主却说不认识”。
        if (string.Equals(assemblyName.Name, typeof(IPluginHost).Assembly.GetName().Name,
                StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return typeof(IPluginHost).Assembly;

        if (assemblyName.Name != null && IsSharedWithHost(assemblyName.Name))
            return null; // 交回默认上下文加载

        if (_resolver != null)
        {
            try
            {
                var resolved = _resolver.ResolveAssemblyToPath(assemblyName);
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(resolved) && System.IO.File.Exists(resolved))
                    return LoadFromAssemblyPath(resolved);
            }
            catch { }
        }

        if (assemblyName.Name != null)
        {
            var local = System.IO.Path.Combine(_directory, assemblyName.Name + ".dll");
            if (System.IO.File.Exists(local)) return LoadFromAssemblyPath(local);
        }
        return null;
    }

    protected override nint LoadUnmanagedDll(string unmanagedDllName)
    {
        try
        {
            var path = _resolver?.ResolveUnmanagedDllToPath(unmanagedDllName);
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(path)) return LoadUnmanagedDllFromPath(path);
        }
        catch { }
        return 0;
    }

    private static bool IsSharedWithHost(string name)
        => name.StartsWith("Avalonia", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
           || name.StartsWith("SkiaSharp", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
           || name.StartsWith("HarfBuzzSharp", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
           || name.StartsWith("MicroCom", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
           || name.StartsWith("CommunityToolkit", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
           || name.StartsWith("System.", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
           || string.Equals(name, "System", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
           || string.Equals(name, "netstandard", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
           || string.Equals(name, "mscorlib", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
}
```

`src/Services/Plugins/PluginManager.cs`:

```cs
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Reflection;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using DashFile.PluginApi;

namespace DashFile.Services.Plugins;

/// <summary>
/// 插件加载与生命周期管理。
///
/// 设计要点：
///  - 扫描 plugins/&lt;id&gt;/plugin.json，一个插件一个目录、一个可回收 AssemblyLoadContext；
///  - 契约程序集（DashFile.PluginApi）和 Avalonia 强制共用宿主那一份，避免类型身份分裂；
///  - 单个插件初始化失败不影响其它插件，失败原因展示在插件页；
///  - 禁用 / 重载会调用 Shutdown 并卸载 ALC，用户不需要重启程序。
/// </summary>
public sealed class PluginManager
{
    private readonly string _hostVersion;
    private readonly Func<PluginManifest, IDashFilePlugin, IPluginHost> _hostFactory;
    private readonly Action<string>? _log;
    private readonly string _stateFile;
    private readonly string _dataDir;
    private readonly string _legacyStateFile;
    private readonly List<string> _roots;
    private readonly List<PluginDescriptor> _plugins = new();
    private readonly List<IPluginEventSink> _sinks = new();
    private readonly Dictionary<string, bool> _enabledState = new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
    private bool _loading;

    public PluginManager(
        string hostVersion,
        IEnumerable<string> pluginRoots,
        string dataRoot,
        Func<PluginManifest, IDashFilePlugin, IPluginHost> hostFactory,
        Action<string>? log = null)
    {
        _hostVersion = hostVersion;
        _roots = pluginRoots.Where(p => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(p)).Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase).ToList();
        _hostFactory = hostFactory;
        _log = log;

        // 插件"数据目录"必须与"扫描根"分开。以前两者都是 <dataRoot>\plugins，
        //   于是插件数据就躺在插件自己的安装目录里：卸载时勾"保留数据"是空话（删目录=删数据），
        //   覆盖升级也一定会把数据一起丢掉；plugin-state.json 还混在扫描目录里。
        _dataDir = Path.Combine(dataRoot, "plugin-data");
        Directory.CreateDirectory(_dataDir);
        _stateFile = Path.Combine(dataRoot, "plugin-state.json");
        _legacyStateFile = Path.Combine(dataRoot, "plugins", "plugin-state.json");
        LoadState();

        foreach (var root in _roots)
        {
            try
            {
                Directory.CreateDirectory(root);
                SeedReadme(root);
            }
            catch { }
        }
    }

    public event EventHandler? Changed;

    public IReadOnlyList<PluginDescriptor> Plugins => _plugins;

    public IReadOnlyList<string> Roots => _roots;

    /// <summary>插件数据根目录（每个插件一个子目录，与安装目录分离）</summary>
    public string DataDirectory => _dataDir;

    public bool IsLoading => _loading;

    /// <summary>扫描目录并加载所有已启用的插件。可重复调用（会先卸载旧插件）。</summary>
    public async Task LoadAllAsync()
    {
        if (_loading) return;
        _loading = true;
        try
        {
            await UnloadAllAsync().ConfigureAwait(true);
            _plugins.Clear();
            _sinks.Clear();

            var manifests = Scan();
            var seen = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
            foreach (var item in manifests)
            {
                var descriptor = item.Descriptor;
                if (!seen.Add(descriptor.Id))
                {
                    descriptor.State = PluginLoadState.Error;
                    descriptor.Error = "插件 id 重复，已跳过：" + descriptor.Directory;
                    _plugins.Add(descriptor);
                    continue;
                }

                descriptor.Enabled = IsEnabled(descriptor);
                _plugins.Add(descriptor);

                if (!descriptor.Enabled)
                {
                    descriptor.State = PluginLoadState.Disabled;
                    continue;
                }

                if (item.Error != null)
                {
                    descriptor.State = PluginLoadState.Error;
                    descriptor.Error = item.Error;
                    continue;
                }

                await LoadOneAsync(descriptor).ConfigureAwait(true);
            }

            _log?.Invoke($"插件扫描完成：{_plugins.Count} 个，已加载 {_plugins.Count(p => p.State == PluginLoadState.Loaded)} 个");
        }
        finally
        {
            _loading = false;
            RaiseChanged();
        }
    }

    /// <summary>重载全部插件（用于开发时反复改 DLL）。</summary>
    public Task ReloadAllAsync() => LoadAllAsync();

    public async Task EnableAsync(string id)
    {
        var descriptor = Find(id);
        if (descriptor == null) return;

        descriptor.Enabled = true;
        _enabledState[id] = true;
        SaveState();

        if (descriptor.State != PluginLoadState.Loaded)
        {
            descriptor.State = PluginLoadState.Disabled;
            descriptor.Error = null;
            await LoadOneAsync(descriptor).ConfigureAwait(true);
        }
        RaiseChanged();
    }

    public async Task DisableAsync(string id)
    {
        var descriptor = Find(id);
        if (descriptor == null) return;

        descriptor.Enabled = false;
        _enabledState[id] = false;
        SaveState();

        await UnloadOneAsync(descriptor).ConfigureAwait(true);
        descriptor.State = PluginLoadState.Disabled;
        descriptor.Error = null;
        RaiseChanged();
    }

    public async Task ReloadOneAsync(string id)
    {
        var descriptor = Find(id);
        if (descriptor == null) return;

        await UnloadOneAsync(descriptor).ConfigureAwait(true);
        descriptor.Error = null;
        if (descriptor.Enabled) await LoadOneAsync(descriptor).ConfigureAwait(true);
        RaiseChanged();
    }

    public IReadOnlyList<PluginActionBinding> GetActions(PluginTargetKind kind)
    {
        if (kind == PluginTargetKind.None) return Array.Empty<PluginActionBinding>();
        var list = new List<PluginActionBinding>();
        foreach (var plugin in _plugins.Where(p => p.State == PluginLoadState.Loaded))
        {
            foreach (var action in plugin.Actions)
            {
                if (action.Targets.Length == 0 ||
                    action.Targets.Contains(PluginTargetKind.Any) ||
                    action.Targets.Contains(kind))
                    list.Add(new PluginActionBinding(plugin, action));
            }
        }
        return list;
    }

    public IReadOnlyList<PluginActionBinding> GetGlobalActions()
    {
        var list = new List<PluginActionBinding>();
        foreach (var plugin in _plugins.Where(p => p.State == PluginLoadState.Loaded))
            foreach (var action in plugin.GlobalActions)
                list.Add(new PluginActionBinding(plugin, action));
        return list;
    }

    public PluginDescriptor? Find(string id)
        => _plugins.FirstOrDefault(p => string.Equals(p.Id, id, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));

    /// <summary>插件在运行期动态注册页面 / 动作后，通知宿主刷新 UI。</summary>
    public void NotifyChanged() => RaiseChanged();

    public void RaiseDeviceChanged(DeviceSnapshot snapshot)
    {
        foreach (var sink in _sinks.ToArray())
        {
            try { sink.RaiseDeviceChanged(snapshot); }
            catch (Exception ex) { _log?.Invoke("插件设备事件失败：" + ex.Message); }
        }
    }

    public void RaiseFileSelection(PluginTarget? target)
    {
        foreach (var sink in _sinks.ToArray())
        {
            try { sink.RaiseFileSelection(target); }
            catch (Exception ex) { _log?.Invoke("插件选择事件失败：" + ex.Message); }
        }
    }

    // ---------------- 内部：扫描 ----------------

    private sealed record ScanItem(PluginDescriptor Descriptor, string? Error);

    private List<ScanItem> Scan()
    {
        var result = new List<ScanItem>();
        var known = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

        foreach (var root in _roots)
        {
            if (!Directory.Exists(root)) continue;

            IEnumerable<string> dirs;
            try { dirs = Directory.EnumerateDirectories(root).OrderBy(d => d, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase).ToList(); }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _log?.Invoke("插件目录枚举失败：" + root + " -> " + ex.Message);
                continue;
            }

            foreach (var dir in dirs)
            {
                var dirName = Path.GetFileName(dir);

                // 内部目录不能当插件扫：残留的 *.bak-<guid> / *.deleted-<guid> 里也有
                //   plugin.json 和 dll，会被当成"同名 id 的重复插件"，甚至让卸载过的插件复活。
                if (IsReservedDirectory(dirName)) continue;

                var manifestPath = Path.Combine(dir, PluginApiInfo.ManifestFileName);
                if (!File.Exists(manifestPath)) continue;
                if (!known.Add(dirName)) continue; // 同名目录只取第一个根

                PluginManifest? manifest = null;
                string? error = null;
                try
                {
                    var json = File.ReadAllText(manifestPath);
                    manifest = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<PluginManifest>(json, new JsonSerializerOptions
                    {
                        PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true,
                        ReadCommentHandling = JsonCommentHandling.Skip,
                        AllowTrailingCommas = true,
                    });
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    error = "plugin.json 解析失败：" + ex.Message;
                }

                manifest ??= new PluginManifest
                {
                    Id = Path.GetFileName(dir),
                    Name = Path.GetFileName(dir),
                };

                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(manifest.Id))
                {
                    manifest.Id = dirName;
                    error ??= "plugin.json 缺少 id";
                }
                else if (!PluginPackage.IsSafeId(manifest.Id))
                {
                    // 之前只有 .dfp 安装路径校验 id；这里手工放进来的目录/改过的 plugin.json
                    //   一旦带 ..\ 之类，后续 Path.Combine(root, id) 会变成越界删除，必须挡住。
                    error ??= "plugin.json 的 id 不合法（只能是字母/数字/._-）";
                    manifest.Id = dirName;
                }

                if (manifest.ApiVersion > PluginApiInfo.Version)
                    error ??= $"插件需要 API v{manifest.ApiVersion}，当前宿主只支持 v{PluginApiInfo.Version}";
                else if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(manifest.MinHostVersion) &&
                         !VersionAtLeast(_hostVersion, manifest.MinHostVersion!))
                    error ??= $"插件要求 DashFile ≥ {manifest.MinHostVersion}，当前 {_hostVersion}";

                var assemblyPath = ResolveAssemblyPath(dir, manifest, ref error);
                var descriptor = new PluginDescriptor(manifest, dir, assemblyPath);
                result.Add(new ScanItem(descriptor, error));
            }
        }

        return result;
    }

    private static string ResolveAssemblyPath(string dir, PluginManifest manifest, ref string? error)
    {
        var assembly = manifest.Assembly;
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(assembly))
        {
            // 允许省略：找目录里唯一一个与目录同名的 dll，或唯一一个 dll
            try
            {
                var dlls = Directory.GetFiles(dir, "*.dll", SearchOption.TopDirectoryOnly);
                var same = dlls.FirstOrDefault(d =>
                    string.Equals(Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(d), Path.GetFileName(dir),
                        StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
                assembly = Path.GetFileName(same ?? (dlls.Length == 1 ? dlls[0] : ""));
            }
            catch { }
        }

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(assembly))
        {
            error ??= "plugin.json 缺少 assembly，且目录里找不到唯一的 dll";
            return "";
        }

        var full = Path.GetFullPath(Path.Combine(dir, assembly));
        var root = Path.GetFullPath(dir);
        if (!full.StartsWith(root + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) &&
            !string.Equals(full, root, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            error ??= "assembly 路径越出了插件目录";
            return "";
        }

        if (!File.Exists(full))
        {
            error ??= "找不到入口程序集：" + assembly;
            return "";
        }
        return full;
    }


    // ---------------- 安装 / 卸载 .dfp ----------------

    public string PrimaryRoot => _roots[0];

    // 扫描时要跳过的内部目录：安装临时区 / 覆盖安装的旧版本备份 / 删除失败的待清理目录
    private const string ReservedPrefixInstall = ".install-";
    private const string ReservedPrefixBackup = ".bak-";
    private const string ReservedPrefixDeleted = ".deleted-";

    private static bool IsReservedDirectory(string name)
        => name.StartsWith(ReservedPrefixInstall, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
           || name.Contains(ReservedPrefixBackup, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
           || name.Contains(ReservedPrefixDeleted, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

    /// <summary>
    /// 安装 .dfp（zip）插件包。只接受 .dfp；已有同 id 插件时必须显式 replaceExisting。
    /// 返回安装后的描述符（加载失败时 State=Error，但仍返回，方便 UI 展示原因）。
    /// </summary>
    public async Task<PluginDescriptor?> InstallPackageAsync(string packagePath, bool replaceExisting,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        if (!PluginPackage.IsPackage(packagePath))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("只接受 .dfp 插件包");
        if (!File.Exists(packagePath))
            throw new FileNotFoundException("找不到插件包", packagePath);

        var root = PrimaryRoot;
        Directory.CreateDirectory(root);
        // 解压目录必须和目标在同一个卷上：Directory.Move 不支持跨卷，
        //   以前解压到 %TEMP%（通常是 C:），程序装在 D: 时安装 100% 失败。
        var temp = Path.Combine(root, ReservedPrefixInstall + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N"));
        Directory.CreateDirectory(temp);
        string? backup = null;
        string? target = null;

        try
        {
            var packageRoot = PluginPackage.Extract(packagePath, temp);
            var manifest = PluginPackage.ReadManifest(packageRoot);
            target = Path.Combine(root, manifest.Id);

            var existing = Find(manifest.Id);
            if (Directory.Exists(target) || existing != null)
            {
                if (!replaceExisting)
                    throw new InvalidOperationException($"插件 {manifest.Id} 已安装；如需覆盖请选择替换。");
                if (existing != null) await UnloadOneAsync(existing).ConfigureAwait(true);
                if (Directory.Exists(target))
                {
                    backup = target + ".bak-" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N");
                    Directory.Move(target, backup);
                }
            }

            // 确保没有残留目录（大小写不敏感文件系统上 id 可能只差大小写）
            if (Directory.Exists(target) && !PathsEqual(target, packageRoot))
                Directory.Delete(target, recursive: true);

            if (!PathsEqual(target, packageRoot))
                Directory.Move(packageRoot, target);

            await LoadAllAsync().ConfigureAwait(true);
            var installed = Find(manifest.Id);
            _log?.Invoke($"插件安装：{manifest.Id} <- {packagePath}");
            if (backup != null)
            {
                try { Directory.Delete(backup, recursive: true); } catch { }
                backup = null;
            }
            return installed;
        }
        catch
        {
            // 安装失败尽量恢复旧版本
            try
            {
                if (target != null && Directory.Exists(target))
                    Directory.Delete(target, recursive: true);
                // CA1508 会把这里判成"backup 恒为 null"：它看不到 await LoadAllAsync() 也会抛，
                // 而那条路径上旧版本已经改名到 backup、新版本已经就位 —— 这里必须回滚。
#pragma warning disable CA1508
                if (backup != null && Directory.Exists(backup) && target != null)
                    Directory.Move(backup, target);
#pragma warning restore CA1508
            }
            catch { }
            throw;
        }
        finally
        {
            if (backup != null)
            {
                try { if (Directory.Exists(backup)) Directory.Delete(backup, recursive: true); } catch { }
            }
            try { if (Directory.Exists(temp)) Directory.Delete(temp, recursive: true); } catch { }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>卸载插件：先停用/卸载 ALC，再删目录；可选删除插件数据（设置/缓存）。</summary>
    public async Task UninstallAsync(string id, bool deleteData, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var descriptor = Find(id);
        if (descriptor == null)
        {
            // 没有运行期描述符时也允许清理残留目录（例如插件加载失败后）
            foreach (var root in _roots)
            {
                var dir = Path.Combine(root, id);
                if (Directory.Exists(dir)) DeleteDirectoryWithRetry(dir);
            }
            _enabledState.Remove(id);
            SaveState();
            if (deleteData)
            {
                var data = Path.Combine(_dataDir, id);
                try { if (Directory.Exists(data)) DeleteDirectoryWithRetry(data); } catch { }
            }
            RaiseChanged();
            return;
        }

        await UnloadOneAsync(descriptor).ConfigureAwait(true);
        await Task.Yield();

        var failures = new List<string>();
        foreach (var root in _roots)
        {
            var dir = Path.Combine(root, descriptor.Id);
            if (!Directory.Exists(dir)) continue;
            try
            {
                DeleteDirectoryWithRetry(dir);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                failures.Add($"{dir}: {ex.Message}");
                // 文件仍被占用时先改名，避免下次扫描又加载旧版本
                try
                {
                    var moved = dir + ".deleted-" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N");
                    Directory.Move(dir, moved);
                    failures.RemoveAt(failures.Count - 1);
                    _log?.Invoke("插件目录暂被占用，已改名待清理：" + moved);
                }
                catch { }
            }
        }

        _plugins.RemoveAll(p => string.Equals(p.Id, descriptor.Id, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
        _enabledState.Remove(descriptor.Id);
        SaveState();

        if (deleteData)
        {
            var data = Path.Combine(_dataDir, id);
            try { if (Directory.Exists(data)) DeleteDirectoryWithRetry(data); }
            catch (Exception ex) { _log?.Invoke("删除插件数据失败：" + ex.Message); }
        }

        _log?.Invoke($"插件卸载：{descriptor.Name}");
        RaiseChanged();

        if (failures.Count > 0)
            throw new IOException("插件已停用，但部分文件删除失败：\n" + string.Join("\n", failures));
    }

    private static void DeleteDirectoryWithRetry(string dir)
    {
        // ALC 卸载后文件句柄可能延迟释放；重试几次比直接失败好
        for (var i = 0; i < 4; i++)
        {
            try
            {
                if (!Directory.Exists(dir)) return;
                Directory.Delete(dir, recursive: true);
                return;
            }
            catch (IOException) when (i < 3)
            {
                GC.Collect();
                GC.WaitForPendingFinalizers();
                Thread.Sleep(120);
            }
            catch (UnauthorizedAccessException) when (i < 3)
            {
                GC.Collect();
                GC.WaitForPendingFinalizers();
                Thread.Sleep(120);
            }
        }
    }

    private static bool PathsEqual(string a, string b)
        => string.Equals(Path.GetFullPath(a).TrimEnd(Path.DirectorySeparatorChar),
            Path.GetFullPath(b).TrimEnd(Path.DirectorySeparatorChar),
            StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

    // ---------------- 内部：加载 / 卸载 ----------------

    private async Task LoadOneAsync(PluginDescriptor descriptor)
    {
        descriptor.Error = null;
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(descriptor.AssemblyPath) || !File.Exists(descriptor.AssemblyPath))
        {
            descriptor.State = PluginLoadState.Error;
            descriptor.Error = "入口程序集不存在";
            return;
        }

        try
        {
            descriptor.LoadContext = new PluginLoadContext(descriptor.AssemblyPath);
            descriptor.Assembly = descriptor.LoadContext.LoadFromAssemblyPath(descriptor.AssemblyPath);

            var type = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(descriptor.Manifest.EntryType)
                ? descriptor.Assembly.GetType(descriptor.Manifest.EntryType, throwOnError: false)
                : null;

            type ??= descriptor.Assembly.GetTypes().FirstOrDefault(t =>
                typeof(IDashFilePlugin).IsAssignableFrom(t) &&
                !t.IsAbstract && t.GetConstructor(Type.EmptyTypes) != null);

            if (type == null)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("找不到实现 IDashFilePlugin 的公共入口类型");

            var instance = Activator.CreateInstance(type) as IDashFilePlugin
                ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("入口类型无法实例化（需要公共无参构造函数）");

            descriptor.Instance = instance;
            var host = _hostFactory(descriptor.Manifest, instance);
            descriptor.HostObject = host;
            // 插件初始化最多等 5 秒：插件挂住时不能把插件页一起拖死，超时标 Error 可重载
            // 不能 using 掉这个 CTS：超时后插件可能还在跑，立刻 Dispose 会让它后续
            //   拿 Register / 创建页面时抛 ObjectDisposedException。改成超时只 Cancel，随插件卸载回收。
            var initCts = new CancellationTokenSource();
            descriptor.InitCts = initCts;
            try
            {
                var init = instance.InitializeAsync(host, initCts.Token);
                var done = await Task.WhenAny(init, Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5))).ConfigureAwait(true);
                if (done != init)
                {
                    initCts.Cancel();
                    _ = init.ContinueWith(t => { _ = t.Exception; }, TaskScheduler.Default);
                    throw new TimeoutException("插件初始化超过 5 秒（疑似挂起）");
                }
                await init.ConfigureAwait(true);
            }
            finally
            {
                // 初始化正常结束：CTS 留着给插件当"生命周期令牌"，卸载时一起释放
            }
            descriptor.State = PluginLoadState.Loaded;
            if (host is IPluginEventSink sink) _sinks.Add(sink);

            _log?.Invoke($"插件已加载：{descriptor.Name} v{descriptor.Manifest.Version} " +
                         $"(页面 {descriptor.Pages.Count} / 动作 {descriptor.Actions.Count})");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            descriptor.State = PluginLoadState.Error;
            descriptor.Error = ex.GetBaseException().Message;
            _log?.Invoke($"插件加载失败：{descriptor.Name} -> {ex}");
            await UnloadOneAsync(descriptor).ConfigureAwait(true);
        }
    }

    private async Task UnloadOneAsync(PluginDescriptor descriptor)
    {
        if (descriptor.Instance != null)
        {
            try
            {
                using var shutdownCts = new CancellationTokenSource(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
                var shutdown = descriptor.Instance.ShutdownAsync(shutdownCts.Token);
                var done = await Task.WhenAny(shutdown, Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5))).ConfigureAwait(true);
                if (done != shutdown)
                {
                    _ = shutdown.ContinueWith(t => { _ = t.Exception; }, TaskScheduler.Default);
                    _log?.Invoke("插件关闭超时（5 秒）：" + descriptor.Name);
                }
                else await shutdown.ConfigureAwait(true);
            }
            catch (Exception ex) { _log?.Invoke("插件关闭失败：" + ex.Message); }
        }

        // 插件可能改过 UI 资源；禁用/重载时由宿主统一恢复，避免主题颜色残留
        if (descriptor.HostObject is IDisposable disposableHost)
        {
            try { disposableHost.Dispose(); }
            catch (Exception ex) { _log?.Invoke("插件 UI 清理失败：" + ex.Message); }
        }

        _sinks.RemoveAll(s => ReferenceEquals(s, descriptor.HostObject));

        descriptor.Instance = null;
        descriptor.HostObject = null;
        descriptor.Assembly = null;
        try { descriptor.InitCts?.Cancel(); } catch { }
        try { descriptor.InitCts?.Dispose(); } catch { }
        descriptor.InitCts = null;
        descriptor.ClearRegistrations();

        var context = descriptor.LoadContext;
        descriptor.LoadContext = null;
        if (context != null)
        {
            try { context.Unload(); } catch { }
        }
    }

    private async Task UnloadAllAsync()
    {
        foreach (var plugin in _plugins.ToArray())
            await UnloadOneAsync(plugin).ConfigureAwait(true);
        _sinks.Clear();
    }

    // ---------------- 状态持久化 ----------------

    private void LoadState()
    {
        try
        {
            // 老版本把状态文件写在扫描目录里，搬到新位置后要能接着读
            var source = File.Exists(_stateFile) ? _stateFile
                : File.Exists(_legacyStateFile) ? _legacyStateFile
                : null;
            if (source == null) return;
            var json = File.ReadAllText(source);
            var map = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<Dictionary<string, bool>>(json);
            if (map == null) return;
            foreach (var kv in map) _enabledState[kv.Key] = kv.Value;
        }
        catch { }
    }

    private readonly object _stateGate = new();

    private void SaveState()
    {
        try
        {
            Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(_stateFile)!);
            // 序列化正在被另一个线程改的 Dictionary 会抛"集合已修改"，
            //   以前被 catch{} 吞掉 = 启用状态静默丢失。这里先取快照再写。
            string json;
            lock (_stateGate)
            {
                var snapshot = new Dictionary<string, bool>(_enabledState, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
                json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(snapshot, new JsonSerializerOptions { WriteIndented = true });
            }
            AtomicFile.WriteAllText(_stateFile, json);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _log?.Invoke("插件状态保存失败：" + ex.Message);
        }
    }

    private bool IsEnabled(PluginDescriptor descriptor)
    {
        if (_enabledState.TryGetValue(descriptor.Id, out var enabled)) return enabled;
        return descriptor.Manifest.Enabled;
    }

    private void RaiseChanged() => Changed?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);

    private static bool VersionAtLeast(string host, string required)
    {
        static Version? Parse(string s)
        {
            var cut = s.IndexOfAny(new[] { '-', '+', ' ' });
            if (cut >= 0) s = s[..cut];
            return Version.TryParse(s, out var v) ? v : null;
        }
        var a = Parse(host);
        var b = Parse(required);
        if (a == null || b == null) return true;
        return a >= b;
    }

    private static void SeedReadme(string root)
    {
        var readme = Path.Combine(root, "README.txt");
        if (File.Exists(readme)) return;
        File.WriteAllText(readme,
            "DashFile 插件目录\r\n" +
            "=================\r\n\r\n" +
            "安装：把 .dfp 插件包拖进「插件」页，或点「安装 .dfp」。\r\n" +
            "本目录下的每个子目录是一个已安装插件：\r\n" +
            "  plugins\\<插件id>\\plugin.json\r\n" +
            "  plugins\\<插件id>\\<入口程序集>.dll\r\n\r\n" +
            "plugin.json 示例：\r\n" +
            "{\r\n" +
            "  \"id\": \"com.example.hello\",\r\n" +
            "  \"name\": \"Hello Plugin\",\r\n" +
            "  \"version\": \"1.0.0\",\r\n" +
            "  \"author\": \"you\",\r\n" +
            "  \"description\": \"示例插件\",\r\n" +
            "  \"assembly\": \"HelloPlugin.dll\",\r\n" +
            "  \"entryType\": \"HelloPlugin.HelloPlugin\",\r\n" +
            "  \"apiVersion\": 1\r\n" +
            "}\r\n\r\n" +
            "插件开发说明见程序目录 docs\\插件开发指南.md。\r\n");
    }
}
```

`src/Services/Plugins/PluginPackage.cs`:

```cs
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.IO.Compression;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text.Json;
using DashFile.PluginApi;

namespace DashFile.Services.Plugins;

/// <summary>
/// .dfp 插件包 = zip：plugin.json + 入口 DLL（可带依赖 DLL/说明/许可证）。
/// 支持根目录直接放文件，或只包一层以插件 id 命名的目录。
/// </summary>
internal static class PluginPackage
{
    public const string Extension = ".dfp";
    private const long MaxTotalBytes = 256L * 1024 * 1024;
    private const long MaxEntryBytes = 128L * 1024 * 1024;

    public static bool IsPackage(string path)
        => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(path) &&
           string.Equals(Path.GetExtension(path), Extension, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

    public static string Extract(string packagePath, string tempDirectory)
    {
        if (!IsPackage(packagePath))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("只接受 .dfp 插件包");
        if (!File.Exists(packagePath))
            throw new FileNotFoundException("找不到插件包", packagePath);

        Directory.CreateDirectory(tempDirectory);
        long total = 0;
        using (var zip = ZipFile.OpenRead(packagePath))
        {
            foreach (var entry in zip.Entries)
            {
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(entry.Name)) continue; // 目录
                var name = entry.FullName.Replace('\\', '/').TrimStart('/');
                if (name.Length == 0 || name.Split('/').Any(s => s == ".." || s.Length == 0))
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("插件包包含非法路径：" + entry.FullName);

                total += entry.Length;
                if (total > MaxTotalBytes || entry.Length > MaxEntryBytes)
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("插件包过大");

                var dest = Path.GetFullPath(Path.Combine(tempDirectory, name));
                var root = Path.GetFullPath(tempDirectory) + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar;
                if (!dest.StartsWith(root, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("插件包路径越界：" + entry.FullName);

                Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(dest)!);
                entry.ExtractToFile(dest, overwrite: true);
            }
        }

        var manifestPath = Path.Combine(tempDirectory, PluginApiInfo.ManifestFileName);
        if (File.Exists(manifestPath)) return tempDirectory;

        var dirs = Directory.GetDirectories(tempDirectory);
        if (dirs.Length == 1 &&
            File.Exists(Path.Combine(dirs[0], PluginApiInfo.ManifestFileName)))
            return dirs[0];

        throw new InvalidOperationException("插件包根目录缺少 plugin.json");
    }

    public static PluginManifest ReadManifest(string packageRoot)
    {
        var path = Path.Combine(packageRoot, PluginApiInfo.ManifestFileName);
        var manifest = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<PluginManifest>(File.ReadAllText(path),
            new JsonSerializerOptions
            {
                PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true,
                ReadCommentHandling = JsonCommentHandling.Skip,
                AllowTrailingCommas = true,
            });
        if (manifest == null || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(manifest.Id))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("plugin.json 缺少 id");
        if (!IsSafeId(manifest.Id))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("plugin.json 的 id 不合法：" + manifest.Id);

        var assembly = manifest.Assembly;
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(assembly))
        {
            var dlls = Directory.GetFiles(packageRoot, "*.dll", SearchOption.TopDirectoryOnly);
            assembly = Path.GetFileName(dlls.Length == 1 ? dlls[0] : "");
        }
        var assemblyFull = Path.GetFullPath(Path.Combine(packageRoot, assembly));
        var rootFull = Path.GetFullPath(packageRoot) + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar;
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(assembly) || !assemblyFull.StartsWith(rootFull, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
            !File.Exists(assemblyFull))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("插件包缺少入口 DLL 或路径越界：" + assembly);
        manifest.Assembly = assembly;
        return manifest;
    }

    public static bool IsSafeId(string id)
        => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(id) && id != "." && id != ".." &&
           id.All(c => char.IsLetterOrDigit(c) || c is '.' or '_' or '-');
}
```

`src/Services/PowerService.cs`:

```cs
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace DashFile.Services;

public enum DeviceMode { None, System, Recovery, Fastboot, Fastbootd }
public enum RebootTarget { System, Bootloader, Fastbootd, Recovery, Edl }

public sealed class PowerService
{
    private readonly AdbRunner _adb;
    public PowerService(AdbRunner adb) => _adb = adb;

    private static string ToolPath(string name)
    {
        var dir = AppContext.BaseDirectory;
        foreach (var d in new[]
        {
            Path.Combine(dir, "Binaries", name == "fastboot" ? "Fastboot" : "Adb"),
            Path.Combine(dir, "Binaries"),
            dir,
            Path.Combine(dir, "tools"),
        })
        {
            var p = Path.Combine(d, name + ".exe");
            if (File.Exists(p)) return p;
        }
        return name;
    }

    private static async Task<string> RunToolAsync(string exe, IEnumerable<string> args, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        try
        {
            var psi = new ProcessStartInfo(exe)
            {
                RedirectStandardOutput = true,
                RedirectStandardError = true,
                UseShellExecute = false,
                CreateNoWindow = true,
            };
            foreach (var a in args) psi.ArgumentList.Add(a);
            using var p = Process.Start(psi);
            if (p == null) return "";
            var so = p.StandardOutput.ReadToEndAsync(ct);
            var se = p.StandardError.ReadToEndAsync(ct);
            await p.WaitForExitAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            return (await so) + (await se);
        }
        catch { return ""; }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 列出当前处于 fastboot / fastbootd 的设备序列号。
    /// 手机重启到 fastboot 之后就不再是 ADB 设备了，只查 adb 会以为"设备没了"。
    /// </summary>
    public async Task<List<string>> ListFastbootSerialsAsync(CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var result = new List<string>();
        try
        {
            var outp = await RunToolAsync(ToolPath("fastboot"), new[] { "devices" }, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            foreach (var raw in outp.Split('\n'))
            {
                var line = raw.Trim();
                if (line.Length == 0) continue;
                if (line.StartsWith("List of devices", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) continue;
                if (!line.Contains("fastboot", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) &&
                    !line.Contains("sideload", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) continue;

                var serial = line.Split('\t', ' ').FirstOrDefault()?.Trim() ?? "";
                if (serial.Length > 0 && !result.Contains(serial)) result.Add(serial);
            }
        }
        catch { }
        return result;
    }

    public async Task<DeviceMode> DetectModeAsync(string serial, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(serial)) return DeviceMode.None;

        // ① fastboot / fastbootd
        var fb = await RunToolAsync(ToolPath("fastboot"), new[] { "devices" }, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        if (fb.Contains(serial, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            var uv = await RunToolAsync(ToolPath("fastboot"),
                new[] { "-s", serial, "getvar", "is-userspace" }, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            return uv.Contains("yes", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ? DeviceMode.Fastbootd : DeviceMode.Fastboot;
        }

        // ② adb：用 get-state 拿真实状态。
        //    不能用"adb devices 里出现这个序列号"就当 System —— recovery / sideload /
        //      unauthorized 都会出现，会被误判成系统模式，于是重启按钮发出无效命令。
        var gs = await _adb.RunAsync(new[] { "-s", serial, "get-state" }, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        var state = (gs.StdOut ?? "").Trim().ToLowerInvariant();
        var err = (gs.StdErr ?? "").ToLowerInvariant();

        // 关键：设备不在时 adb 输出的是 "error: device 'X' not found"，
        //   里面就带 "device" 这个词。以前用 Contains("device") 判断，会把"设备不存在"
        //   当成"已连接"，于是返回 System、发出无效重启命令 —— 表现就是"按什么都没用"。
        //   所以这里只认 get-state 的**整行精确值**，并显式识别 not found。
        var gone = err.Contains("not found") || err.Contains("no devices/emulators");

        if (!gone)
        {
            if (state == "recovery" || state == "sideload") return DeviceMode.Recovery;
            if (state == "bootloader") return DeviceMode.Fastboot;

            if (state == "device")
            {
                var boot = await _adb.RunAsync(new[] { "-s", serial, "shell", "getprop", "sys.boot_completed" }, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
                if (boot.StdOut.Trim() == "1") return DeviceMode.System;

                var mode = await _adb.RunAsync(new[] { "-s", serial, "shell", "getprop", "ro.boot.mode" }, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
                if (mode.StdOut.Contains("recovery", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) return DeviceMode.Recovery;

                return DeviceMode.System;      // adb 通但还没启动完
            }

            // ③ 兜底：adb devices 里有记录（比如 unauthorized），状态未知就按 Recovery 处理，
            //    至少让"重启"这条路还能走
            var dev = await _adb.RunAsync(new[] { "devices" }, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            if (dev.StdOut.Contains(serial, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) return DeviceMode.Recovery;
        }

        return DeviceMode.None;
    }

    public static string ModeText(DeviceMode m) => m switch
    {
        DeviceMode.System => "系统模式",
        DeviceMode.Recovery => "Recovery 模式",
        DeviceMode.Fastboot => "Fastboot 模式",
        DeviceMode.Fastbootd => "Fastbootd 模式",
        _ => "未连接",
    };

    public async Task RebootAsync(string serial, DeviceMode mode, RebootTarget target, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(serial)) return;

        if (mode is DeviceMode.Fastboot or DeviceMode.Fastbootd)
        {
            var args = target switch
            {
                RebootTarget.System => new[] { "-s", serial, "reboot" },
                RebootTarget.Bootloader => new[] { "-s", serial, "reboot", "bootloader" },
                RebootTarget.Fastbootd => new[] { "-s", serial, "reboot", "fastboot" },
                RebootTarget.Recovery => new[] { "-s", serial, "reboot", "recovery" },
                RebootTarget.Edl => new[] { "-s", serial, "oem", "edl" },
                _ => new[] { "-s", serial, "reboot" },
            };
            await RunToolAsync(ToolPath("fastboot"), args, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            return;
        }

        // 9008 比较特殊：不同 ROM 认不同的命令，逐个试，直到设备真的离线
        if (target == RebootTarget.Edl && mode is DeviceMode.System or DeviceMode.Recovery)
        {
            var attempts = new[]
            {
                new[] { "-s", serial, "shell", "reboot", "edl" },
                new[] { "-s", serial, "shell", "su", "0", "reboot", "edl" },
                new[] { "-s", serial, "shell", "su", "-c", Sh.Q("reboot edl") },
                new[] { "-s", serial, "shell", "su", "0", "setprop", "sys.powerctl", "reboot,edl" },
            };

            foreach (var a in attempts)
            {
                await _adb.RunAsync(a, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
                await Task.Delay(700, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);

                var st = await _adb.RunAsync(new[] { "-s", serial, "get-state" }, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
                var stateOut = st.StdOut.Trim();

                // 三种情况要分开：还在系统里 / 探测本身失败（超时、报错）/ 真的掉线。
                //   以前只看"输出里有没有 device"：get-state 超时或报错时 StdOut 也是空的，
                //   会被误判成"已进 9008"，余下的尝试全部放弃。
                if (stateOut.StartsWith("device", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) continue;   // 还在系统里
                if (stateOut.Length == 0 && (st.ExitCode == -1 || st.StdErr.Contains("超时", StringComparison.Ordinal)))
                    continue;                                                                     // 探测不可信，继续试
                return;                                                                            // 有明确响应且已不是 device
            }
            return;
        }

        // Recovery 里 adb shell 能力有限，用宿主端 `adb reboot <target>` 更可靠
        if (mode == DeviceMode.Recovery)
        {
            var hostArgs = target switch
            {
                RebootTarget.System => new[] { "-s", serial, "reboot" },
                RebootTarget.Bootloader => new[] { "-s", serial, "reboot", "bootloader" },
                RebootTarget.Fastbootd => new[] { "-s", serial, "reboot", "fastboot" },
                RebootTarget.Recovery => new[] { "-s", serial, "reboot", "recovery" },
                RebootTarget.Edl => new[] { "-s", serial, "reboot", "edl" },
                _ => new[] { "-s", serial, "reboot" },
            };
            await _adb.RunAsync(hostArgs, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            return;
        }

        // 系统 / Recovery 都走 adb reboot
        var cmd = target switch
        {
            RebootTarget.System => "reboot",
            RebootTarget.Bootloader => "reboot bootloader",
            RebootTarget.Fastbootd => "reboot fastboot",
            RebootTarget.Recovery => "reboot recovery",
            RebootTarget.Edl => "reboot edl",
            _ => "reboot",
        };

        var r = await _adb.RunAsync(new[] { "-s", serial, "shell", cmd }, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        if (!r.Ok)
        {
            // 普通权限下 reboot 可能被拒，改用 root
            // 必须整体加引号：adb shell 是空格拼接后交给设备端 sh，裸写 su -c reboot bootloader
            //   会让 su 只拿到 "reboot"，参数被丢掉，root 兜底静默失效。
            await _adb.RunAsync(new[] { "-s", serial, "shell", "su", "-c", Sh.Q(cmd) }, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
    }
}
```

`src/Services/RemoteFileSystem.cs`:

```cs
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using DashFile.Models;

namespace DashFile.Services;

public sealed class RemoteFileSystem
{
    private readonly AdbRunner _adb;
    public string Serial { get; }
    public bool UseRoot { get; set; }

    public event Action<string>? Log;

    public RemoteFileSystem(AdbRunner adb, string serial, bool useRoot)
    {
        _adb = adb;
        Serial = serial;
        UseRoot = useRoot;
    }

    private void L(string msg) => Log?.Invoke(msg);

    // ---------- 底层执行 ----------

    private async Task<ProcResult> ShellAsync(string command, bool? root = null, CancellationToken ct = default,
        bool quiet = false)
    {
        var useRoot = root ?? UseRoot;
        var args = new List<string> { "-s", Serial, "shell" };
        if (useRoot)
        {
            args.Add("su");
            args.Add("-c");
            args.Add(Sh.Q(command));
        }
        else
        {
            args.Add(command);
        }
        if (!quiet) L((useRoot ? "[root] " : "[shell] ") + command);
        return await _adb.RunAsync(args, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
    }

    public async Task<bool> DetectRootAsync(CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        // su 第一次调用可能因为授权弹窗返回失败，这里多试几种方式 + 重试
        for (int attempt = 0; attempt < 4; attempt++)
        {
            foreach (var cmd in new[] { "id", "whoami" })
            {
                var r = await _adb.RunAsync(new[] { "-s", Serial, "shell", "su", "-c", cmd }, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
                var o = (r.StdOut + r.StdErr);
                if (o.Contains("uid=0") || o.Trim() == "root") return true;
            }

            var r2 = await _adb.RunAsync(new[] { "-s", Serial, "shell", "su", "0", "id" }, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            if ((r2.StdOut + r2.StdErr).Contains("uid=0")) return true;

            // 有些实现需要 -c 后整体加引号；再兜底判断 /data/adb 是否可列出（只有 root 能读）
            var r3 = await _adb.RunAsync(new[] { "-s", Serial, "shell", "su", "-c", $"ls {DevicePaths.KsuDir}/bin" }, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            if (r3.Ok && r3.StdOut.Contains("resetprop")) return true;

            try { await Task.Delay(600, ct); } catch { return false; }
        }
        return false;
    }

    // ---------- 列目录 ----------

    private static readonly Regex RxZ = new(
        @"^(?<p>[bcdlps-][rwxsStT-]{9})\s+\d+\s+(?<u>\S+)\s+(?<g>\S+)\s+(?<c>\S+)\s+(?<sz>\d+)\s+(?<d>\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})\s+(?<t>\d{2}:\d{2}(?::\d{2})?)\s+(?<n>.+)$",
        RegexOptions.Compiled);

    private static readonly Regex RxNoZ = new(
        @"^(?<p>[bcdlps-][rwxsStT-]{9})\s+\d+\s+(?<u>\S+)\s+(?<g>\S+)\s+(?<sz>\d+)\s+(?<d>\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})\s+(?<t>\d{2}:\d{2}(?::\d{2})?)\s+(?<n>.+)$",
        RegexOptions.Compiled);

    public async Task<List<PosixEntry>> ListAsync(string path, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        // 关键：目录加尾斜杠，否则 /sdcard 这类符号链接只会列出链接本身
        var dirPath = path.EndsWith("/") ? path : path + "/";
        var cmd = "LC_ALL=C ls -l -Z -- " + Sh.Q(dirPath);
        var r = await ShellAsync(cmd, ct: ct).ConfigureAwait(false);

        if (r.ExitCode != 0 && string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(r.StdOut))
        {
            // 再试不带 -Z（部分目录/FUSE 不支持上下文）
            var r2 = await ShellAsync("LC_ALL=C ls -l -- " + Sh.Q(dirPath), ct: ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            if (r2.ExitCode != 0 && string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(r2.StdOut))
            {
                var detail = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(r2.All) ? "ls 没有返回内容（目录不存在或无权限）" : r2.All.Trim();
                throw new IOException(detail);
            }
            return Parse(r2.StdOut, path, false);
        }
        return Parse(r.StdOut, path, true);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 只列子目录（目录树专用）：`ls -1p` 不输出权限/SELinux/日期，设备端和解析都更轻。
    /// 拿不到时退回完整 <see cref="ListAsync"/> 再筛目录，行为保持一致。
    /// </summary>
    public async Task<List<PosixEntry>> ListDirsAsync(string path, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var dirPath = path.EndsWith("/") ? path : path + "/";
        var r = await ShellAsync("LC_ALL=C ls -1p -- " + Sh.Q(dirPath), ct: ct).ConfigureAwait(false);

        if (r.ExitCode != 0 && string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(r.StdOut))
        {
            var full = await ListAsync(path, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            return full.Where(e => e.IsDir).ToList();
        }

        var list = new List<PosixEntry>();
        foreach (var raw in r.StdOut.Split('\n'))
        {
            var line = raw.TrimEnd('\r');
            if (line.Length == 0 || line[^1] != '/') continue;   // -p：只有目录带尾斜杠

            var name = line[..^1];
            if (name is "." or "..") continue;

            list.Add(new PosixEntry
            {
                Name = name,
                FullPath = Sh.Join(path, name),
                TypeChar = 'd',
            });
        }

        list.Sort((a, b) => string.Compare(a.Name, b.Name, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
        return list;
    }

    private List<PosixEntry> Parse(string text, string dir, bool withCtx)    {
        var list = new List<PosixEntry>();
        var rx = withCtx ? RxZ : RxNoZ;
        foreach (var raw in text.Split('\n'))
        {
            var line = raw.TrimEnd('\r');
            if (line.Length == 0) continue;
            if (line.StartsWith("total ", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) continue;
            var m = rx.Match(line);
            if (!m.Success) continue;

            var name = m.Groups["n"].Value;
            string? linkTo = null;
            if (m.Groups["p"].Value[0] == 'l')
            {
                var idx = name.IndexOf(" -> ", StringComparison.Ordinal);
                if (idx >= 0)
                {
                    linkTo = name[(idx + 4)..];
                    name = name[..idx];
                }
            }

            DateTime dt = DateTime.MinValue;
            try
            {
                dt = DateTime.ParseExact(m.Groups["d"].Value + " " + m.Groups["t"].Value,
                    m.Groups["t"].Value.Length == 5 ? "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm" : "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss",
                    CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
            }
            catch { }

            list.Add(new PosixEntry
            {
                Name = name,
                FullPath = Sh.Join(dir, name),
                TypeChar = m.Groups["p"].Value[0],
                Perms = m.Groups["p"].Value[1..],
                Owner = m.Groups["u"].Value,
                Group = m.Groups["g"].Value,
                Selinux = withCtx ? m.Groups["c"].Value : "",
                Size = long.TryParse(m.Groups["sz"].Value, out var sz) ? sz : 0,
                Modified = dt,
                LinkTarget = linkTo ?? "",
            });
        }

        return list
            .OrderByDescending(e => e.IsDir)
            .ThenBy(e => e.Name, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .ToList();
    }

    // ---------- 增删改 ----------

    public async Task MkdirAsync(string path, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var r = await ShellAsync("mkdir -p -- " + Sh.Q(path) + " && chmod 755 -- " + Sh.Q(path), ct: ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        EnsureOk(r);
    }

    public async Task TouchAsync(string path, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var r = await ShellAsync("touch -- " + Sh.Q(path) + " && chmod 644 -- " + Sh.Q(path), ct: ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        EnsureOk(r);
    }

    public async Task DeleteAsync(IEnumerable<string> paths, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var all = paths.ToList();
        if (all.Count == 0) return;
        var joined = string.Join(" ", all.Select(Sh.Q));
        var r = await ShellAsync("rm -rf -- " + joined, ct: ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        EnsureOk(r);
    }

    public async Task RenameAsync(string path, string newName, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var target = Sh.Join(Sh.Parent(path), newName);
        var r = await ShellAsync("mv -f -- " + Sh.Q(path) + " " + Sh.Q(target), ct: ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        EnsureOk(r);
    }

    public async Task ChmodAsync(string path, string octal, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var r = await ShellAsync("chmod " + octal + " -- " + Sh.Q(path), ct: ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        EnsureOk(r);
    }

    public async Task ChownAsync(string path, string owner, string group, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var spec = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(group) ? owner : owner + ":" + group;
        var r = await ShellAsync("chown " + spec + " -- " + Sh.Q(path), ct: ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        EnsureOk(r);
    }

    // ---------- SELinux ----------

    public async Task<string> RestoreconPreviewAsync(string path, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var r = await ShellAsync("restorecon -nRv " + Sh.Q(path) + " 2>&1", ct: ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        return r.All.Trim();
    }

    public async Task<string> RestoreconAsync(string path, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var r = await ShellAsync("restorecon -Rv " + Sh.Q(path) + " 2>&1", ct: ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        return r.All.Trim();
    }

    public async Task<string> ChconAsync(string path, string type, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var ctx = "u:object_r:" + type + ":s0";
        var r = await ShellAsync("toybox chcon " + ctx + " -- " + Sh.Q(path) + " 2>&1", ct: ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        return r.All.Trim();
    }

    // ---------- 传输 ----------

    public async Task UploadAsync(string localFile, string remoteDir, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var name = Path.GetFileName(localFile);
        var tmp = DevicePaths.TempFile("up");
        L("[push] " + localFile + " -> " + tmp);

        var r1 = await _adb.RunAsync(new[] { "-s", Serial, "push", localFile, tmp }, _adb.TransferTimeout, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        if (!r1.Ok) throw new IOException(r1.All);

        var target = Sh.Join(remoteDir, name);
        // 不能用 "cp && chmod ; restorecon ; rm" 这种混链：尾部 rm 的退出码会把 cp 的失败盖掉，
        //   权限不足/磁盘满也会显示"上传成功"。改成整条 && 链，只有全成功才 echo DF_OK。
        var cmd = "cp -f " + Sh.Q(tmp) + " " + Sh.Q(target) +
                  " && chmod 644 " + Sh.Q(target) +
                  " && { restorecon " + Sh.Q(target) + " >/dev/null 2>&1; rm -f " + Sh.Q(tmp) + "; echo DF_OK; }";
        var r2 = await ShellAsync(cmd, ct: ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        EnsureOk(r2);
        if (!r2.StdOut.Contains("DF_OK", StringComparison.Ordinal))
            throw new IOException(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(r2.All) ? "上传失败：目标不可写" : r2.All);
    }

    public async Task UploadBytesAsync(byte[] data, string remotePath, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var tmpLocal = DevicePaths.LocalTempFile("bytes");
        try
        {
            await File.WriteAllBytesAsync(tmpLocal, data, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            var tmpRemote = DevicePaths.TempFile("bytes");
            var r1 = await _adb.RunAsync(new[] { "-s", Serial, "push", tmpLocal, tmpRemote }, _adb.TransferTimeout, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            if (!r1.Ok) throw new IOException(r1.All);
            var cmd = "cp -f " + Sh.Q(tmpRemote) + " " + Sh.Q(remotePath) +
                      " && { restorecon " + Sh.Q(remotePath) + " >/dev/null 2>&1; rm -f " + Sh.Q(tmpRemote) + "; echo DF_OK; }";
            var r2 = await ShellAsync(cmd, ct: ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            EnsureOk(r2);
            if (!r2.StdOut.Contains("DF_OK", StringComparison.Ordinal))
                throw new IOException(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(r2.All) ? "写入失败：目标不可写" : r2.All);
        }
        finally
        {
            try { File.Delete(tmpLocal); } catch { }
        }
    }

    public async Task DownloadAsync(string remotePath, string localPath, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        // 关键：不能用 exec-out + su -c + 引号（引号会被吃掉导致 cat 失败）
        // 改用 su 0 cat -- <path>，参数分开传，二进制安全
        var args = new List<string> { "-s", Serial, "exec-out" };
        if (UseRoot)
        {
            args.Add("su");
            args.Add("0");
        }
        args.Add("cat");
        args.Add("--");
        args.Add(remotePath);
        var bytes = await _adb.ExecOutAsync(args, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);

        // 以前不管成功与否都把拿到的字节写盘：cat 失败（权限/文件不存在）也留下一个 0 字节文件，
        //   UI 显示"下载成功"。现在 0 字节时必须确认 exit=0 且 stderr 干净，否则按失败抛出。
        if (bytes.Length == 0)
        {
            var err = (_adb.LastExecError ?? "").Trim();
            if (_adb.LastExecExitCode != 0 || err.Length > 0)
                throw new IOException("下载失败（exit " + _adb.LastExecExitCode + "）：" +
                                      (err.Length > 0 ? err : "远端返回空"));
        }

        await File.WriteAllBytesAsync(localPath, bytes, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
    }

    // ---------- 文本 ----------

    public async Task<string> ReadTextAsync(string path, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var r = await ShellAsync("cat -- " + Sh.Q(path), ct: ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        EnsureOk(r);
        return r.StdOut;
    }

    public Task WriteTextAsync(string path, string content, CancellationToken ct = default)
        => UploadBytesAsync(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(content), path, ct);

    // ---------- 辅助 ----------

    private static void EnsureOk(ProcResult r)
    {
        if (!r.Ok) throw new IOException(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(r.StdErr) ? r.All : r.StdErr);
    }

    public async Task<bool> ExistsAsync(string path, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var r = await ShellAsync("[ -e " + Sh.Q(path) + " ] && echo 1 || echo 0", ct: ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        return r.StdOut.Trim() == "1";
    }

    // ---------- 执行 ----------

    public async Task<string> RunCommandAsync(string command, bool useRoot, CancellationToken ct = default,
        bool quiet = false)
    {
        var r = await ShellAsync(command, useRoot, ct, quiet).ConfigureAwait(false);
        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(r.StdOut)) sb.AppendLine(r.StdOut.TrimEnd());
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(r.StdErr)) sb.AppendLine(r.StdErr.TrimEnd());
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("[退出码] " + r.ExitCode);
        return sb.ToString();
    }

    /// <summary>给插件 API 用的结构化执行入口（保留 stdout / stderr / exit code）。</summary>
    public Task<ProcResult> ExecuteAsync(string command, bool? root = null, CancellationToken ct = default)
        => ShellAsync(command, root, ct);

    /// <summary>
    /// 以 argv 方式执行设备端程序（不经过 shell）。需要 root 时使用 `su 0 &lt;exe&gt; args`，
    /// 这样参数里的空格/引号不会被二次解释。
    /// </summary>
    public async Task<ProcResult> RunArgvAsync(string executable, IEnumerable<string> args, bool? root = null,
        CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var list = new List<string> { "-s", Serial, "shell" };
        if (root ?? UseRoot)
        {
            list.Add("su");
            list.Add("0");
        }
        list.Add(executable);
        list.AddRange(args);
        return await _adb.RunAsync(list, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
    }

    /// <summary>把本机文件推到 /data/local/tmp，返回远端临时路径（已 chmod 644）。插件 API 使用。</summary>
    public async Task<string> PushTempFileAsync(string localPath, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var remote = DevicePaths.TempFile("plugin", Path.GetExtension(localPath));
        var r = await _adb.RunAsync(new[] { "-s", Serial, "push", localPath, remote }, _adb.TransferTimeout, ct)
                          .ConfigureAwait(false);
        if (!r.Ok) throw new IOException(r.All);
        await ShellAsync("chmod 644 " + Sh.Q(remote), ct: ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        return remote;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 直接以 argv 方式执行（不经过 shell），用于取二进制内容，避免引号被吞。
    /// </summary>
    public async Task<byte[]> ExecCaptureArgsAsync(string exe, IEnumerable<string> args, bool? root = null, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var list = new List<string> { "-s", Serial, "exec-out" };
        if (root ?? UseRoot)
        {
            list.Add("su");
            list.Add("0");
        }
        list.Add(exe);
        list.AddRange(args);
        return await _adb.ExecOutAsync(list, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
    }

    /// <summary>执行命令并把 stdout 当二进制取回（取图标等）</summary>
    public async Task<byte[]> ExecCaptureAsync(string command, bool? root = null, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var args = new List<string> { "-s", Serial, "exec-out" };
        if (root ?? UseRoot)
        {
            args.Add("su");
            args.Add("0");
        }
        args.Add("sh");
        args.Add("-c");
        args.Add(Sh.Q(command));
        return await _adb.ExecOutAsync(args, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
    }

    // ---------- 拖出用：把远端目录打包 ----------

    public async Task<string> TarGzAsync(string remoteDir, string remoteOut, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var parent = Sh.Parent(remoteDir);
        var name = Sh.BaseName(remoteDir);
        var cmd = "tar -czf " + Sh.Q(remoteOut) + " -C " + Sh.Q(parent) + " " + Sh.Q(name) + " 2>&1";
        var r = await ShellAsync(cmd, ct: ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        if (!r.Ok) throw new IOException(r.All);
        return remoteOut;
    }

    /// <summary>以二进制方式读取远端文件（su 0 cat，二进制安全）</summary>
    public async Task<byte[]> ReadBytesAsync(string remotePath, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var args = new List<string> { "-s", Serial, "exec-out" };
        if (UseRoot) { args.Add("su"); args.Add("0"); }
        args.Add("cat");
        args.Add("--");
        args.Add(remotePath);
        return await _adb.ExecOutAsync(args, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 覆盖写入远端文件。注意：adb push 是以 shell（uid 2000）身份跑的，
    /// 写 /data/adb 这类 root-only 目录必须先推到 /data/local/tmp，再用 su 搬过去。
    /// </summary>
    public async Task<bool> WriteBytesAsync(string remotePath, byte[] data, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var localTmp = DevicePaths.LocalTempFile("w", ".bin");
        var remoteTmp = DevicePaths.TempFile("w", ".bin");
        try
        {
            await File.WriteAllBytesAsync(localTmp, data, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);

            var push = await _adb.RunAsync(new[] { "-s", Serial, "push", localTmp, remoteTmp }, _adb.TransferTimeout, ct)
                                  .ConfigureAwait(false);
            if (!push.Ok) return false;

            // 该目录 SELinux 策略禁止 mv/unlink，只能原地覆盖
            var r = await RunCommandAsync(
                $"cp -f {Sh.Q(remoteTmp)} {Sh.Q(remotePath)} && " +
                $"chmod 644 {Sh.Q(remotePath)} && rm -f {Sh.Q(remoteTmp)} && echo DF_OK",
                true, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);

            return r.Contains("DF_OK", StringComparison.Ordinal);
        }
        catch { return false; }
        finally { try { File.Delete(localTmp); } catch { } }
    }
}
```

```cs
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace DashFile.Services.Root;

/// <summary>
/// APatch（基于 KernelPatch 的内核级 root）。
/// 模块机制沿用 KernelSU 那套（/data/adb/modules + modules_update），
/// 安装优先尝试 `apd module install`，失败后 ModuleService 会自动退回“直接部署”；
/// 它的授权存储（/data/adb/ap 下的 package_config）没有稳定公开的写入协议，
/// 因此授权表保持只读，避免写坏用户的 root 授权。
/// </summary>
public sealed class APatchProvider : IRootProvider
{
    private readonly RemoteFileSystem _fs;
    private readonly string _apd;
    private readonly string _apdCmd;

    public APatchProvider(RemoteFileSystem fs, string displayName, string version, string workMode,
        string apdCommand, string managerPackage, bool managerInstalled)
    {
        _fs = fs;
        _apd = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(apdCommand) ? "" : apdCommand;
        _apdCmd = _apd.Contains(' ') ? Sh.Q(_apd) : _apd;
        DisplayName = displayName;
        Version = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(version) ? "无管理器" : version;
        WorkMode = workMode;
        ManagerPackage = managerPackage;
        ManagerInstalled = managerInstalled;
    }

    public string Id => "apatch";
    public RootFamily Family => RootFamily.APatch;
    public string DisplayName { get; }
    public string Version { get; }
    public string WorkMode { get; }
    public string ManagerPackage { get; }
    public bool ManagerInstalled { get; }

    public bool CanReadGrants => false;
    public bool CanManageGrants => false;
    public string GrantHint => "APatch 的授权存储由 apd 管理，暂不支持直接读写，请在 APatch App 里修改";
    public bool GrantChangeNeedsReboot => true;

    // APatch 的 apd 确实提供 module 子命令；没确认时 ModuleService 会自动退回通用部署。
    public string? ModuleInstallCommand => _apdCmd.Length == 0 ? null : _apdCmd + " module install {0}";
    public string? ModuleUninstallCommand => _apdCmd.Length == 0 ? null : _apdCmd + " module uninstall {0}";

    public Task<List<RootGrant>> ReadGrantsAsync(CancellationToken ct = default)
        => Task.FromResult(new List<RootGrant>());

    public Task<RootActionResult> SetGrantAsync(string package, int uid, bool allowed,
        CancellationToken ct = default)
        => Task.FromResult(new RootActionResult(false, GrantHint));

    public Task<RootActionResult> RemoveGrantAsync(string package, CancellationToken ct = default)
        => Task.FromResult(new RootActionResult(false, GrantHint));

    public async Task<RootActionResult> SoftRebootAsync(CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        try
        {
            var r = await _fs.ExecuteAsync("setprop ctl.restart zygote", true, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            return r.Ok
                ? new RootActionResult(true, "已重启 zygote（约 10~20 秒，不会丢数据）")
                : new RootActionResult(false, "软重启失败，请手动重启设备");
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { return new RootActionResult(false, "软重启失败：" + ex.Message); }
    }
}

/// <summary>检测到有 root，但实现未知：全部按"只读"处理，不做任何写入。</summary>
public sealed class UnknownRootProvider : IRootProvider
{

        Version = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(version) ? "—" : version;

    public bool ManagerInstalled => false;
    public bool CanReadGrants => false;
    public bool CanManageGrants => false;
    public string GrantHint => "未知的 Root 实现，未做任何修改";
    public bool GrantChangeNeedsReboot => true;
    public string? ModuleInstallCommand => null;
    public string? ModuleUninstallCommand => null;

    public Task<List<RootGrant>> ReadGrantsAsync(CancellationToken ct = default)
        => Task.FromResult(new List<RootGrant>());

    public Task<RootActionResult> SetGrantAsync(string package, int uid, bool allowed,
        CancellationToken ct = default)
        => Task.FromResult(new RootActionResult(false, "未知的 Root 实现，未做任何修改"));

    public Task<RootActionResult> RemoveGrantAsync(string package, CancellationToken ct = default)
        => Task.FromResult(new RootActionResult(false, "未知的 Root 实现，未做任何修改"));

    public Task<RootActionResult> SoftRebootAsync(CancellationToken ct = default)
        => Task.FromResult(new RootActionResult(false, "未知的 Root 实现，未执行软重启"));
}
```

`src/Services/Root/IRootProvider.cs`:

```cs
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace DashFile.Services.Root;

/// <summary>root 实现家族。UI 和模块逻辑按家族做能力判断，避免到处判字符串。</summary>
public enum RootFamily
{
    Unknown = 0,
    KernelSu = 1,
    Magisk = 2,
    APatch = 3,
    SuperSu = 4,
    PhhSuperuser = 5,
    LineageSu = 6,
}

/// <summary>一条 root 授权记录。</summary>
public sealed record RootGrant(string Package, int Uid, bool Allowed);

/// <summary>root 操作结果（带给用户看的说明）。</summary>
public sealed record RootActionResult(bool Ok, string Message);

/// <summary>
/// 各种 root 实现的统一接口。
///
/// 为什么要这一层：KernelSU 系（KSU / KSU-Next / SukiSU / ReSukiSU / KowSU）、
/// Magisk 系（Magisk / Alpha / Kitsune）、APatch、SuperSU、phh、LineageOS SU
/// 的「模块机制」基本一样（/data/adb/modules + disable/remove 标记），
/// 但「授权表」「模块安装命令」「软重启方式」完全不同。
///
/// 新增一个实现 = 新增一个类 + 在 RootProviders 里加识别分支，UI 不需要改。
/// </summary>
public interface IRootProvider
{
    /// <summary>内部标识：ksu / magisk / apatch / supersu / phh / lineage / unknown</summary>
    string Id { get; }

    /// <summary>所属家族，用于统一的 UI 文案和插件 API。</summary>
    RootFamily Family { get; }

    /// <summary>展示名：KernelSU / KernelSU-Next / SukiSU Ultra / Magisk / Magisk Alpha …</summary>
    string DisplayName { get; }

    /// <summary>版本（拿不到时给 "无管理器" / "—"）</summary>
    string Version { get; }

    /// <summary>工作模式：LKM / Built-in / 用户态 / 内核补丁 …</summary>
    string WorkMode { get; }

    /// <summary>管理器 App 包名；没有安装管理器时为空。</summary>
    string ManagerPackage { get; }

    /// <summary>是否检测到管理器 App（不装管理器也可能有 root）。</summary>
    bool ManagerInstalled { get; }

    /// <summary>能否读取授权表。</summary>
    bool CanReadGrants { get; }

    /// <summary>能否直接改写授权表（false 时 UI 只展示，不改写）。</summary>
    bool CanManageGrants { get; }

    /// <summary>授权表存储方式 / 不可写原因，展示给用户。</summary>
    string GrantHint { get; }

    /// <summary>改完授权后是否必须重启（KSU 需要，MagiskSU 不需要）。</summary>
    bool GrantChangeNeedsReboot { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// 模块安装命令模板（{0} = 设备上的 zip 路径）；null 表示用通用的
    /// "解压到 /data/adb/modules_update + touch .update" 直接部署方式。
    /// </summary>
    string? ModuleInstallCommand { get; }

    /// <summary>模块卸载命令模板（{0} = 模块 id）；null 表示打 remove 标记。</summary>
    string? ModuleUninstallCommand { get; }

    /// <summary>读取全部授权（不支持时返回空表，由 UI 提示）。</summary>
    Task<List<RootGrant>> ReadGrantsAsync(CancellationToken ct = default);

    /// <summary>设置某个包的授权。</summary>
    Task<RootActionResult> SetGrantAsync(string package, int uid, bool allowed,
        CancellationToken ct = default);

    /// <summary>从授权表移除某个包。</summary>
    Task<RootActionResult> RemoveGrantAsync(string package, CancellationToken ct = default);

    /// <summary>软重启（重启 Android 用户态，不丢数据）。</summary>
    Task<RootActionResult> SoftRebootAsync(CancellationToken ct = default);
}
```
