`src/Services/Root/KernelSuProvider.cs`:

```cs
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace DashFile.Services.Root;

/// <summary>
/// KernelSU 系（KernelSU / KernelSU-Next / SukiSU Ultra / ReSukiSU / KowSU / MKSU / 各种 fork）。
/// 授权表是二进制 /data/adb/ksu/.allowlist，已有 SuperuserService 负责编解码；
/// 模块安装走 ksud，没有 ksud 时由 ModuleService 退回"直接部署"。
/// </summary>
public sealed class KernelSuProvider : IRootProvider
{
    private readonly RemoteFileSystem _fs;
    private readonly SuperuserService _su;
    private readonly string _ksud;
    private readonly string _ksudCmd;
    private readonly bool _allowlistOk;
    private bool _formatUnsupported;

    public KernelSuProvider(RemoteFileSystem fs, string displayName, string version, string workMode,
        bool allowlistOk, string managerPackage, bool managerInstalled, string ksudCommand = "")
    {
        _fs = fs;
        // 传 fork 名进去：新版授权表（784 步长）只有 1 条记录时与老版同长同偏移，只能靠它区分
        _su = new SuperuserService(fs, displayName);
        DisplayName = displayName;
        Version = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(version) ? "无管理器" : version;
        WorkMode = workMode;
        _allowlistOk = allowlistOk;
        ManagerPackage = managerPackage;
        ManagerInstalled = managerInstalled;
        _ksud = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ksudCommand) ? "ksud" : ksudCommand;
        _ksudCmd = _ksud.Contains(' ') ? Sh.Q(_ksud) : _ksud;
    }

    public string Id => "ksu";
    public RootFamily Family => RootFamily.KernelSu;
    public string DisplayName { get; }
    public string Version { get; }
    public string WorkMode { get; }
    public string ManagerPackage { get; }
    public bool ManagerInstalled { get; }

    // 名字叫 KernelSU 不代表授权表就能写：fork 改过格式、或者根本没装管理器时都可能不可写。
    //   只有"文件在、密数对、但布局不认识"才永久降级为只读；临时读失败（adb 抖动）下次重试即可。
    public bool CanReadGrants => _allowlistOk && !_formatUnsupported;
    public bool CanManageGrants => _allowlistOk && !_formatUnsupported;
    public string GrantHint => CanManageGrants
        ? _su.LayoutAmbiguous
            ? "直接读写 /data/adb/ksu/.allowlist；当前表只有 1 条记录，步长无法判定 —— 可以改已有授权，新增请先在管理器里多授权一个应用"
            : "直接读写 /data/adb/ksu/.allowlist（二进制授权表）"
        : _formatUnsupported
            ? "检测到 KernelSU 系，但授权表不是可识别的 USK 格式，已降级为只读"
            : "授权表读取失败，请刷新或重新连接设备";
    public bool GrantChangeNeedsReboot => true;

    public string? ModuleInstallCommand => _ksudCmd + " module install {0}";
    public string? ModuleUninstallCommand => _ksudCmd + " module uninstall {0}";

    public async Task<List<RootGrant>> ReadGrantsAsync(CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var result = new List<RootGrant>();
        var table = await _su.ReadAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        if (table == null)
        {
            // 只有布局不认识才降级；临时失败不锁死，下次还能读
            _formatUnsupported = _su.FormatUnsupported;
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_su.LastError)) AppLog.Add("授权表读取失败：" + _su.LastError);
            return result;
        }
        _formatUnsupported = false;
        foreach (var e in table) result.Add(new RootGrant(e.Package, e.Uid, e.Allowed));
        return result;
    }

    public async Task<RootActionResult> SetGrantAsync(string package, int uid, bool allowed,
        CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var (ok, msg) = await _su.SetAllowedAsync(package, uid, allowed, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        return new RootActionResult(ok, msg);
    }

    public async Task<RootActionResult> RemoveGrantAsync(string package, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var (ok, msg) = await _su.RemoveAsync(package, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        return new RootActionResult(ok, msg);
    }

    public async Task<RootActionResult> SoftRebootAsync(CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        try
        {
            var r = await _fs.ExecuteAsync(_ksudCmd + " soft-reboot", true, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            if (r.Ok) return new RootActionResult(true, "已发送软重启命令（约 30 秒）");

            // 部分 fork 没把 ksud 放进 PATH，也没有 soft-reboot 子命令：退回 zygote 重启
            var fallback = await _fs.ExecuteAsync("setprop ctl.restart zygote", true, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            return fallback.Ok
                ? new RootActionResult(true, "ksud 不可用，已改为重启 zygote（约 10~20 秒）")
                : new RootActionResult(false, "软重启失败，请手动重启设备");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            return new RootActionResult(false, "软重启失败：" + ex.Message);
        }
    }
}
```

`src/Services/Root/MagiskProvider.cs`:

```cs
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace DashFile.Services.Root;

/// <summary>
/// Magisk 系（Magisk / Magisk Alpha / Kitsune Mask（原 Magisk Delta））。
///
/// 模块机制与 KernelSU 完全一致（/data/adb/modules + disable/remove 标记），
/// 安装用 `magisk --install-module`；授权表是 magisk.db（SQLite），
/// 通过 Magisk 自带的 `magisk --sqlite` 读写，不依赖电脑端 SQLite 库。
///
/// 写入策略：
///  1. 先把 magisk.db 备份到电脑（%LOCALAPPDATA%\DashFile\su\）；
///  2. 先查 policies 是否已有该 uid，有则 UPDATE，没有则 INSERT OR REPLACE；
///  3. 立刻回读校验；不一致就报告失败并给出备份路径，绝不假装成功。
/// MagiskSU 每次授权都会查库，所以改完立即生效，不需要重启。
/// </summary>
public sealed class MagiskProvider : IRootProvider
{
    private readonly RemoteFileSystem _fs;
    private readonly string _magisk;
    private readonly string _magiskCmd;
    private readonly bool _canManage;
    private readonly string _dbPath = DevicePaths.MagiskDb;

    public MagiskProvider(RemoteFileSystem fs, string displayName, string version, string workMode,
        string magiskCommand, bool hasMagiskDb, string managerPackage, bool managerInstalled)
    {
        _fs = fs;
        _magisk = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(magiskCommand) ? "magisk" : magiskCommand;
        _magiskCmd = _magisk.Contains(' ') ? Sh.Q(_magisk) : _magisk;
        _canManage = hasMagiskDb && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(magiskCommand);
        DisplayName = displayName;
        Version = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(version) ? "无管理器" : version;
        WorkMode = workMode;
        ManagerPackage = managerPackage;
        ManagerInstalled = managerInstalled;
    }

    public string Id => "magisk";
    public RootFamily Family => RootFamily.Magisk;
    public string DisplayName { get; }
    public string Version { get; }
    public string WorkMode { get; }
    public string ManagerPackage { get; }
    public bool ManagerInstalled { get; }

    /// <summary>最近一次读取失败原因（成功时为 null）：别再让"读失败"看起来像"没有授权"</summary>
    public string? LastError { get; private set; }

    public bool CanReadGrants => _canManage;
    public bool CanManageGrants => _canManage;
    public string GrantHint => _canManage
        ? "读写 magisk.db（通过 magisk --sqlite），改动立即生效"
        : "magisk 二进制或 magisk.db 不可用，授权表只读";
    public bool GrantChangeNeedsReboot => false;

    public string? ModuleInstallCommand => _magiskCmd + " --install-module {0}";
    public string? ModuleUninstallCommand => null;

    public async Task<List<RootGrant>> ReadGrantsAsync(CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var result = new List<RootGrant>();
        if (!_canManage) return result;

        try
        {
            // ① 包名 → uid（一次调用拿全，避免逐个 stat）
            var pm = await _fs.RunCommandAsync("pm list packages -U 2>/dev/null", false, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            var uidOf = new Dictionary<int, string>();
            foreach (var raw in pm.Split('\n'))
            {
                var t = raw.Trim();
                if (!t.StartsWith("package:", StringComparison.Ordinal)) continue;
                var body = t[8..];
                var at = body.LastIndexOf(" uid:", StringComparison.Ordinal);
                if (at < 0) continue;
                if (!int.TryParse(body[(at + 5)..].Trim(), out var uid)) continue;
                var pkg = body[..at].Trim();
                if (pkg.Length > 0) uidOf[uid] = pkg;
            }

            // ② policies 表
            var rawPol = await SqliteAsync("SELECT uid, policy FROM policies", ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            foreach (var raw in rawPol.Split('\n'))
            {
                var t = raw.Trim();
                if (t.Length == 0 || t.StartsWith("[")) continue;
                var parts = t.Split(new[] { '|', '\t', ' ' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
                if (parts.Length < 2) continue;
                if (!int.TryParse(parts[0].Trim(), out var uid)) continue;
                if (!int.TryParse(parts[1].Trim(), out var pol)) continue;
                if (!uidOf.TryGetValue(uid, out var pkg)) continue;
                result.Add(new RootGrant(pkg, uid, pol == 1));
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            // 以前整段 catch{}：读失败也会显示"0 条授权"，用户以为授权丢了/去改表更危险
            LastError = "读取 magisk.db 失败：" + ex.Message;
            AppLog.Add("[magisk] 读取授权失败：" + ex.Message);
        }
        return result;
    }

    public async Task<RootActionResult> SetGrantAsync(string package, int uid, bool allowed,
        CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        if (!_canManage) return new RootActionResult(false, "Magisk 授权表不可写：" + GrantHint);
        if (uid <= 0) return new RootActionResult(false, "UID 无效，未做任何修改");

        var backup = await BackupDbAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        var value = allowed ? 1 : 0;

        try
        {
            var existingRaw = await SqliteAsync($"SELECT policy FROM policies WHERE uid={uid}", ct)
                .ConfigureAwait(false);
            var hasRow = Regex.IsMatch(existingRaw, @"(?m)^\s*\d+\s*$");

            var sql = !hasRow
                ? $"INSERT OR REPLACE INTO policies (uid, policy, until, logging) VALUES ({uid}, {value}, 0, 1)"
                : $"UPDATE policies SET policy={value} WHERE uid={uid}";

            var r = await ExecuteSqliteAsync(sql, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            if (!r.Ok)
            {
                // 老版本 schema 可能没有 until/logging 列，退回两列写法
                if (!hasRow)
                {
                    r = await ExecuteSqliteAsync(
                        $"INSERT OR REPLACE INTO policies (uid, policy) VALUES ({uid}, {value})", ct)
                        .ConfigureAwait(false);
                }
                if (!r.Ok)
                    return new RootActionResult(false, $"写入 magisk.db 失败：{FirstLine(r.All)}" +
                                                      (backup != null ? $"\n备份：{backup}" : ""));
            }

            // 直接回读这一条 policy，避免包名映射（pm -U）在个别 ROM 上缺失导致误判
            var verifyRaw = await SqliteAsync($"SELECT policy FROM policies WHERE uid={uid}", ct)
                .ConfigureAwait(false);
            var vm = Regex.Match(verifyRaw, @"(?m)^\s*(\d+)\s*$");
            var match = vm.Success && int.TryParse(vm.Groups[1].Value, out var got) && got == value;
            return match
                ? new RootActionResult(true, "已写入 magisk.db，立即生效")
                : new RootActionResult(false, "写入后回读不一致，已保留备份" +
                                              (backup != null ? $"：{backup}" : ""));
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            return new RootActionResult(false, "写入 magisk.db 失败：" + ex.Message +
                                              (backup != null ? $"\n备份：{backup}" : ""));
        }
    }

    public async Task<RootActionResult> RemoveGrantAsync(string package, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        if (!_canManage) return new RootActionResult(false, "Magisk 授权表不可写：" + GrantHint);
        try
        {
            var uidRaw = await _fs.RunCommandAsync(
                "stat -c %u " + Sh.Q(DevicePaths.UserData(package)) + " 2>/dev/null", true, ct)
                .ConfigureAwait(false);
            var m = Regex.Match(uidRaw, @"(?m)^\s*(\d+)\s*$");
            if (!m.Success) return new RootActionResult(false, "取不到 UID");
            var uid = int.Parse(m.Groups[1].Value, System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);

            var backup = await BackupDbAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            var r = await ExecuteSqliteAsync($"DELETE FROM policies WHERE uid={uid}", ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            return r.Ok
                ? new RootActionResult(true, "已从 magisk.db 移除" +
                                              (backup != null ? $"（备份：{backup}）" : ""))
                : new RootActionResult(false, "移除失败：" + FirstLine(r.All));
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { return new RootActionResult(false, "移除失败：" + ex.Message); }
    }

    public async Task<RootActionResult> SoftRebootAsync(CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        try
        {
            var r = await _fs.ExecuteAsync("setprop ctl.restart zygote", true, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            return r.Ok
                ? new RootActionResult(true, "已重启 zygote（约 10~20 秒，不会丢数据）")
                : new RootActionResult(false, "软重启失败，请手动重启设备");
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { return new RootActionResult(false, "软重启失败：" + ex.Message); }
    }

    // ---------------- magisk --sqlite ----------------

    private async Task<string> SqliteAsync(string sql, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        try
        {
            var r = await _fs.ExecuteAsync($"{_magiskCmd} --sqlite {Sh.Q(sql)}", true, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            return r.All;
        }
        catch { return ""; }
    }

    private async Task<ProcResult> ExecuteSqliteAsync(string sql, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var r = await _fs.ExecuteAsync($"{_magiskCmd} --sqlite {Sh.Q(sql)}", true, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        if (r.ExitCode == 0 && !r.All.Contains("error", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) &&
            !r.All.Contains("no such", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) &&
            !r.All.Contains("syntax", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return r;
        return new ProcResult(r.ExitCode == 0 ? -2 : r.ExitCode, r.StdOut, r.StdErr);
    }

    private async Task<string?> BackupDbAsync(CancellationToken ct)
    {
        try
        {
            var dir = AppPaths.Su;
            Directory.CreateDirectory(dir);
            var file = Path.Combine(dir, "magisk-" + DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyyMMdd_HHmmss") + ".db");
            var bytes = await _fs.ReadBytesAsync(_dbPath, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            if (bytes.Length == 0) return null;
            await File.WriteAllBytesAsync(file, bytes, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            return file;
        }
        catch { return null; }
    }

    private static string FirstLine(string s)
    {
        foreach (var line in (s ?? "").Split('\n'))
        {
            var t = line.Trim();
            if (t.Length > 0 && !t.StartsWith("[")) return t;
        }
        return "未知错误";
    }
}
```

`src/Services/Root/RootDetectionContext.cs`:

```cs
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace DashFile.Services.Root;

/// <summary>
/// 一次 Root 识别过程中的共享上下文：设备文件系统、证据、包版本缓存。
/// provider 工厂只依赖这个上下文，不再各自持有 MainViewModel / AdbRunner。
/// </summary>
public sealed class RootDetectionContext
{
    private readonly Dictionary<string, string> _packageVersions = new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

    public RootDetectionContext(RemoteFileSystem fileSystem, RootEvidence evidence)
    {
        FileSystem = fileSystem;
        Evidence = evidence;
    }

    public RemoteFileSystem FileSystem { get; }

    public RootEvidence Evidence { get; }

    /// <summary>读取管理器 App 的 versionName；同一个包只查一次。</summary>
    public async Task<string> PackageVersionAsync(string package)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(package)) return "";
        if (_packageVersions.TryGetValue(package, out var cached)) return cached;

        var version = "";
        try
        {
            var raw = await FileSystem.RunCommandAsync(
                $"dumpsys package {Sh.Q(package)} 2>/dev/null | grep -m1 versionName", false)
                .ConfigureAwait(false);
            var match = Regex.Match(raw, @"versionName=(\S+)");
            if (match.Success) version = match.Groups[1].Value;
        }
        catch { }

        _packageVersions[package] = version;
        return version;
    }
}

/// <summary>
/// Root 实现工厂。默认注册在 <see cref="RootProviderRegistry"/> 里，按注册顺序尝试；
/// 新增一种管理器 = 新增一个工厂并注册，不需要改 DetectAsync 的 if/else。
/// </summary>
public interface IRootProviderFactory
{
    Task<IRootProvider?> TryCreateAsync(RootDetectionContext context);
}
```

`src/Services/Root/RootEvidence.cs`:

```cs
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;

namespace DashFile.Services.Root;

/// <summary>
/// 识别结果的全部证据（一次 root shell 调用收集）。
///
/// 为什么不能只看包名：KernelSU 的改版（KernelSU / KSU-Next / SukiSU / ReSukiSU / KowSU / 私有 fork）
/// 包名千奇百怪，甚至可以不装管理器 App；Magisk 也有官方 / Alpha / Kitsune 多个包名。
/// 所以判定以“设备上的客观痕迹”为主，包名只用来取显示名和版本。
/// </summary>
public sealed record RootEvidence
{
    public string SuPath { get; init; } = "";

    /// <summary>su -v 的输出，例如 "3.3.1:KernelSU" / "27.0:MAGISK" —— 最可靠的家族证据。</summary>
    public string SuVersion { get; init; } = "";

    /// <summary>.allowlist 头 3 字节，"USK" 说明是 KernelSU 格式且可写。</summary>
    public string AllowlistMagic { get; init; } = "";

    public bool HasKsuDir { get; init; }
    public string KsudPath { get; init; } = "";
    public string KsudVersion { get; init; } = "";
    public string KsudInfoVersion { get; init; } = "";

    public bool HasMagiskDb { get; init; }
    public string MagiskPath { get; init; } = "";
    public string MagiskVersion { get; init; } = "";
    public string MagiskVersionCode { get; init; } = "";

    public bool HasApDir { get; init; }
    public string ApdPath { get; init; } = "";
    public string ApatchVersion { get; init; } = "";

    public bool HasModulesDir { get; init; }

    /// <summary>/proc/modules 里的内核模块名（kernelsu / apatch / magisk …），逗号分隔；空=内置。</summary>
    public string KernelModules { get; init; } = "";

    public bool HasSuperSuFiles { get; init; }
    public bool HasPhhFiles { get; init; }
    public bool HasLineageSu { get; init; }

    /// <summary>pm list packages 的原始输出。</summary>
    public string PackageList { get; init; } = "";

    public bool SuOk => SuPath.Length > 0;

    public bool IsKsuAllowlist => AllowlistMagic == "USK";

    public HashSet<string> Packages { get; } = new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

    public bool HasPackage(string package) => Packages.Contains(package);

    public bool LooksKsu =>
        IsKsuAllowlist ||
        HasKsuDir ||
        KsudPath.Length > 0 ||
        KernelModules.Contains("ksu", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
        KernelModules.Contains("kernelsu", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
        SuVersion.Contains("kernelsu", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
        SuVersion.Contains("sukisu", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
        SuVersion.Contains("resukisu", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
        SuVersion.Contains("kowsu", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
        SuVersion.Contains("ksunext", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
        SuVersion.Contains(":ksu", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

    public bool LooksMagisk =>
        HasMagiskDb ||
        MagiskPath.Length > 0 ||
        SuVersion.Contains("magisk", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

    public bool LooksAPatch =>
        HasApDir ||
        ApdPath.Length > 0 ||
        SuVersion.Contains("apatch", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

    public bool LooksSuperSu =>
        HasSuperSuFiles ||
        HasPackage("eu.chainfire.supersu") ||
        SuVersion.Contains("supersu", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

    public bool LooksPhh =>
        HasPhhFiles ||
        HasPackage("me.phh.superuser") ||
        SuVersion.Contains("phh", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
        SuVersion.Contains("superuser", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

    public bool LooksLineageSu =>
        HasLineageSu ||
        HasPackage(RootPackages.LineageSettings) &&
        SuVersion.Contains("lineage", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

    /// <summary>从 "3.3.1:KernelSU" 里取出冒号后面的实现名。</summary>
    public string SuVariant
    {
        get
        {
            var i = SuVersion.IndexOf(':');
            return i >= 0 && i + 1 < SuVersion.Length ? SuVersion[(i + 1)..].Trim() : "";
        }
    }

    /// <summary>从 su -v 里取出冒号前面的版本号。</summary>
    public string SuVersionNumber
    {
        get
        {
            var i = SuVersion.IndexOf(':');
            return i > 0 ? SuVersion[..i].Trim() : "";
        }
    }

    /// <summary>把 /proc/modules 里的模块名做整体小写匹配。</summary>
    public bool KernelModuleContains(string name)
        => KernelModules.Contains(name, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

    /// <summary>用 pm list packages 的输出填充包集合（调用方只需调用一次）。</summary>
    public void FillPackages()
    {
        if (Packages.Count > 0) return;
        foreach (var raw in PackageList.Split('\n'))
        {
            var line = raw.Trim();
            if (!line.StartsWith("package:", StringComparison.Ordinal)) continue;
            var pkg = line[8..].Trim();
            if (pkg.Length > 0) Packages.Add(pkg);
        }
    }

    public string FirstPackage(params string[] candidates)
        => candidates.FirstOrDefault(HasPackage) ?? "";
}
```

`src/Services/Root/RootFactories.cs`:

```cs
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace DashFile.Services.Root;

/// <summary>
/// 内置 Root 识别工厂的注册表。顺序就是优先级：
/// KSU 系 → APatch → Magisk 系 → SuperSU → phh → Lineage → Unknown。
///
/// 新增一种管理器时：
///   1. 实现 IRootProvider + 一个新的 IRootProviderFactory；
///   2. 在 Register 里插入（或外部调用 Register）；
///   3. 不需要改 DetectAsync 的 if/else。
/// </summary>
public static class RootProviderRegistry
{
    private static readonly object Gate = new();
    private static readonly List<IRootProviderFactory> Builtins = new()
    {
        new KernelSuRootFactory(),
        new APatchRootFactory(),
        new MagiskRootFactory(),
        new SuperSuRootFactory(),
        new PhhRootFactory(),
        new LineageRootFactory(),
        new UnknownRootFactory(),
    };

    public static IReadOnlyList<IRootProviderFactory> Factories
    {
        get { lock (Gate) return Builtins.ToArray(); }
    }

    /// <summary>注册到 Unknown 之前（保证自定义实现先被尝试）。</summary>
    public static void Register(IRootProviderFactory factory)
    {
        if (factory == null) return;
        lock (Gate)
        {
            var index = Math.Max(0, Builtins.Count - 1);
            Builtins.Insert(index, factory);
        }
    }
}

internal sealed class KernelSuRootFactory : IRootProviderFactory
{
    public async Task<IRootProvider?> TryCreateAsync(RootDetectionContext context)
    {
        var evidence = context.Evidence;
        if (!evidence.LooksKsu) return null;

        var variant = RootVariants.PickKsu(evidence);
        var managerPackage = variant.Package;
        var managerInstalled = managerPackage.Length > 0;
        var managerVersion = await context.PackageVersionAsync(managerPackage).ConfigureAwait(false);

        var version = RootVariants.FormatVersion(
            RootVariants.FirstVersion(managerVersion, evidence.KsudInfoVersion,
                evidence.KsudVersion, evidence.SuVersionNumber),
            managerInstalled);

        var workMode = evidence.KernelModuleContains("kernelsu") || evidence.KernelModuleContains("ksu")
            ? "LKM（模块加载）"
            : "Built-in（内核内置）";

        // 能不能写授权表由指纹决定，而不是由名字决定（fork 可能改格式）
        return new KernelSuProvider(context.FileSystem, variant.Name, version, workMode,
            evidence.IsKsuAllowlist, managerPackage, managerInstalled, evidence.KsudPath);
    }
}

internal sealed class APatchRootFactory : IRootProviderFactory
{
    public async Task<IRootProvider?> TryCreateAsync(RootDetectionContext context)
    {
        var evidence = context.Evidence;
        if (!evidence.LooksAPatch) return null;

        var managerPackage = evidence.FirstPackage(RootPackages.APatch);
        var managerInstalled = managerPackage.Length > 0;
        var version = RootVariants.FormatVersion(
            RootVariants.FirstVersion(await context.PackageVersionAsync(managerPackage).ConfigureAwait(false),
                evidence.ApatchVersion, evidence.SuVersionNumber),
            managerInstalled);

        return new APatchProvider(context.FileSystem,
            managerInstalled ? "APatch" : "APatch（无管理器）",
            version,
            "内核补丁（KernelPatch）",
            evidence.ApdPath,
            managerPackage,
            managerInstalled);
    }
}

internal sealed class MagiskRootFactory : IRootProviderFactory
{
    public async Task<IRootProvider?> TryCreateAsync(RootDetectionContext context)
    {
        var evidence = context.Evidence;
        if (!evidence.LooksMagisk) return null;

        var variant = RootVariants.PickMagisk(evidence, out var hasManagerPackage);
        var managerPackage = hasManagerPackage ? variant.Package : "";
        var managerInstalled = managerPackage.Length > 0;
        var version = RootVariants.FormatVersion(
            RootVariants.FirstVersion(
                await context.PackageVersionAsync(managerPackage).ConfigureAwait(false),
                RootVariants.StripColon(evidence.MagiskVersion),
                evidence.SuVersionNumber),
            managerInstalled);

        return new MagiskProvider(context.FileSystem, variant.Name, version, "用户态（MagiskSU）",
            string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(evidence.MagiskPath) ? "magisk" : evidence.MagiskPath,
            evidence.HasMagiskDb,
            managerPackage,
            managerInstalled);
    }
}

internal sealed class SuperSuRootFactory : IRootProviderFactory
{
    public async Task<IRootProvider?> TryCreateAsync(RootDetectionContext context)
    {
        var evidence = context.Evidence;
        if (!evidence.LooksSuperSu) return null;

        var managerPackage = evidence.FirstPackage(RootPackages.SuperSu);
        var managerInstalled = managerPackage.Length > 0;
        var version = RootVariants.FormatVersion(
            RootVariants.FirstVersion(
                await context.PackageVersionAsync(managerPackage).ConfigureAwait(false),
                evidence.SuVersionNumber),
            managerInstalled);

        return new SuperSuProvider(context.FileSystem, version, "传统 su（System）",
            managerPackage, managerInstalled);
    }
}

internal sealed class PhhRootFactory : IRootProviderFactory
{
    public async Task<IRootProvider?> TryCreateAsync(RootDetectionContext context)
    {
        var evidence = context.Evidence;
        if (!evidence.LooksPhh) return null;

        var managerPackage = evidence.FirstPackage(RootPackages.PhhSuperuser);
        var managerInstalled = managerPackage.Length > 0;
        var version = RootVariants.FormatVersion(
            RootVariants.FirstVersion(
                await context.PackageVersionAsync(managerPackage).ConfigureAwait(false),
                evidence.SuVersionNumber),
            managerInstalled);

        return new PhhSuperuserProvider(context.FileSystem, version, "传统 su（phh）",
            managerPackage, managerInstalled);
    }
}

internal sealed class LineageRootFactory : IRootProviderFactory
{
    public Task<IRootProvider?> TryCreateAsync(RootDetectionContext context)
    {
        var evidence = context.Evidence;
        if (!evidence.LooksLineageSu) return Task.FromResult<IRootProvider?>(null);

        var version = RootVariants.FormatVersion(
            RootVariants.FirstVersion(evidence.SuVersionNumber), false);
        return Task.FromResult<IRootProvider?>(
            new LineageSuProvider(context.FileSystem, version, "系统内置 su"));
    }
}

internal sealed class UnknownRootFactory : IRootProviderFactory
{
    public Task<IRootProvider?> TryCreateAsync(RootDetectionContext context)
    {
        var evidence = context.Evidence;
        if (!evidence.SuOk) return Task.FromResult<IRootProvider?>(null);

        var version = RootVariants.FormatVersion(
            RootVariants.FirstVersion(evidence.SuVersionNumber), false);
        return Task.FromResult<IRootProvider?>(new UnknownRootProvider(version));
    }
}
```

`src/Services/Root/RootProviders.cs`:

```cs
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace DashFile.Services.Root;

/// <summary>
/// Root 证据收集 + 识别入口。
///
/// 判定顺序完全由 <see cref="RootProviderRegistry"/> 的工厂顺序决定：
///   KSU 系 → APatch → Magisk 系 → SuperSU → phh → Lineage → Unknown。
///
/// 识别不靠包名硬猜，而是收集设备证据（一次 root shell）：
///   su -v、.allowlist 的 USK 指纹、ksud / magisk.db / magisk / apd、
///   /proc/modules、管理器包名。包名只用于显示名、版本、是否装了管理器。
/// </summary>
public static class RootProviders
{
    private static readonly string ProbeScript = string.Join(" ",
        "SU=$(command -v su 2>/dev/null);",
        "V=\"\"; [ -n \"$SU\" ] && V=$($SU -v 2>/dev/null | head -1);",

        // KernelSU 系
        "KSUD=$(command -v ksud 2>/dev/null);",
        $"[ -z \"$KSUD\" ] && [ -x {DevicePaths.AdbData}/ksud ] && KSUD={DevicePaths.AdbData}/ksud;",
        $"[ -z \"$KSUD\" ] && [ -x {DevicePaths.KsuDir}/bin/ksud ] && KSUD={DevicePaths.KsuDir}/bin/ksud;",
        "KSUD_V=\"\"; KSUD_INFO=\"\";",
        "[ -n \"$KSUD\" ] && KSUD_V=$($KSUD -V 2>/dev/null | head -1);",
        "[ -n \"$KSUD\" ] && KSUD_INFO=$($KSUD debug info 2>/dev/null | sed -n \"s/^version: *//p\" | head -1);",

        // Magisk 系
        "MAGISK=$(command -v magisk 2>/dev/null);",
        $"[ -z \"$MAGISK\" ] && [ -x {DevicePaths.MagiskDir}/magisk ] && MAGISK={DevicePaths.MagiskDir}/magisk;",
        $"[ -z \"$MAGISK\" ] && [ -x {DevicePaths.AdbData}/magisk64 ] && MAGISK={DevicePaths.AdbData}/magisk64;",
        "MAGISK_V=\"\"; MAGISK_C=\"\";",
        "[ -n \"$MAGISK\" ] && MAGISK_V=$($MAGISK -v 2>/dev/null | head -1);",
        "[ -n \"$MAGISK\" ] && MAGISK_C=$($MAGISK -V 2>/dev/null | head -1);",

        // APatch
        "APD=$(command -v apd 2>/dev/null);",
        $"[ -z \"$APD\" ] && [ -x {DevicePaths.AdbData}/apd ] && APD={DevicePaths.AdbData}/apd;",
        $"[ -z \"$APD\" ] && [ -x {DevicePaths.APatchDir}/bin/apd ] && APD={DevicePaths.APatchDir}/bin/apd;",
        "APD_V=\"\"; [ -n \"$APD\" ] && APD_V=$($APD -V 2>/dev/null | head -1);",

        // 目录 / 内核模块 / 传统实现痕迹
        $"KSU_DIR=0; [ -d {DevicePaths.KsuDir} ] && KSU_DIR=1;",
        $"MAGDB=0; [ -f {DevicePaths.MagiskDb} ] && MAGDB=1;",
        $"AP_DIR=0; [ -d {DevicePaths.APatchDir} ] && AP_DIR=1;",
        $"MODULES=0; [ -d {DevicePaths.Modules} ] && MODULES=1;",
        "PROC=$(grep -E '^(kernelsu|ksu|apatch|magisk)' /proc/modules 2>/dev/null | cut -d' ' -f1 | tr '\\n' ',');",
        $"SUPERSU=0; [ -e {DevicePaths.SuperSuConfig} ] && SUPERSU=1; " +
        $"[ -d {RootPackages.ManagerDataDir(RootPackages.SuperSu)} ] && SUPERSU=1;",
        $"PHH=0; [ -d {RootPackages.ManagerDataDir(RootPackages.PhhSuperuser)} ] && PHH=1;",
        $"LINEAGE=0; [ -x {DevicePaths.SystemSu} ] && LINEAGE=1;",

        // 输出
        "echo \"S=$SU\"; echo \"V=$V\";",
        "echo \"KSU_DIR=$KSU_DIR\";",
        $"echo \"ALLOW=$(head -c 3 {DevicePaths.KsuAllowlist} 2>/dev/null)\";",
        "echo \"KSUD=$KSUD\"; echo \"KSUD_V=$KSUD_V\"; echo \"KSUD_INFO=$KSUD_INFO\";",
        "echo \"MAGDB=$MAGDB\";",
        "echo \"MAGISK=$MAGISK\"; echo \"MAGISK_V=$MAGISK_V\"; echo \"MAGISK_C=$MAGISK_C\";",
        "echo \"AP_DIR=$AP_DIR\";",
        "echo \"APD=$APD\"; echo \"APD_V=$APD_V\";",
        "echo \"MODULES=$MODULES\";",
        "echo \"PROC=$PROC\";",
        "echo \"SUPERSU=$SUPERSU\"; echo \"PHH=$PHH\"; echo \"LINEAGE=$LINEAGE\";",
        "echo \"PKGS_BEGIN\"; pm list packages 2>/dev/null; echo \"PKGS_END\"");

    public static async Task<RootEvidence> CollectAsync(RemoteFileSystem fs, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var raw = "";
        try { raw = await fs.RunCommandAsync(ProbeScript, true, ct).ConfigureAwait(false); }
        catch (Exception ex) { AppLog.Add("Root 探测失败：" + ex.Message); }

        // 一次扫描成字典，避免对每个字段单独跑正则（原来 10 次 Regex.Match）
        var fields = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
        foreach (var rawLine in raw.Split('\n'))
        {
            var line = rawLine.Trim();
            var index = line.IndexOf('=');
            if (index <= 0) continue;
            var key = line[..index].Trim();
            if (key.Length is > 0 and <= 24) fields[key] = line[(index + 1)..].Trim();
        }

        string Get(string key)
            => fields.TryGetValue(key, out var value) ? value : "";

        var pkgStart = raw.IndexOf("PKGS_BEGIN", StringComparison.Ordinal);
        var pkgEnd = raw.IndexOf("PKGS_END", StringComparison.Ordinal);
        var packages = pkgStart >= 0 && pkgEnd > pkgStart
            ? raw[(pkgStart + "PKGS_BEGIN".Length)..pkgEnd]
            : "";

        var evidence = new RootEvidence
        {
            SuPath = Get("S"),
            SuVersion = Get("V"),
            AllowlistMagic = Get("ALLOW"),
            HasKsuDir = Get("KSU_DIR") == "1",
            KsudPath = Get("KSUD"),
            KsudVersion = Get("KSUD_V"),
            KsudInfoVersion = Get("KSUD_INFO"),
            HasMagiskDb = Get("MAGDB") == "1",
            MagiskPath = Get("MAGISK"),
            MagiskVersion = Get("MAGISK_V"),
            MagiskVersionCode = Get("MAGISK_C"),
            HasApDir = Get("AP_DIR") == "1",
            ApdPath = Get("APD"),
            ApatchVersion = Get("APD_V"),
            HasModulesDir = Get("MODULES") == "1",
            KernelModules = Get("PROC"),
            HasSuperSuFiles = Get("SUPERSU") == "1",
            HasPhhFiles = Get("PHH") == "1",
            HasLineageSu = Get("LINEAGE") == "1",
            PackageList = packages,
        };
        evidence.FillPackages();
        return evidence;
    }

    public static async Task<IRootProvider?> DetectAsync(RemoteFileSystem fs, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var evidence = await CollectAsync(fs, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        var context = new RootDetectionContext(fs, evidence);

        foreach (var factory in RootProviderRegistry.Factories)
        {
            var provider = await factory.TryCreateAsync(context).ConfigureAwait(false);
            if (provider != null) return provider;
        }
        return null;
    }
}
```

`src/Services/Root/RootVariants.cs`:

```cs
using System;
using System.Linq;

namespace DashFile.Services.Root;

internal sealed record RootVariant(string Name, string Package);

/// <summary>
/// 显示名、包名、版本号的整理逻辑。识别顺序仍在各 factory 里，这里只处理“认出来之后叫什么”。
/// </summary>
internal static class RootVariants
{
    // 顺序 = 优先级。同一个 KSU 内核可能同时存在多个管理器 App（例如 KSU + SukiSU 共存），
    // 取“更具体”的那个展示，避免把 SukiSU 显示成 KernelSU。
    private static readonly RootVariant[] KsuManagers =
    {
        new("SukiSU Ultra", RootPackages.SukiSuUltra),
        new("ReSukiSU", RootPackages.ReSukiSU),
        new("KernelSU-Next", RootPackages.KernelSuNext),
        new("KowSU", RootPackages.KowSU),
        new("MKSU", RootPackages.MKSU),
        new("KernelSU", RootPackages.KernelSu),
    };

    private static readonly RootVariant[] MagiskManagers =
    {
        new("Magisk Alpha", RootPackages.MagiskAlpha),
        new("Kitsune Mask", RootPackages.KitsuneMask),
        new("Magisk", RootPackages.Magisk),
    };

    public static RootVariant PickKsu(RootEvidence evidence)
    {
        foreach (var variant in KsuManagers)
            if (evidence.HasPackage(variant.Package)) return variant;

        var fork = evidence.SuVariant;
        var name = fork switch
        {
            _ when fork.Contains("SukiSU", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) => "SukiSU Ultra",
            _ when fork.Contains("ReSukiSU", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) => "ReSukiSU",
            _ when fork.Contains("KowSU", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) => "KowSU",
            _ when fork.Contains("KSUN", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                   fork.Contains("KSU-Next", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) => "KernelSU-Next",
            _ when fork.Contains("MKSU", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) => "MKSU",
            _ when fork.Contains("KernelSU", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) => "KernelSU",
            _ => "KernelSU",
        };
        return new RootVariant(name + "（无管理器）", "");
    }

    public static RootVariant PickMagisk(RootEvidence evidence, out bool hasManagerPackage)
    {
        foreach (var variant in MagiskManagers)
        {
            if (!evidence.HasPackage(variant.Package)) continue;
            hasManagerPackage = true;
            return variant;
        }

        hasManagerPackage = false;
        var name = evidence.SuVariant.Contains("alpha", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ? "Magisk Alpha"
                 : evidence.SuVariant.Contains("kitsune", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ? "Kitsune Mask"
                 : "Magisk";
        return new RootVariant(name + "（无管理器）", "");
    }

    public static string FirstVersion(params string[] values)
        => values.FirstOrDefault(v => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(v))?.Trim() ?? "";

    public static string StripColon(string value)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value)) return "";
        var index = value.IndexOf(':');
        return (index > 0 ? value[..index] : value).Trim();
    }

    public static string FormatVersion(string raw, bool managerInstalled)
    {
        var version = StripColon(raw);
        if (version.Length == 0)
            return managerInstalled ? "—" : "无管理器";
        if (!version.StartsWith("v", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) version = "v" + version;
        return managerInstalled ? version : version + "（无管理器）";
    }
}
```

`src/Services/SafeTask.cs`:

```cs
using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace DashFile.Services;

/// <summary>
/// 统一处理"发出去就不管"的后台任务：异常立即写崩溃日志 + 运行日志 + 状态栏，
/// 不再等 GC/finalizer 才由 UnobservedTaskException 报出来（那时已经丢了上下文）。
/// </summary>
public static class SafeTask
{
    public static void Safe(this Task task, string operation, Action<string>? report = null)
        => _ = ObserveAsync(task, operation, report);

    public static void Safe(this Func<Task> factory, string operation, Action<string>? report = null)
    {
        try { _ = ObserveAsync(factory(), operation, report); }
        catch (Exception ex) { Handle(ex, operation, report); }
    }

    private static async Task ObserveAsync(Task task, string operation, Action<string>? report)
    {
        try { await task.ConfigureAwait(false); }
        catch (Exception ex) { Handle(ex, operation, report); }
    }

    private static void Handle(Exception ex, string operation, Action<string>? report)
    {
        // 取消是正常流程（切目录/关窗口时的预取），不该写崩溃日志也不能报"失败"
        if (ex is OperationCanceledException) return;

        var message = operation + "失败：" + ex.GetBaseException().Message;
        try
        {
            App.WriteCrash("Task:" + operation, ex);
            AppLog.Add("后台任务失败：" + operation + " -> " + ex.GetBaseException().Message);
        }
        catch { }

        if (report == null) return;

        // 这里跑在线程池线程上（ObserveAsync 用了 ConfigureAwait(false)），
        //   而所有调用点都是 m => StatusText = m —— 直接调用会抛"跨线程访问 UI"，
        //   然后被下面的 catch 吞掉，用户永远看不到失败提示。
        try
        {
            if (Avalonia.Threading.Dispatcher.UIThread.CheckAccess())
                report(message);
            else
                Avalonia.Threading.Dispatcher.UIThread.Post(() =>
                {
                    try { report(message); } catch { }
                });
        }
        catch { }
    }
}
```

`src/Services/Sh.cs`:

```cs
namespace DashFile.Services;

/// <summary>shell 单引号转义工具</summary>
public static class Sh
{
    /// <summary>把任意字符串包成 shell 单引号字面量</summary>
    public static string Q(string s) => "'" + s.Replace("'", "'\\''") + "'";

    /// <summary>远端路径拼接（POSIX 风格）</summary>
    public static string Join(string dir, string name)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(dir)) dir = "/";
        if (dir == "/") return "/" + name;
        return dir.TrimEnd('/') + "/" + name;
    }

    public static string Parent(string path)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(path) || path == "/") return "/";
        var p = path.TrimEnd('/');
        var i = p.LastIndexOf('/');
        if (i <= 0) return "/";
        return p[..i];
    }

    public static string BaseName(string path)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(path)) return "";
        var p = path.TrimEnd('/');
        var i = p.LastIndexOf('/');
        return i < 0 ? p : p[(i + 1)..];
    }
}
```

`src/Services/SuperuserService.cs`:

```cs
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace DashFile.Services;

/// <summary>
/// 直接读写 KernelSU 系的授权表（/data/adb/ksu/.allowlist），完全不经过管理器 App。
///
/// 授权表 = 文件头 + N 条定长记录。不同 fork 的记录长度不一样，实测有两种：
///   老版：头 12 字节，记录 780 字节，记录内包名从 0 开始；
///   新版（KernelSU-Next / SukiSU 3.x）：头 8 字节，记录 784 字节，包名前多 4 字节（版本/标志）。
/// 但两种记录「包名之后」的字段偏移一致：
///   包名 256 字节 | uid 4 | allow_su 4 | …（root profile）… | SELinux 上下文 @700 | flags @772
/// 所以这里不写死布局：读的时候按候选布局逐条校验（包名可读 + uid 合理），
/// 写回时原样保留不认识的字节，只改 allow 字段；新增记录则沿用同表记录的前缀。
/// </summary>
public sealed class SuperuserService
{
    // 不同 KSU fork 的授权表文件名基本一致，但少数版本/移植会用不带点的 allowlist；
    // 读的时候依次尝试，写回时写回“实际读到的那个路径”，不要凭空创建新文件。
    private static readonly string[] CandidatePaths =
    {
        DevicePaths.KsuAllowlist,
        DevicePaths.KsuAllowlistAlt,
    };

    private const int PackageLen = 256;
    private const int UidOffset = 256;
    private const int AllowOffset = 260;
    private const int ProfileFieldOffset = 268;
    private const int SeContextOffset = 700;
    private const int FlagsOffset = 772;
    private const int BaseRecordLen = 780;   // 包名字段之后的相对长度（含包名本身）
    private const int ExtendedRecordLen = 784;  // 新版：多 4 字节 profile 前缀
    private const int ExtendedPrefixLen = 4;

    private readonly RemoteFileSystem _fs;
    private readonly string _variant;
    private string? _path;

    /// <summary>读-改-写必须串行：连点两个开关时，后一个不能基于旧快照重排整表</summary>
    private readonly SemaphoreSlim _gate = new(1, 1);

    public SuperuserService(RemoteFileSystem fs, string? variant = null)
    {
        _fs = fs;
        _variant = variant ?? "";
    }

    /// <summary>本次识别时是否存在多个"都解析得通"的布局（只有表里恰好 1 条记录时会出现）</summary>
    public bool LayoutAmbiguous { get; private set; }

    /// <summary>歧义时的统一提示：不猜布局，让表自己变长再判定</summary>
    internal const string AmbiguousAppendHint =
        "授权表只有 1 条记录，无法判定它用 780 还是 784 的记录步长，新增/删除会写坏整表，已中止（原有授权未改动）。" +
        "请在 KernelSU 管理器里再授权一个应用，表变长后即可自动判定；也可以直接用管理器添加。";

    private string AllowlistPath => _path ?? CandidatePaths[0];

    public sealed record Entry(string Package, int Uid, bool Allowed, byte[] Raw);

    /// <summary>表头 + 记录布局（读成功后缓存，写回时复用）。</summary>
    internal sealed record Layout(int HeaderLen, int RecordLen, int PackageOffset, int Count, byte[] Header);

    private Layout? _layout;

    /// <summary>最近一次读取失败的原因（成功时为 null），用于界面/日志提示。</summary>
    public string? LastError { get; private set; }

    /// <summary>文件存在但格式不认识（只有这种情况才值得降级为只读）。</summary>
    public bool FormatUnsupported { get; private set; }

    // 候选布局：头长 / 记录长 / 包名在记录内的偏移。首个校验通过的即采用。
    private static readonly int[] HeaderLens = { 12, 8, 4 };
    private static readonly int[] RecordLens = { 780, 784, 776, 788, 792 };
    private static readonly int[] PackageOffsets = { 0, 4, 8 };

    /// <summary>读取当前授权表；文件不存在/格式不符返回 null（调用方应降级为只读）。</summary>
    public async Task<List<Entry>?> ReadAsync(CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        LastError = null;
        FormatUnsupported = false;

        foreach (var candidate in CandidatePaths)
        {
            byte[] bytes;
            try
            {
                bytes = await _fs.ReadBytesAsync(candidate, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                LastError = $"读取 {candidate} 失败：{ex.Message}";
                continue;
            }

            if (bytes.Length == 0) continue;   // 没有这个文件，试下一个

            // 1~2 字节的畸形响应：以前直接读 bytes[1]/bytes[2] 抛 IndexOutOfRange
            if (bytes.Length < 3)
            {
                FormatUnsupported = true;
                LastError = $"{candidate} 内容异常（只有 {bytes.Length} 字节）";
                continue;
            }

            if (bytes[0] != (byte)'U' || bytes[1] != (byte)'S' || bytes[2] != (byte)'K')
            {
                FormatUnsupported = true;
                LastError = $"{candidate} 不是 USK 授权表（{bytes.Length} 字节）";
                continue;
            }

            var layout = DetectLayout(bytes);
            if (layout == null)
            {
                FormatUnsupported = true;
                LastError = $"授权表格式无法识别（{bytes.Length} 字节，可能是未适配的 fork）";
                continue;
            }

            var list = new List<Entry>(layout.Count);
            for (var i = 0; i < layout.Count; i++)
            {
                var recordStart = layout.HeaderLen + i * layout.RecordLen;
                var raw = new byte[layout.RecordLen];
                Array.Copy(bytes, recordStart, raw, 0, layout.RecordLen);

                var pkg = ReadCString(raw, layout.PackageOffset, PackageLen);
                var uid = BitConverter.ToInt32(raw, layout.PackageOffset + UidOffset);
                var allow = BitConverter.ToInt32(raw, layout.PackageOffset + AllowOffset) != 0;
                if (pkg.Length == 0) continue;
                list.Add(new Entry(pkg, uid, allow, raw));
            }

            _layout = layout;
            _path = candidate;
            return list;
        }

        return null;
    }

    /// <summary>设置某个包的授权状态；不存在则追加</summary>
    public async Task<(bool Ok, string Message)> SetAllowedAsync(string pkg, int uid, bool allowed,
        CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        await _gate.WaitAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        try
        {
            var entries = await ReadAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            if (entries == null || _layout == null) return (false, "授权表格式不支持，未做任何修改");

            var idx = entries.FindIndex(e => e.Package == pkg);
            if (idx >= 0)
            {
                // 只改 allow 这 4 字节：两种布局下 allow 的**绝对偏移完全一致**（12+260 == 8+4+260），
                // 所以即使布局有歧义，原地打补丁也是零风险的。
                var raw = (byte[])entries[idx].Raw.Clone();
                BitConverter.GetBytes(allowed ? 1 : 0)
                    .CopyTo(raw, _layout.PackageOffset + AllowOffset);
                entries[idx] = entries[idx] with { Allowed = allowed, Raw = raw };
            }
            else
            {
                // 新增要按记录步长重排整表，这时布局必须是真的。
                // 只有 1 条记录的授权表两种布局同长同偏移，无法判定 —— 绝不猜，宁可让用户多点一步。
                if (LayoutAmbiguous) return (false, AmbiguousAppendHint);

                entries.Add(new Entry(pkg, uid, allowed, BuildRecord(pkg, uid, allowed, entries)));
            }

            return await WriteAsync(entries, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
        finally { _gate.Release(); }
    }

    /// <summary>从表中移除一个包</summary>
    public async Task<(bool Ok, string Message)> RemoveAsync(string pkg, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        await _gate.WaitAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        try
        {
            var entries = await ReadAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            if (entries == null || _layout == null) return (false, "授权表格式不支持，未做任何修改");

            var idx = entries.FindIndex(e => e.Package == pkg);
            if (idx < 0) return (true, "该应用不在授权表中");

            // 删除会改变记录条数 → 必须按正确步长重排，歧义时同样不能猜
            if (LayoutAmbiguous) return (false, AmbiguousAppendHint);

            entries.RemoveAt(idx);
            return await WriteAsync(entries, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
        finally { _gate.Release(); }
    }

    // ---------------- 布局识别 ----------------

    private Layout? DetectLayout(byte[] bytes)
    {
        var candidates = new List<Layout>();

        foreach (var headerLen in HeaderLens)
        {
            if (bytes.Length <= headerLen) continue;
            var body = bytes.Length - headerLen;

            foreach (var recordLen in RecordLens)
            {
                if (body % recordLen != 0) continue;
                var count = body / recordLen;
                if (count <= 0) continue;

                foreach (var packageOffset in PackageOffsets)
                {
                    if (packageOffset + FlagsOffset + 8 > recordLen) continue;
                    if (!Validate(bytes, headerLen, recordLen, packageOffset, count)) continue;
                    if (candidates.Exists(c => c.HeaderLen == headerLen && c.RecordLen == recordLen &&
                                               c.PackageOffset == packageOffset)) continue;

                    var header = new byte[headerLen];
                    Array.Copy(bytes, header, headerLen);
                    candidates.Add(new Layout(headerLen, recordLen, packageOffset, count, header));
                }
            }
        }

        LayoutAmbiguous = candidates.Count > 1;
        if (candidates.Count > 0) return PickLayout(candidates, _variant);

        // 空表：只有一个文件头（老版 12 字节 / 新版 8 字节 / 只有魔数 4 字节）
        if (bytes.Length is 4 or 8 or 12)
        {
            var extended = PrefersExtendedLayout(_variant);
            // header 数组长度必须等于 Layout.HeaderLen：以前 4 字节文件 + 新版枚举会造出
            //   Layout(8,…) 却带 12 字节 header，写回时 CopyTo 直接越界。
            var headerLen = extended ? 8 : 12;
            var header = new byte[headerLen];
            Array.Copy(bytes, header, Math.Min(headerLen, bytes.Length));
            return extended
                ? new Layout(8, ExtendedRecordLen, ExtendedPrefixLen, 0, header)
                : new Layout(headerLen, BaseRecordLen, 0, 0, header);
        }

        return null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 多个布局都解析得通时怎么选。
    ///
    /// 这里为什么需要"猜"：新版（头 8 + 记录 784，记录前有 4 字节前缀）在**只有 1 条授权**时
    ///   总长 792，和老版（头 12 + 记录 780）完全同长；而且包名/uid/allow/flags 的**绝对偏移也相同**
    ///   （12+260 == 8+4+260，12+772 == 8+4+772），所以单条记录的数据本身无法区分两种布局。
    ///   以前固定按 {12,8,4} 的顺序先命中老版，于是新版单条表被当成 780 步长：读没问题，
    ///   一旦新增第 2 条就按 12+2×780 重排，(1572-8)%784≠0 → 整表不可解析，授权全丢。
    ///   现在用"管理器 fork 名"这个外部证据来选：3.x 那几家用 784，其余按老版。
    /// </summary>
    private static Layout PickLayout(List<Layout> candidates, string variant)
    {
        if (candidates.Count == 1) return candidates[0];

        var extended = PrefersExtendedLayout(variant);

        // 只在"真实存在的两种布局"里挑。别的组合（例如 4+788）只是长度整除+包名恰好可读的
        // 巧合解，跟着它重排会把表写坏。
        var known = candidates.Where(c =>
            (c.HeaderLen == 8 && c.RecordLen == ExtendedRecordLen && c.PackageOffset == ExtendedPrefixLen) ||
            (c.HeaderLen == 12 && c.RecordLen == BaseRecordLen && c.PackageOffset == 0)).ToList();

        var pool = known.Count > 0 ? known : candidates;
        return pool
            .OrderByDescending(c => IsExtended(c) == extended ? 1 : 0)
            .ThenBy(c => c.HeaderLen)
            .ThenBy(c => c.RecordLen)
            .First();
    }

    /// <summary>新版布局特征：记录里包名前面还有 4 字节前缀</summary>
    private static bool IsExtended(Layout c) => c.PackageOffset > 0;

    /// <summary>从管理器名推断布局：这几家 3.x 系用 头8 + 记录784（前 4 字节 profile 版本）</summary>
    private static bool PrefersExtendedLayout(string variant)
        => variant.Contains("Next", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
           || variant.Contains("SukiSU", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
           || variant.Contains("ReSukiSU", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
           || variant.Contains("KowSU", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
           || variant.Contains("MKSU", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

    /// <summary>逐条校验：包名可读、uid 在 Android 应用 uid 范围内。错一个就整体否决，避免误判布局。</summary>
    private static bool Validate(byte[] bytes, int headerLen, int recordLen, int packageOffset, int count)
    {
        for (var i = 0; i < count; i++)
        {
            var start = headerLen + i * recordLen + packageOffset;
            if (!IsPackageName(bytes, start)) return false;
            if (start + UidOffset + 4 > bytes.Length) return false;
            var uid = BitConverter.ToInt32(bytes, start + UidOffset);
            if (uid < 1000 || uid > 999999) return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    private static bool IsPackageName(byte[] bytes, int offset)
    {
        if (offset >= bytes.Length) return false;
        var first = bytes[offset];
        if (!(first is >= (byte)'a' and <= (byte)'z' || first is >= (byte)'A' and <= (byte)'Z')) return false;

        var len = 0;
        for (var i = 0; i < PackageLen; i++)
        {
            if (offset + i >= bytes.Length) return false;
            var b = bytes[offset + i];
            if (b == 0) break;
            var ok = b is >= (byte)'a' and <= (byte)'z'
                     || b is >= (byte)'A' and <= (byte)'Z'
                     || b is >= (byte)'0' and <= (byte)'9'
                     || b == (byte)'.' || b == (byte)'_' || b == (byte)'-';
            if (!ok) return false;
            len++;
        }
        return len >= 3;
    }

    private static string ReadCString(byte[] buf, int offset, int max)
    {
        var end = Array.IndexOf(buf, (byte)0, offset, Math.Min(max, buf.Length - offset));
        if (end < 0) end = Math.Min(offset + max, buf.Length);
        return Encoding.UTF8.GetString(buf, offset, end - offset);
    }

    // ---------------- 写回 ----------------

    private byte[] BuildRecord(string pkg, int uid, bool allowed, List<Entry> existing)
    {
        var layout = _layout!;
        var raw = new byte[layout.RecordLen];
        var p = layout.PackageOffset;

        // 新版记录前 4 字节含义未知（所有记录都相同，疑似 profile 版本）：优先照抄同表记录，其次抄表头末尾
        if (p > 0)
        {
            if (existing.Count > 0) Array.Copy(existing[0].Raw, 0, raw, 0, p);
            else if (layout.Header.Length >= p) Array.Copy(layout.Header, layout.Header.Length - p, raw, 0, p);
        }

        var key = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(pkg);
        Array.Copy(key, 0, raw, p, Math.Min(key.Length, PackageLen - 1));
        BitConverter.GetBytes(uid).CopyTo(raw, p + UidOffset);
        BitConverter.GetBytes(allowed ? 1 : 0).CopyTo(raw, p + AllowOffset);
        BitConverter.GetBytes(1).CopyTo(raw, p + ProfileFieldOffset);   // 与现存记录一致

        var ctx = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("u:r:ksu:s0");
        Array.Copy(ctx, 0, raw, p + SeContextOffset, ctx.Length);
        BitConverter.GetBytes(1L).CopyTo(raw, p + FlagsOffset);        // flags
        return raw;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 按布局把记录拼成整表字节。抽成纯函数的原因：
    /// 布局识别的风险全在"重排之后还能不能被设备解析"，这条只能在字节层面验证。
    /// </summary>
    internal static byte[]? ComposeTable(Layout layout, IReadOnlyList<Entry> entries)
    {
        if (layout.Header.Length != layout.HeaderLen) return null;   // 头部长度自相矛盾

        var buf = new byte[layout.HeaderLen + entries.Count * layout.RecordLen];
        layout.Header.CopyTo(buf, 0);

        var off = layout.HeaderLen;
        foreach (var e in entries)
        {
            if (e.Raw.Length != layout.RecordLen) return null;
            Array.Copy(e.Raw, 0, buf, off, layout.RecordLen);
            off += layout.RecordLen;
        }
        return buf;
    }

    private async Task<(bool Ok, string Message)> WriteAsync(List<Entry> entries, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var layout = _layout;
        if (layout == null) return (false, "读取表头失败");

        var buf = ComposeTable(layout, entries);
        if (buf == null) return (false, "内部记录长度不一致，已中止写入");
        var total = buf.Length;

        // 备份存到电脑（设备上不留任何文件）
        var backupDir = AppPaths.Su;
        Directory.CreateDirectory(backupDir);
        try
        {
            var old = await _fs.ReadBytesAsync(AllowlistPath, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            await File.WriteAllBytesAsync(
                Path.Combine(backupDir, "allowlist-" + DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyyMMdd_HHmmss_fff") + ".bak"),
                old, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
        catch { }

        if (!await _fs.WriteBytesAsync(AllowlistPath, buf, ct).ConfigureAwait(false))
            return (false, "写入失败（请检查 root 授权）");

        // 回读校验：只比长度等于没校验（改既有记录时长度必然不变），必须逐字节比对
        var check = await _fs.ReadBytesAsync(AllowlistPath, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        if (check.Length != total || !check.SequenceEqual(buf))
            return (false, $"写入后内容与预期不一致（{check.Length}/{total} 字节），原表已备份到电脑");

        return (true, "已写入，重启后生效");
    }
}
```

`src/Services/SvgPathParser.cs`:

```cs
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;
using SkiaSharp;

namespace DashFile.Services;

/// <summary>SVG pathData（VectorDrawable 用的就是这套语法）→ SKPath</summary>
public static class SvgPathParser
{
    public static SKPath? Parse(string data)
    {
        SKPath? path = null;
        try
        {
            path = new SKPath();
            var t = new Tok(data);
            var guard = 0;
            float cx = 0, cy = 0;          // 当前点
            float sx = 0, sy = 0;          // 子路径起点
            char cmd = 'M';
            float lastCtrlX = 0, lastCtrlY = 0;

            while (true)
            {
                // 兜底：畸形 pathData（如 "M0 0z5"）里 Z 分支不消费任何字符，
                //   以前会在 while(true) 里空转把 UI 线程 100% 打死，且 CancellationToken 无效。
                if (++guard > 200_000) break;

                t.SkipSep();
                if (t.Eof) break;

                var posBefore = t.Pos;
                var ch = t.Peek();
                if (char.IsLetter(ch)) { cmd = ch; t.Next(); }
                else if (cmd == 'M') cmd = 'L';     // 隐式重复：M 之后按 L
                else if (cmd == 'm') cmd = 'l';

                switch (cmd)
                {
                    case 'M': cx = t.Num(); cy = t.Num(); path.MoveTo(cx, cy); sx = cx; sy = cy; break;
                    case 'm': cx += t.Num(); cy += t.Num(); path.MoveTo(cx, cy); sx = cx; sy = cy; break;
                    case 'L': cx = t.Num(); cy = t.Num(); path.LineTo(cx, cy); break;
                    case 'l': cx += t.Num(); cy += t.Num(); path.LineTo(cx, cy); break;
                    case 'H': cx = t.Num(); path.LineTo(cx, cy); break;
                    case 'h': cx += t.Num(); path.LineTo(cx, cy); break;
                    case 'V': cy = t.Num(); path.LineTo(cx, cy); break;
                    case 'v': cy += t.Num(); path.LineTo(cx, cy); break;
                    case 'C':
                        {
                            var x1 = t.Num(); var y1 = t.Num(); var x2 = t.Num(); var y2 = t.Num(); var x = t.Num(); var y = t.Num();
                            path.CubicTo(x1, y1, x2, y2, x, y); lastCtrlX = x2; lastCtrlY = y2; cx = x; cy = y;
                            break;
                        }
                    case 'c':
                        {
                            var x1 = cx + t.Num(); var y1 = cy + t.Num(); var x2 = cx + t.Num(); var y2 = cy + t.Num();
                            var x = cx + t.Num(); var y = cy + t.Num();
                            path.CubicTo(x1, y1, x2, y2, x, y); lastCtrlX = x2; lastCtrlY = y2; cx = x; cy = y;
                            break;
                        }
                    case 'S':
                        {
                            var x1 = 2 * cx - lastCtrlX; var y1 = 2 * cy - lastCtrlY;
                            var x2 = t.Num(); var y2 = t.Num(); var x = t.Num(); var y = t.Num();
                            path.CubicTo(x1, y1, x2, y2, x, y); lastCtrlX = x2; lastCtrlY = y2; cx = x; cy = y;
                            break;
                        }
                    case 's':
                        {
                            var x1 = 2 * cx - lastCtrlX; var y1 = 2 * cy - lastCtrlY;
                            var x2 = cx + t.Num(); var y2 = cy + t.Num(); var x = cx + t.Num(); var y = cy + t.Num();
                            path.CubicTo(x1, y1, x2, y2, x, y); lastCtrlX = x2; lastCtrlY = y2; cx = x; cy = y;
                            break;
                        }
                    case 'Q':
                        {
                            var x1 = t.Num(); var y1 = t.Num(); var x = t.Num(); var y = t.Num();
                            path.QuadTo(x1, y1, x, y); cx = x; cy = y;
                            break;
                        }
                    case 'q':
                        {
                            var x1 = cx + t.Num(); var y1 = cy + t.Num(); var x = cx + t.Num(); var y = cy + t.Num();
                            path.QuadTo(x1, y1, x, y); cx = x; cy = y;
                            break;
                        }
                    case 'T':
                        {
                            var x1 = 2 * cx - lastCtrlX; var y1 = 2 * cy - lastCtrlY;
                            var x = t.Num(); var y = t.Num();
                            path.QuadTo(x1, y1, x, y); lastCtrlX = x1; lastCtrlY = y1; cx = x; cy = y; break;
                        }
                    case 't':
                        {
                            var x1 = 2 * cx - lastCtrlX; var y1 = 2 * cy - lastCtrlY;
                            var x = cx + t.Num(); var y = cy + t.Num();
                            path.QuadTo(x1, y1, x, y); lastCtrlX = x1; lastCtrlY = y1; cx = x; cy = y; break;
                        }
                    case 'A': case 'a':
                        {
                            var rx = t.Num(); var ry = t.Num(); var rot = t.Num();
                            var large = t.Flag(); var sweep = t.Flag();
                            var ex = t.Num(); var ey = t.Num();
                            if (cmd == 'a') { ex += cx; ey += cy; }
                            AddArc(path, cx, cy, rx, ry, rot, large, sweep, ex, ey);
                            cx = ex; cy = ey;
                            break;
                        }
                    case 'Z': case 'z':
                        path.Close();
                        cx = sx; cy = sy;
                        break;
                    default:
                        t.Next();       // 未知命令，跳过
                        break;
                }

                if (t.Eof) break;
                if (t.Pos == posBefore) t.Next();   // 本趟没前进一个字符：强制吃掉一个，绝不允许死循环
            }

            return path;
        }
        catch
        {
            path?.Dispose();
            return null;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>SVG 圆弧 → 中心参数化 → 三次贝塞尔</summary>
    private static void AddArc(SKPath path, float x0, float y0, float rx, float ry,
        float rotationDeg, bool largeArc, bool sweep, float x, float y)
    {
        if (rx == 0 || ry == 0) { path.LineTo(x, y); return; }
        rx = Math.Abs(rx); ry = Math.Abs(ry);

        var phi = rotationDeg * Math.PI / 180.0;
        var cosPhi = Math.Cos(phi); var sinPhi = Math.Sin(phi);

        var dx = (x0 - x) / 2.0; var dy = (y0 - y) / 2.0;
        var x1p = cosPhi * dx + sinPhi * dy;
        var y1p = -sinPhi * dx + cosPhi * dy;

        var lambda = (x1p * x1p) / (rx * rx) + (y1p * y1p) / (ry * ry);
        if (lambda > 1) { var s = Math.Sqrt(lambda); rx = (float)(rx * s); ry = (float)(ry * s); }

        var sign = largeArc != sweep ? 1.0 : -1.0;
        var num = (double)rx * rx * ry * ry - (double)rx * rx * y1p * y1p - (double)ry * ry * x1p * x1p;
        var den = (double)rx * rx * y1p * y1p + (double)ry * ry * x1p * x1p;
        var coef = den == 0 ? 0 : sign * Math.Sqrt(Math.Max(0, num / den));

        var cxp = coef * rx * y1p / ry;
        var cyp = -coef * ry * x1p / rx;

        var cx = cosPhi * cxp - sinPhi * cyp + (x0 + x) / 2.0;
        var cy = sinPhi * cxp + cosPhi * cyp + (y0 + y) / 2.0;

        double Angle(double ux, double uy, double vx, double vy)
        {
            var dot = ux * vx + uy * vy;
            var len = Math.Sqrt((ux * ux + uy * uy) * (vx * vx + vy * vy));
            if (len == 0) return 0;
            var a = Math.Acos(Math.Clamp(dot / len, -1, 1));
            return ux * vy - uy * vx < 0 ? -a : a;
        }

        var theta1 = Angle(1, 0, (x1p - cxp) / rx, (y1p - cyp) / ry);
        var dTheta = Angle((x1p - cxp) / rx, (y1p - cyp) / ry, (-x1p - cxp) / rx, (-y1p - cyp) / ry);
        if (!sweep && dTheta > 0) dTheta -= 2 * Math.PI;
        if (sweep && dTheta < 0) dTheta += 2 * Math.PI;

        var segments = (int)Math.Ceiling(Math.Abs(dTheta) / (Math.PI / 2));
        if (segments <= 0) segments = 1;
        var delta = dTheta / segments;
        var k = 4.0 / 3.0 * Math.Tan(delta / 4);

        var t1 = theta1;
        double Ex(double th) => cx + rx * Math.Cos(th) * cosPhi - ry * Math.Sin(th) * sinPhi;
        double Ey(double th) => cy + rx * Math.Cos(th) * sinPhi + ry * Math.Sin(th) * cosPhi;
        double Dx(double th) => -rx * Math.Sin(th) * cosPhi - ry * Math.Cos(th) * sinPhi;
        double Dy(double th) => -rx * Math.Sin(th) * sinPhi + ry * Math.Cos(th) * cosPhi;

        for (var i = 0; i < segments; i++)
        {
            var t2 = t1 + delta;
            var x1 = Ex(t1) + k * Dx(t1);
            var y1 = Ey(t1) + k * Dy(t1);
            var x2 = Ex(t2) - k * Dx(t2);
            var y2 = Ey(t2) - k * Dy(t2);
            var x3 = Ex(t2);
            var y3 = Ey(t2);
            path.CubicTo((float)x1, (float)y1, (float)x2, (float)y2, (float)x3, (float)y3);
            t1 = t2;
        }
    }

    private sealed class Tok
    {
        private readonly string _s;
        private int _i;
        public Tok(string s) => _s = s;
        public bool Eof => _i >= _s.Length;
        public int Pos => _i;

        public char Peek() => _s[_i];
        public void Next() => _i++;
        public void SkipSep()
        {
            while (_i < _s.Length && (char.IsWhiteSpace(_s[_i]) || _s[_i] == ',')) _i++;
        }

        public bool Flag()
        {
            SkipSep();
            if (_i >= _s.Length) return false;
            var c = _s[_i];
            if (c == '0' || c == '1') { _i++; return c == '1'; }
            return Num() != 0;
        }

        public float Num()
        {
            SkipSep();
            var start = _i;
            if (_i < _s.Length && (_s[_i] == '-' || _s[_i] == '+')) _i++;
            while (_i < _s.Length && (char.IsDigit(_s[_i]) || _s[_i] == '.')) _i++;
            if (_i < _s.Length && (_s[_i] == 'e' || _s[_i] == 'E'))
            {
                _i++;
                if (_i < _s.Length && (_s[_i] == '-' || _s[_i] == '+')) _i++;
                while (_i < _s.Length && char.IsDigit(_s[_i])) _i++;
            }
            if (start == _i) return 0;
            return float.Parse(_s.AsSpan(start, _i - start), NumberStyles.Float, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        }
    }
}
```

```cs
using System;
using Avalonia;
using Avalonia.Media;

namespace DashFile.Services;

/// <summary>
/// 主题 + 风格。
/// m3   = Material You：表面由主题色轻微染色，12px 圆角，紧凑行高。
/// miui = HyperOS/MIUIx：中性灰面（不染色）、靠亮度分层、几乎无描边、20px 大圆角、行高更松。
/// </summary>
public static class ThemeService
{
    public static string Style { get; private set; } = "m3";

    public static void ApplyStyle(string style, string hex)
    {
        // 只有 标准(m3) / MIUI 两种；玻璃风格已整体移除（历史配置里的 glass 会归位到 m3）
        Style = string.Equals(style?.Trim(), "miui", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ? "miui" : "m3";
        Apply(hex);
    }

    public static void Apply(string hex)
    {
        var app = Application.Current;
        if (app == null) return;
        if (!Color.TryParse(hex, out var c)) return;

        // ---- 强调色（两种风格共用）----
        Set(app, "Accent",      c);
        Set(app, "AccentSoft",  Blend(c, Colors.White, 0.38));

        Set(app, "AccentHover", Blend(c, Color.Parse("#211D2D"), 0.52));
        Set(app, "AccentDeep",  Blend(c, Color.Parse("#15121D"), 0.42));
        Set(app, "AccentFill",  Color.FromArgb(48, c.R, c.G, c.B));
        Set(app, "StrokeStrong", Blend(c, Color.Parse("#3B3450"), 0.55));

            app.Resources["RadiusCard"] = new CornerRadius(Style == "miui" ? 20 : 12);
            app.Resources["RadiusCtl"]  = new CornerRadius(Style == "miui" ? 12 : 6);
            app.Resources["RadiusPill"] = new CornerRadius(Style == "miui" ? 999 : 11);
            app.Resources["RowH"]       = Style == "miui" ? 38d : 34d;
            app.Resources["TreeRowH"]   = Style == "miui" ? 30d : 26d;

            // X / Grok 那种"白按钮 + 黑字"
            Set(app, "BtnPriBg",    Color.Parse("#F2F2F3"));
            Set(app, "BtnPriFg",    Color.Parse("#0A0A0B"));
            Set(app, "BtnPriHover", Color.Parse("#FFFFFF"));

            SetGhost(app, "SelGhost", "SelBg");
            SetSystemAccent(app, Color.Parse("#E9E9EA"));
            return;
        }

        Set(app, "KnobFill", Color.Parse("#FFFFFF"));

        if (Style == "miui")
        {
            // ===== HyperOS 风：中性面 + 大圆角 + 几乎无边框 =====
            Set(app, "Bg",         Color.Parse("#0A0A0C"));
            Set(app, "Panel",      Color.Parse("#121216"));
            Set(app, "PanelAlt",   Color.Parse("#202027"));   // 卡片明显比底色亮，靠亮度分层
            Set(app, "Stroke",     Color.Parse("#3A3A43"));
            Set(app, "StrokeSoft", Color.Parse("#2A2A32"));   // 内部分隔线很淡

            Set(app, "Hover",      Color.Parse("#2C2C34"));
            Set(app, "Pressed",    Color.Parse("#37373F"));
            Set(app, "SelBg",      Blend(c, Color.Parse("#34343E"), 0.74));
            Set(app, "CardSel",    Blend(c, Color.Parse("#42424C"), 0.58));
            Set(app, "ChipBg",     Color.Parse("#26262C"));
            Set(app, "ChipBorder", Color.Parse("#3A3A43"));
            Set(app, "TrackBg",    Color.Parse("#33333B"));
            Set(app, "ChartBg",    Color.Parse("#141418"));

            app.Resources["RadiusCard"] = new CornerRadius(20);
            app.Resources["RadiusCtl"]  = new CornerRadius(12);
            app.Resources["RadiusPill"] = new CornerRadius(999);
            app.Resources["RowH"]       = 38d;
            app.Resources["TreeRowH"]   = 30d;
        }
        else
        {
            // ===== Material You 风：表面由主题色轻染 =====
            Set(app, "Bg",         Blend(c, Color.Parse("#0C0B10"), 0.93));
            Set(app, "Panel",      Blend(c, Color.Parse("#121017"), 0.91));
            Set(app, "PanelAlt",   Blend(c, Color.Parse("#181520"), 0.885));
            Set(app, "Stroke",     Blend(c, Color.Parse("#2A2535"), 0.74));
            Set(app, "StrokeSoft", Blend(c, Color.Parse("#201C28"), 0.80));
            Set(app, "TrackBg",    Blend(c, Color.Parse("#241F2E"), 0.74));
            Set(app, "ChartBg",    Blend(c, Color.Parse("#131016"), 0.89));

            Set(app, "Hover",      Blend(c, Color.Parse("#221F2C"), 0.74));
            Set(app, "Pressed",    Blend(c, Color.Parse("#2A2638"), 0.58));
            Set(app, "SelBg",      Blend(c, Color.Parse("#2E2B3E"), 0.40));
            Set(app, "CardSel",    Blend(c, Color.Parse("#3D3460"), 0.36));
            Set(app, "ChipBg",     Blend(c, Color.Parse("#262135"), 0.70));
            Set(app, "ChipBorder", Blend(c, Color.Parse("#3D3654"), 0.56));

            app.Resources["RadiusCard"] = new CornerRadius(12);
            app.Resources["RadiusCtl"]  = new CornerRadius(6);
            app.Resources["RadiusPill"] = new CornerRadius(11);
            app.Resources["RowH"]       = 34d;
            app.Resources["TreeRowH"]   = 26d;
        }

        Set(app, "BtnPriBg",    Blend(c, Color.Parse("#1E1A29"), 0.66));
        Set(app, "BtnPriFg",    Blend(c, Colors.White, 0.58));
        Set(app, "BtnPriHover", Blend(c, Color.Parse("#211D2D"), 0.52));
        SetGhost(app, "SelGhost", "SelBg");
        SetSystemAccent(app, c);
    }

    /// <summary>让 Fluent 自带的控件（下拉、焦点框、选中）也用主题色，避免残留系统蓝</summary>
    private static void SetSystemAccent(Application app, Color c)
    {
        try
        {
            app.Resources["SystemAccentColor"] = c;
            app.Resources["SystemAccentColorLight1"] = Blend(c, Colors.White, 0.2);
            app.Resources["SystemAccentColorLight2"] = Blend(c, Colors.White, 0.35);
            app.Resources["SystemAccentColorLight3"] = Blend(c, Colors.White, 0.5);
            app.Resources["SystemAccentColorDark1"] = Blend(c, Colors.Black, 0.2);
            app.Resources["SystemAccentColorDark2"] = Blend(c, Colors.Black, 0.35);
            app.Resources["SystemAccentColorDark3"] = Blend(c, Colors.Black, 0.5);
        }
        catch { }
    }

    private static void Set(Application app, string key, Color c)
        => app.Resources[key] = new SolidColorBrush(c);

    /// <summary>
    /// 把某个 SolidColorBrush 复制成 alpha=0 的同色“幽灵”。
    /// 用途：选中底色的默认值。直接写 Transparent(#00FFFFFF) 时，
    /// BrushTransition 会从白色插值到紫色，中途闪白；同色幽灵才不会。
    /// </summary>
    private static void SetGhost(Application app, string ghostKey, string sourceKey)
    {
        if (app.Resources[sourceKey] is ISolidColorBrush b)
            app.Resources[ghostKey] = new SolidColorBrush(Color.FromArgb(0, b.Color.R, b.Color.G, b.Color.B));
    }

    private static Color Blend(Color a, Color b, double t)
    {
        t = Math.Clamp(t, 0, 1);
        return Color.FromRgb(
            (byte)(a.R + (b.R - a.R) * t),
            (byte)(a.G + (b.G - a.G) * t),
            (byte)(a.B + (b.B - a.B) * t));
    }
}
```
