```cs
            _owner = owner;
            Title = title;
        }

        public string Title { get; }

        public void Report(string value)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value)) return;
            RunOnUi(() => _owner._vm.StatusText = value);
            _owner._vm.AppendLog($"[{_owner.Metadata.Name}] {value}");
        }

        public void Complete(string? message = null)
        {
            if (_completed) return;
            _completed = true;
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(message)) Toast(message);
        }

        public void Dispose() => _completed = true;

        private void Toast(string message) => RunOnUi(() => _owner._vm.Toast(message));
    }

    // ================= 设备 =================

    private sealed class PluginDeviceApi : IPluginDevice
    {
        private readonly PluginHostBridge _owner;
        public PluginDeviceApi(PluginHostBridge owner) => _owner = owner;

        private RemoteFileSystem? Fs => _owner._vm.FileSystem;

        public bool IsConnected => Fs != null;
        public bool IsRoot => _owner._vm.IsRoot;
        public string Serial => Fs?.Serial ?? "";
        public string RootManagerName => _owner._vm.RootImpl;
        public string Model => _owner._vm.DevModel;
        public string AndroidVersion => _owner._vm.DevAndroid;

        public async Task<PluginShellResult> ShellAsync(string command, bool root = true,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            var fs = Fs;
            if (fs == null) return new PluginShellResult(-1, "", "未连接设备");
            var r = await fs.ExecuteAsync(command ?? "", root, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
            return new PluginShellResult(r.ExitCode, r.StdOut, r.StdErr);
        }

        public async Task<PluginShellResult> ExecAsync(string executable, IReadOnlyList<string> arguments,
            bool root = true, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            var fs = Fs;
            if (fs == null) return new PluginShellResult(-1, "", "未连接设备");
            var r = await fs.RunArgvAsync(executable, arguments ?? Array.Empty<string>(), root, cancellationToken)
                            .ConfigureAwait(false);
            return new PluginShellResult(r.ExitCode, r.StdOut, r.StdErr);
        }

        public async Task<byte[]> ExecCaptureAsync(string command, bool root = true,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            var fs = Fs;
            if (fs == null) return Array.Empty<byte>();
            return await fs.ExecCaptureAsync(command ?? "", root, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }

        public async Task<byte[]> ReadBytesAsync(string remotePath, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            var fs = Fs;
            if (fs == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("未连接设备");
            return await fs.ReadBytesAsync(remotePath, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }

        public async Task<bool> WriteBytesAsync(string remotePath, byte[] data,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            var fs = Fs;
            if (fs == null) return false;
            return await fs.WriteBytesAsync(remotePath, data ?? Array.Empty<byte>(), cancellationToken)
                           .ConfigureAwait(false);
        }

        public async Task<string> ReadTextAsync(string remotePath, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            var fs = Fs;
            if (fs == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("未连接设备");
            return await fs.ReadTextAsync(remotePath, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }

        public async Task WriteTextAsync(string remotePath, string text,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            var fs = Fs;
            if (fs == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("未连接设备");
            await fs.WriteTextAsync(remotePath, text ?? "", cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }

        public async Task<bool> ExistsAsync(string remotePath, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            var fs = Fs;
            if (fs == null) return false;
            return await fs.ExistsAsync(remotePath, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }

        public async Task DownloadAsync(string remotePath, string localPath,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            var fs = Fs;
            if (fs == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("未连接设备");
            await fs.DownloadAsync(remotePath, localPath, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }

        public async Task UploadAsync(string localPath, string remoteDirectory,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            var fs = Fs;
            if (fs == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("未连接设备");
            await fs.UploadAsync(localPath, remoteDirectory, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }

        public async Task<string> PushTempFileAsync(string localPath,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            var fs = Fs;
            if (fs == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("未连接设备");
            return await fs.PushTempFileAsync(localPath, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }

        public async Task<string> CreateTempDirectoryAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            var fs = Fs;
            if (fs == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("未连接设备");
            var remote = DevicePaths.TempDirectory("plugin");
            await fs.RunCommandAsync($"mkdir -p {PluginShell.Quote(remote)} && chmod 777 {PluginShell.Quote(remote)}",
                true, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
            return remote;
        }

        public async Task DeleteRemoteAsync(string remotePath, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            var fs = Fs;
            if (fs == null) return;
            await fs.RunCommandAsync("rm -rf " + PluginShell.Quote(remotePath ?? ""), true, cancellationToken)
                    .ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
    }

    private sealed class PluginFilesApi : IPluginFiles
    {
        private readonly PluginHostBridge _owner;
        public PluginFilesApi(PluginHostBridge owner) => _owner = owner;

        private RemoteFileSystem? Fs => _owner._vm.FileSystem;

        public string CurrentDirectory => _owner._vm.CurrentPath;

        public PluginTarget? SelectedTarget => _owner._vm.PluginSelection.FirstOrDefault();

        public IReadOnlyList<PluginTarget> SelectedTargets => _owner._vm.PluginSelection;

        public async Task<IReadOnlyList<PluginFileEntry>> ListAsync(string remotePath,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            var fs = Fs;
            if (fs == null) return Array.Empty<PluginFileEntry>();
            var list = await fs.ListAsync(remotePath, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
            return list.Select(e => new PluginFileEntry(
                e.Name, e.FullPath, e.IsDir, e.Size, e.Modified, e.Perms, e.Owner, e.Selinux, e.LinkTarget)).ToList();
        }

        public async Task<bool> ExistsAsync(string remotePath, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            var fs = Fs;
            return fs != null && await fs.ExistsAsync(remotePath, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }

        public async Task CreateDirectoryAsync(string remotePath, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            var fs = Fs ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("未连接设备");
            await fs.MkdirAsync(remotePath, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }

        public async Task DeleteAsync(string remotePath, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            var fs = Fs ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("未连接设备");
            await fs.DeleteAsync(new[] { remotePath }, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }

        public async Task RenameAsync(string remotePath, string newName,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            var fs = Fs ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("未连接设备");
            await fs.RenameAsync(remotePath, newName, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }

        public async Task<byte[]> ReadAllBytesAsync(string remotePath,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            var fs = Fs ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("未连接设备");
            return await fs.ReadBytesAsync(remotePath, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }

        public async Task WriteAllBytesAsync(string remotePath, byte[] data,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            var fs = Fs ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("未连接设备");
            if (!await fs.WriteBytesAsync(remotePath, data ?? Array.Empty<byte>(), cancellationToken)
                         .ConfigureAwait(false))
                throw new IOException("写入失败（请检查 root 授权）");
        }

        public async Task<string> ReadAllTextAsync(string remotePath,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            var fs = Fs ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("未连接设备");
            return await fs.ReadTextAsync(remotePath, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }

        public async Task WriteAllTextAsync(string remotePath, string text,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            var fs = Fs ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("未连接设备");
            await fs.WriteTextAsync(remotePath, text ?? "", cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }

        public async Task DownloadAsync(string remotePath, string localPath,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            var fs = Fs ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("未连接设备");
            await fs.DownloadAsync(remotePath, localPath, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);

            await fs.UploadAsync(localPath, remoteDirectory, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }

            await fs.ChmodAsync(remotePath, octal, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);

    // ================= 应用 =================

    private sealed class PluginAppsApi : IPluginApps
    {
        private readonly PluginHostBridge _owner;
        public PluginAppsApi(PluginHostBridge owner) => _owner = owner;

        private RemoteFileSystem? Fs => _owner._vm.FileSystem;

        public async Task<IReadOnlyList<PluginApp>> ListAsync(bool systemApps,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            var fs = Fs;
            if (fs == null) return Array.Empty<PluginApp>();
            var list = await new AppService(fs).ListAsync(systemApps, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
            return list.Select(a => new PluginApp(a.Package, string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(a.Label) ? a.Package : a.Label,
                a.IsSystem, a.ApkPath, 0, false)).ToList();
        }

        public async Task<PluginApp?> GetAsync(string package, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            var fs = Fs;
            if (fs == null || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(package)) return null;

            var raw = await fs.RunCommandAsync("pm list packages -f " + PluginShell.Quote(package), false,
                cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
            var apk = "";
            var found = false;
            foreach (var line in raw.Split('\n'))
            {
                var t = line.Trim();
                if (!t.StartsWith("package:", StringComparison.Ordinal)) continue;
                var body = t[8..];
                var eq = body.LastIndexOf('=');
                if (eq <= 0) continue;
                if (!string.Equals(body[(eq + 1)..].Trim(), package, StringComparison.Ordinal)) continue;
                apk = body[..eq].Trim();
                found = true;
                break;
            }
            if (!found) return null;

            var service = new AppService(fs);
            var label = await service.GetLabelAsync(package, apk, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
            var uidRaw = await fs.RunCommandAsync(
                "stat -c %u " + PluginShell.Quote(DevicePaths.UserData(package)) + " 2>/dev/null", true,
                cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
            var uid = 0;
            foreach (var line in uidRaw.Split('\n'))
            {
                var t = line.Trim();
                if (int.TryParse(t, out var parsed)) { uid = parsed; break; }
            }

            var isSystem = false;
            try
            {
                var sys = await fs.RunCommandAsync("pm list packages -s " + PluginShell.Quote(package), false,
                    cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
                isSystem = sys.Contains(package, StringComparison.Ordinal);
            }
            catch { }

            var granted = false;
            try
            {
                var root = _owner._vm.RootProvider;
                if (root != null)
                {
                    var grants = await root.ReadGrantsAsync(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
                    granted = grants.Any(g => string.Equals(g.Package, package, StringComparison.Ordinal) && g.Allowed);
                }
            }
            catch { }

            return new PluginApp(package, string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(label) ? package : label,
                isSystem, apk, uid, granted);
        }

        public async Task<bool> SetRootGrantAsync(string package, bool allowed,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(package)) return false;
            return await OnUiAsync(async () =>
            {
                var item = new AppItem { Package = package, Label = package };
                await _owner._vm.ToggleRootAsync(item, allowed).ConfigureAwait(true);
                return item.IsGranted == allowed;
            }).ConfigureAwait(true);
        }

        public Task<bool> InstallApkAsync(string localApkPath, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
            => _owner._vm.InstallApkAsync(localApkPath, cancellationToken);   // 插件取消 = 真的中止 adb install

        public async Task<bool> UninstallAsync(string package, bool keepData = false,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            var app = await GetAsync(package, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
            if (app == null) return false;
            return await OnUiAsync(async () =>
            {
                var item = new AppItem
                {
                    Package = app.Package,
                    Label = app.Label,
                    IsSystem = app.IsSystem,
                    ApkPath = app.ApkPath,
                };
                return await _owner._vm.UninstallAppAsync(item).ConfigureAwait(true);
            }).ConfigureAwait(true);
        }

        public async Task<bool> ExtractApkAsync(string package, string localApkPath,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            var app = await GetAsync(package, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
            if (app == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(app.ApkPath)) return false;
            return await OnUiAsync(async () =>
            {
                var item = new AppItem
                {
                    Package = app.Package,
                    Label = app.Label,
                    IsSystem = app.IsSystem,
                    ApkPath = app.ApkPath,
                };
                return await _owner._vm.ExtractApkToPcAsync(item, localApkPath).ConfigureAwait(true);
            }).ConfigureAwait(true);
        }
    }

    private sealed class PluginModulesApi : IPluginModules
    {
        private readonly PluginHostBridge _owner;
        public PluginModulesApi(PluginHostBridge owner) => _owner = owner;

        public async Task<IReadOnlyList<PluginModule>> ListAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            return await OnUiAsync(async () =>
            {
                await _owner._vm.LoadModulesAsync().ConfigureAwait(true);
                return (IReadOnlyList<PluginModule>)_owner._vm.Modules.Select(m => new PluginModule(
                    m.Id, m.Name, m.Version, m.Author, m.Description, m.Dir,
                    m.Enabled, m.HasWebUI, m.HasAction)).ToList();
            }).ConfigureAwait(true);
        }

        public async Task<bool> InstallAsync(string localZipPath, Action<string>? log = null,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            return await OnUiAsync(async () =>
                await _owner._vm.InstallModuleZipAsync(localZipPath, s => log?.Invoke(s)).ConfigureAwait(true))
                .ConfigureAwait(true);
        }

        public async Task<bool> SetEnabledAsync(string moduleId, bool enabled,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            return await OnUiAsync(async () =>
            {
                var module = _owner._vm.Modules.FirstOrDefault(m =>
                    string.Equals(m.Id, moduleId, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
                if (module == null) return false;
                return await _owner._vm.SetModuleEnabledAsync(module, enabled).ConfigureAwait(true);
            }).ConfigureAwait(true);
        }

        public async Task<bool> UninstallAsync(string moduleId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            return await OnUiAsync(async () =>
            {
                var module = _owner._vm.Modules.FirstOrDefault(m =>
                    string.Equals(m.Id, moduleId, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
                if (module == null) return false;
                // 以前无条件 return true：VM 把异常咽进 StatusText，插件永远以为卸载成功。
                return await _owner._vm.UninstallModuleAsync(module).ConfigureAwait(true);
            }).ConfigureAwait(true);
        }

        public async Task<string> RunActionAsync(string moduleId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            return await OnUiAsync(async () =>
            {
                var module = _owner._vm.Modules.FirstOrDefault(m =>
                    string.Equals(m.Id, moduleId, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
                return module == null ? "模块不存在" : await _owner._vm.RunModuleActionAsync(module).ConfigureAwait(true);
            }).ConfigureAwait(true);
        }
    }

    // ================= 设置 / 日志 / 事件 =================

    private sealed class PluginSettingsStore : IPluginSettings
    {
        private readonly string _path;
        private readonly object _lock = new();
        private Dictionary<string, JsonElement> _map = new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        private bool _loaded;

        public PluginSettingsStore(string path)
        {
            _path = path;
            Load();
        }

        private void Load()
        {
            if (_loaded) return;
            _loaded = true;
            try
            {
                if (!File.Exists(_path)) return;
                var json = File.ReadAllText(_path);
                var map = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<Dictionary<string, JsonElement>>(json);
                if (map != null) _map = new Dictionary<string, JsonElement>(map, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
            }
            catch { }
        }

        public T? Get<T>(string key, T? defaultValue = default)
        {
            lock (_lock)
            {
                Load();
                if (!_map.TryGetValue(key, out var element)) return defaultValue;
                try { return element.Deserialize<T>(); }
                catch { return defaultValue; }
            }
        }

        public void Set<T>(string key, T value)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(key)) return;
            lock (_lock)
            {
                Load();
                _map[key] = JsonSerializer.SerializeToElement(value);
            }
            Save();
        }

        public bool Remove(string key)
        {
            lock (_lock)
            {
                Load();
                var removed = _map.Remove(key);
                if (removed) Save();
                return removed;
            }
        }

        public void Save()
        {
            lock (_lock)
            {
                try
                {
                    Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(_path)!);
                    // 原子写：插件设置写到一半崩溃/断电，不能留下半截 JSON
                    AtomicFile.WriteAllText(_path, JsonSerializer.Serialize(_map,
                        new JsonSerializerOptions { WriteIndented = true }));
                }
                catch { }
            }
        }
    }

    private sealed class PluginLogApi : IPluginLog
    {
        private readonly PluginHostBridge _owner;
        private readonly object _lock = new();

        public PluginLogApi(PluginHostBridge owner) => _owner = owner;

        public void Info(string message) => Write("INFO", message, null);

        public void Warn(string message) => Write("WARN", message, null);

        public void Error(string message, Exception? exception = null) => Write("ERROR", message, exception);

        public void Debug(string message)
        {
            if (!AppEnvironment.PluginDebug) return;
            Write("DEBUG", message, null);
        }

        private void Write(string level, string message, Exception? exception)
        {
            var line = $"[{DateTime.Now:HH:mm:ss}] [{level}] {message}";
            if (exception != null) line += Environment.NewLine + exception;

            lock (_lock)
            {
                try
                {
                    var dir = AppPaths.Ensure(AppPaths.PluginLogs);
                    var safe = _owner.Metadata.Id;
                    foreach (var c in Path.GetInvalidFileNameChars()) safe = safe.Replace(c, '_');
                    File.AppendAllText(Path.Combine(dir, safe + ".log"), line + Environment.NewLine);
                }
                catch { }
            }

            _owner._vm.AppendLog($"[{_owner.Metadata.Name}] {message}");
        }
    }

    private sealed class PluginEvents : IPluginEvents
    {
        public event EventHandler<DeviceSnapshot>? DeviceChanged;
        public event EventHandler<PluginTarget?>? FileSelectionChanged;

        public void RaiseDeviceChanged(DeviceSnapshot snapshot)
            => DeviceChanged?.Invoke(this, snapshot);

        public void RaiseFileSelection(PluginTarget? target)
            => FileSelectionChanged?.Invoke(this, target);
    }
}
```

```cs
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Avalonia.Controls;
using Avalonia.Interactivity;
using Avalonia.Markup.Xaml;

namespace DashFile.Views;

public partial class AppDetailDialog : Window
{
    public AppDetailDialog()
    {
        AvaloniaXamlLoader.Load(this);
        DashFile.Controls.ViewAnimator.AttachWindow(this);
    }

    public static async Task ShowAsync(Window owner, string title, string subtitle,
        List<(string Label, string Value)> rows)
    {
        var dlg = new AppDetailDialog { Title = title };
        dlg.FindControl<TextBlock>("TitleText")!.Text = title;
        dlg.FindControl<TextBlock>("SubText")!.Text = subtitle;

        var host = dlg.FindControl<ItemsControl>("RowsHost")!;
        var items = new List<KeyValuePair<string, string>>();
        foreach (var r in rows) items.Add(new KeyValuePair<string, string>(r.Label, r.Value));
        host.ItemsSource = items;

        await dlg.ShowDialog(owner);
    }

    private void OnClose(object? sender, RoutedEventArgs e) => Close();
}
```

```cs
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Avalonia;
using Avalonia.Controls;
using Avalonia.Input;
using Avalonia.Interactivity;
using Avalonia.Markup.Xaml;
using Avalonia.Media;
using Avalonia.Media.Imaging;
using SkiaSharp;

namespace DashFile.Views;

/// <summary>通用只读查看器：文本/十六进制报告、图片、字体预览。</summary>
public partial class FileViewerWindow : Window
{
    public FileViewerWindow()
    {
        AvaloniaXamlLoader.Load(this);
        DashFile.Controls.ViewAnimator.AttachWindow(this);
        Opened += (_, _) => WindowPlacement.ClampToWorkingArea(this);
        KeyDown += (_, e) => { if (e.Key == Key.Escape) Close(); };
    }

    public static async Task ShowTextAsync(Window owner, string title, string text)
    {
        var w = new FileViewerWindow { Title = title };
        w.FindControl<TextBlock>("PathText")!.Text = title;
        w.FindControl<TextBox>("Output")!.Text = text;
        await w.ShowDialog(owner);
    }

    public static async Task ShowImageAsync(Window owner, string title, byte[] bytes, bool ninePatch = false)
    {
        var w = new FileViewerWindow { Title = title };
        w.FindControl<TextBlock>("PathText")!.Text = title;
        w.FindControl<TextBox>("Output")!.IsVisible = false;
        w.FindControl<ScrollViewer>("ImageScroll")!.IsVisible = true;

        Bitmap bmp;
        try
        {
            // 解码是同步的，Bitmap 自己留一份像素，所以流可以立刻释放
            using var ms = new MemoryStream(bytes);
#pragma warning disable CA2000 // 位图交给窗口里的 Image 显示，所有权转移，这里不能 Dispose
            bmp = new Bitmap(ms);
#pragma warning restore CA2000
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            w.FindControl<TextBox>("Output")!.IsVisible = true;
            w.FindControl<TextBox>("Output")!.Text = "无法解码为图片：" + ex.Message;
            await w.ShowDialog(owner);
            return;
        }

        var canvas = w.FindControl<Canvas>("ImageCanvas")!;
        canvas.Width = bmp.PixelSize.Width;
        canvas.Height = bmp.PixelSize.Height;

        var img = new Image { Source = bmp, Stretch = Stretch.None, Width = bmp.PixelSize.Width, Height = bmp.PixelSize.Height };
        Canvas.SetLeft(img, 0); Canvas.SetTop(img, 0);
        canvas.Children.Add(img);

        if (ninePatch) AddNinePatchGuides(canvas, bytes, bmp.PixelSize.Width, bmp.PixelSize.Height);

        await w.ShowDialog(owner);
        bmp.Dispose();
    }

    /// <summary>点九预览：从 PNG 边框的黑色像素推导可拉伸区域，画参考线。</summary>
    private static void AddNinePatchGuides(Canvas canvas, byte[] png, int w, int h)
    {
        try
        {
            using var src = SKBitmap.Decode(png);
            if (src == null || src.Width < 3 || src.Height < 3) return;
            var brush = new SolidColorBrush(Color.Parse("#7FE3FF"));
            void VLine(int x) => canvas.Children.Add(new Avalonia.Controls.Shapes.Line
            {
                StartPoint = new Point(x + 0.5, 0), EndPoint = new Point(x + 0.5, h),
                Stroke = brush, StrokeThickness = 1,
                StrokeDashArray = new Avalonia.Collections.AvaloniaList<double> { 4, 3 },
            });
            void HLine(int y) => canvas.Children.Add(new Avalonia.Controls.Shapes.Line
            {
                StartPoint = new Point(0, y + 0.5), EndPoint = new Point(w, y + 0.5),
                Stroke = brush, StrokeThickness = 1,
                StrokeDashArray = new Avalonia.Collections.AvaloniaList<double> { 4, 3 },
            });

            for (var x = 1; x < w - 1; x++)
            {
                var c = src.GetPixel(x, 0);
                if (c.Red < 8 && c.Green < 8 && c.Blue < 8 && c.Alpha > 200) VLine(x);
            }
            for (var y = 1; y < h - 1; y++)
            {
                var c = src.GetPixel(0, y);
                if (c.Red < 8 && c.Green < 8 && c.Blue < 8 && c.Alpha > 200) HLine(y);
            }
        }
        catch { }
    }

    /// <summary>字体预览：用 SkiaSharp 渲染几种字号。</summary>
    public static async Task ShowFontAsync(Window owner, string title, byte[] fontBytes)
    {
        byte[] png;
        try { png = RenderFont(fontBytes); }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            await ShowTextAsync(owner, title, "无法解析字体：" + ex.Message);
            return;
        }
        await ShowImageAsync(owner, title, png);
    }

    private static byte[] RenderFont(byte[] fontBytes)
    {
        using var fontData = SKData.CreateCopy(fontBytes);
        using var typeface = SKTypeface.FromData(fontData)
                             ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("不是可识别的字体文件");
        const int width = 900, height = 560;
        using var surface = SKSurface.Create(new SKImageInfo(width, height, SKColorType.Rgba8888, SKAlphaType.Premul));
        var canvas = surface.Canvas;
        canvas.Clear(new SKColor(18, 18, 22));
        using var paint = new SKPaint { Color = new SKColor(232, 232, 238), IsAntialias = true, Typeface = typeface };
        var samples = new[] { "DashFile 字体预览", "abcdefg 0123456789", "中文样式：安卓文件管理器", "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog" };
        var y = 70f;
        foreach (var size in new[] { 48f, 34f, 26f, 20f, 14f })
        {
            paint.TextSize = size;
            foreach (var s in samples)
            {
                canvas.DrawText(s, 32, y, paint);
                y += size + 14;
                if (y > height - 30) break;
            }
            y += 12;
            if (y > height - 30) break;
        }
        using var image = surface.Snapshot();
        using var data = image.Encode(SKEncodedImageFormat.Png, 100);
        return data.ToArray();
    }

    private void OnClose(object? sender, RoutedEventArgs e) => Close();
}
```

`src/Views/FolderPickerDialog.axaml.cs`:

```cs
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Collections.ObjectModel;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Avalonia.Controls;
using Avalonia.Interactivity;
using Avalonia.Markup.Xaml;
using DashFile.Services;

namespace DashFile.Views;

/// <summary>
/// 设备端目录选择器（用于"保存到手机"）。
/// dirLoader 负责列目录，返回子目录名列表。
/// </summary>
public partial class FolderPickerDialog : Window
{
    private readonly ObservableCollection<string> _dirs = new();
    private Func<string, Task<List<string>>>? _loader;
    private string _path = DevicePaths.Sdcard;

    public string? Result { get; private set; }

    public FolderPickerDialog()
    {
        AvaloniaXamlLoader.Load(this);
        DashFile.Controls.ViewAnimator.AttachWindow(this);
    }

    public static async Task<string?> ShowAsync(Window owner, string title, string startPath,
        Func<string, Task<List<string>>> dirLoader)
    {
        var dlg = new FolderPickerDialog();
        dlg.FindControl<TextBlock>("TitleText")!.Text = title;
        dlg._loader = dirLoader;
        dlg._path = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(startPath) ? DevicePaths.Sdcard : startPath;
        var list = dlg.FindControl<ListBox>("DirsList")!;
        list.ItemsSource = dlg._dirs;
        await dlg.LoadAsync(dlg._path);
        await dlg.ShowDialog(owner);
        return dlg.Result;
    }

    private async Task LoadAsync(string path)
    {
        if (_loader == null) return;
        _path = path;
        this.FindControl<TextBox>("PathBox")!.Text = path;
        _dirs.Clear();
        try
        {
            var list = await _loader(path);
            foreach (var d in list) _dirs.Add(d);
        }
        catch { }
    }

    private async void OnUp(object? sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        var p = _path.TrimEnd('/');
        var i = p.LastIndexOf('/');
        var parent = i <= 0 ? "/" : p[..i];
        await LoadAsync(parent);
    }

    private async void OnDirDoubleTap(object? sender, Avalonia.Input.TappedEventArgs e)
    {
        var sel = this.FindControl<ListBox>("DirsList")!.SelectedItem as string;
        if (sel == null) return;
        var next = _path == "/" ? "/" + sel : _path.TrimEnd('/') + "/" + sel;
        await LoadAsync(next);
    }

    private void OnConfirm(object? sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        Result = _path;
        Close();
    }

    private void OnCancel(object? sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        Result = null;
        Close();
    }

    public string CurrentPath => _path;
}
```

`src/Views/InputDialog.axaml.cs`:

```cs
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Avalonia.Controls;
using Avalonia.Interactivity;
using Avalonia.Markup.Xaml;

namespace DashFile.Views;

public partial class InputDialog : Window
{
    public InputDialog()
    {
        AvaloniaXamlLoader.Load(this);
        DashFile.Controls.ViewAnimator.AttachWindow(this);
    }

    public string? Result { get; private set; }

    public static async Task<string?> ShowAsync(Window owner, string title, string label, string initial = "")
    {
        var dlg = new InputDialog { Title = title };
        dlg.FindControl<TextBlock>("TitleText")!.Text = title;
        dlg.FindControl<TextBlock>("LabelText")!.Text = label;
        var box = dlg.FindControl<TextBox>("Input")!;
        box.Text = initial;
        box.SelectAll();
        box.AttachedToVisualTree += (_, _) => box.Focus();
        var r = await dlg.ShowDialog<string?>(owner);
        return r;
    }

    private void OnOk(object? sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        var text = this.FindControl<TextBox>("Input")!.Text ?? "";
        Result = text.Trim();
        Close(Result);
    }

    private void OnCancel(object? sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        Close(null);
    }
}
```

`src/Views/MainWindow.axaml.cs`:

```cs
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.IO;
using System.IO.Compression;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Avalonia;
using Avalonia.Controls;
using Avalonia.Controls.Primitives;
using Avalonia.Controls.Templates;
using Avalonia.VisualTree;
using Avalonia.Input;
using Avalonia.Interactivity;
using Avalonia.Markup.Xaml;
using Avalonia.Media;
using Avalonia.Threading;
using Avalonia.Platform.Storage;
using DashFile.Models;
using DashFile.Controls;
using DashFile.PluginApi;
using DashFile.Services;
using DashFile.Services.Plugins;
using DashFile.Services.OpenWith;
using DashFile.ViewModels;

namespace DashFile.Views;

public partial class MainWindow : Window
{
    // 拖出：按下后移动超过阈值即开始拖
    private bool _dragArmed;
    private Point _pressPos;
    private PosixEntry? _pressEntry;


    // 长按 / 多选
    private DispatcherTimer? _holdTimer;
    private PosixEntry? _holdEntry;
    private PosixEntry? _pendingToggle;
    private bool _multiMode;
    private ListBoxItem? _hlItem;

    // 内部拖拽数据格式（行 -> 同目录文件夹）
    private const string InternalFormat = "dashfile/paths";

    // 右键落点
    private Point _rightPos;
    private ContextMenu? _ctx;

    private MainViewModel? _subscribedVm;
    private PropertyChangedEventHandler? _vmPropertyHandler;

    private void OnVmPropertyChanged(object? sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
    {
        switch (e.PropertyName)
        {
            case nameof(MainViewModel.SelectedTab):
                // 标签指示器现在由 SegmentedTabs 自己维护，这里只管页面内的行高亮
                Dispatcher.UIThread.Post(() => UpdateRowPill(false), DispatcherPriority.Loaded);
                // 树/行的高亮是在隐藏状态下构建时量不出位置的（Bounds=0），
                //   切回文件页后必须重新量一次，否则"当前目录"那块高亮会消失。
                RequestTreePill();
                break;
            case nameof(MainViewModel.AppMode): UpdateModePill(); break;
            case nameof(MainViewModel.CurrentPath): AnimateFileList(); break;
        }
    }

    private void OnClosedUnsubscribe(object? sender, EventArgs e)
    {
        var vm = _subscribedVm;
        _subscribedVm = null;
        if (vm == null) return;
        try { vm.TreeVisualChanged -= RequestTreePill; } catch { }
        if (_vmPropertyHandler != null)
        {
            try { vm.PropertyChanged -= _vmPropertyHandler; } catch { }
        }
        Closed -= OnClosedUnsubscribe;
    }

    public MainWindow()
    {
        AvaloniaXamlLoader.Load(this);
        Opened += async (_, _) =>
        {
            if (DataContext is MainViewModel vm)
            {
                // 两个订阅都要能解绑：以前是匿名 lambda，挂在 Vm 上一辈子（窗口关了也不放）
                _subscribedVm = vm;
                vm.TreeVisualChanged += RequestTreePill;
                _vmPropertyHandler ??= OnVmPropertyChanged;
                vm.PropertyChanged += _vmPropertyHandler;
                Closed += OnClosedUnsubscribe;

                MainViewModel.Perf("UI opened");
                await vm.InitializeAsync();
                MainViewModel.Perf("UI initialized");
                Dispatcher.UIThread.Post(() =>
                {
                    UpdateModePill();
                    UpdateTreePill();
                }, DispatcherPriority.Loaded);
            }
        };
        SizeChanged += (_, _) =>
        {
            UpdateTreePill();
            Dispatcher.UIThread.Post(() => UpdateRowPill(false), DispatcherPriority.Loaded);
        };
        _filePage = this.FindControl<Control>("FilePage");


        // 页面/浮层过场动画
        ViewAnimator.Attach(this.FindControl<Control>("DevPage"), 10, 210);
        ViewAnimator.Attach(this.FindControl<Control>("FilePage"), 10, 210);
        ViewAnimator.Attach(this.FindControl<Control>("ModPage"), 10, 210);
        ViewAnimator.Attach(this.FindControl<Control>("PluginPage"), 10, 210);
        ViewAnimator.Attach(this.FindControl<Control>("SetPage"), 10, 210);
        ViewAnimator.Attach(this.FindControl<Control>("ToastHost"), 12, 170);
        ViewAnimator.AttachWindow(this, 6, 220);

        // 上次的窗口尺寸放到 Opened 里还原：那里才拿得到当前屏幕的工作区，
        // 才能判断记下来的值是不是"满屏/最大化"留下的，见 RestoreWindowSize()。

        Closing += OnClosingCleanup;

        AddHandler(KeyDownEvent, OnWindowKeyDown, RoutingStrategies.Tunnel);

        // 插件页拖入安装：窗口级先接，避免页面级 Drop 收不到
        AddHandler(DragDrop.DragOverEvent, OnWindowDragOver, RoutingStrategies.Tunnel);
        AddHandler(DragDrop.DropEvent, OnWindowDrop, RoutingStrategies.Tunnel);

        // 启动卡顿探针（DASHFILE_PERF=1）：UI 线程被同步阻塞 >150ms 就记一笔，
        //   否则"刚打开卡一阵"只能靠猜。
        if (AppEnvironment.Perf)
        {
            var sw = System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.StartNew();
            var probe = new Avalonia.Threading.DispatcherTimer { Interval = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(80) };
            long last = -1;
            probe.Tick += (_, _) =>
            {
                var now = sw.ElapsedMilliseconds;
                if (last >= 0 && now - last > 150)
                    MainViewModel.Perf($"UI STALL {now - last}ms @{now}ms");
                last = now;
                if (now > 15000) probe.Stop();
            };
            probe.Start();
            MainViewModel.Perf("UI window-ctor");
        }
        Opened += (_, _) =>
        {
            RestoreWindowSize();      // 还原上次尺寸（满屏/最大化的值不复原）
            ClampToScreen();          // 换过显示器/分辨率后，保证窗口还在工作区内
            // 首次启动的引导页；勾过「以后不再显示」就不弹（见 WelcomeWindow.ShowOnceAsync）
            Dispatcher.UIThread.Post(() => { _ = WelcomeWindow.ShowOnceAsync(this); },
                                     DispatcherPriority.Background);
            UpdateSortGlyphs();
            HookDeviceNotifications();
            // 调试用：DASHFILE_DEBUG_DROPBAR=1 时直接显示"上传到当前目录"落点条
            if (string.Equals(Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("DASHFILE_DEBUG_DROPBAR"), "1", StringComparison.Ordinal))
                ShowUploadBar(true);
        };

        var tree = this.FindControl<ItemsControl>("DirTree");
        tree?.AddHandler(PointerPressedEvent, OnTreePointerPressed, RoutingStrategies.Tunnel);

        Dispatcher.UIThread.Post(() =>
        {
            var sv = Files.GetVisualDescendants().OfType<ScrollViewer>().FirstOrDefault();
            if (sv != null)
                sv.ScrollChanged += (_, _) =>
                {
                    _hoverEntry = null;
                    SetHoverBorder(null);
                    // 滑块在滚动内容里，天然跟随；只有容器刚实现/还没定位时才补一次
                    if (!_rowPillShown) UpdateRowPill(false);
                };
        }, DispatcherPriority.Loaded);

        var files = Files;
        files.AddHandler(PointerPressedEvent, OnFilesPointerPressed, RoutingStrategies.Tunnel);
        files.AddHandler(PointerReleasedEvent, OnFilesPointerReleased, RoutingStrategies.Tunnel);
        files.AddHandler(PointerMovedEvent, OnFilesPointerMoved, RoutingStrategies.Tunnel);

        // 悬停在窗口层统一跟踪：列表项按下/选中后可能拿到指针捕获，
        //   只挂在 FilesList 上会漏事件，表现为“点完选中，高亮停在原地”。
        AddHandler(PointerMovedEvent, OnWindowPointerMoved, RoutingStrategies.Tunnel);
        AddHandler(PointerExitedEvent, (_, _) => ClearFileHover(), RoutingStrategies.Tunnel);
        AddHandler(PointerCaptureLostEvent, (_, _) => ClearFileHover(), RoutingStrategies.Tunnel);

        // 应用行 / 模块卡片：右键追加插件动作
        var apps = this.FindControl<ListBox>("AppsList");
        apps?.AddHandler(PointerPressedEvent, OnAppsPointerPressed, RoutingStrategies.Tunnel);
        var modScroll = this.FindControl<ScrollViewer>("ModScroll");
        modScroll?.AddHandler(PointerPressedEvent, OnModulesPointerPressed, RoutingStrategies.Tunnel);
    }


    // ================= 插件安装 / 卸载 =================

    private async void OnPluginInstallClick(object? sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (Vm == null) return;
        var files = await StorageProvider.OpenFilePickerAsync(new FilePickerOpenOptions
        {
            Title = "选择 .dfp 插件包",
            AllowMultiple = true,
            FileTypeFilter = new[]
            {
                new FilePickerFileType("DashFile 插件包 (.dfp)") { Patterns = new[] { "*.dfp" } },
            },
        });
        if (files.Count == 0) return;
        await InstallDfpFilesAsync(files.Select(f => f.TryGetLocalPath()).Where(p => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(p)).Select(p => p!));
    }

    private async Task InstallDfpFilesAsync(IEnumerable<string> paths)
    {
        if (Vm == null) return;
        var list = paths.Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase).ToList();
        if (list.Count == 0) return;
        foreach (var path in list)
        {
            if (!string.Equals(Path.GetExtension(path), ".dfp", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                Vm.Toast("只接受 .dfp 插件包：" + Path.GetFileName(path));
                continue;
            }
            // 同一个 id 直接覆盖升级；管理器会先卸载旧版并保留回滚目录
            await Vm.InstallPluginPackageAsync(path, replaceExisting: true);
        }
    }

    private async void OnPluginUninstallClick(object? sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (Vm?.SelectedPlugin is not { } plugin) return;
        var choice = await ChoiceDialog.ShowAsync(this, "卸载插件",
            $"确定卸载「{plugin.Name}」？\n\n仅卸载会保留插件设置/缓存；卸载并删除数据会一并清理。",
            "仅卸载", "卸载并删除数据");
        if (choice == null) return;
        await Vm.UninstallPluginAsync(plugin, deleteData: choice == 1);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 从拖拽数据里取本机路径。Explorer 给的 DataObject 形态不止一种：
    /// 有时 GetFiles() 直接可用，有时要按 DataFormats.Files 取成 IStorageItem / string[]。
    /// 以前只用第一种，取不到就当成"不是文件"，表现就是拖进来毫无反应。
    /// </summary>
    private static List<string> DroppedLocalPaths(IDataObject data)
    {
        var list = new List<string>();

        void Add(IEnumerable<string?>? items)
        {
            if (items == null) return;
            foreach (var p in items)
                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(p) && !list.Contains(p!, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    list.Add(p!);
        }

        try { Add(data.GetFiles()?.Select(i => i.TryGetLocalPath())); } catch { }

        if (list.Count == 0)
        {
            try
            {
                if (data.Get(DataFormats.Files) is IEnumerable<IStorageItem> items)
                    Add(items.Select(i => i.TryGetLocalPath()));
            }
            catch { }
        }

        if (list.Count == 0)
        {
            try
            {
                if (data.Get(DataFormats.Files) is IEnumerable<string> strs) Add(strs);
            }
            catch { }
        }

        return list;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 插件页拖入安装走窗口级隧道路由：页面级 Drop 在部分环境下收不到（光标变了但松手没反应），
    /// 这里在最外层先接一次，只处理"当前在插件页 + 拖的是 .dfp"。
    /// </summary>
    private void OnWindowDragOver(object? sender, DragEventArgs e)
    {
        if (Vm?.IsPluginsTab != true) return;
        var paths = DroppedLocalPaths(e.Data);
        if (paths.Count == 0) return;
        var ok = paths.All(p => string.Equals(Path.GetExtension(p), ".dfp", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
        e.DragEffects = ok ? DragDropEffects.Copy : DragDropEffects.None;
        PluginDropHint.IsVisible = ok;
        e.Handled = true;
    }

    private async void OnWindowDrop(object? sender, DragEventArgs e)
    {
        if (Vm?.IsPluginsTab != true) return;
        var paths = DroppedLocalPaths(e.Data);
        if (paths.Count == 0)
        {
            // 有拖拽数据但取不到本机路径：记录下来，下次能直接看出是哪种形态
            AppLog.Add("PLUGIN DROP 无本机路径 files=" + e.Data.Contains(DataFormats.Files));
            Vm.Toast("没能读取拖入的文件路径，请改用「安装 .dfp」按钮");
            return;
        }

        e.Handled = true;
        PluginDropHint.IsVisible = false;
        AppLog.Add($"PLUGIN DROP {paths.Count} 项：{string.Join(",", paths.Select(Path.GetFileName))}");

        var dfp = paths.Where(p => string.Equals(Path.GetExtension(p), ".dfp", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)).ToList();
        if (dfp.Count == 0)
        {
            Vm.Toast("只接受 .dfp 插件包");
            return;
        }
        await InstallDfpFilesAsync(dfp);
    }

    private void OnPluginDragOver(object? sender, DragEventArgs e)
    {
        var paths = DroppedLocalPaths(e.Data);
        if (paths.Count == 0)
        {
            e.DragEffects = DragDropEffects.None;
            PluginDropHint.IsVisible = false;
            return;
        }

        var ok = paths.All(p => string.Equals(Path.GetExtension(p), ".dfp", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
        e.DragEffects = ok ? DragDropEffects.Copy : DragDropEffects.None;
        PluginDropHint.IsVisible = ok;
        e.Handled = true;
    }

    private void OnPluginDragLeave(object? sender, DragEventArgs e)
    {
        PluginDropHint.IsVisible = false;
    }

    private async void OnPluginDrop(object? sender, DragEventArgs e)
    {
        PluginDropHint.IsVisible = false;
        if (Vm == null) return;
        var paths = DroppedLocalPaths(e.Data);
        if (paths.Count == 0) return;
        e.Handled = true;
        await InstallDfpFilesAsync(paths);
    }

    // ================= 插件右键菜单 =================

    /// <summary>把插件注册的文件/应用/模块动作追加到现有右键菜单末尾。</summary>
    private void AppendPluginMenuItems(List<Control> items, PluginTargetKind kind, PluginTarget target)
    {
        if (Vm == null) return;
        var actions = Vm.GetPluginActions(kind);
        if (actions.Count == 0) return;

        if (items.Count > 0 && items[^1] is not Separator) items.Add(new Separator());

        var byPlugin = actions.GroupBy(a => a.Plugin.Id, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase).ToList();

        MenuItem ActionItem(PluginActionBinding binding)
        {
            var mi = new MenuItem
            {
                Header = binding.Action.Title,
                Icon = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(binding.Action.Icon)
                    ? MenuIcons.CreatePath(binding.Action.Icon)
                    : MenuIcons.Create("plugin"),
                IsEnabled = CanRunPluginAction(binding, target),
            };
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(binding.Action.Description))
                Avalonia.Controls.ToolTip.SetTip(mi, binding.Action.Description);
            mi.Click += async (_, _) =>
            {
                if (Vm != null) await Vm.ExecutePluginActionAsync(binding, target);
            };
            return mi;
        }

        // 一律挂在"插件"子菜单下：鼠标悬停展开，插件加的功能都收在这里，不往主菜单里散。
        var root = MenuIcons.Item("插件", "plugin");
        var children = new List<Control>();
        if (byPlugin.Count == 1)
        {
            foreach (var binding in byPlugin[0]) children.Add(ActionItem(binding));
        }
        else
        {
            foreach (var group in byPlugin)
            {
                var pluginMenu = MenuIcons.Item(group.First().Plugin.Name, "plugin");
                var actionsInPlugin = new List<Control>();
                foreach (var binding in group) actionsInPlugin.Add(ActionItem(binding));
                pluginMenu.ItemsSource = actionsInPlugin;
                children.Add(pluginMenu);
            }
        }
        root.ItemsSource = children;
        items.Add(root);
    }

    private bool CanRunPluginAction(PluginActionBinding binding, PluginTarget target)
    {
        try { return binding.Action.CanExecute?.Invoke(target) ?? true; }
        catch { return false; }
    }

    private void OnAppsPointerPressed(object? sender, PointerPressedEventArgs e)
    {
        var list = this.FindControl<ListBox>("AppsList");
        if (list == null || Vm == null) return;
        var pt = e.GetCurrentPoint(list);
        if (!pt.Properties.IsRightButtonPressed) return;

        var item = (e.Source as Control)?.DataContext as AppItem;
        if (item == null) return;
        if (Vm.GetPluginActions(PluginTargetKind.App).Count == 0) return;

        list.SelectedItem = item;
        var items = new List<Control>();
        AppendPluginMenuItems(items, PluginTargetKind.App,
            PluginTarget.ForApp(item.Package, item.Label, item.ApkPath));
        while (items.Count > 0 && items[^1] is Separator) items.RemoveAt(items.Count - 1);
        if (items.Count == 0) return;

        var menu = MenuFor(list);
        menu.ItemsSource = items;
        menu.Open(list);
        e.Handled = true;
    }

    private void OnModulesPointerPressed(object? sender, PointerPressedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (Vm == null) return;
        var pt = e.GetCurrentPoint(this);
        if (!pt.Properties.IsRightButtonPressed) return;

        var item = (e.Source as Control)?.DataContext as ModuleInfo;
        if (item == null) return;
        if (Vm.GetPluginActions(PluginTargetKind.Module).Count == 0) return;

        var items = new List<Control>();
        AppendPluginMenuItems(items, PluginTargetKind.Module,
            PluginTarget.ForModule(item.Id, item.Name, item.Dir));
        while (items.Count > 0 && items[^1] is Separator) items.RemoveAt(items.Count - 1);
        if (items.Count == 0) return;

        var target = sender as Control ?? this;
        var menu = MenuFor(target);
        menu.ItemsSource = items;
        menu.Open(target);
        e.Handled = true;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 复用同一个 ContextMenu 实例：以前每次右键都 new 一个，连同十几个 MenuItem 和它们的闭包
    /// 一起挂着（菜单关闭后 ItemsSource 还握着整批控件），长时间用会一路涨句柄。
    /// 这里关旧菜单、清空 ItemsSource，再交给调用方塞新的一批。
    /// </summary>
    private ContextMenu MenuFor(Control target)
    {
        if (_ctx == null) _ctx = new ContextMenu();
        else
        {
            try { _ctx.Close(); } catch { }
            _ctx.ItemsSource = null;     // 放开上一批 MenuItem（连同其 Click 闭包）
        }
        _ctx.Placement = PlacementMode.Pointer;
        _ctx.PlacementTarget = target;
        return _ctx;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 还原上次关闭时的窗口尺寸，但只在"普通窗口"的范围内生效：
    /// 上次是最大化、或者尺寸贴满工作区（≥ 92%）时不还原，回落到 XAML 里的默认尺寸。
    /// 以前是把 Bounds 原样存下再原样套用，于是最大化过一次之后，之后每次启动都是满屏、再也回不去。
    /// </summary>
    private void RestoreWindowSize()
    {
        try
        {
            var st = AppSettings.Current;
            var w = st.WindowWidth;
            var h = st.WindowHeight;
            if (w < MinWidth || h < MinHeight) return;   // 没存过，或值不可信

            var screen = Screens.ScreenFromWindow(this) ?? Screens.Primary;
            if (screen != null)
            {
                var scale = screen.Scaling <= 0 ? 1.0 : screen.Scaling;
                var waW = screen.WorkingArea.Width / scale;
                var waH = screen.WorkingArea.Height / scale;
                if (w >= waW * 0.92 || h >= waH * 0.92) return;   // 满屏/最大化的残留值，不继承
                Width = Math.Min(w, waW);
                Height = Math.Min(h, waH);
            }
            else
            {
                Width = w;
                Height = h;
            }
        }
        catch { }
    }

    /// <summary>把窗口尺寸钳制到屏幕工作区内，并居中（避免超出屏幕被裁）</summary>
    private void ClampToScreen()
    {
        try
        {
            var screen = Screens.ScreenFromWindow(this) ?? Screens.Primary;
            if (screen == null) return;
            var scale = screen.Scaling <= 0 ? 1.0 : screen.Scaling;
            var waW = screen.WorkingArea.Width / scale;
            var waH = screen.WorkingArea.Height / scale;
            Width = Math.Min(Width, waW - 8);
            Height = Math.Min(Height, waH - 8);
            Position = new PixelPoint(
                screen.WorkingArea.X + (int)((screen.WorkingArea.Width - Width * scale) / 2),
                screen.WorkingArea.Y + (int)((screen.WorkingArea.Height - Height * scale) / 2));
        }
        catch { }
    }

    private List<PosixEntry> SelectedEntries()
        => Files.SelectedItems?.OfType<PosixEntry>().ToList() ?? new List<PosixEntry>();
```
