`src/Views/ModuleInstallWindow.axaml.cs`:

```cs
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Avalonia.Controls;
using Avalonia.Interactivity;
using Avalonia.Markup.Xaml;
using Avalonia.Threading;

namespace DashFile.Views;

public partial class ModuleInstallWindow : Window
{
    private Func<Action<string>, CancellationToken, Task>? _job;
    private Func<int, Task>? _sendKey;

    /// <summary>中止信号：关窗时取消，安装流程（上传/ksud 执行）会带着它退出</summary>
    private readonly CancellationTokenSource _cts = new();
    private bool _finished;

    public ModuleInstallWindow()
    {
        AvaloniaXamlLoader.Load(this);
        DashFile.Controls.ViewAnimator.AttachWindow(this);
        Closing += OnClosingWhileRunning;
        Closed += (_, _) => { try { _cts.Dispose(); } catch { } };
    }

    public static async Task ShowAsync(Window owner, string fileName,
        Func<Action<string>, CancellationToken, Task> job, Func<int, Task> sendKey)
    {
        var w = new ModuleInstallWindow { Title = "刷入模块 · " + fileName };
        w._job = job;
        w._sendKey = sendKey;
        w.FindControl<TextBlock>("FileText")!.Text = fileName;
        w.Opened += async (_, _) => await w.RunAsync();
        await w.ShowDialog(owner);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 以前这个窗口可以随时被关掉，而安装 job 还在跑；外层是 foreach 刷多个模块，
    ///   用户关掉窗口后下一个 adb install 立刻开始 —— 两个安装抢同一台设备。
    ///   现在关窗 = 取消，而且要等 job 真的结束才关（带兜底超时，绝不能把窗口卡死）。
    /// </summary>
    private async void OnClosingWhileRunning(object? sender, WindowClosingEventArgs e)
    {
        if (_finished) return;

        e.Cancel = true;
        var state = this.FindControl<TextBlock>("StateText");
        if (state != null) state.Text = "正在中止安装…";
        try { _cts.Cancel(); } catch { }

        // 给安装流程一点时间退出；超时就直接放行，避免用户关不掉窗口
        for (var i = 0; i < 40 && !_finished; i++) await Task.Delay(100);
        _finished = true;
        Close();
    }

    private void Append(string line)
        => Dispatcher.UIThread.Post(() =>
        {
            var box = this.FindControl<TextBox>("LogBox")!;
            box.Text = (box.Text ?? "") + line + "\n";
            box.CaretIndex = box.Text.Length;
        });

    private async Task RunAsync()
    {
        var state = this.FindControl<TextBlock>("StateText")!;
        var close = this.FindControl<Button>("CloseBtn")!;
        state.Text = "正在安装…";
        try
        {
            if (_job != null) await _job(Append, _cts.Token);
            state.Text = _cts.IsCancellationRequested ? "已中止安装" : "安装流程已结束";
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException)
        {
            Append("× 已中止");
            state.Text = "已中止安装";
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Append("执行异常：" + ex.Message);
            state.Text = "执行异常";
        }
        finally
        {
            _finished = true;
            close.IsEnabled = true;
        }
    }

    private async void OnVolDown(object? sender, RoutedEventArgs e) { if (_sendKey != null) await _sendKey(25); Append("· 已发送 音量-"); }
    private async void OnVolUp(object? sender, RoutedEventArgs e) { if (_sendKey != null) await _sendKey(24); Append("· 已发送 音量+"); }
    private async void OnPower(object? sender, RoutedEventArgs e) { if (_sendKey != null) await _sendKey(26); Append("· 已发送 电源"); }

    private void OnClose(object? sender, RoutedEventArgs e) => Close();
}

`src/Views/PermissionDialog.axaml.cs`:

```cs
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Avalonia.Controls;
using Avalonia.Interactivity;
using Avalonia.Markup.Xaml;

namespace DashFile.Views;

public partial class PermissionDialog : Window
{
    private bool _loading;

    public PermissionDialog()
    {
        AvaloniaXamlLoader.Load(this);
        DashFile.Controls.ViewAnimator.AttachWindow(this);
    }

    public string Result { get; private set; } = "644";

    public static async Task<string?> ShowAsync(Window owner, string path, string currentOctal)
    {
        var dlg = new PermissionDialog { Title = "权限" };
        dlg.FindControl<TextBlock>("PathText")!.Text = path;
        dlg.ApplyOctal(currentOctal);
        return await dlg.ShowDialog<string?>(owner);
    }

    private CheckBox C(string n) => this.FindControl<CheckBox>(n)!;

    private void ApplyOctal(string octal)
    {
        _loading = true;
        try
        {
            var s = (octal ?? "644").Trim();
            if (s.Length == 3) s = "0" + s;
            while (s.Length < 4) s = "0" + s;

            int su = s[0] - '0', u = s[1] - '0', g = s[2] - '0', o = s[3] - '0';
            SetTriplet(u, "U_R", "U_W", "U_X");
            SetTriplet(g, "G_R", "G_W", "G_X");
            SetTriplet(o, "O_R", "O_W", "O_X");
            C("SetUid").IsChecked = (su & 4) != 0;
            C("SetGid").IsChecked = (su & 2) != 0;
            C("Sticky").IsChecked = (su & 1) != 0;
            Refresh();
        }
        finally
        {
            _loading = false;
        }
    }

    private void SetTriplet(int v, string r, string w, string x)
    {
        C(r).IsChecked = (v & 4) != 0;
        C(w).IsChecked = (v & 2) != 0;
        C(x).IsChecked = (v & 1) != 0;
    }

    private int Triplet(string r, string w, string x)
        => (C(r).IsChecked == true ? 4 : 0) + (C(w).IsChecked == true ? 2 : 0) + (C(x).IsChecked == true ? 1 : 0);

    private string BuildOctal()
    {
        int su = (C("SetUid").IsChecked == true ? 4 : 0) + (C("SetGid").IsChecked == true ? 2 : 0) + (C("Sticky").IsChecked == true ? 1 : 0);
        int u = Triplet("U_R", "U_W", "U_X");
        int g = Triplet("G_R", "G_W", "G_X");
        int o = Triplet("O_R", "O_W", "O_X");
        return su > 0 ? $"{su}{u}{g}{o}" : $"{u}{g}{o}";
    }

    private string BuildSymbolic()
    {
        string t(string r, string w, string x, bool su, bool sg, bool st)
        {
            var rd = C(r).IsChecked == true ? 'r' : '-';
            var wr = C(w).IsChecked == true ? 'w' : '-';
            var ex = C(x).IsChecked == true ? 'x' : '-';
            if (su) ex = C(x).IsChecked == true ? 's' : 'S';
            if (st) ex = C(x).IsChecked == true ? 't' : 'T';
            return $"{rd}{wr}{ex}";
        }
        return t("U_R","U_W","U_X", C("SetUid").IsChecked==true, false, false)
             + t("G_R","G_W","G_X", false, C("SetGid").IsChecked==true, false)
             + t("O_R","O_W","O_X", false, false, C("Sticky").IsChecked==true);
    }

    private void Refresh()
    {
        Result = BuildOctal();
        this.FindControl<TextBlock>("OctalText")!.Text = $"{BuildSymbolic()}({Result})";
    }

    private void OnAnyClick(object? sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (_loading) return;
        Refresh();
    }

    private void OnQuick(object? sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (sender is Button b && b.Tag is string s) ApplyOctal(s);
    }

    private void OnOk(object? sender, RoutedEventArgs e) => Close(Result);
    private void OnCancel(object? sender, RoutedEventArgs e) => Close(null);
}

```cs
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Avalonia.Controls;
using Avalonia.Interactivity;
using Avalonia.Markup.Xaml;
using Avalonia.Media;
using DashFile.Models;

namespace DashFile.Views;

public partial class PropertyDialog : Window
{
    public PropertyDialog()
    {
        AvaloniaXamlLoader.Load(this);
        DashFile.Controls.ViewAnimator.AttachWindow(this);
    }

    public static async Task ShowAsync(Window owner, PosixEntry e)
    {
        var dlg = new PropertyDialog { Title = "属性 - " + e.Name };
        dlg.GetControlT<TextBlock>("NameText").Text = e.Name;
        dlg.GetControlT<TextBlock>("PathText").Text = e.FullPath;
        dlg.GetControlT<TextBlock>("IconGlyph").Text = e.IsDir ? "📁" : (e.IsLink ? "🔗" : "📄");

        var grid = dlg.GetControlT<Grid>("InfoGrid");
        var rows = new (string Label, string Value, bool Mono)[]
        {
            ("名称",         e.Name,                    false),
            ("目录类型",     e.TypeText + "（" + e.Kind + "）", false),
            ("大小",         e.SizeFull,                false),
            ("修改时间",     e.ModifiedText,            false),
            ("权限",         e.Perms + "  (" + e.ModeOctal + ")", true),
            ("所有者",       e.Owner,                   true),
            ("用户组",       e.Group,                   true),
            ("SELinux 上下文", e.Selinux == "" ? "（无）" : e.Selinux, true),
        };

        grid.RowDefinitions.Clear();
        for (int i = 0; i < rows.Length; i++) grid.RowDefinitions.Add(new RowDefinition(GridLength.Auto));

        for (int i = 0; i < rows.Length; i++)
        {
            var lbl = new TextBlock
            {
                Text = rows[i].Label,
                FontSize = 12,
                Foreground = (IBrush?)dlg.FindResource("TextMuted") ?? Brushes.Gray,
                VerticalAlignment = Avalonia.Layout.VerticalAlignment.Center,
            };
            var val = new TextBlock
            {
                Text = rows[i].Value,
                FontSize = 12.5,
                Foreground = (IBrush?)dlg.FindResource("TextMain") ?? Brushes.White,
                TextWrapping = TextWrapping.Wrap,
                VerticalAlignment = Avalonia.Layout.VerticalAlignment.Center,
            };
            if (rows[i].Mono) val.FontFamily = new FontFamily("Consolas, Cascadia Mono, monospace");

            Grid.SetRow(lbl, i); Grid.SetColumn(lbl, 0); grid.Children.Add(lbl);
            Grid.SetRow(val, i); Grid.SetColumn(val, 1); grid.Children.Add(val);
        }

        await dlg.ShowDialog(owner);
    }

    private T GetControlT<T>(string name) where T : Control => this.FindControl<T>(name)!;

    private void OnClose(object? sender, RoutedEventArgs e) => Close();
}

`src/Views/RunDialog.axaml.cs`:

```cs
using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Avalonia.Controls;
using Avalonia.Interactivity;
using Avalonia.Markup.Xaml;

namespace DashFile.Views;

public partial class RunDialog : Window
{
    private Func<string, bool, Task<string>>? _exec;
    private Func<int, Task>? _sendKey;
    private string _filePath = "";

    public RunDialog()
    {
        AvaloniaXamlLoader.Load(this);
        DashFile.Controls.ViewAnimator.AttachWindow(this);
        Opened += (_, _) => WindowPlacement.ClampToWorkingArea(this);
    }

    public static async Task ShowAsync(Window owner, string filePath, string initialCommand,
        bool canRoot, bool defaultRoot, Func<string, bool, Task<string>> exec,
        Func<int, Task>? sendKey = null)
    {
        var dlg = new RunDialog();
        dlg._exec = exec;
        dlg._sendKey = sendKey;
        dlg._filePath = filePath;
        dlg.GetControlC<TextBox>("CmdBox").Text = initialCommand;
        var root = dlg.GetControlC<CheckBox>("UseRootBox");
        root.IsChecked = canRoot && defaultRoot;
        root.IsEnabled = canRoot;
        await dlg.ShowDialog(owner);
    }

    private T GetControlC<T>(string name) where T : Control => this.FindControl<T>(name)!;

    private void OnFillSh(object? sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_filePath)) return;
        GetControlC<TextBox>("CmdBox").Text = "sh " + Quote(_filePath);
    }

    private void OnFillLs(object? sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        => GetControlC<TextBox>("CmdBox").Text = "ls -lZ .";

    private void OnFillPerm(object? sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_filePath)) return;
        GetControlC<TextBox>("CmdBox").Text = "ls -lZ " + Quote(_filePath);
    }

    private void OnClear(object? sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        => GetControlC<TextBox>("OutBox").Text = "";

    private async void OnVolDown(object? sender, RoutedEventArgs e) => await SendKeyAsync(25, "音量−");
    private async void OnVolUp(object? sender, RoutedEventArgs e) => await SendKeyAsync(24, "音量＋");
    private async void OnPower(object? sender, RoutedEventArgs e) => await SendKeyAsync(26, "电源");

    private async Task SendKeyAsync(int code, string label)
    {
        if (_sendKey == null) return;
        try
        {
            await _sendKey(code);
            GetControlC<TextBox>("OutBox").Text += "· 已发送 " + label + Environment.NewLine;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            GetControlC<TextBox>("OutBox").Text += "· 发送失败：" + ex.Message + Environment.NewLine;
        }
    }

    private static string Quote(string s) => "\"" + s.Replace("\"", "\\\"") + "\"";

    private async void OnRun(object? sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (_exec == null) return;
        var cmd = GetControlC<TextBox>("CmdBox").Text ?? "";
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(cmd)) return;

        var useRoot = GetControlC<CheckBox>("UseRootBox").IsChecked == true;
        var btn = GetControlC<Button>("RunBtn");
        var state = GetControlC<TextBlock>("StateText");
        var outBox = GetControlC<TextBox>("OutBox");

        btn.IsEnabled = false;
        state.Text = useRoot ? "正在以 root 执行…" : "正在以普通权限执行…";
        outBox.Text = (outBox.Text ?? "") + "\n$ " + cmd + "\n";

        try
        {
            var result = await _exec(cmd, useRoot);
            outBox.Text += result;
            state.Text = "执行完成";
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            outBox.Text += "执行出错：" + ex.Message;
            state.Text = "执行出错";
        }
        finally
        {
            btn.IsEnabled = true;
            outBox.CaretIndex = outBox.Text?.Length ?? 0;
        }
    }

    private void OnClose(object? sender, RoutedEventArgs e) => Close();
}

```cs
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Avalonia.Controls;
using Avalonia.Interactivity;
using Avalonia.Markup.Xaml;
using DashFile.Services;

namespace DashFile.Views;

/// <summary>
/// 首次启动的引导页：USB 调试怎么开、有 root 时给 shell 放行、作者署名提示。
/// 底部「以后不再显示」默认不勾，勾了并关闭才写永久标识（AppSettings.WelcomeHidden）。
/// </summary>
public partial class WelcomeWindow : Window
{
    public WelcomeWindow()
    {
        AvaloniaXamlLoader.Load(this);
        DashFile.Controls.ViewAnimator.AttachWindow(this);
        var ver = this.FindControl<TextBlock>("VerText");
        if (ver != null) ver.Text = "v" + AppInfo.Version;
        Opened += (_, _) => WindowPlacement.ClampToWorkingArea(this);
    }

    /// <summary>没勾过「不再显示」才弹；已经勾过就直接返回，不打扰。</summary>
    public static async Task ShowOnceAsync(Window owner)
    {
        try
        {
            if (AppSettings.Current.WelcomeHidden) return;
            await new WelcomeWindow().ShowDialog(owner);
        }
        catch { }
    }

    private void OnOk(object? sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        try
        {
            if (this.FindControl<CheckBox>("DontShowBox")?.IsChecked == true)
            {
                var st = AppSettings.Current;
                st.WelcomeHidden = true;
                AppSettings.Save();
            }
        }
        catch { }
        Close();
    }
}

`src/Views/WindowPlacement.cs`:

```cs
using System;
using Avalonia;
using Avalonia.Controls;

namespace DashFile.Views;

/// <summary>把窗口钳制到当前屏幕的工作区，避免居中到超宽窗体后跑到屏幕外。</summary>
internal static class WindowPlacement
{
    public static void ClampToWorkingArea(Window w)
    {
        try
        {
            var screen = w.Screens.ScreenFromWindow(w) ?? w.Screens.Primary;
            if (screen == null) return;
            var scale = screen.Scaling <= 0 ? 1.0 : screen.Scaling;
            var wa = screen.WorkingArea;
            var wPx = (int)Math.Round(w.Bounds.Width * scale);
            var hPx = (int)Math.Round(w.Bounds.Height * scale);
            var x = w.Position.X;
            var y = w.Position.Y;
            var maxX = wa.X + wa.Width - wPx;
            var maxY = wa.Y + wa.Height - hPx;
            if (x > maxX) x = maxX;
            if (y > maxY) y = maxY;
            if (x < wa.X) x = wa.X;
            if (y < wa.Y) y = wa.Y;
            w.Position = new PixelPoint(x, y);
        }
        catch { }
    }
}

using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Reflection;
using System.Text;
using DashFile.Services;

var fail = 0;
void Check(string name, bool ok, string detail = "")
{
    Console.WriteLine((ok ? "PASS " : "FAIL ") + name + (detail.Length > 0 ? "  [" + detail + "]" : ""));
    if (!ok) fail++;
}

// ---------- 1) SVG pathData 死循环 ----------
var sw = Stopwatch.StartNew();
var p = DashFile.Services.SvgPathParser.Parse("M0 0z5");
sw.Stop();
Check("svg 'M0 0z5' 在 1.5s 内返回", sw.ElapsedMilliseconds < 1500, sw.ElapsedMilliseconds + "ms");
Check("svg 'M0 0z5' 仍产出路径", p != null && p.PointCount >= 1, p == null ? "null" : "pts=" + p.PointCount);

sw.Restart();
var p2 = DashFile.Services.SvgPathParser.Parse("M10 10 L20 20 Z");
sw.Stop();
Check("svg 正常路径", p2 != null && sw.ElapsedMilliseconds < 500, sw.ElapsedMilliseconds + "ms");

sw.Restart();
var p3 = DashFile.Services.SvgPathParser.Parse("M0 0 Z Z Z Z 5 6 7 garbage $$$ 8");
sw.Stop();
Check("svg 尾部垃圾不死循环", sw.ElapsedMilliseconds < 1500, sw.ElapsedMilliseconds + "ms");

var suType = asm.GetType("DashFile.Services.SuperuserService")!;
var layoutType = suType.GetNestedType("Layout", BindingFlags.NonPublic)!;
var detect = suType.GetMethod("DetectLayout", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance)!;

object Probe(byte[] bytes, string variant)
{
    var fsType = asm.GetType("DashFile.Services.RemoteFileSystem")!;
    var adbType = asm.GetType("DashFile.Services.AdbRunner")!;
    var adb = Activator.CreateInstance(adbType, "adb.exe")!;
    var fs = Activator.CreateInstance(fsType, adb, "SERIAL", true)!;
    var svc = Activator.CreateInstance(suType, fs, variant)!;
    return detect.Invoke(svc, new object[] { bytes })!;
}

string Describe(object layout)
{
    if (layout == null) return "null";
    string F(string n) => layoutType.GetProperty(n)!.GetValue(layout)!.ToString()!;
    return "header=" + F("HeaderLen") + " record=" + F("RecordLen") + " pkgOff=" + F("PackageOffset") + " count=" + F("Count");
}

// 新版：头 8 + 记录 784（前 4 字节前缀），1 条记录 -> 总长 792，与老版同长
var rec = new byte[784];
BitConverter.GetBytes(1).CopyTo(rec, 0);
Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("com.test.app").CopyTo(rec, 4);
BitConverter.GetBytes(10123).CopyTo(rec, 4 + 256);
BitConverter.GetBytes(1).CopyTo(rec, 4 + 260);
var newFile = new byte[792];
Encoding.ASCII.GetBytes("USK").CopyTo(newFile, 0);
BitConverter.GetBytes(1).CopyTo(newFile, 4);
rec.CopyTo(newFile, 8);

var a = Describe(Probe(newFile, "KernelSU-Next"));
Check("新版单条表 + KernelSU-Next -> 8/784/4", a.Contains("header=8") && a.Contains("record=784") && a.Contains("pkgOff=4"), a);

var bdesc = Describe(Probe(newFile, "KernelSU"));
Check("同一份数据 + KernelSU -> 12/780/0（说明该布局确实有歧义）", bdesc.Contains("header=12") && bdesc.Contains("record=780"), bdesc);

System.Collections.IList EntryList(params object[] items)
{
    var list = (System.Collections.IList)Activator.CreateInstance(typeof(List<>).MakeGenericType(entryType))!;
    foreach (var i in items) list.Add(i);
    return list;
}
string PkgAt(byte[] buf, int off)
{
    var end = Array.IndexOf(buf, (byte)0, off, 256);
    return Encoding.UTF8.GetString(buf, off, (end < 0 ? 256 : end - off));
}

{
    var fsType2 = asm.GetType("DashFile.Services.RemoteFileSystem")!;

}

// ================= AXML 测试用的最小二进制 XML 建造器 =================

void WriteU16(List<byte> b, int v) { b.Add((byte)(v & 0xFF)); b.Add((byte)((v >> 8) & 0xFF)); }
void WriteU32(List<byte> b, uint v)
{
    b.Add((byte)(v & 0xFF)); b.Add((byte)((v >> 8) & 0xFF));
    b.Add((byte)((v >> 16) & 0xFF)); b.Add((byte)((v >> 24) & 0xFF));
}

byte[] BuildPool(List<string> strings)
{
    var pool = new List<byte>();
    var offsets = new List<int>();
    foreach (var s in strings)
    {
        offsets.Add(pool.Count);
        var bytes = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(s);
        var u16 = s.Length;
        if (u16 > 0x7F) { pool.Add((byte)(0x80 | (u16 >> 8))); pool.Add((byte)(u16 & 0xFF)); }
        else pool.Add((byte)u16);
        if (bytes.Length > 0x7F) { pool.Add((byte)(0x80 | (bytes.Length >> 8))); pool.Add((byte)(bytes.Length & 0xFF)); }
        else pool.Add((byte)bytes.Length);
        pool.AddRange(bytes);
        pool.Add(0);
    }

    var chunk = new List<byte>();
    int stringsStart = 28 + 4 * strings.Count;
    WriteU16(chunk, 0x0001); WriteU16(chunk, 28); WriteU32(chunk, (uint)(stringsStart + pool.Count));
    WriteU32(chunk, (uint)strings.Count); WriteU32(chunk, 0); WriteU32(chunk, 0x100);
    WriteU32(chunk, (uint)stringsStart); WriteU32(chunk, 0);
    foreach (var o in offsets) WriteU32(chunk, (uint)o);
    chunk.AddRange(pool);
    return chunk.ToArray();
}

int FindFirstChunk(byte[] buf, ushort type)
{
    int p = 8;
    while (p + 8 <= buf.Length)
    {
        int t = buf[p] | (buf[p + 1] << 8);
        int size = BitConverter.ToInt32(buf, p + 4);
        if (size <= 0) return -1;
        if (t == type) return p;
        p += size;
    }
    return -1;
}

byte[] BuildAxml()
{
    var strings = new List<string>
    {
        "manifest", "package", "com.demo.app", "versionCode", "application", "icon",
        "uses-permission", "name", "android.permission.CAMERA", "android.permission.INTERNET",
        "label", "演示应用", "android", "xmlns",
    };
    int Idx(string s) => strings.IndexOf(s);

    List<byte> Start(string name, params (string n, byte t, uint d)[] attrs)
    {
        var c = new List<byte>();
        WriteU16(c, 0x0102); WriteU16(c, 16); WriteU32(c, (uint)(16 + 20 + 20 * attrs.Length));
        WriteU32(c, 1); WriteU32(c, 0xFFFFFFFF);
        WriteU32(c, 0xFFFFFFFF); WriteU32(c, (uint)Idx(name));
        WriteU16(c, 20); WriteU16(c, 20); WriteU16(c, attrs.Length);
        WriteU16(c, 0); WriteU16(c, 0); WriteU16(c, 0);
        foreach (var a in attrs)
        {
            WriteU32(c, 0xFFFFFFFF); WriteU32(c, (uint)Idx(a.n)); WriteU32(c, 0xFFFFFFFF);
            WriteU16(c, 8); c.Add(0); c.Add(a.t); WriteU32(c, a.d);
        }
        return c;
    }

    List<byte> End(string name)
    {
        var c = new List<byte>();
        WriteU16(c, 0x0103); WriteU16(c, 16); WriteU32(c, 24);
        WriteU32(c, 1); WriteU32(c, 0xFFFFFFFF);
        WriteU32(c, 0xFFFFFFFF); WriteU32(c, (uint)Idx(name));
        return c;
    }

    var body = new List<byte>();
    body.AddRange(BuildPool(strings));
    body.AddRange(Start("manifest",
        ("xmlns", (byte)0x03, (uint)Idx("android")),
        ("package", (byte)0x03, (uint)Idx("com.demo.app")),
        ("versionCode", (byte)0x01, 7u)));
    body.AddRange(Start("application",
        ("icon", (byte)0x01, 0x7f0e0002u),
        ("label", (byte)0x03, (uint)Idx("演示应用"))));
    body.AddRange(Start("uses-permission", ("name", (byte)0x03, (uint)Idx("android.permission.CAMERA"))));
    body.AddRange(End("uses-permission"));
    body.AddRange(Start("uses-permission", ("name", (byte)0x03, (uint)Idx("android.permission.INTERNET"))));
    body.AddRange(End("uses-permission"));
    body.AddRange(End("application"));
    body.AddRange(End("manifest"));

    var file = new List<byte>();
    WriteU16(file, 0x0003); WriteU16(file, 8); WriteU32(file, (uint)(8 + body.Count));
    file.AddRange(body);
    return file.ToArray();
}

byte[] BuildDeepAxml(int depth)
{
    var strings = new List<string> { "a" };
    var body = new List<byte>();
    body.AddRange(BuildPool(strings));

    for (int i = 0; i < depth; i++)
    {
        var c = new List<byte>();
        WriteU16(c, 0x0102); WriteU16(c, 16); WriteU32(c, 36);
        WriteU32(c, 1); WriteU32(c, 0xFFFFFFFF);
        WriteU32(c, 0xFFFFFFFF); WriteU32(c, 0);
        WriteU16(c, 20); WriteU16(c, 20); WriteU16(c, 0);
        WriteU16(c, 0); WriteU16(c, 0); WriteU16(c, 0);
        body.AddRange(c);
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < depth; i++)
    {
        var c = new List<byte>();
        WriteU16(c, 0x0103); WriteU16(c, 16); WriteU32(c, 24);
        WriteU32(c, 1); WriteU32(c, 0xFFFFFFFF);
        WriteU32(c, 0xFFFFFFFF); WriteU32(c, 0);
        body.AddRange(c);
    }

    var file = new List<byte>();
    WriteU16(file, 0x0003); WriteU16(file, 8); WriteU32(file, (uint)(8 + body.Count));
    file.AddRange(body);
    return file.ToArray();
}

`tools/StringDump/Program.cs`:

```cs
using System.Reflection.Metadata;
using System.Reflection.Metadata.Ecma335;
using System.Reflection.PortableExecutable;

// 从程序集 IL 里把 ldstr 的用户字符串全部倒出来（附带所在类型/方法）。
// 用途：源码被编码事故损坏时，从"事故前编译好的 DLL"里找回原始文案。
// 用法：dotnet run -- <assembly.dll> [filterSubstring]

var path = args.Length > 0 ? args[0] : throw new ArgumentException("need assembly path");
var filter = args.Length > 1 ? args[1] : null;

using var stream = File.OpenRead(path);
using var pe = new PEReader(stream);
var reader = pe.GetMetadataReader();

var seen = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);

foreach (var th in reader.TypeDefinitions)
{
    var td = reader.GetTypeDefinition(th);
    var typeName = reader.GetString(td.Name);
    var ns = reader.GetString(td.Namespace);
    var fullType = string.IsNullOrEmpty(ns) ? typeName : ns + "." + typeName;

    foreach (var mh in td.GetMethods())
    {
        var md = reader.GetMethodDefinition(mh);
        if (md.RelativeVirtualAddress == 0) continue;

        var body = pe.GetMethodBody(md.RelativeVirtualAddress);
        var il = body.GetILContent();

        for (var i = 0; i + 4 < il.Length; i++)
        {
            if (il[i] != 0x72) continue;                        // ldstr
            var token = il[i + 1] | (il[i + 2] << 8) | (il[i + 3] << 16) | (il[i + 4] << 24);
            if ((token & unchecked((int)0xFF000000)) != 0x70000000) continue;

            string value;
            try
            {
                value = reader.GetUserString(MetadataTokens.UserStringHandle(token & 0x00FFFFFF));
            }
            catch
            {
                continue;
            }

            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value) || !seen.Add(value)) continue;
            if (filter != null && !value.Contains(filter, StringComparison.Ordinal) &&
                !fullType.Contains(filter, StringComparison.Ordinal)) continue;

            Console.WriteLine($"{fullType} :: {value.Replace("\r", "\\r").Replace("\n", "\\n")}");
        }
    }
}

```

`tools/StringDump/README.txt`:

```txt
StringDump：从编译好的 .NET 程序集里倒出字符串字面量。

用途：源码被编码事故/误操作破坏、又没有版本库时，用事故前的 DLL 找回界面文案。

用法：
  dotnet run --project tools/StringDump -- path/to/App.dll [过滤词]

原理：扫描每个方法体里的 IL `ldstr`，取 #US 堆里的用户字符串。

```

`tools/adb/README.md`:

```md
# tools/adb

本目录在本地构建时存放 **Android SDK Platform-Tools**（`adb.exe`、`fastboot.exe`、
`AdbWinApi.dll`、`AdbWinUsbApi.dll`）。这些二进制**不纳入版本库**（已在 `.gitignore` 中排除），
所以刚克隆下来的仓库里这里是空的——这是预期状态，不是文件丢失。

## 为什么不入库

- 平台工具是 Google 的第三方二进制，按 Apache-2.0 分发，体积约 10 MB，随本仓库的
  GPLv3 源码一起托管既无必要也不便于审计；
- 源码仓库只保留版本、来源与放置说明，二进制由发版流程从本机复制进发布包。

## 本地补齐（构建发布包前需要）

1. 下载官方 platform-tools：
   <https://developer.android.com/tools/releases/platform-tools>
2. 解压后把下面 4 个文件放到本目录：

   ```
   tools\adb\
     adb.exe
     AdbWinApi.dll
     AdbWinUsbApi.dll
     fastboot.exe
   ```

3. 校验版本一致后再发版：

   ```powershell
   .\tools\adb\adb.exe version
   .\tools\adb\fastboot.exe --version
   ```

## 发布时如何使用

`build\publish.ps1` 会读取本目录，把 `adb.exe`、`AdbWinApi.dll`、`AdbWinUsbApi.dll`
复制到产物的 `Binaries\Adb\`，把 `fastboot.exe` 复制到 `Binaries\Fastboot\`。
因此**源码仓库不含 adb，但用户下载的发布包开箱即用**，无需自行配置环境变量。

## 许可

platform-tools 版权归 The Android Open Source Project，按 Apache License 2.0 授权，
全文见 `licenses/Apache-2.0.txt`；来源与声明同时记录在 `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md`。
本仓库对其仅作原样再分发，未作修改。

```
